qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de aanpak van koperdiefstal

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about copper theft, including low arrest rates, registration of thefts by the KLPD, and delays on the railways. The government answered that arrest rates rose slightly, that registration is handled through agreed codes, and that the Actie Koperslag convenant progress report was sent to parliament.
In the first half of 2012, 13 suspects of copper theft (mainly on the railways) were arrested.
In de eerste helft van 2012 zijn 13 verdachten van koperdiefstal (vooral op het spoor) aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over ambulances op de vluchtstrook

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Health about ambulances using the hard shoulder, including why buses get exemptions while B-transport ambulances must queue and request permission per ride, and about a terminal cancer patient stuck in traffic. The minister referred to earlier answers, said the Amsterdam dispatch centre had no record of the incident, reported no signals of frequent refusals, and noted that existing rules already allow upgrading B-rides to A-rides, with the health minister to clarify scope with the ambulance association.
To give a substantively correct answer about the incident mentioned, it is important to have the date, time and possibly patient details and/or ride number.
Om inhoudelijk een correct antwoord te kunnen geven op het genoemde incident is het van belang om over datum, tijdstip en eventueel patiëntgegevens en/of ritnummer te beschikken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het convenant inzake de landelijk werkende instellingen

Two MPs asked whether the state secretary still supports the agreement giving national working institutions a transition period in the youth care reform, and how continuity of identity-based care is protected as some provinces plan to end funding from 1 January 2013. The state secretary reaffirms the agreement, notes provinces may phase out subsidies while statutory client choice and identity-based care rules are met, and says provinces assured careful handling.
Provinces are free to phase out subsidies to institutions, as long as they continue to meet the statutory obligations mentioned above.
Het staat provincies vrij subsidies aan instellingen af te bouwen, zolang zij aan wettelijke verplichtingen zoals hierboven genoemd blijven voldoen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over kinderrechten op Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked about children's rights on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including whether differential treatment and the lack of a coordinating minister meet the UN Convention and the Constitution. The State Secretary answered that the islands receive tailored policy, that ministries coordinate via departmental coordinators, and that more action is planned, but declined to pre-judge the forthcoming UNICEF report.

I do not yet wish to anticipate the possible content of this report, its recommendations, and the possible action I may or may not take, in cooperation with other responsible ministries and government services.

Ik wil nu nog niet vooruitlopen op de mogelijke inhoud van dit rapport, de aanbevelingen en de mogelijke actie die ik al dan niet in samenwerking met andere verantwoordelijke ministeries en overheidsdiensten zal nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over open data in het openbaar vervoer

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment about open data for public transport, including compliance with the reporting duty under the Besluit Personenvervoer 2000, licensing terms, the NDOV loket timeline and budget. The minister answered that operators supply static data and most supply real-time data, that no enforcement is needed because concession agreements cover data delivery, and that the NDOV criteria are a minimum requirement with budget largely unspent.
Since the decentralised authorities have agreed in their concessions on the supply of data, I see no need at this time to enforce the provisions of the Besluit personenvervoer.

Aangezien de decentrale overheden in hun concessies afspraken hebben gemaakt met betrekking tot levering van gegevens, zie ik geen noodzaak op dit moment tot handhaving van de bepalingen uit het Besluit personenvervoer over te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het weigeren van een verzekerde enkel op grond van Downsyndroom

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the minister why an adopted daughter with Down syndrome was refused coverage under an expat health policy by De Goudse, and whether the acceptance duty applies and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that expat policies are private law contracts outside the Zvw acceptance duty and that EU insurance directives bar government rules on such policies, so no intervention is possible.
Under the European non-life insurance directives, the government may not set rules on policy conditions and premiums for health insurance other than the Zvw.

Op grond van de Europese schadeverzekeringsrichtlijnen mag de overheid ten aanzien van andere soorten van (ziektekosten)verzekeringen dan de Zvw geen regels stellen met betrekking tot verzekeringsvoorwaarden en premiestelling.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over incontinentiezorg

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked whether budgeting incontinence supplies into insurer-defined patient profiles leaves patients with inadequate material, and what remedies exist when supplies run out early. Minister Schippers answered that the Zvw guarantees adequate care, that patient profiles are a cost-efficiency measure, and that patients can turn to their insurer, while she has no role in insurer-pharmacy contracts.
I have no role in the agreements that are concluded between the parties.
Ik heb geen rol in de overeenkomsten die tussen partijen worden afgesloten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, Van Toorenburg en Van der Staaij over de schadelijke gevolgen door blowen

MPs asked the government about harms of heavy cannabis use among young people, including effects on brain development and psychosis risk, and whether schools should act more strictly and the minimum age for softdrugs be raised to 21. The minister replied that existing drug policy already reflects these risks, that schools are tightening enforcement and drug use is declining, that the research shows no case for raising the age to 21 on current evidence, and that the 350-metre coffeeshop distance rule takes effect in 2014 after a transition period.
This report does not give cause for this at present.
Daartoe geeft dit bericht vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind over de bezuinigingen bij FIOM

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the health minister why subsidies to the counselling organisation Fiom were cut, how quality and expertise would be preserved, and how teenage mothers and the advisory report on women's shelters were treated. The minister replied that taboos have fallen and mainstream care can provide the help, that Fiom receives a phased transition subsidy to transfer expertise to mainstream organisations, and that teenage mothers will move under municipal shelter policy.

Given the reduced taboo, the availability of offerings within regular provisions and citizens' freedom of choice, I no longer consider it appropriate for the central government to subsidise Fiom's specific psychosocial activities.

Gelet op de afname van het taboe, de beschikbaarheid van het aanbod binnen de reguliere voorzieningen en met het oog op de keuzevrijheid van de burger acht ik het niet langer opportuun om vanuit de rijksoverheid de specifieke activiteiten op het terrein van psychosociale hulpverlening van Fiom te subsidiëren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind over de meldlijn zelfdoding

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister whether she would act against the NVVE's new hotline for assisted suicide and its publication of stories about helping others die, which they argued may breach article 294 of the Criminal Code. The minister replied that she sees no reason to act while the NVVE stays within the law, that the legal question is for the courts, and that she will not talk to the NVVE to stop it.
The weighing and assessment of that is ultimately reserved for the judge.
De weging en waardering daarvan is uiteindelijk aan de rechter voorbehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het aanleggen van graanvoorraden in Nederland

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about grain stockpiling in the Netherlands, the grain market situation, Germany's reserve, US and EU biofuel effects on prices, and whether EU biofuel blending should be raised. The government answered that the EU grain market is stable with no shortage, that member-state crisis reserves are for the member states and subject to Commission oversight, and that a biofuel report is due by the end of 2012.
Both the European Commission and the FAO are closely monitoring developments on the grain market.
Zowel de Europese Commissie als de FAO volgen de ontwikkelingen op de graanmarkt nauwlettend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over melkveehouders die in de problemen komen door de lage melkprijs

MP Wiegman-Van Meppelen Scheppink asked whether low milk prices are pushing half of Dutch dairy farmers deeper into debt, whether the 2011 price rise was a one-off, and whether the government will request early payment of EU area subsidies. The state secretary replied that the margin is above the 2006-2011 average though below 2011, that prices are expected to recover and not fall structurally, and that the Netherlands will not request early subsidy payment.
The Netherlands has therefore not submitted a request.
Nederland heeft dan ook geen verzoek ingediend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de relatietherapie

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the government would follow the CVZ advice to remove relationship therapy from the basic insurance package, and about the costs and child effects of divorce. The state secretary said the government follows the CVZ view that relationship problems fall outside the basic GGZ package because relationships belong to citizens' private sphere, declined a national study of divorce costs, and pointed to municipal support and a forthcoming guidance document for Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin.
We follow the CVZ's judgement, because this contributes to the sustainability of the geneeskundige GGZ package.
Wij volgen het oordeel van het CVZ, omdat hiermee wordt bijgedragen aan de houdbaarheid van het pakket voor geneeskundige GGZ
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het bericht Dubbel verdriet om verlies Danique

An ChristenUnie MP asked the health minister about a case of parents losing a stillborn or very early-born child and why rights to burial costs, leave and reflection time differ by gestational age, and whether the 24-week abortion limit and 20-week scan were harmful. The minister answered that burial obligations depend on gestation (24 weeks), that insurers and UWV set their own rules, that the 24-week limit will not be raised, and that no changes to the abortion framework are planned.
I have no indication that doctors should fill their role better.
Ik heb geen aanwijzing dat artsen hun rol beter zouden moeten invullen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Ormel over het belang van het herdenken van aanslagen

MPs from several parties asked whether the minister would use her influence to persuade the NOC*NSF and the IOC to hold a minute's silence at the London Olympic opening ceremony for the 1972 Munich attack. The minister acknowledged the tragedy but declined to intervene, saying the IOC is autonomous and it is not the government's responsibility to influence its protocols.
No. I do not consider it my responsibility to point this out to the IOC.
Neen. Ik acht het niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid het IOC hierop te wijzen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de voortgang van de infrastructuuraanpassingen van de spoorlijn Heerlen-Aachen en de realisatie van een intercityverbinding op dit traject

An MP asked the minister about progress on rail infrastructure works and an intercity link Heerlen-Aachen, including whether NS should bear full responsibility and whether the link should be a binding result obligation in the new concession. The minister answered that a variant study is underway, that a heavy effort obligation rather than a result obligation applies to NS, and that a concession-level result obligation is not planned.
I expect to have insight into the planning in July 2012, based on the action plan from ProRail and DB Netz.
Ik verwacht in juli 2012, op basis van het Plan van Aanpak van Prorail en DB Netz, zicht te hebben op de planning.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over spoorcapaciteitsproblemen rondom Zwolle

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the minister why rail capacity around Zwolle and the Herfte-Emmen stretch was only declared overloaded in March 2012, why ProRail did not act earlier, why signal densification and a third or fourth track were not pursued, and about Robuust Spoor priority projects. The minister answers that the overload declaration followed the normal timetable process, that capacity analyses and a capacity plan are pending, that the 8-minute problem analysis is outdated, and that about 50 locations are being studied under the Kleine Functiewijzigingen budget.
Following an overload declaration, ProRail will carry out a capacity analysis exploring possible cost-effective solutions.
Volgend op een overbelastverklaring zal door ProRail een capaciteitsanalyse uitgevoerd worden waarin mogelijke kosteneffectieve oplossingen verkend zullen worden.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Mededingingsautoriteit (NMa) pleit voor een apart invoedingstarief voor decentrale energieopwekking

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether the NMa's call for a separate feed-in tariff for decentralised generators means political decisions were taken, what the effects are on completed projects, level playing field and SDE+ subsidies, and how the smart grid test gardens reduce grid costs. The minister answered that the policy review on a producer tariff is not yet finished, will be completed before summer and will cover a general producer tariff rather than one for decentralised producers only, and that the NMa will study grid cost savings from decentralised feed-in by year end.
The policy review into the effects of introducing a producer tariff has not yet been completed.
De beleidsmatige beschouwing naar de effecten van de invoering van een producententarief is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de financiële situatie van EuroPsyche

An MP asked the health minister whether insurers may suspend payments to the mental health provider EuroPsyche without official findings, whether the Inspectorate or insurers should investigate, and why only EuroPsyche was targeted. The minister said insurers have their own competence to suspend and audit payments, that the Inspectorate and NZa were asked to investigate similar providers, and that she sees no critical continuity problem.

I asked the supervisors (IGZ and NZa) on 7 February 2012 to investigate further the extent to which EuroPsyche and other comparable care providers comply with all applicable legal frameworks and to inform me about it.

Overigens heb ik de toezichthouders (IGZ en de NZa) op 7 februari 2012 verzocht nader onderzoek in te stellen naar de mate waarin Europsyche en andere vergelijkbare zorgaanbieders in hun functioneren voldoen aan alle geldende wettelijke kaders en mij daar over te informeren.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over nazorg bij ruiming in de veehouderij om dierziekte

An MP asked the State Secretary whether aftercare is needed for farming families and owners facing culling due to animal disease, whether aftercare existed during the 2001 foot-and-mouth crisis, and what aftercare is available now and what lessons were drawn. The State Secretary answered that aftercare is needed, that during foot-and-mouth support came mainly from sector organisations, social networks and churches, and that the GGD now organises psychosocial aid with improvements from past evaluations, with (Z)LTO offering aftercare to its members.
Evaluations of various animal disease crises show that affected livestock farmers have a need for aftercare.
Uit de evaluaties van verschillende dierziektecrises komt naar voren dat er bij de getroffen veehouder behoefte is aan nazorg.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de euthanasie bij dementie

An MP asks the ministers of Health and Justice about a euthanasia case involving a dementia patient, including whether the Regional Euthanasia Review Committee's ruling is reliable, whether a Public Prosecution Service investigation is warranted, and the legal status of advance written declarations. The minister defends the committee's ruling, says no prosecution investigation is needed, states that the law clearly allows written declarations, and points to KNMG guidance and the upcoming evaluation of the Euthanasia Act.
The ruling of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees contains a description of the committee's assessment of the notification.
Het oordeel van de Regionale toetsingscommissies euthanasie bevat een weergave van de beoordeling van de melding door de commissie.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind over het rapport ‘Belofte maakt schuld? Scheiden ook’

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked the state secretary about a report on the societal costs of divorce, including whether research into those costs, measures to support couples, relationship courses and tax incentives would be undertaken. The government answered that it sees no added value in a national cost study, pointed to Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin guidance and existing programmes, declined a follow-up to the family policy note, and ruled out tax measures given the financial climate.
I do not get the impression that a national study into the total societal costs of divorce in the Netherlands would add value to supporting the responsibility of municipalities in this matter.

Ik heb niet de indruk dat een landelijk onderzoek naar de totale maatschappelijk kosten van echtscheiding in Nederland een toegevoegde waarde heeft als het gaat om het ondersteunen van de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten in deze.

MPs from six parties asked the health minister about breast implants (PIP), the ASIA syndrome, the AZM autoimmune centre closure, registration, quality standards and liability. The minister said evidence linking implants to autoimmune disease is limited, referred to the pending NIV/NVPC study, and said clinics and insurers will cover aftercare while IGZ monitors, with other matters deferred to a separate letter.
Aftercare is the responsibility of the clinics and hospitals where these prostheses were implanted.
De nazorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van de klinieken en ziekenhuizen, waar deze protheses zijn ingebracht.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over wettelijke eisen aan de responstijd van de crisisdienst psychiatrie

An MP asked the health minister why the psychiatric crisis service has no statutory response-time norm, unlike police, ambulance and other acute services, and whether one should be introduced to reduce aggression against responders. The minister replied that existing acute-care norms and the police-GGZ covenant (arrival within 2 hours, or 3 hours) are sufficient, so no statutory norm is planned, while promising a national action plan on aggression against care workers.
I therefore see no reason in advance to legally anchor a specific (accessibility) norm for the crisis service.
Ik zie daarom op voorhand geen aanleiding om een specifieke (bereikbaarheids)norm voor de crisisdienst wettelijk te verankeren.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Van Dekken over de financiële situatie van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Doven Sport Bond

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the financial position of the Dutch deaf sports federation KNDSB, its membership of NOC*NSF, earmarked funding for deaf sport, exclusion from the Paralympics, and a meeting with the federation. The minister said the KNDSB does not yet meet NOC*NSF membership criteria and that earmarking is partly done via Special Heroes, but declined to earmark budget for deaf sport or to meet the federation, since government policy favours integration into regular sports federations.
For that reason I see no need to enter into discussion with the KNSDB.
Om die reden zie ik geen noodzaak om in gesprek te gaan met de KNSDB.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het medicijn Remicade

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the drug Remicade for colitis ulcerosa may be removed from the basic insurance package and whether patients could pay for it themselves. The minister said extra hospital funding would be stopped because additional cost-effectiveness research was not done, but patients keep their entitlement until the CVZ issues its advice, which will be sent to parliament.
Once the CVZ issues a package advice on Remicade, I will ultimately decide whether the drug for this indication belongs in the package or not.
Als het CVZ een pakketadvies uitbrengt over Remicade, zal ik uiteindelijk beslissen of het middel bij deze indicatie tot het pakket behoort of niet.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het bericht dat de gemiddelde leeftijd van de eerste keer seks niet klopt

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister whether public sex education policy rests on a wrong norm, since the average age of first intercourse (16.5) reportedly holds for only about half of Dutch youth, and whether the median should be used instead. The minister rejected the claim that policy is based on a faulty norm, said prevention is aimed at a broad age group, and promised clearer labelling of the average as applying to sexually active youth, while declining to change the policy or run a comprehensive sex education campaign.
I do not believe that government policy on sex education is based on a faulty norm.
Ik ben niet van mening dat het overheidsbeleid op het gebied van seksuele voorlichting is afgestemd op een foutieve norm.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de situatie van kinderen op Bonaire (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the health minister about the situation of children on Bonaire, including poverty, neglect, abuse, drugs, crime and teen pregnancy, and about responsibilities and action plans. The state secretary acknowledged serious problems, described improved youth facilities, a 2012-2014 plan and a joint action plan with the island government, and said follow-up with the public body would follow in early 2012.
Early 2012, VWS will discuss the follow-up of this plan with the Public Body.
Begin 2012 zal VWS met het Openbaar Lichaam over de follow-up van dit plan spreken.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Dijsselbloem (PvdA), Kooiman (SP), Koşer Kaya (D66), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn e

Six MPs asked the state secretary of Health why the Stichting Adoptievoorzieningen faces an extra structural cut to its aftercare subsidy on top of an earlier 1.5% efficiency cut, and whether this is disproportionate given a further cut from Justice. The state secretary answered that the cuts are justified by falling adoption numbers, that adoption-specific aftercare will largely remain, and that alternatives exist, and left the decision on a pending SGP amendment to the Chamber.
The budget cut obligation has forced me to make choices.
De bezuinigingstaakstelling heeft mij genoodzaakt keuzes te maken.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de nieuwe voorlichtingscampagne van Sense «hun eerste keer» (ingezonden 19 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the Sense campaign 'hun eerste keer' and whether its framing of average first-sex age (16.4) is appropriate for the 15-16 year-old target group. The minister replies that the campaign aims at sexual assertiveness for not-yet-sexually-active youth, that 'seks' covers more than intercourse, that the average is not presented as a norm, and that the campaign will not be adapted.
The message that the average age at which young people in the Netherlands have intercourse is 16.4 years merely provides factual information based on large-scale research among young people.

Met het bericht dat de gemiddelde leeftijd waarop jongeren in Nederland geslachtsgemeenschap hebben 16,4 jaar is, wordt slechts feitelijke informatie verschaft die is gebaseerd op grootschalig onderzoek onder jongeren.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van vijf tankstation-houders om bier en wijn te gaan verkope

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the health minister about five petrol station owners planning to sell beer and wine despite the Drank- en Horecawet ban, and about enforcement by the nVWA and mystery-shop results on underage alcohol sales. The minister answered that the plan breaches the law and enforcement will follow, gave 2008-2011 enforcement figures, said the Inspector-General will act where needed, and noted the national mystery-shop results were already sent to parliament.
If petrol station owners start selling beer and wine, action will be taken against it.
Indien tankstationhouders bier en wijn gaan verkopen, zal daartegen worden opgetreden.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de oproep van artsen tegen jongensbesnijdenis (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the KNMG's call against male circumcision, whether it takes a political stance, and whether a legal ban would violate religious freedom. The minister answered that the KNMG may take a position, that a ban would restrict religious freedom and lacks justification for boys since properly performed circumcision has no lasting harm, and that the KNMG does not advocate a ban.
A ban would restrict the freedom to practise religion.
Een verbod zou de vrijheid van godsdienstuitoefening beperken.

Vragen namens de leden Ortega-Martijn en Wiegman-Van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zorgverzekering op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 28 september 2011

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister about the health insurance system on the BES islands, including whether private insurers were ordered to cancel policies, whether insured people were informed, whether the new scheme is less favourable and cannot be supplemented, and whether the ID card is recognised abroad for medical care. The minister replied that insurers were not ordered to cancel, that transitional rules let broader private coverage continue and allow supplementary insurance, and that access to specialist care abroad is arranged through contracts and agreements with neighbouring facilities.
The reasonableness and fairness of such a cancellation is a matter for the judge to assess.
De redelijkheid en billijkheid van een dergelijke opzegging staat ter beoordeling aan de rechter.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Veldhoven (D66), Leegte (VVD), Van Tongeren (GL), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (CU), Van der Werf (CDA), Van Vliet (PVV), Samsom (PvdA) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecret

Nine MPs asked why the Hagestein hydropower plant has been out of use since 2005, why a renovation plan and a private 20-year concession offer were not acted upon, and what the government's view is on the case. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat is still studying technical, legal and environmental requirements and will decide in 2012 whether to tender, integrate or shut down the plant, and will inform stakeholders in coming months.
RWS will take the initiative to inform the interested companies and governments about the state of affairs in a few months' time.
RWS zal het initiatief nemen om de belanghebbende bedrijven en overheden over enkele maanden in te lichten over de stand van zaken
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over vrijwillige kavelruil (ingezonden 9 juni 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the province of Overijssel's suspension of land-consolidation projects, linked to national nature budget cuts, breaches the minister's earlier promise not to obstruct voluntary plot exchanges, and what the national government will do about it. The State Secretary replies that national government does not obstruct voluntary plot exchanges, that provinces may proceed under their own responsibility and funds until a Bestuursakkoord is reached, and that EU co-financing remains available.
Despite the budget cuts and the recalibration of the EHS, the national government is not obstructing voluntary plot exchange.
Ondanks de bezuinigingen en de herijking van de EHS belemmert het Rijk de vrijwillige kavelruil niet.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over jeugdzorgproblematiek (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether closing the 26 temporary Jeugdzorg Plus places at Icarus in Limburg would create a waiting list, and whether shelter for girls who are victims of loverboys would be endangered. The secretary answered that no waiting list is expected because about 20% of Jeugdzorg Plus capacity is unused, and that most Jeugdzorg Plus institutions take in girls with loverboy problems, so no shortage is anticipated.
No, there is no danger of a waiting list arising.
Nee, er dreigt geen gevaar voor het ontstaan van een wachtlijst.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het sluiten van NUON Helianthos (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

MP Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked the economics minister about NUON's plan to close solar cell firm Helianthos, the loss of innovation and jobs, government subsidies, and whether policy could have prevented it. The minister said the market had not found investors, refused new support, said knowledge would be preserved and subsidy recovery was being examined, and defended market-led policy.
I am currently examining, for the part of the subsidy not yet legally settled, what happens to the knowledge developed.
Ik onderzoek op dit moment voor het deel van de subsidie dat nog niet in rechte vaststaat wat er met de ontwikkelde kennis gebeurt.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ingezonden 23 september 2011

An MP asked the health minister about the effects of mental health care budget cuts, including job losses and loss of treatment for about 1,000 patients at Bouman GGZ in Rotterdam, and asked what would be done to protect vulnerable patients and continue treatment trajectories. The minister said she would study the effects of a co-payment on vulnerable groups, expected treatment will not be stopped without valid reason, and pointed to cost reductions from integrated care models while stating the sector must still be financially sustainable.
I will conduct research into the possible effects of a co-payment on the care demand of vulnerable groups.
Ik zal onderzoek doen naar de mogelijke effecten van een eigen bijdrage op de zorgvraag van kwetsbare groepen.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de enquête van het RIVM over prenatale screening op Downsyndroom en de 20-weken echo (ingezonden

An MP asks the minister why a RIVM survey on prenatal Down syndrome screening and the 20-week scan asks respondents about religion, and why midwives must put such questions when their profession does not. The minister replies that the survey measures whether pregnant women make an informed choice, that religion is one element of their values, that answers are anonymous and questions may be skipped, and that the survey was drawn up with the professional groups.
For the record, the results are processed anonymously and the survey clearly offers the option of not answering certain questions.
Voor de goede orde vermeld ik dat de resultaten anoniem worden verwerkt en in de enquête duidelijk de mogelijkheid wordt geboden om bepaalde vragen niet te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over betere uitleg van de overheid over rookvrije horeca (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether the government should have explained the 2008 smoke-free hospitality rule better, and whether it should now launch a public campaign on secondhand smoke harm, and why the WHO's four recommendations were not fully adopted. The minister replied that the 2008 communication was extensive and humorous in tone, that the country largely follows WHO advice, and that she does not favour a new generic mass campaign.
I do not share that view.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de effectiviteitsstudie van time-outvoorziening Het Passion in Hum

An ChristenUnie MP asked ministers about the effectiveness study of the Het Passion time-out facility, how municipalities could pool Wmo funds across borders, and access to care for homeless people. The state secretary welcomed the study's findings, said municipalities decide on support provision, pointed to a cost-benefit report on homeless support and a pilot on faster indication, and saw no need for changed care-package financing.
It is up to municipalities to determine the provision of social support facilities for their citizens.
Het is aan gemeenten om het aanbod van voorzieningen op het terrein van maatschappelijke ondersteuning voor hun burgers te bepalen.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een koopzondagenbesluit van de gemeenteraad van Vlaa

MPs Dijkgraaf, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Gesthuizen asked the minister whether Vlaardingen's council decision allotting 18 Sunday shopping days, with shopkeepers choosing 12, violates the Winkeltijdenwet, and whether the minister will petition for annulment. The minister answers that the council ordinance is lawful since it delegates 12 days to the mayor and aldermen, that the college's later designation has been ordered brought into line with the law, and that he will await the municipality's reply before deciding on annulment.
I have pointed this out to the municipality and asked it to adjust the designation of the number of Sunday shopping days so that it complies with the Winkeltijdenwet.
Ik heb de gemeente hierop gewezen en verzocht om de aanwijzing van het aantal koopzondagen aan te passen, zodat deze in overeenstemming met de Winkeltijdenwet is.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma (PvdA), Leijten (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Wiegman-van Meppelen Schepping (ChristenUnie) en Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van

MPs from several parties asked the health minister why a second cochlear implant for young deaf children is not reimbursed, and whether the evidence supports it, including costs and the CVZ's pending reassessment. The minister said the CVZ must judge the added benefit, that the research in Nijmegen is uncertain, and that she is open to temporary admission or conditional financing to generate evidence, as the motion requested.
It is for the College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) to answer that question within the context of its role as package manager.
Het is aan het College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) om die vraag te beantwoorden binnen de context van zijn rol als pakketbeheerder.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Irrgang (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensen in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Irrgang asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about weak oversight of drug trials in developing countries, outsourcing to CROs, Helsinki Declaration compliance and EU database transparency. The minister answered that the sponsor remains responsible, the CBG checks compliance retrospectively, and the government supports EU review and a public EU clinical trials register, but did not commit to new mandatory measures.
Yes, I am willing to work towards ensuring that ethical guidelines are actually embedded in the approval process where this is not yet sufficiently the case.
Ja ik ben bereid mij ervoor in te zetten dat de ethische richtlijnen daar waar dat nog niet voldoende het geval is daadwerkelijk worden verankerd in het toelatingsproces.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over operatie in de baarmoeder bij kinderen met een ernstige vorm van spina bifida (ingezonden 18 febr

An MP asks the health minister about a US trial of prenatal surgery for severe spina bifida, its implications for diagnosis information, and whether such surgery should become available in the Netherlands. The minister answers that the procedure is experimental, long-term effects are unclear, it is not offered in the Netherlands, and a centre of reference may develop later.
Currently this treatment is not offered in the Netherlands.
Momenteel wordt deze behandeling niet in Nederland aangeboden.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over roken richt blijvende schade aan in puberbrein (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about research showing nicotine causes lasting brain damage in adolescents, and about investing more in youth smoking prevention, rules on school grounds, knowledge gaps about tobacco harm, and perinatal smoking. The minister acknowledged the research, pointed to the existing age limit and prevention programmes, said the school-grounds proposal would first be discussed with education ministry, and described a pilot on pre-conception counselling.
In the letter sent to the House on 25 February following the General Consultation, I indicated that the minister of Education, Culture and Science will first discuss this proposal with education.
In de brief die 25 februari jl. naar de Kamer is gestuurd naar aanleiding van het Algemeen Overleg, heb ik aangegeven dat de minister van OCenW dit voornemen eerst met het onderwijs bespreekt.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over nieuwe DNA-test (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a new DNA test for Down syndrome screening that VUmc plans to introduce, including its legal basis, consent, insurance coverage and wider societal effects. The minister answered that the test cannot be offered as screening without a permit under the Population Screening Act, that it is too early to decide on coverage or RIVM coordination, and that a broad debate is already taking place in the Central Organ for prenatal screening.
The test cannot be offered to pregnant women as screening without a permit under the Population Screening Act (WBO).
De test kan niet als screening aan zwangeren aangeboden worden zonder een vergunning in het kader van de Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek (WBO).

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken. Landbouw en Innovatie over innovatie en nieuwe medische behandelingen (ing

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about delays in clinical trial approval and drug reimbursement, slow Dutch regulatory timelines, the gap with other countries, access to unregistered drugs for rare diseases, and the future of the Topinstituut Pharma. The minister answered that approval delays stem from ethics committee workload and EU rules, that Dutch trial law is stricter only for minors, that a fast conditional reimbursement system is under consideration, and that a life sciences top team reports in June 2011.
That is why I am now considering an approach to achieve substantial improvements in the review system for research involving human subjects.
Daarom beraad ik mij nu op een aanpak om substantiële verbeteringen te realiseren in de toetsingssystematiek voor mensgebonden onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-Van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over extra treinen tussen Leeuwarden en Zwolle (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister about adding a third and fourth train per hour between Leeuwarden and Zwolle, following a motion, and about who should bear the extra costs. The minister answers that NS and ProRail are studying the options, that the province would need to pay for service above the minimum level, that no start-up subsidy budget is available for 2013-2014, and that the concession decision is still pending.
We do not pay for running trains, but in fact receive a concession fee from NS.
Wij betalen niet voor het rijden van treinen, maar ontvangen juist een concessieprijs van de NS.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het KNMG-concept standpunt over de rol van de arts bij het zelfgekozen levenseinde (ingezonden 5

An MP asked the health minister about a KNMG draft position suggesting a medically classifiable condition is not an absolute requirement for assessing unbearable suffering under the euthanasia law, contrary to the Supreme Court's reading, and whether this causes confusion among doctors. The minister answered that the draft is a discussion for the KNMG, declined substantive comment, and said the current system of regional review committees provides sufficient safeguards, pending the final KNMG position.
The current system offers sufficient guarantees for compliance with the legal assessment criteria.
Het huidige systeem biedt voldoende waarborgen voor het naleven van de wettelijke toetsingscriteria.

Vragen van de leden Slob en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Rijksinpassingsplan Windmolenpark No

MPs Slob and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked why the Noordoostpolder wind park spatial plan was adopted before a meeting with Urk, whether NUON wind plans in eastern Flevoland are being considered together, and whether alternative sites were studied. The minister replied that Urk was consulted repeatedly, seven turbines were dropped in response, the EIA addendum examined alternative locations, and follow-up talks were held.
I have informed your House separately about the outcomes of those talks.
Over de uitkomsten van die gesprekken heb ik uw Kamer separaat geïnformeerd.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de website van de regionale toetsingscommissie euthanasie (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

An MP asked the minister why the regional euthanasia review committees' website has not been updated with anonymised rulings since 2008 and how this will be fixed. The minister acknowledged the importance of publishing the rulings, attributed the delay to heavy workload and said staffing is being expanded and the website redesigned so rulings return from spring 2011.
Together this will lead to the anonymised rulings of the committees being placed back on the website from spring 2011.
Dit zal er gezamenlijk toe leiden dat de geanonimiseerde oordelen van de commissies vanaf het voorjaar van 2011 weer op de website zullen worden geplaatst.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de chaos bij de spermabank (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about chaos at sperm banks frustrating children's searches for their donors, including lost donor records and how donor data are now administered. The minister answered that pre-2004 records were partly destroyed and cannot be recovered, that the foundation SDKB manages post-2004 records satisfactorily, and that only 11 of 74 pre-2004 requests could be honoured.
Unfortunately it is not possible to recover these destroyed data.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om deze vernietigde gegevens alsnog te achterhalen.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Rouvoet (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat in de, onder scholieren verspreidde, EU-agenda de christelijke feest

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about a European school agenda that omitted Christian holidays from its footnotes, and whether the Netherlands had complained. The State Secretary confirmed the agenda was distributed to 404 Dutch schools, regretted the omission, and said he contacted the European Commission, which promised a correction and a full list of national holidays in the next edition.
When I heard of this, I sought contact with the European Commission and asked for clarification.
Toen ik hiervan hoorde heb ik contact gezocht met de Europese Commissie en om opheldering gevraagd.

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) en Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over barrières in regelgeving voor stichting Solink (ingezonden 29 n

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether regulatory barriers (AOW rules on shared households) hinder the SOlink initiative pairing students with lonely elderly people, and whether the SVB could treat such arrangements as commercial. The minister supports the initiative, says it can proceed within AOW rules if contracts are businesslike, and refuses a generic exemption on equality grounds.
Your request to instruct the SVB to generally regard the agreements between SOlink, the students and the lonely elderly as a 'commercial' relationship, I cannot grant.
Uw verzoek om de SVB op te dragen de overeenkomsten tussen SOlink, de studenten en de alleenstaande ouderen generiek te gaan beschouwen als een «commerciële» relatie, kan ik niet inwilligen.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de vrijstelling van Europese aanbestedingen voor Britse elektriciteitsproducenten (ingezo

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about EU procurement exemptions granted to some member states for energy markets, including whether this enables protectionism and how exemptions are reviewed. The minister answered that exemptions require competitive, open markets, that complaints can go to the Commission or the Dutch competition authority, and that a Dutch exemption request for the energy sector is forthcoming.
I expect to submit this request to the European Commission shortly.
Ik verwacht deze aanvraag op korte termijn bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bestaan van een wachtlijst voor klinische opnamen van het Landelijk GGZ-centrum De Riethorst

An MP asks the minister about a waiting list for inpatient beds at De Riethorst for deaf and hard-of-hearing patients, and why it arose despite approved expansion. The minister confirms the waiting list, attributes it to delayed realisation of 10 approved beds by Pro Persona (partly because the insurer will not contract in advance), and says the institution is deciding how to proceed.
Pro Persona must implement the plan to realise the approved places.
Pro Persona dient uitvoering te geven aan het plan om de goedgekeurde plaatsen te realiseren.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat vier technologische topinstituten voor farmacie en biotechnologie dreigen

MP Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether ending FES funding for the Top Institute Pharma will halt public-private pharmaceutical research and jeopardise jobs and universities. The minister answers that FES money was a one-off impulse, that TI Pharma receives a EUR 6 million bridging grant until July 2012, and that future life sciences policy will be set out in a business policy note.
It is now mainly up to the participating parties to valorise promising results from this cooperation and turn them into valuable products.
Het is nu vooral aan de deelnemende partijen om kansrijke resultaten uit deze samenwerking te valoriseren en om te zetten in waardevolle producten.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman van Meppelen-Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Tilburgse raad akkoord met subsidie aan Willem II» (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the health minister how a Tilburg council subsidy to football club Willem II relates to a platform of municipalities with professional football clubs, EU state aid rules, and municipal social support obligations under the Wmo. The minister answered that municipalities are autonomous and responsible for state aid compliance, that no state aid notification was made, and that the Wmo spending is a local responsibility the minister does not intend to enter.
I consider this a local responsibility in which I do not want and cannot intervene.
Ik vind dit een lokale verantwoordelijkheid waarin ik niet wil en kan treden.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de gemeente Venray (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked whether Venray municipality plans a questionnaire to assess whether pregnant women are fit for parenthood, and whether this is an improper intrusion. The minister answered that the questionnaire is a tool for midwives to identify support needs, that participation is voluntary, municipalities do not receive results, and that the municipality is responsible for deciding how to implement prenatal prevention with care professionals.
Municipalities do not have access to the results of the conversations.
Gemeenten hebben geen toegang tot de resultaten van de gesprekken.

Vragen van het de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over MVO-criteria voor banken (i

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the government will require a transparent CSR policy and a minimum CSR level in all tenders for financial services, and whether it will exclude banks linked to cluster munitions or harmful firms. The minister replied that CSR criteria will be considered case by case under proportionality rules, that a minimum CSR level is not suitable, and that financial services already fall under Duurzaam Inkopen and generic social criteria.
In future tenders for financial services, the central government will consider which criteria focusing on the socially responsible conduct of the contractor can be included.
Het Rijk zal bij toekomstige aanbestedingen van financiële diensten bezien welke criteria kunnen worden meegenomen die zich richten op het maatschappelijk verantwoord handelen van de opdrachtnemer.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het nieuwe ivf-protocol (ingezonden 24 juni 2010).

A ChristenUnie MP asked the health minister whether the new IVF protocol, which conditions treatment on parents' willingness to terminate a pregnancy if a serious handicap is found, is acceptable, whether it shifts parental responsibility onto doctors, how it fits the legal framework, and whether the minister will ask the professional body to revise it. The minister replied that the protocol is only a decision framework for doctors, that doctors share responsibility for the child's welfare, that the protocol's legal fit is governed by licensing and planning rules, and that he will not ask the NVOG to amend it.
No, I am not willing to do so. Moreover, I do not see this as my responsibility.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid. Ik zie dit overigens ook niet als mijn verantwoordelijkheid.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over de KNMG-richtlijn euthanasie bij verlaagd bewustzijn (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Health and Justice about the KNMG guideline on euthanasia in patients with reduced consciousness, asking whether full consciousness is required at the request and at execution, whether suffering can still be assessed, and whether palliative care is being prioritised. The ministers answered that full consciousness is required for the request but not strictly at execution, that unbearable suffering can still be assessed through observable signs, and that no new palliative measures are planned.
At the moment of carrying out euthanasia too, all due-care requirements must be met, so the physician must be convinced of unbearable and hopeless suffering.
Ook op het moment van het uitvoeren van euthanasie moet voldaan zijn aan alle zorgvuldigheidseisen en dus moet de arts overtuigd zijn van ondraaglijk en uitzichtloos lijden.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stopzetten van de financiering van projecten van het Platform Palliatieve Zorg (ingezonden 2

An MP asked the health minister whether a funding freeze for palliative care projects was real, whether the coalition agreement commitments would be kept, and the status of a commitment on a chair in spiritual care at Tilburg University. The minister confirmed a temporary departmental commitment pause due to a possible budget overrun, promised to resume subsidy processing after a review by 1 August 2010, and deferred the chair question until then.
A temporary departmental commitment pause has been announced.
Departementsbreed is een tijdelijke verplichtingenpauze afgekondigd.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitsp

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about a Council of State ruling on noise nuisance from Leger des Heils church services in Zutphen, including whether the Activiteitenbesluit exemption for religious services distinguishes amplified from unamplified sound and whether the law should be amended. The minister answered that the ruling is a provisional measure, the legal procedure is not finished, so the cabinet cannot comment on the case, while confirming the exemption applies regardless of amplification.
The judgment of the chair of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State concerns a provisional measures ruling.
Het oordeel van de voorzitter van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State betreft een voorlopige voorzieningsuitspraak.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Giro d’Italia (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about the costs and benefits to central and municipal government of the Giro d'Italia start in the Netherlands, how this compares to larger events like the Olympics and World Cup, and whether a cost-benefit analysis framework for major sports events would be prepared. The minister said the Giro costs were not yet clear due to missing budget information, that the bigger events are of a different order, and that a cost-benefit evaluation instrument is being developed with a project subsidy while analyses for the 2018/2022 World Cup and 2028 Olympics are underway or done.
Due to insufficient insight into the budget of the Giro d'Italia, it is not yet possible to state well what the costs and benefits of the event are.
Vanwege onvoldoende inzicht in de begroting van de Giro d’Italia is nog niet goed aan te geven wat de kosten en baten van het evenement zijn.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat Nederla

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about the European Commission's move to take the Netherlands to the European Court over Noord-Holland's requirement of organic or fairtrade coffee in a coffee-machine tender, and whether governments have enough clarity on sustainability criteria. The minister answered that the rules allow sustainability criteria meeting transparency, non-discrimination and proportionality principles, that the Commission's case is a question for the European Court, and that a factsheet and guidance on social criteria are being prepared.
It is desirable that this question be answered by the European Court of Justice.
Het is wenselijk dat deze vraag door het Europese Hof van Justitie wordt beantwoord.
qn: Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over ambulante hulp bij zelfdoding aan huis (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a proposed NVVE euthanasia clinic offering assisted suicide at home, and whether it conflicts with the euthanasia review law and Article 294 of the Criminal Code. The minister answered that doctors' professional responsibility should govern such requests, that the law does not regulate the place of assisted dying, and that review committees would refer any non-compliance to the Public Prosecution Service and the Health Care Inspectorate.

The due care criteria under the Termination of Life on Request and Assisted Suicide (Review Procedures) Act apply to doctors performing euthanasia or assisted suicide, regardless of whether it takes place at home, in a hospital or in a clinic.

De zorgvuldigheidseisen waarop ingevolge de Wet toetsing levensbeëindiging op verzoek en hulp bij zelfdoding wordt getoetst zijn van toepassing op de artsen die de euthanasie of de hulp bij zelfdoding uitvoeren, ongeacht of dit thuis, in een ziekenhuis of in een kliniek plaatsvindt.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over eerdere antwoorden over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

The SP MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers many questions about the use of force and civilian casualties during the June 2007 defence of Chora, Afghanistan, including rules of engagement, artillery accuracy, civilian warnings and investigations. The government answered that the Dutch troops acted lawfully under humanitarian law and self-defence, withheld some operational details and classified logs citing NATO rules and the ongoing court case, and rejected calls for an independent inquiry.
To avoid disrupting the legal proceedings, no statements can be made about certain details of the deployment in question while the matter is before the court.
Om de rechtsgang niet te verstoren, kunnen zo lang deze kwestie onder de rechter is geen uitspraken worden gedaan over enkele details van de inzet in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het WK voetbal in Qatar

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about implementing a parliamentary motion to avoid official government representation at the 2022 Qatar World Cup over labour abuses, the labour conditions, the 6,500 worker deaths, compensation for victims, and why trade promotion with Qatar continues. The ministers answered that qualification is not yet settled, outlined Qatari labour reforms and continued dialogue, and said a digital trade mission was postponed while Dutch firms can still get support.

Following the worrying reports about migrant workers building football stadiums in Qatar, the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development decided to postpone the digital trade mission to Qatar, which was planned from 22 March to 1 April 2021.

Four MPs asked the minister why the Netherlands' trade agency RVO encourages Dutch investment in Qatar's sports sector given reported deaths and poor conditions of migrant workers building World Cup stadiums, and whether this conflicts with CSR policy. The minister acknowledges the abuses, notes Qatari labour reforms and ongoing concerns, says RVO warns firms of IMVO risks, and postpones a trade mission to Qatar while refusing to end RVO support.

Following the worrying reports about migrant workers building football stadiums in Qatar, the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development decided to postpone the digital trade mission to Qatar planned for 22 March to 1 April 2021.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over eerdere antwoorden over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

MP Karabulut asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers, after a Trouw report of a veteran's account of a 2007 incident in Uruzgan with possible civilian deaths, about the internal review, archives, and rules on force use and battle damage assessments. Minister Bijleveld-Schouten answered that the Public Prosecution Service has an ongoing fact-finding inquiry, so further details, witness hearings and the full list of incident reports are withheld for now, while a search of incident reports from 2009–2010 and an updated list will be shared.

To prevent any own investigation by the Ministry of Defence from hindering the Public Prosecution Service's inquiry, I choose to await the completion of this fact-finding inquiry before deciding on an own investigation.
Om te voorkomen dat een eventueel eigen onderzoek van het Ministerie van Defensie het onderzoek van het OM belemmert, kies ik er voor om de afronding van dit feitenonderzoek af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Karabulut over “LIMC, JISTARC en andere inlichtingenwerkzaamheden van de Krijgsmacht”

MPs Belhaj and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister about the experimental Land Information Manoeuvre Centre (LIMC), its data gathering on domestic activist groups, its links to JISTARC and whether it had a legal mandate. The state secretary answered that LIMC lacked a mandate for activities outside the armed forces' own tasks, that the activities were halted in November 2020, that data is being archived or destroyed under archive rules, and that the legal framework was being reinforced.
Without a mandate it is not permitted to approach Dutch citizens.
Zonder mandaat is het niet toegestaan Nederlandse burgers te benaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een door Israël ingetrokken reisvergunning voor een Palestijnse minister na een bezoek aan Den Haag

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel revoked a travel permit for the Palestinian foreign minister after his visit to The Hague and whether this was retaliation, asking the government to press Israel for free travel for ministers. The minister denied any revocation, confirmed the delegation was refused smooth passage and questioned about the ICC visit, and said the Netherlands had raised the matter with Israel and would continue to monitor the situation.
In contacts with Israeli authorities, clarification has been requested about what happened.
In contacten met Israëlische autoriteiten is om opheldering gevraagd over de gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ondermijning van de democratie in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about threats to Turkey's democracy, including a possible ban on the pro-Kurdish HDP party and stripping MPs of immunity, and what the government would do about it. The minister replied that concerns are raised bilaterally and multilaterally, that the EU and Netherlands issued statements, and that the government favours suspending EU IPA funds while human rights do not improve.
Concerns about the situation regarding elected representatives are regularly raised both bilaterally and multilaterally.
De zorgen over de situatie m.b.t. gekozen volksvertegenwoordigers worden regelmatig zowel bilateraal als multilateraal aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bevindingen van het Panel of Experts on Yemen dat Nederlandse wapenexportvergunningen zijn misbruikt

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Dutch components found in intercepted Iranian air-defence missiles bound for Yemen reflect misuse of Dutch export licences, what the government shared with the UN Panel of Experts, and what it will do to prevent recurrence. The government confirmed the components were of Dutch origin, said the firms acted in good faith as targets of covert procurement, stated licences were conditioned on no re-export, and promised tightened company practices, EU information sharing and an export-control proposal, while declining to name other firms.
We cannot make any statements about this in public.
Wij kunnen hierover in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul en Van Ojik over de sloop van een Palestijns dorp

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to Israel's repeated demolition of the Palestinian village Humsah al-Fawqa, which left over seventy people homeless, and whether the government will push for firm EU measures against continued demolitions. The minister says the Netherlands and the EU are very concerned, have called on Israel to stop demolitions, visited the village with other European representatives, and will pursue a joint European response such as demarches and diplomatic visits, without committing to sanctions.
The Netherlands is actively working toward a joint European response to the demolition of Palestinian buildings.
Nederland zet zich actief in voor een gezamenlijke Europese reactie ten aanzien van sloop van Palestijnse gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over chroom-6 in PC-7 lestoestellen in Woensdrecht

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence whether chromium-6 had been found in 13 PC-7 training aircraft at Woensdrecht, why it was investigated, and how this squares with the 2018 letter on chromium-6 paint. The State Secretary confirmed chromium-6 dust was found in an avionics bay, flying was briefly halted, aircraft were cleaned and flying resumed, and the interior chromium-6 paint is not replaced because no chromium-free system is certified for enclosed parts.
The interior paint system will not be replaced, because no chromium-free paint system has been certified for enclosed parts.
Het verfsysteem aan de binnenzijde wordt niet vervangen, omdat er geen chroomvrij verfsysteem is gecertificeerd voor afgesloten delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het ’s nachts uitschakelen van de SMART-L-radar in Wier

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence why the SMART-L radar at Wier is switched off at night, its distance from the village, and the status of finding an alternative site to Herwijnen. The government answered that night operation exceeds noise norms and is unnecessary during testing, that at least two radars are needed for structural airspace surveillance, and that a new alternative-location study is being started.
Compensating for the lost radar coverage with temporary and limited alternatives is not a structural guarantee of airspace surveillance.
Het opvangen van de weggevallen radardekking met tijdelijke en beperkte alternatieven is geen structurele borging van luchtruimbewaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over derubricering bilaterale verdragen van Nederland en de VS over plaatsing van kernwapens in Nederland

An MP asked why the government did not itself release nineteen documents on US nuclear weapons in the Netherlands, whether further declassification is planned, and why MoUs on nuclear weapons remain secret. The ministers answered that security and alliance obligations prevent disclosure of locations, numbers and bilateral arrangements, while some older treaties were declassified where NATO agreed.
On grounds of state security, no statements can be made about secret treaties between the Netherlands and other countries.
Op grond van overwegingen van staatsveiligheid kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over geheime verdragen tussen Nederland en andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een opgepakte journalist in Marokko en gedetineerde Rif-activisten

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he agrees with Amnesty International that journalist Maati Monjib should be released, whether he will press Morocco for release, and whether detained Rif activists were unnecessarily dispersed across prisons. The minister said embassies monitor such cases and raise press freedom with Morocco where opportune, that Morocco is responsible for prison matters, and that the Moroccan authorities are sufficiently aware of the Dutch position.
It is up to the Moroccan authorities to ensure a careful legal process.
Het is aan de Marokkaanse autoriteiten om een zorgvuldige rechtsgang te borgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Van den Hul, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het ter dood veroordeelde Pakistaanse echtpaar Shafqat Emmanuel en Shagufta Kausar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence for blasphemy imposed on the Pakistani couple Shafqat Emmanuel and Shagufta Kausar, the repeated postponements of their appeal, and what the government would do through diplomacy, EU channels and asylum support. The minister condemned the death sentence, said the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns with Pakistani authorities without intervening in the court process, and declined to commit to attending the trial or to pre-judging any asylum request.
The Netherlands and the EU do not intervene in the legal proceedings in other countries.
Nederland en de EU interveniëren niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over uitlevering van oorlogsmisdadiger en wapenhandelaar Kouwenhoven aan Nederland

SP MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the extradition of convicted war criminal and arms dealer Kouwenhoven from South Africa, including a December 2020 High Court ruling and whether his assets are being pursued. The Minister said the matter is before South African courts, that Dutch authorities remain in close contact with South Africa and that Nederland continues to seek extradition, and that no asset confiscation order exists in the Dutch case so no asset investigation arises.
It is not for me to further interpret rulings of foreign judges, nor how the extradition procedure relates to any other procedures concerning Mr. Kouwenhoven.

Het is niet aan mij om verdere duiding te geven aan uitspraken van buitenlandse rechters, noch hoe de uitleveringsprocedure zich verhoudt tot eventuele andere procedures in relatie tot dhr. Kouwenhoven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over maatschappelijk verantwoord investeren en wapenproductie

SP MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about insurers investing in arms producers, the implementation of the insurance sector IMVO covenant, and whether the government will act on the Eerlijke Verzekeringswijzer findings. The minister replied that insurers bear individual responsibility under OECD guidelines, pointed to a themakader and webinar, said a follow-up meeting with insurers is planned, and stated that broader mandatory due diligence legislation is the direction of policy.
The cabinet shares the conclusion that the outcome of the covenants alone is not sufficient.
Het kabinet deelt de conclusie dat het resultaat van de convenanten alleen niet voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bloedbad van Sivas in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands had prosecuted anyone over the 1993 Sivas massacre that killed Dutch citizen Carina Thuijs, whether the embassy would attend the ongoing trial and join it, and whether the government would contact Germany about nine convicted suspects reportedly residing there. The minister answered that the embassy attended the 20 January 2021 hearing and monitors such cases, but sees no reason to join the Turkish proceedings or to pursue Germany further.
There are however no indications that the Turkish judge has interpreted or applied international law incorrectly.
Er zijn echter geen aanwijzingen dat door de Turkse rechter het internationaal recht op onjuiste wijze geïnterpreteerd of toegepast is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het verzoek voor inzet van het Defensiepersoneel ter ondersteuning van het zorgpersoneel

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister how many requests for military support to healthcare staff were received, which were granted or refused, how priorities against foreign missions are set, whether more personnel can be freed, and how a motion on this was implemented. The minister answers that 25 requests since October 2020 were granted, that priority is balanced against foreign missions and core tasks, that up to 160 (later 100) medical staff support UMC Utrecht, and that 1,000 personnel are on standby, without naming refused requests.
Defence must ensure that ongoing missions abroad are carried out and properly prepared.
Defensie moet zekerstellen dat de lopende missies in het buitenland worden uitgevoerd en terdege worden voorbereid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over journalist Julian Assange

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to the UK ruling blocking Julian Assange's extradition to the US and whether it would press for his release and against a US appeal. The minister said the Dutch government trusts the independence of British courts, that extradition is a matter for the UK government, and that the Netherlands has no means to support Assange.
The case is still before the courts. Even if the British court on appeal considers extradition in principle lawful, it is for the British government to decide.
De zaak is nog onder de rechter. Ook indien de Britse rechter in hoger beroep uitlevering in beginsel rechtmatig acht, is het aan de Britse regering hierover te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over de uitzending van Zembla over de betrokkenheid van Shell-medewerkers bij het creëren van olielekkages in de Nigerdelta

MPs Alkaya and Karabulut asked the ministers about a Zembla broadcast alleging Shell staff paid youths to cause oil spills in the Niger Delta, whether the Dutch government knew, and related issues. The government answered that the allegations are a matter for Nigerian prosecutors, that the former ambassador was informed in 2018 but the matter was not passed on, and that no external inquiry is needed, while citing Shell's $900 million clean-up commitment.
An external inquiry into the relationship between the Dutch embassy and Shell would, in our view, produce no new relevant information and is therefore not desirable.
Een extern onderzoek naar de relatie tussen de Nederlandse ambassade en Shell zal naar onze mening geen nieuwe relevante informatie opleveren en is om die reden niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over burgerdoden in Uruzgan

MP Karabulut asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about a reported 2007 incident in the Chora valley in Uruzgan where a Dutch veteran said civilians may have been killed, including questions on reports, rules of engagement, a complaints channel and civilian casualty counts. The Minister of Defence said the archives had not yet matched the described incident, a veteran interview had been held, a new archive search and consultation with the Public Prosecution Service were under way, and that a fact-finding inquiry by the OM had been started.
On the basis of this, I will, after consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, decide whether or not to launch an investigation.
Op basis hiervan zal ik, na overleg met het OM, besluiten al dan niet een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Raan, Van Ojik, Van Helvert en Van der Staaij over de mensenrechtensituatie in West-Papua

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about arms exports to Indonesia, the Community Policing Programme, human rights in West Papua, journalist access, the murder of Yeremia Zanambani, and environmental damage by companies. The minister answered that arms licences are assessed case by case including the Papua situation, the Dutch programme ended in 2019 with local continuation, and human rights concerns are raised bilaterally, though no full overview of documented violations or environmental damage is held.
However, I do not have a complete overview of all documented damage to the environment, living environment and climate in Papua.
Ik beschik echter niet over een totaaloverzicht van alle gedocumenteerde schade aan milieu, leefomgeving en klimaat in Papua.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de aanslag op de Iraanse atoomgeleerde

An SP MP asks the foreign minister about the killing of Iranian nuclear scientist Fakhrizadeh: whether a satellite was used, whether a non-state actor could do it, how to characterise it, whether it is a casus belli, and what steps are planned against such practices.
