The minister says the government has no verified information on the circumstances, calls for de-escalation alongside E3 and the EU, and states that assessing a casus belli is not for the cabinet.
The cabinet has no information about the actual circumstances.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie over de feitelijke toedracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over het bericht 'Egypt arrested its leaders, but a leading human rights group remains defiant'

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of three senior staff of the Egyptian Initiative for Personal Rights, shortly after Western ambassadors including the Dutch one had visited the group, and about whether the Netherlands would raise concerns. The minister confirmed the arrests and their charges, said the three were released on 3 December while charges remain, and stated that the Netherlands has raised concerns with Egyptian authorities through diplomatic channels.
Both in Cairo and in The Hague, the Netherlands has engaged with the Egyptian authorities at various levels to convey our concerns and ask for clarification.
Zowel in Cairo en in Den Haag is Nederland op verschillende niveaus in gesprek gegaan met de Egyptische autoriteiten om onze zorgen over te brengen en opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Australische excessen in Afghanistan en de reactie hierop

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Australian special forces killing 39 civilians and detainees in Afghanistan, including in Uruzgan where the Netherlands was active, and how the Netherlands responded. The Defence Minister answered that no Dutch involvement has been found so far, that Defence is conducting an internal inventory of joint operations and Australian recommendations, and described the Dutch-Australian coordination and separate command lines in 2006-2010.
If there is cause to do so, the cabinet will inform the House as soon as possible of the findings of the inventory.
Indien hier aanleiding toe is, stelt het kabinet de Kamer zo snel mogelijk op de hoogte van de bevindingen van de inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over het Nederlandse kernwapenbeleid

Three MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about NATO's decision to publicise the nuclear dimension of exercise Steadfast Noon, transparency on Dutch nuclear policy, the Secretary-General's visit to Volkel, and whether nuclear sharing breaches the Non-Proliferation Treaty. The ministers answered that transparency is being increased within alliance limits, that exercise details and US nuclear locations remain classified, and that nuclear sharing arrangements predate and are consistent with the NPT.
As your House is aware, no statements can be made on the numbers and locations of American nuclear weapons present in Europe, due to alliance and legally binding agreements.

Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kunnen over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een verzoek aan de Nederlandse ambassade in Turkije aangaande het bloedbad van Sivas

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the 1993 Sivas massacre, ongoing trials of suspects, a request to the Dutch embassy in Ankara to pass a letter to the King, and whether fugitive convicts in Germany could be pursued internationally. The minister replied that the embassy follows the trial, that a petition was not handed over because the group did not leave it, and that the cabinet sees no reason to take steps toward Germany.
In these conversations no request was made to the Netherlands to join a legal case.
Bij deze gesprekken is geen verzoek aan Nederland gedaan om zich bij een rechtszaak te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over langeafstandsrelaties in tijden van corona

An SP MP asked the Justice, and Foreign Affairs ministers about the rules and practical obstacles for long-distance partners seeking to meet during COVID-19, including visa problems. The government described the temporary long-distance partner scheme, acknowledged difficulties abroad due to consular scaling-down and local restrictions, and said it is working with EU partners on exceptional visa facilitation.
I am aware of this problem and can imagine it has been very difficult for the affected couples that they could not be reunited as quickly as desired.
Ik ben bekend met dit probleem en kan me voorstellen dat het voor de getroffen koppels erg moeilijk is geweest dat zij niet zo snel herenigd konden worden als gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de bijeenkomst van de G20 georganiseerd door Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked whether the Dutch UN envoy would attend the G20 meeting hosted by Saudi Arabia, and about the detention of Saudi women's rights activists and what the government has done about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not attend the G20 summit or side events, raised the activists' detention through several channels, and expressed concern about their treatment without committing to new concrete action.
The Netherlands did not take part in the G20 summit held virtually on 21 and 22 November.
Nederland nam niet deel aan de G20-top die op 21 en 22 november jl. virtueel plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van den Hul over een ten onrechte ontslagen klokkenluider op de ambassade in Nigeria

MPs Karabulut and Van den Hul asked about a whistleblower at the Abuja embassy whom a court found was wrongly dismissed, and about alleged leaking of confidential information to Shell and whether the ambassador was dismissed. The minister acknowledged the ruling, said lessons will be drawn and that the complainant's dismissal was not properly handled, but declined to give details of the investigation citing personnel confidentiality, and said no new embassy guidelines are needed.
Unfortunately, BZ did not succeed in convincing the judge that the employee's dismissal was not the result of the integrity report they had made.
Helaas is BZ er niet in geslaagd de rechter ervan te overtuigen dat het ontslag van de medewerker niet het gevolg was van de integriteitsmelding die zij had gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Karabulut over Nagorno-Karabach

MPs from ChristenUnie, CDA, SGP and SP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's alleged deployment of Syrian fighters in the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, Azerbaijan's ceasefire violations, possible sanctions, arms embargoes, war crimes allegations and recognition of Karabakh's independence. The minister answered that the government now knows of Turkish involvement, condemned the use of Syrian fighters, said no sanctions are currently under consideration, reaffirmed the OSCE arms embargo with no Dutch exports, and rejected recognition of independence.
Sanctions are not on the agenda at this moment.
Sancties zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een regeling voor kinderen van standrechtelijk geëxecuteerden in Indonesië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that only three children of Indonesians executed by summary execution qualify under the new compensation scheme, and whether conditions could be loosened for all children and widows. The minister replied that anyone may apply, individual claims will be assessed against the scheme's requirements under the 'reasonable term' case law, and declined to broaden the conditions.
Anyone who believes they are entitled to the compensation offered under the scheme may submit an application.
Iedereen die meent recht te hebben op de schadevergoeding die in de regeling wordt aangeboden kan een aanvraag indienen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Kuiken, Van Ojik, De Roon, Karabulut en Voordewind over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneem

Six MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Dutch child Insiya, abducted to India by her father, has not been returned, what steps have been taken, and whether ministers will personally intervene. The government answered that Dutch court rulings are not automatically binding in India, that it keeps raising the case bilaterally and at high level, and that it has contact persons for the mother, but that return depends on Indian legal procedures and it will not detail enforcement steps against the father.
The Netherlands will keep drawing India's attention to the rulings of the Dutch court and will closely follow the proceedings in India.
Nederland zal de uitspraken van de Nederlandse rechter bij India onder de aandacht blijven brengen en zal uitspraak in de procedures in India nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over transparantie met betrekking tot het oefenen van het gebruik van atoomwapens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Defence about transparency on nuclear-weapons exercises and transport at Volkel air base, and about the government's transparency policy, including whether earlier answers needed correcting. The minister answered that Netherlands pursues transparency within NATO agreements, confirmed a NATO exercise with a nuclear dimension was disclosed this year while details stay classified, and declined to give locations or numbers of US nuclear weapons, citing security and binding agreements.
Regarding the numbers and locations of American nuclear weapons present in Europe, no statements can likewise be made, on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.
Over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, eveneens geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Israëlische opdracht tot sloop van een basisschool in bezet Palestijns gebied

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli demolition order for a primary school in Ras al-Tin in occupied Palestinian territory, its EU co-funding, whether the Netherlands would protest, and consequences if demolition proceeds. The minister confirmed the announced demolition and the donor funding, said the Netherlands joined a joint demarche urging Israel to stop demolitions, and said it will stay in contact with donors on further steps since demolition had not yet occurred.
The Netherlands will remain in contact with the school's donors about further steps that could be taken to prevent demolition or respond to its execution.
Nederland zal met de donoren van de school in contact blijven over welke verdere stappen gezet kunnen worden om sloop te voorkomen of te reageren op uitvoering van de slooporder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een Nederlandse journalist die Turkije niet in mag

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch-Palestinian journalist Sakir Khader was barred from Turkey as a security risk under anti-terrorism law, what information Turkey based this on, and whether the government would raise press freedom concerns with Turkey. The minister confirmed the refusal, said the basis is not yet known and Nederland has requested information, and stated the government regularly raises press freedom concerns with Turkey bilaterally and via the EU.
The Netherlands has made inquiries and is awaiting information from Turkey. Your House will be informed further about this.
Nederland heeft hier navraag naar gedaan en is in afwachting van informatie van Turkije. Uw Kamer zal hierover nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Amerikaanse sancties tegen het Internationaal Strafhof

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the US sanctioned ICC staff including the chief prosecutor, what measures apply, and what follow-up steps the government would take. The minister confirmed economic sanctions and visa restrictions, described diplomatic protests and EU/multilateral letters, and outlined ongoing contacts with the Court, banks and EU partners, including raising the sanctions with the Commission for the anti-boycott regulation.
The Cabinet is further in discussion with the European Commission about adding the sanctions to the EU's Anti-Boycott Regulation.
Het Kabinet is verder met de Europese Commissie in gesprek over het toevoegen van de sancties aan de Antiboycotverordening van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Raan over de beveiliging van Nobelprijswinnaar dr. Denis Mukwege

MPs asked whether MONUSCO protection of Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the Panzi hospital is sufficient, whether Nederland will play a role in his security, and whether he should be protected. The minister answered that Nederland pressed the UN for adequate protection, MONUSCO assigned Nepalese troops to the compound and committed to continued protection, and Nederland is exploring a new contribution to security without a formal request from Mukwege.
For this reason, the Netherlands has in recent weeks pressed the UN for adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft daarom de afgelopen weken bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bouali, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Israël martelde verdachte Palestijnen van een NGO gesteund door Nederland'

MPs asked whether the Israeli detention and alleged torture of two former staff of the Palestinian NGO UAWC, which the Netherlands supports, breaches international law, and about military trial, access to counsel and administrative detention. The ministers say the Netherlands is concerned, has raised torture and fair-trial rights with Israel and the EU, notes an Israeli Justice Ministry inquiry without published results, and will keep monitoring the case.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the progress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het oppakken van een Palestijnse activist door Israël

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Palestinian BDS leader Mahmoud Nawajaa by Israel, his incommunicado detention, whether the arrest was political, the number of Palestinian security detainees, and whether the government would raise concerns with Israel. The minister answered that Nawajaa was arrested on 30 July 2020, held without access to counsel for a week, and released on 17 August without charge; the motives are unknown, the Netherlands raises concerns about pressure on civil society with Israel, but no concrete new step is announced.
The reasons for the arrest and release are unknown to the cabinet.
De redenen voor arrestatie en vrijlating zijn het kabinet onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over in Bahrein geplande executies

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the upheld death sentences of two men in Bahrain, alleged torture-obtained confessions, and the number of people sentenced to death. The minister confirmed the rulings, condemned torture and reiterated Dutch opposition to the death penalty through bilateral, EU and UN channels, committing to continue raising the issue.
According to Bahraini human rights organisations, 18 persons have currently been sentenced to death since 2017.
Volgens Bahreinse mensenrechtenorganisaties zijn er momenteel 18 personen veroordeeld tot de doodstraf sinds 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het oppakken van een journalist in Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of critical journalist Omar Radi in Morocco on charges of rape and threats to state security, including whether the case involves Dutch espionage, and whether the Netherlands will press for a fair trial and monitoring. The minister answered that Dutch embassies follow press freedom and fair trial developments, that the Netherlands has no indication Radi's case refers to the Netherlands, and that the Moroccan authorities must investigate the charges, while declining to confirm or refute Amnesty's spyware findings.
I do not have independent information that confirms or refutes this reporting, and therefore cannot give a judgment on it.
Ik beschik niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt dan wel ontkracht, en kan daar dan ook geen oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de leefomstandigheden van overlevers van de genocide in Srebrenica

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about living conditions for Srebrenica genocide survivors still housed in collective centres 25 years later. The minister confirmed about 5,000 displaced persons remain in centres, acknowledged poor conditions, and listed past Dutch and EU support including housing projects and an ongoing centre-closure programme, committing only to continued pressure on Bosnian authorities.
After years of intensive support, the Netherlands urges the Bosnian authorities to ensure adequate housing and, where desired, return of displaced persons.
Na jarenlang intensieve steun, spoort Nederland de Bosnische autoriteiten aan om te zorgen voor adequate huisvesting en -desgewenst- terugkeer van ontheemden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Karabulut en Kerstens over het artikel 'Een soft maar gevaarlijk wapen: moderne oorlogsvoering richt zich op beïnvloeding van de bevolking'

MPs from GroenLinks, SP and PvdA asked the Defence Minister about the use of the Behavioural Dynamics Methodology (BDM) by the armed forces, its origins linked to Cambridge Analytica's parent company, the absence of an ethical framework, legal review, a Caribbean pilot, procurement, MIVD overlap, oversight and parliamentary information. The Minister answered that BDM is a legitimate tool operated within existing legal and ethical frameworks, that parliament was not separately informed of the SCL-Defence purchase, that a procurement process started in 2019, and that PsyOps are approved by the political-strategic level with parliament informed under existing procedures.
Defence bought the BDM course in 2017 not from Cambridge Analytica but from SCL-Defence.
Defensie kocht de BDM-cursus in 2017 niet bij Cambridge Analytica, maar bij SCL-Defence.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een zoekgeraakte wapenleverantie in Libië in 2017

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers to give a full account of the 2017 disappearance of weapons and communications equipment shipped to Tripoli to protect the Dutch embassy, and why Parliament was not informed. The minister responded with a timeline of the shipment and loss, confidentially briefed Parliament earlier, but withheld the types and quantities of goods on security grounds and gave no further details.
We do not disclose the nature of the goods for security reasons.
Over de aard van de goederen doen we uit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de afgifte van een vergunning voor export militair materieel naar Egypte

An SP MP asked the government about an export licence for military radar and C3 equipment to Egypt, including its possible use in the Yemen blockade, human rights concerns and Libya tensions. The minister declined to give details on the licence and product for confidentiality reasons, said the licence was assessed under the EU Common Position, and refused to suspend it.
No statements can be made about the details of the application. That concerns commercially confidential information.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de details van de aanvraag. Dat betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over "het verdringen van reguliere arbeid"

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Karabulut asked why the government's Participation Act factsheet gives no information on displacement testing, what 'other workplaces' include, and whether municipalities test for displacement of regular work, asking for figures, follow-up and measures. The state secretary answered that displacement testing is a municipal responsibility not monitored centrally, that no figures on detected displacement exist, that the existing legal framework is adequate, and that he opposes a statutory displacement test (Wet verdringingstoets).
Testing for displacement is a decentralised responsibility of municipalities, and no statistical information on it is collected centrally.
De toetsing op verdringing is een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en daarover wordt (centraal) geen statistische informatie verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over de bombardementen van Turkije in de Iraakse regio Sinjar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish bombings in the Sinjar region of Iraq, including alleged strikes on a refugee camp, a hospital and Yezidi areas, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification or condemn them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the camp and hospital were reportedly not directly hit according to local sources, cited PKK presence as the reason for Turkish strikes, and said the Netherlands raised the bombings with EU partners and urges restraint and respect for international humanitarian law.
I have also recently raised the Turkish bombings with my European colleagues at the Foreign Affairs Council on 13 July.
Ook heb ik de Turkse bombardementen recentelijk opgebracht bij mijn Europese collega's tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse zaken op 13 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over verdwijningen, marteling en willekeurige detentie door alle partijen in het conflict in Jemen

The MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister about a Mwatana report on enforced disappearance, torture and arbitrary detention by all parties in Yemen, and whether the government will press them to end these practices. The minister confirms the findings are very serious, notes Yemen's treaty obligations and the possibility of war crimes, says the Netherlands raised concerns at the Human Rights Council and will keep pressing bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands will continue to raise its concerns about human rights violations by all warring parties in Yemen in bilateral and multilateral settings.
Nederland zal zijn zorgen ten aanzien van mensenrechtenschendingen van alle strijdende partijen in Jemen onder de aandacht blijven brengen in bilateraal als multilateraal verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van den Hul over de doorvoer van ruim 10 miljoen kogelpatronen naar Turkije

Opposition MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a transit of over 10 million cartridges from Czechia through Rotterdam to Turkey despite Dutch restrictions, and about prior assurances on Czech export checks. The minister confirmed the transit without transhipment, said no Dutch licence was required, explained that end-use details are confidential and not held in the Netherlands, and said the government would not require standard customs checks on Czech consignments.

Since the goods require a licence in Czechia rather than in the Netherlands, and given the confidential nature of the information, the cabinet cannot provide additional information on the end use of the goods.

Aangezien de goederen niet in Nederland maar in Tsjechië vergunningplichtig zijn, en gelet op de vertrouwelijke aard van de informatie kan het kabinet geen aanvullende informatie verstrekken aangaande het eindgebruik van de goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het debat over burgerslachtoffers in Irak op 14 mei 2020

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Defence Minister about civilian casualties from the 2015 Dutch airstrike on Hawija, including death tolls, CENTCOM verification, the ICRC list, allied refusals, transparency rules and compensation. The Minister largely referred back to earlier letters, declined to answer several questions on CENTCOM's counting system as outside her ministry's control, and pointed to forthcoming proposals on informing parliament about civilian harm and on compensation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over de verplichte Marokkaanse nationaliteit

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they would support Dutch-Moroccans seeking to renounce their compulsory Moroccan nationality, whether consular support and Moroccan consular influence in the Netherlands would be addressed, and whether they would negotiate with Morocco and EU partners. The government sympathised with the wish for choice in nationality, said it would raise the issue with Morocco, which pointed to its existing law, and said it would address undesirable foreign influence under its existing approach, without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet has understanding for this wish for freedom of choice.
Het kabinet heeft begrip voor deze wens tot keuzevrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat Nederlandse ambassadeur in Nigeria informatie lekte naar Shell

MPs asked whether the former Dutch ambassador to Nigeria leaked confidential information about a corruption investigation into Shell, and about the integrity investigation, handling and reasons for replacing him. The ministers refused to disclose the integrity findings and related documents citing privacy and integrity-reporting concerns, rejected the claim that he favoured Shell, and gave a limited account of the Niger Delta cleanup.
The answers to questions 1 through 7 and question 9 will be sent to your House on a confidential basis.
De antwoorden op vraag 1 t/m 7 en vraag 9 zullen uw Kamer vertrouwelijk toegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over de Nederlandse kernwapentaak en de Duitse kernwapendiscussie

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the government about Dutch nuclear weapons tasks, past nuclear exercises and consultations, US nuclear weapons in Europe, and German debate on nuclear deterrence. The ministers largely declined to give details on nuclear decision-making, exercises and US weapons arrangements, citing binding alliance agreements and security, while pointing to NATO unanimity and committing to arms-control and de-escalation work.
Regarding agreements and procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear weapons task, no statements can be made on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.

Over afspraken en procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de dood van George Floyd als gevolg van racistisch politiegeweld

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about George Floyd's death, press arrests and force against protesters in the US, and whether he raised concerns with his US counterpart. The minister condemned the killing, said the Netherlands expressed concern in a videoconference with Secretary Pompeo, and largely deferred to US institutions to investigate and prosecute.
The cabinet trusts that the American democratic rule of law will investigate the death of George Floyd and that justice will be done.
Het kabinet vertrouwt erop dat de Amerikaanse democratische rechtstaat de dood van George Floyd zal onderzoeken en dat recht zal worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over straffeloosheid voor Israëlisch geweld tegen demonstranten in Gaza

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he still stands by his earlier calls for independent investigation and prosecution of Israeli forces over the 2018 Gaza border killings, including the death of medic Razan al-Najjar, and whether impunity prevails. The minister answers that the government still supports independent investigations, has repeatedly urged Israel's military advocate to proceed, notes the criminal inquiry is ongoing, and commits to continued pressure.
While the investigation is ongoing, the MAG makes no further statements on this case.
Lopende het onderzoek doet het MAG geen verdere uitspraken over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de ‘losse eindjes ten aanzien van de compensatie van het AOW-gat van gewezen militairen’

SP MP Karabulut asked the State Secretary for Defence about outstanding issues in compensating former military personnel for the AOW gap, whether the government accepts their claim of disadvantage, whether the UGM benefit should run to the AOW age, and the costs. The State Secretary replied that the AOW gap is structurally resolved for new personnel, that the compensation of 100% of the justified entitlement is an adequate arrangement, that formal regulation is pending consultation with unions, and that continuing the UGM to AOW age would cost about 2 billion euro.
It is my intention to schedule a concluding conversation with Mr Van den H. as soon as that is possible.
Het is mijn intentie om een afrondend gesprek met de heer Van den H. in te plannen zodra dat mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'Protesten in HongKong laaien weer op na ‘coronastop’: zeker 230 arrestaties'

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about police violence against protesters and journalists in Hong Kong, Chinese interference in Hong Kong's autonomy, and whether the government would act at EU and bilateral level, including support for universal suffrage and an independent inquiry into police conduct. The minister answered that the government is concerned, shares the EU's statement on national security legislation, has raised concerns with Beijing and Hong Kong authorities, and supports universal suffrage and an independent inquiry in EU settings.

The government has repeatedly conveyed its concerns over the past year to both the central government in Beijing and the local government in Hong Kong, and will continue to do so as long as there is reason to.

Het kabinet heeft het afgelopen jaar herhaaldelijk zorgen overgebracht aan zowel de centrale overheid in Peking als de lokale overheid in Hongkong, en zal dat blijven doen zolang daar aanleiding toe is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'China: Free Covid-19 Activists, ‘Citizen Journalists’

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Chinese COVID-19 citizen journalists had disappeared, and about censorship's effect on China's official information. The minister affirmed the importance of independent journalism, said he would raise the issue in the EU-China human rights dialogue, and noted the EU had already called for the release of detained citizen journalists.
No, but the cabinet is willing to raise this issue in the human rights dialogues with China of the Netherlands and the EU.
Nee, maar het kabinet is bereid aandacht te vragen voor deze kwestie in het kader van de mensenrechtendialogen met China van Nederland en de EU.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de rol van de Karel Doorman in de Caribische Zee en de oproep van voormalig VN-chef Egeland om economische sancties tegen diverse landen, waaronder Venezuela op te heffen

An SP MP asked why the Karel Doorman is deployed for maritime border patrol near the Leeward Antilles, whether it joins anti-drug operations against Venezuela, and whether the government will support lifting sanctions on Venezuela during the pandemic. The minister answered that the deployment supports the Caribbean Coast Guard against possible COVID-19-related migration, corrected a press release wrongly suggesting anti-drug patrols, and stated that sanctions should not hinder humanitarian aid while the EU keeps them targeted.
The cited Ministry of Defence news item unfortunately contained an editorial error, which gave the impression that the Karel Doorman could also be deployed for anti-drug patrols.

Het aangehaalde nieuwsbericht van het Ministerie van Defensie bevatte helaas een redactionele fout, waardoor de indruk werd gewekt dat Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman tevens kon worden ingezet voor anti-drugspatrouilles.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘China wil de ‘klus’ in Hongkong afmaken’

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the April 2020 arrests of fifteen pro-democracy figures in Hong Kong, whether it will coordinate with EU partners and contact Beijing, and how it reads the Liaison Office's claim that the Basic Law's Article 22 does not bind it. Minister Blok answered that the government and the EU will closely monitor the cases, will seek clarification if needed, and restated that Hong Kong's autonomy under One Country, Two Systems must be respected, while leaving the Liaison Office interpretation to Hong Kong's own legal debate.
The cabinet, together with the EU, will closely follow the further course of their cases.
Het kabinet zal, mede in EU-verband, het verdere verloop van hun zaken nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over politieke gevangenen in Turkije

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why Turkey releases tens of thousands of prisoners during the coronavirus pandemic while political prisoners are excluded, and whether the minister will urge his Turkish counterpart to release them. The minister confirms the release of about 90,000 prisoners with exceptions for anti-terror convicts, says the Netherlands has repeatedly raised freedom of expression and the political prisoner issue with Turkey, but states that reliable figures on political prisoners are not available.
The Netherlands regularly raises the human rights situation in Turkey, including freedom of expression, at all levels and will continue to do so, including in European and international contexts.
Nederland kaart de mensenrechtensituatie in Turkije, waaronder de vrijheid van meningsuiting, regelmatig en op alle niveaus aan en zal dit blijven doen, ook in Europees en internationaal verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse militairen in Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the withdrawal and rotation of Dutch troops in Afghanistan during the COVID-19 pandemic, including what 'essential' personnel means and whether NATO can help fight the virus there. The minister answered that non-essential staff were temporarily withdrawn, explained the quarantine and remote-advice arrangements, and said NATO is not the primary actor for COVID-19 aid in Afghanistan.
As your House was informed on 24 March (reference 2020D11584), the commander of the Resolute Support mission ordered that personnel not essential to continuing the mission be temporarily withdrawn.
(kenmerk 2020D11584 ) is door de commandant van de Resolute Support missie opdracht gegeven het personeel dat niet essentieel is voor de voortzetting van de missie, tijdelijk terug te trekken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over in Marokko gestrande reizigers

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked why about 3,000 Dutch travellers remained stranded in Morocco, what the government was doing to repatriate them, and whether it would show leniency on extra costs. The minister confirmed the figure, described diplomatic efforts with Morocco and the EU, but refused a cost-leniency scheme, citing personal responsibility and budget constraints while offering payment arrangements.
I have made a pressing appeal to Morocco to make this possible.
Ik heb een klemmend beroep op Marokko gedaan om dit mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over wapenimporten uit Turkije

An MP asked whether Turkish military imports cost the Netherlands over 16 million dollars in two months, which systems were bought and whether the government would press allies to stop imports from Turkey given Syria and human rights concerns. The government could not verify the figures, said the Ministry of Defence only bought maintenance and modification services for Stinger launching systems, and refused to ask allies for an import ban, arguing that export controls are the more effective tool.
No independent figures are available on imports of military goods from Turkey in the first two months of 2020.
Er zijn geen onafhankelijke cijfers beschikbaar ten aanzien van de import van militaire goederen uit Turkije in de eerste twee maanden van 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over sancties die de bestrijding van het coronavirus belemmeren

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he supports UN calls to suspend sanctions that hinder COVID-19 response, and whether he will press for lifting sanctions and blockades such as those on Yemen and Gaza. The minister answered that sanctions carry humanitarian exemptions, that no signals of obstruction have been received for specific EU or UN sanctions, and that targeted sanctions will not be eased while Yemen and Gaza access issues are being raised with the relevant parties.
For now the cabinet has received no signals from companies or aid organisations that specific EU or UN sanctions hinder the fight against the coronavirus.
Vooralsnog heeft het kabinet geen signalen van bedrijven of hulporganisaties gekregen dat specifieke EU- of VN-sancties de bestrijding van het coronavirus belemmeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het aanpassen van de oefening Defender 2020

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether she had warned the Defender 2020 exercise leadership about COVID-19 risks, why the exercise was not ended, and what legal basis and Host Nation Support provisions were used. The minister answered that the US largely cancelled the exercise, that troop movements through the Netherlands were fully cancelled, that health precautions were taken, and that the Host Nation Support request was withdrawn, but did not directly answer whether the Netherlands urged cancellation or consulted other governments.
The US has largely cancelled the Defender 2020 exercise.
De VS heeft de oefening Defender 2020 grotendeels afgelast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Karabulut over toeristen in Nederland die vanwege het Coronavirus niet terug kunnen keren

Two SP MPs asked whether the government would act on reports that tourists in the Netherlands with expiring visas cannot return home due to coronavirus, and how many are affected. The minister said visa extensions can be requested by phone from the IND, which judges each case individually, but could not give exact numbers and does not track these cases.
In addition, the IND does not register the number of people who cannot return due to the coronavirus and who for that reason submit a request to extend a visa.
Daarnaast registreert de IND niet het aantal mensen dat niet kan terugkeren vanwege het Coronavirus en om die reden een verzoek om verlenging van een visum indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de mogelijke inzet van delen van de krijgsmacht ter ondersteuning van de bestrijding van de COVID-19 pandemie

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Defence Minister whether Defence would suspend ship and unit programmes to support COVID-19 response, offer ICU places, and what role military hospitals, engineers and transport could play, plus questions on personnel limits, the Wuhan evacuees, hospital cooperation and protection of deployed troops. The Minister answered that Defence supports the crisis response on request, lists loans of planners and medical staff, 65 ventilators to hospitals and Caribbean territories, food-bank support and Caribbean border and public-order assistance, and that deployments are reviewed continuously.
When, what and in what way Defence deploys capabilities is discussed during the crisis on the basis of a request from civil authorities and in consultation with the other departments.
Wanneer, wat voor en op welke manier Defensie capaciteiten inzet, wordt gedurende de crisis op basis van een verzoek van civiele autoriteiten en in overleg met de andere departementen besproken.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Karabulut over een boek over de missie in Uruzgan, Afghanistan

MPs Karabulut asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a book by a veteran claiming there were no Taliban in Uruzgan and that Dutch force use was excessive and civilian casualties were high. The government rejects the portrayal, says it cannot reliably count enemy or civilian casualties, and says the international mission helped Afghanistan.
Defence did not keep a registration of the number of enemy combatants killed as a result of Dutch action.
Defensie heeft geen registratie bijgehouden over het aantal gevallen vijandelijke strijders ten gevolge van Nederlands optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut  en Van Ojik over het staatsbezoek aan Indonesië

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked for the programme of the state visit to Indonesia, whether apologies for the colonial past were on it, and why broad apologies had not been given. The minister answered that the programme was adjusted after a boat accident, listed past apologies and spijtbetuigingen by Dutch officials, and stated the King expressed regret and apologies on 10 March 2020.

On 10 March 2020, during the state visit to Indonesia, the King, following earlier statements by Dutch ministers and ambassadors, expressed regret and apologies for acts of violence by Dutch forces in the years after the proclamation.

Op 10 maart 2020 heeft de Koning tijdens het staatsbezoek aan Indonesië, in navolging van eerdere uitspraken door Nederlandse bewindspersonen en ambassadeurs, spijt en excuses uitgesproken over geweldsontsporingen van Nederlandse zijde in de jaren na de proclamatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over noodhulp aan Syriërs

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the source and channels of extra humanitarian aid for north-west Syria, EU and member state efforts, Dutch diplomacy, and obstacles to aid for internally displaced people. The minister answered that the funds come from the BHOS aid budget, are spent via the Dutch Relief Alliance and the Syria Cross-Border Humanitarian Fund, and outlined diplomatic efforts and remaining aid obstacles.
The Netherlands is in active contact with the European Commission and other member states on this.
Nederland onderhoudt actief contact met de Europese Commissie en andere lidstaten hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht dat voormalige IS-strijders mogelijk zullen worden overgebracht naar een (te bouwen) instelling in de Ninevé vlakte

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of and had responded to reports that former IS fighters might be transferred to a planned facility in the Nineveh Plain, and what role the Netherlands would take. The minister answered that the transfer concerns Iraqi nationals, is primarily Iraq's responsibility, that the Netherlands remains in dialogue with Iraq and partners, and that no official transfer decision appears to have been taken.
The transfer to Iraq referred to in the article concerns only people with Iraqi nationality.
De in het artikel aangehaalde overplaatsing naar Irak betreft alleen mensen met de Iraakse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over het bericht dat Oeigoeren worden tewerkgesteld in Westerse bedrijven

MPs Alkaya and Karabulut asked the foreign and trade ministers about reports that Uyghurs are employed under forced-labour conditions in Western company supply chains, and whether Dutch firms are involved. The government confirmed awareness, said it cannot independently verify the ASPI findings, pointed to business information sessions and EU/UN diplomacy, and said firms failing IMVO conditions can be excluded from trade missions.
The cabinet cannot confirm the conclusions of the ASPI report on the basis of its own independent information.
Het kabinet kan de conclusies van het ASPI-rapport niet op basis van eigenstandige informatie bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over verloop Defender 2020 naar aanleiding van maatregelen in het kader van de bestrijding van Coivd-19 pandemie

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister what EUCOM's decision to reduce US participation in exercise Defender 2020 means for Dutch involvement, whether only the media day was cancelled, whether Dutch participation would be cancelled for pandemic reasons, and what the new gathering limits mean for Defence exercises. The minister replied that the planned movement of a US armoured brigade through the Netherlands will not proceed, that Defence will keep supporting allies until they leave, and referred to a letter on COVID-19 impacts on missions and exercises.
The planned movement of a US combat brigade through the Netherlands will not be continued.
De geplande troepenverplaatsing van een Amerikaanse gevechtsbrigade door Nederland wordt niet voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Koopmans, Karabulut, Voordwind en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘In Saudi Arabia, contacting the EU is a crime,

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports that contacting an EU or Dutch embassy is treated as a crime in Saudi Arabia, and whether EU diplomats may attend trials of women's rights activists. The minister answered that the government regards such contacts as legitimate, has raised the matter repeatedly with Saudi authorities, and that EU diplomats have so far been refused access to hearings despite continued efforts.
It is correct that EU diplomats, including Dutch diplomats, have not been granted access to court hearings since autumn 2018.
Het klopt dat EU-diplomaten, waaronder Nederlandse diplomaten, sinds het najaar van 2018 geen toegang hebben gekregen tot hoorzittingen van rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over bedrijven met banden met illegale Israëlische nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed it is undesirable that Dutch firms named by the UN human rights council have ties to illegal Israeli settlements, and whether he would press them to sever those ties. The government answered that settlement-related business activity is undesirable, but that companies bear their own responsibility under OECD guidelines and it is up to them to decide their activities, while the non-facilitation policy still applies.
It is then up to Dutch companies themselves to determine which activities they undertake and with which partners they cooperate.
Het is vervolgens aan Nederlandse bedrijven zelf om te bepalen welke activiteiten zij ontplooien en met welke partners zij samenwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over offensieve inzet van Afghaanse agenten in de periode 2011-2013

An SP MP asks the Prime Minister and the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the Chamber was misled about offensive deployment of Dutch-trained Afghan police in Kunduz (2011-2013), as a post-mission assessment suggests, and why the final evaluation did not report it. The minister replies that the government had always said it could not fully exclude incidental involvement of Afghan police in operations against the Taliban, that structural offensive use was not seen, and that the Chamber was informed of placement problems in 2012-2013.
The government could not and cannot fully exclude that incidentally Afghan civilian police could have been involved in military operations in Kunduz against the Taliban.
De regering kon en kan echter niet volledig uitsluiten dat incidenteel Afghaanse civiele agenten betrokken konden worden bij militaire operaties in Kunduz tegen de Taliban.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij bewapening Libië

An SP MP asked the government about Dutch involvement in arming Libyan factions, including ships sold by a Dutch intermediary and Damen Shipyards vessels later armed, and about possible prosecution and export permit misuse. The minister declined to comment on prosecutions, denied permit misuse since the unarmed ships needed no permit, and outlined reinforced monitoring of the Libya arms embargo.
The cabinet makes no statements about which cases are or are not investigated criminally.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over de vraag welke zaken al dan niet strafrechtelijk worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over openheid over gezondheidsrisico’s afvalverbranding op missies

MP Karabulut asks the Defence Minister why a 2008 risk assessment on waste burning (burn pits) at Tarin Kowt, which flagged health risks, was not disclosed in earlier answers, and why earlier health concerns were downplayed. The Minister answers that the 2008 report contained no new information, that air quality measurements showed no exceedance of health norms, and that the Chamber was informed in 2010-2011 and the relevant reports were made public.
Leading for me is that all relevant information is shared with the Chambers.
Leidend voor mij is dat alle relevante informatie wordt gedeeld met de Kamers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het zogeheten 'Istanboel 10'-proces

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the 'Istanbul 10' trial of eleven human rights defenders arrested in 2017, including concerns about fair trial and the use of Turkish anti-terror law. The minister answered that the Netherlands cannot judge individual prosecutions, monitors the hearings with EU partners, has raised the rule of law and fair trial with Turkey including in EU and UN settings, and continues to support civil society.
The Netherlands may and cannot, however, interfere in the legal proceedings in another state.
Nederland mag en kan zich echter niet mengen in de rechtsgang in een andere staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een in Turkije gevangengenomen Nederlandse vrouw

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch woman detained in Turkey who is reportedly on hunger strike, including her health, consular assistance, the reasons for her arrest, and fair-trial concerns. The minister declined to discuss the specific case for privacy reasons, described consular assistance in general terms, and only expressed general concern about Turkey's rule of law.
For privacy reasons and in line with the general framework for consular assistance, I cannot go further into the substantive aspects of this single case.
Uit privacy-overwegingen en in lijn met de algemene kaders voor consulaire bijstand kan ik niet verder ingaan op de inhoudelijke aspecten van deze ene zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over geweldpleging tegen een Pakistaanse blogger in Nederland

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether the government considers Pakistani state involvement in an assault on a Pakistani blogger in the Netherlands, and what it will do to protect him and summon the Pakistani ambassador. The minister answered that the police and prosecutor are investigating, that he cannot comment on individual cases or the outcome, and that the matter must await the investigation before further steps.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to investigate this report.
Het is aan de Politie en het Openbaar Ministerie om onderzoek te doen naar deze aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Karabulut over een bezoek aan het noorden van Marokko

MPs Marijnissen and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about political prisoners from the Hirak movement in northern Morocco, trials, torture allegations, detention conditions, development aid and migration. The minister said the Netherlands monitored trials, had raised concerns, and would not verify torture claims independently, and that it lacks data on many detainees and cannot take a position on the broader questions asked.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not keep track of how many detainees in Morocco are serving sentences for their participation in the Hirak movement, as they are not persons with Dutch nationality.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt niet bij hoeveel gedetineerden in Marokko een straf uitzitten naar aanleiding van hun deelname aan de Hirak-beweging, daar het geen personen met de Nederlandse nationaliteit betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over burgerslachtoffers door Nederlands optreden in de strijd tegen Islamitische Staat

MP Karabulut asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about civilian casualties from the Dutch bombing at Hawija in June 2015, including when officials were informed, whether information was withheld from parliament, and compensation. The government answers that the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister were informed only in general terms about secondary explosions and possible civilian harm without figures, that an ICRC list was not shared with parliament, that the OM investigation documents cannot be made public, and that compensation options and a progress letter are still being studied.
It was standing policy that for operational reasons and domestic security no statements were made about specific cases.
Het was staand beleid dat om operationele redenen en omwille van de binnenlandse veiligheid geen uitspraken werden gedaan over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het intrekken van perskaarten in Turkije

MPs from SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey revoked press cards of journalists from the paper Evrensel, whether this fits a pattern of state repression, and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey on press freedom. The minister answered that the Evrensel revocations were reversed, that Turkey has revoked nearly 3,804 press cards since 2015, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom concerns with Turkey at all levels, including with the Turkish foreign minister and within the EU and Council of Europe.
The Netherlands therefore continuously raises concerns about the lack of press freedom in Turkey with Turkey at all levels.
Nederland brengt daarom in contacten met Turkije voortdurend en op alle niveaus de zorgen over het gebrek aan persvrijheid in Turkije op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over vermeende “jarenlange misleiding over de oorlog in Afghanistan”

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether leaked US interviews showing repeated deception about the Afghanistan war, corruption, Afghan forces' readiness and progress, and the Dutch communication on it, were a concern. The government acknowledged the complexity and corruption problems, said the interviewees' views are personal, and admitted transparency and communication need improvement, referring to the post-mission review (PMB) Kunduz.
The cabinet underlines the importance of transparency about what does and does not go well in military and other deployments abroad.
Het kabinet onderstreept het belang van transparantie over wat er wel en niet goed gaat bij militaire en andere inzet in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over vernietiging van Europees gefinancierde projecten in Palestina

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's defence minister threatened to demolish EU-funded projects in occupied Palestinian territory, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government says the report is based on a closed briefing, cites Israel's obligations under occupation law, and says it demands compensation and seeks to prevent demolitions, without announcing sanctions.
The report is based on a closed briefing for the EU ambassadors by Minister Bennett.
Het bericht is gebaseerd op een besloten briefing voor de EU-ambassadeurs door Minister Bennett.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Amerikaanse luchtaanval op de internationale luchthaven van de Iraakse hoofdstad Bagdad, waarbij de Iraanse generaal Qassem Soleimani om het leven is gekomen

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the political consequences of the US strike at Baghdad airport that killed Qassem Soleimani, whether the government condemns it and its legality under international law, and whether the Hormuz naval deployment should be reconsidered. The ministers said Soleimani's militia role justified US concern but called for restraint, supported E3 dispute-settlement steps on the JCPOA, could not assess the US self-defence claim, and kept the EMASOH deployment while promising to inform parliament before departure if developments warrant.
If further developments give cause for this, they will be included in the letter that reaches your House before the Dutch frigate departs.
Indien verdere ontwikkelingen daartoe aanleiding geven, zullen deze worden meegenomen in de brief die uw Kamer toekomt, voor vertrek van het Nederlandse fregat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlands vetorecht in geval van inzet kernwapens

An SP MP asks whether the Netherlands has a veto over US nuclear weapon use, the legal basis for Dutch personnel's role, the 1992 nuclear accident agreement and the B61 modernisation. The ministers answer that NATO decisions require unanimity so Dutch consent is always needed, but refuse details on locations, procedures and the agreement citing security and NATO confidentiality obligations.

Regarding the number and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe, as well as the precise procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear task, no information can be provided, based on allied and legally binding agreements.

Over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens, alsmede de precieze procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over door CENTCOM erkende burgerslachtoffers in Irak en Syrië

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the 1,346 civilian deaths acknowledged by CENTCOM in Iraq and Syria are confirmed, whether they include the Dutch strikes at Hawija and Mosul, and how the figures were verified. The minister answered that CENTCOM counts 1,347 confirmed civilian deaths, that the Hawija deaths were never confirmed and are excluded, and that the Mosul deaths (four) are included as credible.
The most recent monthly report of December 2 estimates that at least 1,347 civilian casualties resulted from actions of the anti-ISIS coalition.
In het meest recente maandelijkse overzicht van december 2 wordt ingeschat dat er ten minste 1.347 burgerslachtoffers te betreuren zijn ten gevolge van acties van de anti-ISIS coalitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en De Roon over een rapport over mensenrechtenschendingen in het noorden van Syrië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a Human Rights Watch report on abuses by Turkish-backed Syrian National Army forces in northern Syria, including whether Turkey is responsible and whether former Dutch non-lethal aid reached groups fighting with Turkey and the Syrian Kurds. The minister says Turkey bears responsibility, that Nederland raises this with Turkey, that the groups concerned cannot be named publicly, and that it cannot exclude that Dutch-supplied vehicle parts were used in Operation Peace Spring.
Because the names of the moderate armed groups previously supported by the Netherlands could be traced, this cannot be addressed publicly here.
In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de namen van de gematigde gewapende groepen die voorheen door Nederland gesteund zijn kan hier in het openbaar niet op in worden gegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over berichten over marteling van protestleider Zafzafi in Marokko

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of torture of imprisoned Rif protest leader Nasser Zafzafi in Morocco, whether solitary confinement was imposed on prisoners for leaking audio, and whether the government would press for independent investigation and release. The minister said the reports give cause for concern but he has no independent information, that Morocco's own authorities and national human rights council should investigate, and that Morocco is aware of Dutch positions while a cassation appeal is pending.
It is in the first place up to the authorities in Morocco themselves to investigate in response to these reports.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de autoriteiten in Marokko zelf om onderzoek te doen naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een luchtaanval op Mosul, Irak, waarbij vier burgers werden gedood

MPs Karabulut asked about a 2015 Mosul airstrike, attributed to the Netherlands, that killed four civilians, including why it took so long to acknowledge responsibility, why the coalition's investigations and CENTCOM reports are not shared, and whether compensation is available. The minister answered that Dutch involvement was reported to CENTCOM, that the targeting was judged lawful at the time, that CENTCOM reports are US-classified, that secrecy was needed for security reasons until recently, and that a voluntary compensation proposal will be sent to parliament.
The Netherlands therefore cannot unilaterally make these reports public.
Nederland kan deze rapporten dan ook niet eenzijdig openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over beleggingen in wapenproducerende bedrijven die exporteren naar Turkije

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the partial arms-export embargo on Turkey affects the 631 million euro in loans and investments by ING, ABN Amro and Van Lanschot in eleven arms-supplying firms, whether banks should be pressed to divest, and about progress on a thematic framework and talks with banks. Minister Kaag answered that the embargo has no direct effect on banks, that banks decide themselves under the UNGP and OECD guidelines, that a thematic framework is being developed by the insurance-sector convention parties and is not yet finished, and that the government will share it with banks once ready.
Banks and investors make their own assessment of whether to invest in or provide financing to the defence industry.
Banken en investeerders maken hun eigen afweging of zij beleggen in of financiering verlenen aan de defensie-industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Karabulut, Van Oijk en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Israëlisch hooggerechtshof keurt uitzetting HRW-directeur goed'

MPs from PvdA, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked how the government responds to the Israeli Supreme Court's approval of the expulsion of Human Rights Watch director Omar Shakir, and whether it fears this chills civil society and human rights defenders. The minister says the government raised concerns with the Israeli ambassador and at senior official level, its embassy monitored the hearings, and the EU urged Israel to reverse the decision.

Because of the government's and the EU's concern about increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, and specifically this case, the Minister of Foreign Affairs emphatically raised concerns about this threatened expulsion with the Israeli ambassador on 7 November.

Vanwege de bezorgdheid van het kabinet en de EU over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, en specifiek deze zaak, heeft de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met de Israëlische ambassadeur op 7 november jl. de zorgen over deze dreigende uitzetting nadrukkelijk opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de besluitvorming over geheimhouding burgerslachtoffers in Irak in 2015

The MPs asked how and when ministers were informed of civilian casualties in the 2015 Dutch air operation at Hawija, Iraq, whether the matter was discussed in ministerial sub-councils, and whether the Prime Minister was involved in keeping it secret. The Defence Minister answered that ministers were briefed in June 2015 on the basis of the After Action Report, that civilian casualties remain unconfirmed, that no decision to keep the facts secret was ever taken, and that the matter was not specifically discussed in the relevant sub-councils.
No, such a decision has never been taken.
Nee, van een dergelijke beslissing is nooit sprake geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een passage uit het boek Missie F-16 over mogelijke burgerslachtoffers in Irak

An SP MP asks the defence and foreign ministers about a reported Dutch F-16 strike in Iraq at Christmas 2014 that may have hit civilians, and why it was never reported to parliament, and asks whether other unreported strikes exist. The minister answers that analysts doubted civilian harm at the time, it was quickly ruled out, CENTCOM investigated and found none, and that all reported Dutch cases with possible civilian harm have been disclosed to parliament.
The Ministry of Defence therefore saw no reason to launch an investigation into this case.
Het Ministerie van Defensie zag daarom geen aanleiding om een onderzoek in te stellen naar dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de situatie in Chili

Three MPs asked the Dutch Foreign Minister about the protests in Chile, including excessive police force, deaths and mass arrests, and whether the government had condemned the violence and raised concerns with the Chilean counterpart. The minister condemned violence on all sides, said the government shares UN concerns and awaits the OHCHR investigation and the national human rights institute's review before considering further steps.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of the OHCHR investigation before considering possible steps.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomst van het OHCHR-onderzoek af, alvorens mogelijke stappen te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een Nederlandse luchtaanval in Irak waarbij tientallen burgerslachtoffers zouden zijn gevallen

An MP from the SP asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about a Dutch airstrike in Hawija, Iraq in June 2015 that reportedly killed around seventy civilians, asking whether the Chamber was misinformed, whether targeting was careful, whether compensation was paid, whether the OM investigated, and whether other strikes were withheld. The Defence minister answered that the Chamber was informed in 2018 without exact details due to an ongoing operation, that the strike caused unintended collateral damage, that the targeting process was careful, that no victims claimed Dutch compensation, and that the OM found no reason for prosecution, promising a further letter on transparency.
In my letter of 4 November 2019 (reference BS2019018779) on the feasibility of greater transparency about possible civilian casualties from air strikes, I will elaborate on the reasons
In mijn brief van 4 november 2019 (referentie BS2019018779) over de haalbaarheid van meer transparantie over mogelijke burgerslachtoffers bij luchtaanvallen, ga ik nader in op de redenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de aanwezigheid van een Nederlandse militaire functionaris bij een militaire conferentie in Saoedi-Arabië

MP Karabulut asked the Defence Minister whether a Dutch military official attended a Saudi-hosted military conference on 21 October 2019 about military aid to Saudi Arabia, why the Netherlands accepted, and what was requested and agreed. The minister answered that no Dutch military official attended, only an embassy secretary as observer, that no Dutch commitments were made, and that the conference produced no concrete results beyond Saudi information-sharing.
During the international conference in Saudi Arabia on 21 October, no Dutch military official was present.
Tijdens de internationale conferentie in Saoedi-Arabië van 21 oktober jl. was geen Nederlandse militaire functionaris aanwezig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over samenwerking tussen scheepsbouwer Damen en de Nederlandse staat naar aanleiding interne memo’s op het gebied van een corruptieaffaire bij Damen

An SP MP asked the state secretaries whether Damen breached anti-corruption rules after incorrect information on agent payments in 14 cases, whether such conduct is systematic, whether Damen should be excluded from Atradius DSB guarantees, and whether corruption should weigh in the submarine tender. The government declined to judge while the criminal investigation runs, described corrective measures (reassessed cases, lifted World Bank listing, enhanced supervision), and saw no reason to exclude Damen from guarantees or the tender.
Because a criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about that.
Omdat er nog sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik daar geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de militarisering van Europa’s Afrikabeleid

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether European security and military firms shape EU migration policy, whether drone surveillance has replaced rescue ships, and whether the Mali UN mission has worked, among other questions. The government rejected the premise that arms firms drive migration policy, said no causal link was shown between drones and reduced sea rescue, and defended its Mali engagement and restrictive arms export policy.

The picture that European military and security companies, including through the European Organisation for Security, have played a dominant and determining role in shaping European migration policy is not recognised by the cabinet.

Het beeld dat Europese militaire en beveiligingsbedrijven, onder andere via de European Organisation for Security, een dwingende en bepalende rol hebben gespeeld bij het vormgeven van het Europese migratiebeleid wordt door het kabinet niet herkend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over bloedvergieten op Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about deadly violence in Wamena, Papua, on 23 September 2019, the Indonesian demonstration ban, the end of the Dutch contribution to the Community Policing Programme, and Dutch diplomatic efforts. The minister answered that the causes and casualty breakdown remain unclear, described the programme's results, and said Dutch diplomacy on Papua continues at ministerial and senior official level.
The cabinet closely follows developments in Papua and gives priority to raising these developments as a standing item with the Indonesian authorities.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Papua nauwgezet, en geeft er prioriteit aan deze ontwikkelingen als vast onderdeel bij de Indonesische autoriteiten aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de veroordeling van een wetenschapper in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction in Turkey of scientist Bülent Şık for publishing a cancer-risk study, and whether the Netherlands would press for annulment and dispute that the trial was fair. The minister confirmed the facts of the conviction but said the Netherlands does not interfere in other countries' legal proceedings while the case is open, though it raises rule-of-law concerns with Turkey regularly.
The Netherlands does not interfere in the legal proceedings of other countries.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Karabulut over Marokkaanse journaliste die veroordeeld is vanwege een abortus

MPs Ploumen and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of Moroccan journalist Hajar Raissouni for illegal abortion and sex outside marriage, and whether the Netherlands would act for her release and for women's access to safe abortion. The minister said the Netherlands supports sexual and reproductive rights broadly but does not fund specific abortion programmes in Morocco, noted that clemency had been granted to Raissouni, her doctor and her partner, and declined to speculate on motives or raise the case with his Moroccan counterpart.
I therefore see no reason to discuss this with my counterpart.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om hierover in gesprek te treden met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij een cyberaanval tegen Iran

MP Karabulut asked the ministers whether the Netherlands was involved in the Stuxnet cyberattack on Iran, how decisions were made, whether parliament was informed, and how the operation relates to international law. The minister neither confirmed nor denied Dutch involvement, citing the duty to protect sources and secrecy, and declined to give substantive answers to most questions while stating the IAEA supervised Natanz in 2007.
Given the nature of the AIVD's work and its methods, and because of the statutory duty to protect sources, I cannot respond substantively to alleged Dutch involvement.
Gezien de aard van het werk en de werkwijze van de AIVD en vanwege de wettelijke plicht tot bescherming van bronnen, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Ploumen, Voordewind, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Jaar na dood Khashoggi: zaken doen met de kroonprins kan weer’

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's incomplete accountability for the killing of Jamal Khashoggi, the crown prince's responsibility, pressure for openness, trade missions, sanctions and attending the G20. The minister answered that the Saudi account remains incomplete, that the Netherlands keeps pressing bilaterally and in UN and EU fora, that no government-led trade missions are planned, and that sanctions lack international consensus while an EU human rights sanctions regime is being pursued.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over het bezoek van premier Rutte aan Indonesië

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the topics of Rutte's visit to Indonesia, including the military crackdown in Papua, and whether the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights would be invited to Papua. The government answered that human rights and Papua were discussed, that the Netherlands urged a prompt UN visit, and that the visit is now up to the UN and Indonesian authorities to arrange.
The aim of this conversation was to stress that dialogue and restraint are important to reach a lasting solution.
De inzet van dit gesprek was te benadrukken dat dialoog en terughoudendheid belangrijk zijn om tot een duurzame oplossing te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over hulp aan veteranen die lijden aan PTSS

MP Karabulut (SP) asked the Defence Minister what concrete steps will improve veterans' PTSS care, whether the Thuisbasis Veteranen in Eelde's experiences warrant new measures, and how the duty of care applies to veterans who avoid care or are homeless. The minister replied that the existing care system is sound with ongoing improvements, that no new measures are needed, that Defence has no oversight of care-avoiders, and that the Thuisbasis is a civilian institution outside Defence's system.
Neither Defence nor anyone else has insight into the numbers of veterans who avoid care or wander about.
Defensie noch anderen hebben zicht op de aantallen veteranen die zorg mijden dan wel rondzwerven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over openheid over betrokkenheid van bedrijven bij illegale Israëlische nederzettingen

MP Karabulut asked whether the government would press for publication of the UN database of businesses active in Israeli settlements, given NGO calls for openness and the delay in publication.
