The minister confirms the 2016 Human Rights Council mandate, says the Netherlands opposed the database but will not press for its publication, leaving implementation to the High Commissioner.
The Netherlands will therefore not press for publication of the database in question.
Nederland zal derhalve niet aandringen op publicatie van de betreffende database.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, en Van Raan over een aanval op de democratie in Turkije

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's removal of elected HDP and CHP mayors and appointment of state supervisors, and whether the Netherlands and EU would condemn it and what consequences would follow. The minister answered that the government shares EU and Council of Europe concerns, supports the EU's public statements, raises the issue bilaterally, and backed halting accession talks, though that proposal lacked support and talks have stalled.
The government does not have precise figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over precieze aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inbeslagname van een vrachtschip door zowel Groot-Brittannië als Iran

MP Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the seizure of the tanker Grace I by Britain and Iran's response, including Panama's deregistration, the legality under UNCLOS, US sanctions pressure, and a possible European maritime mission in the Gulf. The minister answered that the UK's account was not doubted, that Netherlands is studying a possible contribution to maritime security in Hormuz, and that it favours a diplomatic approach to Iran, though many questions were answered only in general terms.
Once the study gives reason to do so, the House will be informed further.
Zodra het onderzoek daartoe aanleiding geeft zal de Kamer nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bezoek van de Minister-President aan de Verenigde Staten en de hoogopgelopen spanningen tussen de Verenigde Staten en Iran

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would raise concerns about rising US-Iran tensions during his visit to the United States, what topics would be discussed, whether the Netherlands would warn against war, and whether it would seek de-escalation via international channels. The government answered that the Prime Minister spoke with President Trump on 18 July, discussed bilateral relations, trade, defence and Iran including a US request on the Strait of Hormuz, and that the Netherlands calls for de-escalation and supports EU diplomatic efforts while urging Iran to respect the nuclear deal.
The Netherlands regularly calls on all parties involved, both bilaterally and multilaterally, to de-escalate tensions in the Gulf and around the nuclear agreement.
Nederland roept met regelmaat alle betrokken partijen, zowel in bilaterale als in multilaterale gelegenheden, op tot de-escalatie van spanningen in de Golf en rond het nucleaire akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een vluchtelingenkamp in het noorden van Irak

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkish airstrikes hit the Makhmur refugee camp in northern Iraq and that local authorities imposed movement restrictions, and whether Turkey's actions and the restrictions were lawful and consistent with refugee rights. The minister said Turkey reported strikes in the wider Karacok area without confirming any attack on the camp, that residents retain movement within Ninewa and medical access to Erbil, that the Netherlands is concerned and urges Turkey to respect international law, and that the government lacks sufficient information to judge compliance with the refugee convention.
The cabinet has insufficient information on which to judge whether the conditions in the Makhmur camp can be qualified as contrary to the UN Refugee Convention.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende informatie op basis waarvan de omstandigheden in kamp Makhmur wel of niet gekwalificeerd kunnen worden als zijnde in strijd met het VN-vluchtelingenverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Karabulut over de groeiende angst onder activisten om naar Marokko te gaan

Two MPs (Ploumen, Karabulut) asked whether the government is aware of fear among activists about travelling to Morocco, whether signals of insecurity were received, and whether a complaints point or stronger action is warranted. The minister replied that travel decisions are personal, no signals of increased insecurity were received, consular help is available, and the Rif cities carry a yellow travel advisory with no reason yet for stronger action.
Neither the Ministry of Foreign Affairs nor the embassy has received signals of increased insecurity.
Er zijn noch bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken noch bij de ambassade signalen binnen gekomen over toegenomen onveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de in beslagname van een vrachtschip door zowel Groot-Brittannië als Iran

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the UK seizure of an Iranian tanker at Gibraltar and the Iranian seizure of a British tanker, including whether these seizures were lawful under UNCLOS and EU sanctions. The minister relayed the UK position, rejected an independent inquiry, and said Netherlands is studying a possible contribution to maritime security in the Strait of Hormuz.
I see no reason for an independent investigation. I have no reason to question the UK's account.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een onafhankelijk onderzoek. Ik heb geen reden om de lezing van het VK in twijfel te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ‘een mogelijke nieuwe illegale militaire interventie door Turkije in het noorden van Syrië’

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey is preparing an illegal military intervention in northern Syria, whether the government shares concerns about it, whether the minister will raise this with Turkish counterparts, and whether sanctions will be pursued in the EU and NATO. The minister answered that Turkey has massed troops at the border but there are no signs of concrete offensive preparations, that talks with the US on a safe zone continue, that legality cannot be judged in advance, and that the Netherlands has raised Syria with Turkey bilaterally without committing to sanctions.
In advance, no judgment can be made on the lawfulness of possible action.
Op voorhand valt geen uitspraak te doen over de rechtmatigheid van mogelijk optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de sloop van gebouwen door Israël in gebieden deels onder bestuur van de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister about Israel's demolition of Palestinian buildings near a barrier in East Jerusalem, some in areas under Palestinian Authority planning control, and whether the Netherlands will condemn it and pursue measures. The minister condemns the demolition, notes the Israeli Supreme Court departs from the ICJ's 2004 advisory opinion, and says the Netherlands has joined EU and UN Security Council statements calling for restraint without ruling out any EU policy instruments.
The cabinet condemns this demolition and is concerned that more buildings will be demolished in this neighbourhood and in other parts of the West Bank.
Het kabinet veroordeelt deze sloop en is bezorgd dat er nog meer gebouwen zullen worden gesloopt in deze buurt en op andere delen van de Westelijke Jordaanoever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de zorgelijke situatie van Aramese christenen in zuidoost Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Aramean Christians in southeast Turkey, including arson at three sites, and whether Turkish authorities protect minorities and whether the Netherlands will press for an investigation. The minister answered that the embassy has raised the arson with Turkish authorities at high level, that the Turkish authorities are responsible for investigating, and that the Netherlands will keep raising minority rights with Turkey.
It is now for the Turkish authorities to investigate the mentioned fires.
Het is nu aan de Turkse autoriteiten om de genoemde branden te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over een rapport over beleggingen in wapenproductie en wapenhandel

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked the ministers whether Dutch banks ING, ABN AMRO and Van Lanschot Kempen investing in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt is compatible with Dutch arms export policy, and whether the IMVO banking covenant and the government should act. The government answered that banks are individually responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines and UN principles, that export licensing is a national competence, and that it would not ban such investments or add covenant commitments.
The cabinet therefore does not consider it necessary to prohibit the said investments.
Het kabinet acht het verbieden van de genoemde investeringen daarom niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Van der  Staaij over het Nederlandse kind Duncan en de Spaanse kinderbescherming

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the case of a Dutch child with Down syndrome held under Spanish child protection and whether he should be reunited with his mother quickly. The minister said the matter falls to the competent Spanish authority, that the ministry is following the case and has mediated contact, and withheld case details citing data protection.
For reasons of personal data protection, I cannot give your House any details about the individual case.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming kan ik uw Kamer geen details geven over de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de samenwerking tussen scheepsbouwer Damen en de Nederlandse staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries and Foreign Minister about Atradius export-credit insurance for shipbuilder Damen, alleged fraud and irregularities, and whether the submarine replacement decision should wait for clarity on Damen. The government confirmed 67 policies worth 1.89 billion euro, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and said suspicion of fraud is not grounds for exclusion from tender under the Defence procurement law.
Because this case involves an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide further statements on this.
Omdat er in deze casus sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik daar geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen, Van den Hul, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht ‘IND stuurt yezidi’s terug naar kampen in Noord-Irak, VN ongerust’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Iraqi Yezidis are being returned to camps in Northern Iraq despite UNHCR concern, and whether Kurdish camps can absorb them. The State Secretary answered that Yezidis from other parts of Iraq who fled to the Kurdistan Region and lived there long-term are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, so the vulnerable minority policy applies, and that the Kurdish shelter situation is not generally inadequate.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over gelekte documenten aangaande smerige politiek in Brazilië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether leaked documents showing alleged political manipulation of Lula's conviction in Brazil were known, how they were assessed, and what they say about judicial independence. The minister acknowledged the reports and described the parliamentary hearing and Supreme Court proceedings, stating that it is for the Brazilian legal system to reach a judgment.
It is for the Brazilian legal system to reach a legal judgment on the alleged statements of Mr. Sergio Moro.
Het is aan het Braziliaanse rechtssysteem om tot een juridisch oordeel te komen over de al dan niet vermeende uitlatingen van dhr. Sergio Moro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een gelekt document van de OPCW over een chemische aanval in Syrië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a leaked internal OPCW document suggesting doubts about the official findings on the 2018 chemical attack in Douma, Syria, and whether it was withheld. The minister confirmed the internal report exists, said the OPCW considered its contents, that independent ballistic analyses supported the official conclusion, and that the Netherlands has no reason to doubt the official report.
It is correct that an internal OPCW report exists on the poison gas attack in Douma on 7 April 2018, with findings that partly deviate from those included in the official OPCW FFM report.

Het klopt dat er een OPCW-intern rapport bestaat over de gifgasaanval in Douma op 7 april 2018 met bevindingen die deels afwijken van de bevindingen die door de Fact Finding Mission (FFM) van de Organisatie voor het Verbod op Chemische Wapens (OPCW) zijn opgenomen in het officiële OPCW-FFM rapport
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over geweld tegen demonstranten in Soedan

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the deadly violence against protesters in Sudan, whether he shares calls for targeted sanctions and a handover of power to civilians. Minister Blok confirmed over 100 deaths, said he had voiced concerns and urged a civilian transition, and described EU and African Union steps including a call for sanctions to be considered if violence escalates.
The Netherlands advocates an active supporting role for the EU in the run-up to and during the transition process in Sudan.
Nederland pleit voor een actieve ondersteunende rol van de EU in aanloop naar en tijdens het transitieproces in Soedan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de mogelijke executie van een Saudische tiener

The MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister about the possible execution of a Saudi teenager who was arrested as a child for protesting, and whether Saudi Arabia executes people arrested as minors, and asks the government to protest and consider targeted sanctions. The minister answers that the youth was sentenced to 12 years rather than death, the Netherlands and EU have raised concerns and will follow the appeal, there are no official figures on such executions, and sanctions lack the required international political consensus.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the case.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het gebruik van geweld tegen demonstranten in Pakistan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the use of force against Pashtun activists in North Waziristan, the arrest of MP Ali Wazir, calls for independent investigation, and whether the Netherlands would raise concerns with Pakistan. The minister confirmed the reports (casualty figures disputed), said Pakistani authorities are responsible for investigating, and said the Netherlands raises rule-of-law concerns bilaterally and the EU will raise the Pashtun movement's suppression at a 25 June meeting.
The government is of the view that the Pakistani authorities have the responsibility to investigate the circumstances of the violence.
De regering is van mening dat de Pakistaanse autoriteiten de verantwoordelijkheid hebben de toedracht van het geweld te onderzoeken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over maatregelen tegen Amerikaanse sancties tegen Iran

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked whether the EU anti-boycott regulation against US sanctions on Iran is effective and whether the US sanctions are unlawful, and what steps can protect the JCPOA and trade with Iran. The ministers answered that the regulation is in place but unused by Dutch firms, that INSTEX is being developed, that Dutch firms decide independently to cut trade, and that the Netherlands remains committed to the JCPOA.
The cabinet has no figures on the trading activities of individual Dutch companies with Iran.
Het kabinet heeft geen cijfers over de handelsactiviteiten van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven met Iran.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat een Nederlandse strafrechtadvocaat de toegang tot de Verenigde Staten geweigerd wordt

SP MPs asked the government whether it would act after reports that a Dutch criminal lawyer representing terrorism suspects was denied entry to the United States, and how US authorities obtained that information. The minister said advocates must be free to practise, that the US decides its own entry criteria and gave no individual explanation, that the government raised the matter with US authorities and will monitor it, and that the Dutch government shares no information about such lawyers with the US.
Enquiries with the American authorities show that an application for an ESTA or visa is assessed against many different criteria.
Navraag bij de Amerikaanse autoriteiten leert dat een aanvraag voor een ESTA of visum wordt getoetst aan de hand van vele verschillende criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het gebruik van chroom-6 houdende verf bij de krijgsmacht

An MP asks the State Secretary of Defence whether the labour inspectorate's critical findings on chromium-6 paint use in the armed forces are acknowledged, what measures will tighten control and when chromium-6 use will end. The State Secretary accepts the inspection's findings, attributes responsibility to local commanders, and points to an improvement plan with deadlines running to 2020-2022, while stating that full phase-out is not yet possible.
Of course we take the violations seriously, want to solve them and prevent them in the future.
Uiteraard trekken we ons de overtredingen aan, willen we deze oplossen en in de toekomst voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Van Ojik en Karabulut over vervolging van de Palestijnse mensenrechtenverdediger Issa Amro

MPs Van den Hul, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the government about prosecutions of Palestinian human rights defender Issa Amro by Palestinian and Israeli authorities, including criticism of Amnesty and Front Line Defenders reports and whether the EU and the Netherlands support him. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concern over shrinking civic space, urges both authorities to respect free expression and drop charges covered by that right, and that the EU and member states have attended hearings, with the next hearing set for 22 May.
The EU and the Netherlands both follow the two legal cases against Amro closely, including by attending hearings.
De EU en Nederland volgen beide rechtszaken tegen Amro nauwgezet, onder andere door het bijwonen van hoorzittingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de arrestatie en mogelijke uitlevering van WikiLeaks oprichter Julian Assange

MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister why Julian Assange was arrested in the UK, whether a US extradition request is involved, and whether the US charges threaten press freedom, along with related questions on Swedish proceedings, Afghanistan/Iraq disclosures, Amnesty concerns and Dutch advocacy against extradition. The minister answers that the UK arrest followed a failure to surrender to court on a Swedish request, that a provisional US extradition request for computer intrusion has been filed, that Sweden's case may be reopened, and that the Netherlands does not intervene in other states' prosecution policy or the UK legal process.
The Netherlands does not interfere in other countries' considerations regarding prosecution policy.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de overwegingen van andere landen omtrent het vervolgingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Saoedi-Arabië executeert 37 gevangenen om terrorisme’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Saudi Arabia's execution of 37 prisoners convicted of terrorism, including the use of the 2014 counterterrorism law against activists and critics, and whether sanctions were considered. The minister condemned the executions, said Nederland opposes the death penalty and raised concerns in EU and UN settings, but stated that sanctions lack the required international political consensus and gave no concrete new measures.
Imposing sanctions requires broad international political agreement.
Voor het instellen van sancties is internationaal brede politieke overeenstemming nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

An SP MP asked why the Landentabel in the Basisregistratie Personen no longer allows the name '(bezet) Palestijns gebied' and why people born there may be registered as born in Israel. The State Secretary replied that the name does not fit the Landentabel's systematics as an administrative/state list, so 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' will be used, with a change planned for 1 July 2019 and a registration option for affected persons.
An effort is being made to have the change take effect on 1 July 2019.
Er wordt naar gestreefd om de wijziging op 1 juli 2019 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘It Wasn’t Just Khashoggi: A Saudi Prince’s Brutal Drive to Crush Dissent’

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a Saudi intervention team targeting dissidents, Saudi human rights abuses, detention conditions and the arrest of women's rights activists. The minister could not confirm the intervention team, said Dutch concerns are raised bilaterally and multilaterally including a joint UN statement, and noted that embassy access to trials had been refused four times.
I cannot provide any information on the exact content of these contacts with partners.
Over de exacte inhoud van deze contacten met partners kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over bemoeienis vanuit Turkije met een slijter in Den Haag

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Turkish interference with a Hague liquor shop over the name 'Rumi', and what he would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands allows freedom of expression and product naming within the law, that the ambassador responded to the Konya mayor's letter, and that the Dutch position was clear enough without further contact with Turkish counterparts.
The cabinet is aware of the reporting concerned.
Het kabinet is bekend met de betreffende berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de arrestatie van een 9-jarige Palestijn

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of a 9-year-old Palestinian boy at his school by Israeli troops, and about how common such arrests are and whether Israel should be pressed to guarantee safe schools. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises children's rights with Israel bilaterally, multilaterally and through the EU, and that the Dutch embassy leads an EU working group on the issue, without committing to a new concrete step.
The Netherlands plays a leading role in protecting the rights of Palestinian minors in Israeli detention.
Nederland speelt een voortrekkersrol bij de bescherming van de rechten van minderjarige Palestijnen in Israëlische detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mensenrechten in Iran gruwelijk geschonden’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the deteriorating human rights situation in Iran, including executions, harsh crackdowns, the morality police and the appointment of Ebrahim Raisi as head of the judiciary. The minister answered that the government shares concerns, raises them multilaterally, bilaterally and through the EU, but does not comment on appointments in other countries.
The cabinet does not concern itself with appointments in other countries.
Het kabinet gaat niet over benoemingen in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over veroordelingen van activisten in de Rif

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked whether the minister would condemn the upheld prison sentences against Rif activists in Morocco, call for their release, and summon the Moroccan ambassador. The minister said the Netherlands has already expressed its view in earlier letters, raised the matter during visits, and sees no purpose in summoning the ambassador, while noting cassation remains possible.
I do not consider it opportune to summon the Moroccan ambassador over this issue.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om de Marokkaanse ambassadeur over deze kwestie te ontbieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over de mogelijke invoering van twee wetten in Guatemala

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether he shares concerns about Guatemalan bills 5377 (amnesty for wartime crimes 1990-1996) and 5257 (stricter rules for NGOs), and what their status is. The minister shares the concerns, reports that the Netherlands raised them bilaterally, in an EU High Representative statement and with donors, and says the bills are pending a third reading with uncertain timing.
Yes, I am aware of the concerns of human rights organisations and UN experts about laws no. 5377 and no. 5257. I indeed share these concerns.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de zorgen van mensenrechtenorganisaties en VN-experts over de wetten nr. 5377 en nr. 5257. Ik deel deze zorgen inderdaad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over maatschappelijk verantwoord investeren door levensverzekeraars en andere institutionele beleggers

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked whether Minister Kaag discussed the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights with insurers, whether she raised arms trade investment, and whether stricter monitoring is warranted. The minister answered that the talks covered controversial weapons within the IMVO insurance covenant, that a working group will develop due diligence questions, and that tightening the covenant is not currently warranted.
Additional agreements on monitoring the application of the UNGPs do not seem appropriate so soon after the covenant was signed.
Aanvullende afspraken met betrekking tot de monitoring van de toepassing van de UNGP's liggen zo kort na de ondertekening van het convenant niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'It Wasn’t Just Khashoggi: A Saudi Prince’s Brutal Drive to Crush Dissent'

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister how he views reports of a Saudi intervention team allegedly surveilling, detaining and torturing dissidents, whether he has information on secret detention sites, and what concerns he has about pre-trial detention. The minister said the reports cannot be confirmed, that Netherlands shares concern about the human rights situation and has raised it bilaterally and in the UN Human Rights Council, and that the Netherlands has no independent information on secret detention sites.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot confirm the reporting about the existence of the said intervention team.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan de berichtgeving over het bestaan van het genoemde interventieteam niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over doorvoer van munitie naar de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten

An SP MP asked the minister whether transit of about 57 million 9mm cartridges from Czechia through the Netherlands to the UAE, despite the Netherlands' tightened policy on Yemen-involved states, was permitted without Dutch review and how it passed EU criteria. The minister answered that transit without transhipment from an ally is not licensable in the Netherlands, so Dutch authorities did not assess it, that Dutch policy would likely have blocked a comparable shipment, and that the government will press EU partners to adopt similar restrictions.
Transit shipments without transhipment originating from an ally are however not subject to a licence requirement, so responsibility for the assessment is not assigned to the Netherlands.
Doorvoerzendingen zonder overlading afkomstig van een bondgenoot zijn echter niet vergunningplichtig, waardoor de verantwoordelijkheid voor de toetsing niet bij Nederland is belegd

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de krimpende bewegingsruimte, democratische vrijheden en veiligheid van mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about threats to human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, including an Israeli UN envoy's insult to B'Tselem, a law affecting Breaking the Silence, and the deportation order against Human Rights Watch's Omar Shakir. The government answered that it shares concern about intimidation and shrinking civic space, has protested at the UN and bilaterally, and will keep raising the issues with Israeli and Palestinian authorities together with the EU.

The government, together with the EU, is concerned about the increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, partly caused by bills that restrict the space of civil society organisations.

Het kabinet is, samen met de EU, bezorgd over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, mede veroorzaakt door wetsvoorstellen die de ruimte van maatschappelijke organisaties beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de veroordeling van Nasrin Sotoudeh in Iran

MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the sentence of 33 years and 148 lashes given to Iranian lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh, whether it is condemned as punishment for peaceful activism, and whether he will call for her release with Iranian and EU counterparts. The minister answers that the cabinet is shocked, has publicly voiced concern, supported an EU statement calling for review, and will keep urging Iran to respect her rights while her appeal is pending.
As I also stated during the General Consultation on the Foreign Affairs Council of 14 March, I publicly expressed my concerns about the conviction of Nasrin Sotoudeh.
Zoals ik ook stelde tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken van 14 maart heb ik publiekelijk mijn zorgen uitgesproken over de veroordeling van Nasrin Sotoudeh
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Ojik over een hongerstaking in Turkije

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked about a hunger strike in Turkey by MP Leyla Güven and others, the demands of the strikers, and the number of political prisoners and Dutch efforts for their release. The minister said the situation is critical according to contacts, that the government takes no position on the demands, that it lacks reliable figures on political prisoners, and that it raises rule-of-law and fair-trial concerns with Turkey.
The cabinet does not have reliable figures on the number of political prisoners in Turkey.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over betrouwbare cijfers wat betreft het aantal politieke gevangen in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over het uitzetten van een journalist door Marokko

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about the expulsion of a Dutch journalist from Morocco, the reasons given, and whether the government would press Morocco on press freedom and the health of an imprisoned Rif protest leader. The minister answered that the journalist lacked accreditation as Morocco legally allows, that a French journalist was expelled for the same reason in 2018, that press freedom is raised bilaterally, and that the appeals and the ambassador's monitoring continue, while the detainee's health reportedly is relatively good.
I see no reason to do so.
Daar zie ik geen reden toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een rapport over het geweld vorig jaar aan de grens met Gaza

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister for his reaction to a UN report finding that Israel likely violated international law and committed war crimes in using lethal force against protesters at the Gaza border, and asked whether he would condemn Israel and press it to follow the report's recommendations. The minister's answer was a referral to a separate letter on a motion by another MP, so the questions were not answered on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over spanningen tussen Pakistan en India

An MP asked the foreign and trade ministers whether the Netherlands had responded to the India-Pakistan clashes over Kashmir, what would end the conflict, whether Dutch arms exports to both countries should be halted, and whether the tensions justify action on nuclear weapons. The ministers replied that the Netherlands and the EU called for de-escalation, that arms exports are assessed case by case without a moratorium or embargo, and that they would not sign the nuclear weapons ban treaty.
The Netherlands voted against the text of the nuclear weapons ban treaty.
Nederland heeft tegen de tekst van het kernwapenverbodsverdrag gestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over toeristische bedrijven die verdienen aan illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An MP asked the government whether it condemns online booking firms such as Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia and TripAdvisor for offering accommodation in Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory, and whether it would discourage such trade and ban settlement goods. The ministers answered that companies are responsible for their own human rights due diligence, that the government does not support import bans on settlement goods, and that it discourages economic ties with settlement businesses while Booking.com has agreed to label settlement listings.
The cabinet, in line with the EU, is not in favour of an import ban on goods from settlements or measures leading to a boycott of these goods.
Het kabinet is, in lijn met de EU, geen voorstander van een importverbod van goederen uit nederzettingen of maatregelen die leiden tot een boycot van deze goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over klachten over asbest in Nederlandse basis in Litouwen

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Defence Minister whether Defence knows of complaints about asbestos among Dutch soldiers at the Rukla base in Lithuania, how these complaints are handled, and whether an competent inspection service will investigate and the recommendations will be implemented. The answer refers the questions to a separate letter responding to a request from MP Kerstens about the same asbestos reports, rather than answering them directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het vertrek van VN-gezant Patrick Cammaert uit Jemen

Three MPs asked the ministers about the early departure of UN envoy Patrick Cammaert from Yemen, the stalled Hodeidah ceasefire and redeployment talks, humanitarian effects and Houthi refusal to negotiate. The ministers confirmed the short mandate was known, reported that the ceasefire largely holds despite delays, outlined humanitarian funding and ongoing contacts with the UN and EU, and gave limited detail on the Crisis Group report and Houthi motives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het (mogelijke) gebruik van chemische middelen tijdens militaire operatie in West Papoea door het door het Indonesische leger

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports of possible chemical weapons use by the Indonesian military in West Papua and whether the Netherlands would seek an independent fact-finding mission. The minister answered that Indonesia denies the reports, that neither local sources nor the OPCW can confirm them, and that he sees no reason yet for an independent investigation, while Nederland continues to press for free access for NGOs and journalists.
In view of the above answer, I currently see no reason to call for an international independent investigation.
Gezien het bovenstaande antwoord zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding voor een oproep tot het instellen van een internationaal onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Sjoerdsma over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Karabulut and Sjoerdsma asked why a person born in East Jerusalem is registered in the Basisregistratie Personen as born in Israel, and whether the government will change the system. The Staatssecretaris explains that the Landentabel only allows recognised states and territories, that the government will amend the table to add 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' for births from 15 May 1948 onward, and admits the earlier 2014 option of 'Onbekend' was a policy choice.

I intend to amend the Landentabel (table 34) and include the designation 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem' for persons born in those areas from 15 May 1948 onward.

Ik ben voornemens de Landentabel (tabel 34) te wijzigen en de benaming «Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever, met inbegrip van Oost-Jeruzalem» daarin op te nemen voor personen die vanaf 15 mei 1948 in die gebieden zijn geboren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over een naar Bahrein uitgezette man

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked whether a rejected asylum seeker deported to Bahrain was arrested and possibly mistreated, why the IND did not weigh this risk, and whether deportations to Bahrain should be suspended with an independent investigation. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, said the IND assesses each application on its merits and acknowledges worsening human rights, but refused a moratorium or investigation, while promising to monitor developments.
As your House is aware, in connection with the privacy of the person concerned I cannot make statements about individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Europese wapens in handen van jihadisten in Jemen

Karabulut (SP) asks whether European arms supplied to Saudi Arabia and the UAE have ended up with jihadists in Yemen, whether EU export criteria bar supply where terrorist diversion is a risk, and whether the minister will push for independent investigation. Minister Kaag says the government has no own evidence of such diversion but cannot rule it out, points to the EU criterion on terrorist end-users, and says violations are investigated by UN bodies that the Netherlands will alert.
The Netherlands will draw the attention of both bodies to the reporting.
Nederland zal beiden instanties op de berichtgeving attenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de repressie tegen Nicaraguaanse ngo’s

MPs from five parties asked the Dutch foreign and development ministers about Nicaragua's dissolution of NGOs including CENIDH, police raids on NGOs and the Confidencial newsroom, seizure of Dutch-funded assets, and the anti-terror law 977 used against civil society. The ministers confirmed the raids and seizures, said Nederland raised the issue with the Nicaraguan ambassador and within the EU, and shared the concern that civil society is under pressure.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and, where possible, including within the EU, continue to speak out against repression in Nicaragua.
Nederland zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en waar mogelijk zich, onder meer in EU-verband, blijven uitspreken tegen onderdrukking in Nicaragua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht dat de visa van 11 onderzoekers van CICIG door Guatemala zijn ingetrokken

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the minister about Guatemala expelling 11 CICIG investigators and revoking their visas and immunity, and whether the Netherlands would condemn this and support CICIG's mandate. The minister condemned Guatemala's termination of the UN agreement, said the Netherlands backs CICIG and a renewed mandate, and reported EU and G13 statements and diplomatic contacts, while declining to commit to a specific new step beyond existing advocacy.
The international community has sharply condemned the Guatemalan government's termination of the CICIG agreement.
De internationale gemeenschap heeft het opzeggen van het CICIG-akkoord door de Guatemalteekse regering scherp veroordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een publicatie van Instituut Clingendael over het Israëlisch-Palestijns conflict

An MP asks the Foreign Minister to respond to four criticisms in a Clingendael publication on Israel-Palestine policy, and whether the government agrees with its recommendations on supporting civil society and an international conference. The minister largely defends existing Dutch policy, rejects the claim of complicity, sees no need for a new human rights forum, and restates non-recognition of Israeli sovereignty over occupied territories.
The cabinet is not convinced that establishing a separate forum for enforcing human rights in Israel and the Palestinian Territories, as recommended in the publication, has sufficient added value.

Het kabinet is er niet van overtuigd dat de oprichting van een apart forum voor de handhaving van mensenrechten in Israël en de Palestijnse Gebieden – zoals in de publicatie wordt aanbevolen – voldoende toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over de detentie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked about the detention of anti-slavery activist Biram Dah Abeid in Mauritania, the conditions and fairness of his trial, and whether the minister would press Mauritania to stop repressing anti-slavery activists. The minister answered that Abeid was arrested in August 2018, released on 31 December 2018, that the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns with Mauritanian authorities, and that Dutch support for local human rights NGOs continues.
Information on the exact conditions in detention and the course of the trial was limited.
Informatie over de exacte omstandigheden in detentie en verloop van het proces was beperkt beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een gedetineerde mensenrechtenverdediger in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Arash Sadeghi, a detained human rights defender in Iran whom Amnesty calls a prisoner of conscience, including his reported lack of adequate cancer care and whether the government would press Iran for his release. The minister confirmed awareness, agreed the detention concerns peaceful activity, said Iran has provided no new information, and said the government will raise humane treatment and medical access with Iranian authorities in general terms.

The Netherlands will continue to raise with the Iranian authorities, more broadly, the humane treatment of detainees, the importance of fair and transparent legal proceedings, and the need to provide detainees access to adequate medical care.

Nederland zal de Iraanse autoriteiten in bredere zin blijven aanspreken op de humane behandeling van gedetineerden, het belang van een eerlijke en transparante rechtsgang en de noodzaak tot het verlenen van toegang tot adequate medische zorg aan gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse onderhandelingen met de Taliban in 2010 over een ontvoerde Nederlander

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands negotiated with or paid ransom to the Taliban in 2010 over a kidnapped Dutch aid worker, and asked about an ex-informant's debts, passport, and KHAD background, plus whether special operations in Afghanistan would be disclosed. The minister denied any negotiation or ransom, declined to discuss informants, ongoing legal procedures or secret operations citing confidentiality, and gave a general account of Afghanistan.
I cannot publicly discuss any sources of the MIVD.
Ik kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op eventuele bronnen van de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de precieze oorzaak van het ongeluk met een Apachehelikopter in Mali

MP Karabulut asks whether the 2015 Apache crash in Mali was caused by a chain of factors including the servo actuator, poor maintenance and safety awareness, and why the cause was not reported earlier, plus whether a 2013 recommendation on the logistics chain was ignored. The minister answers that the Commission of Inquiry found a technical failure of a bent LVDT probe, no causal link to safety culture, that the probe type has been removed from the fleet, and describes safety measures taken.
The report on the Chinook incident, except for staff-confidential information and technical data falling under ITAR export control rules, has been on the government website since 10 September 2018.

Het rapport over het Chinook-voorval, uitgezonderd personeelsvertrouwelijke informatie en de technische gegevens die vallen onder International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)-regelgeving voor exportcontrole, staat sinds 10 september 2018 op de website van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over brievenbusfirma’s van internationale wapenbedrijven in Nederland

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked whether nuclear weapons-linked arms firms should be allowed to settle in the Netherlands for tax reasons, obtain tax rulings, and face extra taxation, and whether the government would act on arms sales to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that it opposes tax-motivated settlement, rejects a special tax or exclusion for arms firms, notes no commercial firm produces nuclear weapons, and stresses its strict export controls.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual taxpayers.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de investeringen van Nederlandse levensverzekeraars in wapenbedrijven die aan Saoedi-Arabië leveren

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Dutch life insurers investing in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, used in Yemen, conflicts with Dutch arms export policy and the insurers' covenant on responsible business, and whether the government will act to restrict such investments. The minister answered that insurers decide their own investments under OECD and UN guidelines, that no EU sanctions apply to Saudi Arabia, and that the government will continue talks with the insurers under the covenant, which sets a two-year deadline for controversial arms trade frameworks.
Insurers in principle decide for themselves in which companies to invest.
Verzekeraars bepalen in principe zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht Saudi Arabia Allegedly Tortured Women’s Rights Activists Before Khashoggi Murder

MPs Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked whether the government knows of reports that Saudi Arabia detained eight women's rights activists for exercising free expression and allegedly tortured them, and what it will do, bilaterally, in the EU and with partners, to condemn this and seek release. The minister replied that the Netherlands raised concerns with the Saudi ambassador, in multilateral fora and through EU channels, promoted a formal EU-Saudi human rights dialogue, and works with the embassy to gather information, while weighing public versus quiet diplomacy case by case.
The Netherlands, together with partners, weighs case by case what degree of public attention is most effective, with the wishes of the persons concerned or their families being decisive.
Nederland maakt samen met partners per geval de afweging welke mate van publieke aandacht het meest effectief is, waarbij de wensen van de betrokkenen zelf, of hun families, leidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over export van 'dual use'-goederen en wapens naar Saudi-Arabië

An MP asks the government about Dutch exports of dual-use goods and weapons to Saudi Arabia, including whether 94 contracts worth 136 million euro are valid and whether the goods could be used in Yemen or for internal repression. The ministers answer that about 88 valid licences exist (133 million euro), that goods are civilian end-use, that military exports are now effectively presumed denied, and they list all licences issued since January 2016.
Following the latest report of the Group of Eminent Experts, the Cabinet decided to further tighten the arms export policy.
Naar aanleiding van het meest recente rapport van de Group of Eminent Experts, heeft het Kabinet besloten het wapenexportbeleid verder aan te scherpen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over doorvoer van militaire goederen via Schiphol en andere Nederlandse havens

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Trade, Finance and Justice about fines on airlines at Schiphol for illegally transporting strategic goods, prosecution figures, Customs capacity and procedures, and an alleged shipment of Dagaie missile defence parts to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that courts have fined some transporters since 2013 but that OM does not register such cases by sector, that Customs stopped 19 military shipments to Saudi Arabia since 2014 (two illegal exports found), that the current enforcement approach has been policy since 2013, and that carriers are legally obliged to assist Customs.

It is not possible to provide an overview of convictions by sector (such as transport companies) or an overview of the number of investigations per year, because the illegal transit of military goods is not registered as such in the OM's systems.

Het is niet mogelijk een overzicht te geven van veroordelingen per branche (zoals die van vervoersbedrijven) dan wel een overzicht van het aantal onderzoeken per jaar, omdat het illegaal doorvoeren van militaire goederen niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd in de systemen van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Nederland Shell aan gaswinst helpt in straatarm Mozambique

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Dutch support helps Shell pursue gas profits in Mozambique, covering aid amounts, export credit insurance, transparency, land rights and a tax treaty. The minister replied that no Dutch development money benefits Shell, that OECD guidelines apply to Dutch firms, that export credit policy is published, and that the tax treaty is meant to fight avoidance, while answering most points on substance.
There are no indications that Shell in Mozambique acts in violation of the OECD guidelines and that land rights are being violated.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat Shell in Mozambique handelt in strijd met de OESO-richtlijnen en landrechten geschonden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de The Hague Youth Declaration on Human Rights in Action van 20 oktober 2018

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the Hague Youth Declaration on Human Rights in Action adopted at the One Young World Summit, including its relevance to human rights promotion and how the government will publicise it among young people. The minister answered that the government sponsored youth participation, supports youth voice initiatives in the Netherlands, and will promote the declaration in line with existing human rights policy, without committing to a new concrete step.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Belhaj over het aanhoudend gebruik van chroom-6 bij de Koninklijke Luchtmacht

MPs Karabulut and Belhaj asked the State Secretary of Defence about the continued use of chromium-6 in High Solids Primer on Royal Netherlands Air Force aircraft, including whether it contains double the chromium-6 of the earlier paint, whether Belgium and Norway use chromium-free paints, and why certification of alternatives stalled. The government answered that the higher solids percentage does not mean more chromium-6 added, that a roadmap toward chromium-free systems is due by 1 March 2019, and that exposure stays below legal limits with protective equipment.
This plan will be ready by 1 March 2019 at the latest.
Dit plan is uiterlijk 1 maart 2019 gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de mensenrechtensituatie in Egypte

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about mass unfair trials, torture, death sentences, journalists and minors convicted, and impunity for security forces over the 2013 Rabaa dispersal in Egypt, and whether the Netherlands would press Egypt on this. The minister answered that the government is concerned, monitors the case, opposes the death penalty, raised concerns with Egyptian counterparts, notes no security officers were convicted for the Rabaa dispersal, and that Egypt's 2018 law shields certain officers from prosecution.
The Cabinet considers combating impunity to be of great importance.
Het Kabinet acht het tegengaan van straffeloosheid van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bijna helikoptercrash met tien militaire passagiers in Afghanistan in 2009

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a near-crash of a Cougar helicopter in Afghanistan in 2009, including the communication restrictions placed on passengers, the cockpit voice recorder, the adequacy of aftercare and the depth of past investigations, and whether the Dutch Safety Board should investigate. The minister acknowledged poor communication and insufficient aftercare, apologised and organised an information session, but rejected a new independent investigation.
Defence has no reason to doubt the results of the investigation report and therefore sees no reason for a new investigation.
Defensie heeft geen reden om te twijfelen aan de resultaten van het onderzoeksrapport en ziet dan ook geen aanleiding voor een nieuw onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over onvermogen Defensie om uitrusting te verzorgen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence why he learned from the press about the procurement problems with cold-weather clothing for a battalion exercise, what internal conclusions he drew, and whether the exercise should have been cancelled. The State Secretary acknowledged room for improvement, pointed to steps taken on stock levels and internal communication, and said cancellation was not needed because the required cold-weather gear was supplied in time to participants who needed it.
As stated in the question hour of 25 September, the course of events is open to improvement.
Zoals verwoord in het vragenuur van 25 september jl. is de gang van zaken voor verbetering vatbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Karabulut over het nieuws dat de bescherming van defensiepersoneel tegen chroom-6 nog steeds onvoldoende is

MPs Belhaj and Karabulut asked whether defence personnel are adequately protected against chromium-6 exposure, whether measured levels exceed the 1 µg/m3 limit, and whether protective measures and equipment (spray booths, gas-mask filters) are adequate. The State Secretary answered that spray-booth air concentrations can exceed the limit but personnel wear protective masks, that replacement booths and chromium-free alternatives are planned with long timelines, and that the AMF-12 filters were replaced as a precaution, with a full-risk elimination not possible and structural measures targeted for end 2020.
Defence naturally aims to improve working conditions so that wearing respiratory protection is no longer necessary.
Defensie streeft er uiteraard naar om de werksituaties zodanig te verbeteren dat het dragen van adembescherming niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Karabulut over het recht op vakbondswerkzaamheden door defensiepersoneel

MPs Karabulut asked whether the Defence Ministry effectively blocked union activity by the ODB by withdrawing its facilities after the ODB left its confederation CMHF, and whether the rules should change. The State Secretary answered that the ODB lost its facility rights because it is no longer affiliated with an admitted confederation, that he will not interfere in the internal affairs of a confederation, and that he sees no reason to amend the regulations.
I cannot and will not interfere in the internal affairs of a confederation, and on the basis of the current situation I see no reason to amend the regulations.
Ik kan en wil niet treden in de interne aangelegenheden van een centrale en zie op basis van de huidige situatie geen aanleiding om de regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over één meldpunt voor alle klachten bij Defensie

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the external reporting point of the Giebels commission closed on 1 October 2018, whether a new single complaints desk for Defence personnel will handle the same complaints, and how the government implements a motion to keep the external point open. The Secretary of State confirmed the closure, said the new desk is a practical-problems point distinct from the Giebels investigation and will be set up through a separate letter, and referred to a June 2018 letter saying the commission would keep its point open during its investigation.
The desk has a brokering function between staff questions and solutions the Defence organisation can offer.
Het loket heeft daarbij een makelaarsfunctie tussen vragen van de medewerkers en oplossingen die de Defensieorganisatie kan bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over handel met illegale Israëlische nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

Karabulut (SP) asked how large trade with illegal Israeli settlements is, by product and over time, and whether the government would seek clarification from Israel where data is lacking. The government replied that neither it nor the European Commission has figures quantifying such trade, Israel does not keep them, and it points to EU origin rules, customs checks and NVWA labelling enforcement instead.
Neither the cabinet nor the European Commission has figures quantifying trade with illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian territory.
Antwoord 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 en 6 Zowel het kabinet als de Europese Commissie 1 beschikken niet over cijfers die de handel met illegale Israëlische nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied kwantificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne

MP Karabulut (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about US lethal weapons deliveries to Ukraine, their compatibility with the Minsk agreements, and Dutch arms export policy and past exports to Ukraine. The ministers answered that the conflict must be solved politically, that Ukraine has a legitimate security need, that exports are assessed case by case against the EU criteria, and listed Dutch export licences and refusals.
Since 2004 the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has published every month a detailed overview of all licences issued for military goods and dual-use goods with military end use.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken publiceert sinds 2004 elke maand een gedetailleerd overzicht van alle afgegeven vergunningen voor militaire goederen en dual-use goederen met militair eindgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een Iraanse aanval op Irak

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm an Iranian attack on the KDPI Kurdish opposition in Iraq that reportedly killed over ten people, including civilians, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it. The minister confirmed the attack, reported 17 deaths and 46 injured, and said the Netherlands raises Iran's destabilising role with it and calls for dialogue rather than violence.
In various forums the Netherlands raises this conduct with Iran, and Iran is called upon to play a more constructive role in the Middle East.
In verschillende gremia spreekt Nederland Iran aan op dit gedrag en wordt Iran opgeroepen om een constructievere rol te spelen in het Midden-Oosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Nederlandse financiële stromen naar Nicaragua

Karabulut (SP) asked whether FMO's loan to Nicaraguan bank BanPro and the export credit insurance for two Damen patrol vessels to Nicaragua fit Dutch positions on the Nicaraguan human rights crisis, and what risk assessment applies. Minister Kaag answers that the loan is a private-sector investment, the insurance was granted under the policy then in force, Dutch cooperation with the Nicaraguan government is suspended, and export credit cover for Nicaragua has since been suspended.
For details on specific investments I am happy to refer you to FMO.
Voor details over specifieke investeringen verwijs ik u graag door naar FMO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het repressieve optreden van de Venezolaanse autoriteiten tegen jongeren

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares Amnesty's findings that Venezuelan authorities kill young men in poor neighbourhoods under the guise of fighting crime, and whether he will press for an end to disproportionate force and prosecution of abusers. The minister said he lacks sufficient information to confirm all Amnesty findings, but shares concern about rule-of-law erosion and impunity and says the issue is raised bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Human Rights Council.
However, I do not have sufficient information to confirm all findings from the Amnesty International report.
Ik beschik echter niet over voldoende informatie om alle bevindingen uit het rapport van Amnesty International te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een aanslag in Iran

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the deadly 2018 attack in Ahvaz, Iran, was claimed by a group based in Delft, and what the Dutch branch of the Arab Struggle Movement for the Liberation of Ahwaz does and whether the ambassador discussed the matter. The minister answered that IS and an Ahwaz separatist claimed the attack, that the Dutch ASMLA branch disavows it, that he urged Iran to substantiate its accusations, and that the ambassador conveyed condolences and said any assessment would rest on facts and EU consultation.
Minister Blok called on his Iranian counterpart Zarif on 28 September to substantiate accusations against the Netherlands or persons or groups established in the Netherlands with evidence.

Minister Blok heeft zijn Iraanse ambtsgenoot Zarif op 28 september jl. opgeroepen om aantijgingen aan het adres van Nederland of in Nederland gevestigde personen of groepen te onderbouwen met bewijslast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mensenrechtenschendingen in Afrin in Noord-Syrië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about human rights violations by Turkish-backed groups and Turkish forces in Afrin, Syria, including whether Turkey must stop them and ensure displaced residents can return, and whether Dutch non-lethal aid reached those groups. The minister acknowledged the serious picture, said Turkey bears responsibility and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, NATO and UN, and admitted Dutch-supplied equipment could have been used in the offensive, referring to a confidential letter.
Your House was informed in a confidential letter of 23 January about the situation in Afrin and the Dutch contribution to the NLA programme.
Uw kamer is middels een vertrouwelijke brief op 23 januari jl. (kenmerk: 32 623, nr. 184 ) over de situatie in Afrin en de Nederlandse bijdrage aan het NLA-programma geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Escalatie President Guatemala weert corruptie-aanklager VN’

MPs asked the ministers about Guatemala's refusal to renew the UN anti-corruption commission CICIG and about the government's response, protection of human rights defenders, and intimidation of NGOs. The ministers said they regret the non-renewal, cite Dutch funding, EU statements and the Shelter City programme, and promised continued monitoring and raising of the issue with Guatemalan authorities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will continue to closely monitor the situation and keep raising it with the Guatemalan government.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en blijven aankaarten bij de Guatemalteekse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de betekenis van de Amerikaanse schorsing van Turkije in het F-35 project

The MP asks whether the US has suspended Turkey from the F-35 programme, what the NDAA measure means, and what consequences follow for the Dutch industry and the Block Buy contract. The State Secretary replies that Turkey remains a project partner, that the NDAA only bars F-35 deliveries to Turkey pending a Mattis/Pompeo report due in November, that the Netherlands was not consulted, and that the Block Buy contract is not yet signed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een aantal gedetineerden in Bahrein

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether detained activists in Bahrain, including Hassan Mushaima, are denied medical care, whether they are prisoners of conscience who should be released, and whether the government will call for it. The minister said the Netherlands has no independent information, pointed to a Bahraini Ombudsman report saying appropriate care is provided, and said the government raises human rights and fair-trial concerns with Bahraini authorities and in the UN Human Rights Council without committing to demand release.
The Netherlands does not have its own information about this case.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigen informatie over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over de hongerstaking van gedetineerde Rif-activisten in Marokko

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the hunger strike of detained Rif activists in Morocco, including Nasser Zefzafi's health, contacts with Moroccan authorities, review of the verdicts and calls for release. The minister confirmed the hunger strike ended after most demands were met, said the embassy is in contact with lawyers but not detainees, and declined to request release or better treatment, citing that verdicts and appeal are still pending.
Regarding the treatment of Mr Zefzafi and other political prisoners, I do not have information that would support a request for better treatment.
Wat betreft de behandeling van de heer Zefzafi en andere politieke gevangenen, beschik ik niet over informatie die een verzoek om betere behandeling zou kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Raan over het bericht dat de VS alle hulp aan UNRWA stopt

MPs asked the government how it views the US decision to halt all funding to UNRWA, and whether it will press Washington, increase its own contribution, and address the wider political consequences. The government regrets the US decision, says it opposes politicising humanitarian aid, pledges to raise the issue with the US and other donors, and keeps its existing 13 million euro annual contribution while deferring any extra funding to year-end review.
As usual, at the end of the year the cabinet will assess, within existing humanitarian aid agreements, which additional Dutch contributions based on the humanitarian imperative are desirable.

Zoals gebruikelijk beoordeelt het kabinet aan het einde van het jaar binnen de bestaande afspraken over humanitaire hulp welke aanvullende Nederlandse bijdragen op basis van het humanitair imperatief wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mogelijke normalisatie van de relatie met Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether normalising relations with Turkey is acceptable given the rule-of-law decline, the proposed law giving the president power over judges, and the detention of opposition figures, and what was done on a motion for release of political prisoners. The minister answered that rule-of-law concerns are raised in EU and Council of Europe settings, that normalisation does not mean agreement on the facts, and described diplomatic steps taken on the Demirtaş and Kiliç cases.
The Netherlands regularly raises concerns about the rule of law and human rights in Turkey, including within the European Union and the Council of Europe.
Nederland stelt de zorgen over de rechtsstaat en mensenrechten in Turkije regelmatig aan de orde, onder andere binnen de Europese Unie en in het kader van de Raad van Europa (RvE).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mensenrechtenschendingen in Saudi-Arabië

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares Amnesty's analysis that Saudi Arabia's detention of women's rights defenders and possible death sentences aim to deter other rights activists, and whether he will press Saudi Arabia on Amnesty's demands. The minister answered that the Netherlands is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises these concerns via political channels and an EU demarche of 8 August, and will raise activist arrests at the UN Universal Periodic Review in November.
The Netherlands is very concerned about the recent arrests and the broader human rights situation in Saudi Arabia.
Nederland is zeer bezorgd over de recente arrestaties en de bredere mensenrechtensituatie in Saoedi-Arabië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een VN-rapport over mogelijke oorlogsmisdaden in Jemen

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about a UN report on possible war crimes by all parties in Yemen, including its recommendations and whether the Netherlands would push for a Security Council resolution and an end to arms supplies. Minister Blok said the findings are worrying, that follow-up falls to the Human Rights Council, and that existing UN arms embargo rules and Dutch export policy apply, without committing to a Security Council resolution.

The Netherlands, in line with its commitment to the House of Representatives, does not export weapons to countries involved in the coalition operation unless it can be ruled out that they will be used in Yemen.

Nederland exporteert, conform toezegging aan de Tweede Kamer, geen wapens naar landen die betrokken zijn bij de operatie van de coalitie, tenzij uitgesloten kan worden dat deze worden ingezet in Jemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de verwerving van gevechtsvesten in het kader van het VOSS-project door het Israëlisch concern Elbit

An MP asks the Defence and Foreign Ministers about the procurement of combat vests from Israeli firm Elbit under the VOSS project, including whether a contract option bypassed competition and whether differentiation policy on Israeli settlements should apply. The government answers that using a contract option is standard, the DMP procedure was applied correctly, and Elbit's activities do not contribute to settlements, so there is no reason to revise the relationship.
Defence is using an option within the contract concluded with Elbit under the VOSS project.
Defensie maakt gebruik van een optie binnen de overeenkomst die met Elbit is gesloten in het kader van het project VOSS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het wangedrag van hulpverleners in Afrika

An MP asked the minister about aid workers allegedly trading medicines for sex with prostitutes in Africa, a reported blacklist targeting whistleblowers, and progress on the sector's action plan against misconduct. The minister condemned such conduct, said she knew of no whistleblower blacklist, described integrity-system improvements and a planned autumn progress report, and gave outcomes for Médecins Sans Frontières-Holland's cases.
As promised during the debate with your House on misconduct in the aid sector of 13 June, I will report on the progress made on the action plan in the autumn.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het debat met uw Kamer over misstanden in de hulpsector van 13 juni jl., zal ik in het najaar rapporteren over de geboekte voortgang van het actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over de tweede tranche van de Turkijedeal

SP MPs asked the government about a second tranche of the EU-Turkey deal, including a reported 50 million euro Dutch contribution, whether the funds would fund border control, how their use would be reported, and whether Turkey had been challenged over reports of shootings at the Syrian border. The minister said the first 2 billion euro is funded from the EU budget with no national request yet, that FRIT projects target refugees' living conditions under Commission reporting and Dutch committee seat, and that the Commission could not confirm the shooting reports, though it monitors the situation.
As often exchanged with your House, projects are financed from the Facility for Refugees in Turkey (FRIT) to further improve the situation of refugees in Turkey and the communities hosting them.

Antwoord 4, 6 Zoals vaker met uw Kamer gewisseld 2 , worden vanuit de Faciliteit voor vluchtelingen in Turkije (FRIT) projecten gefinancierd om de situatie van vluchtelingen in Turkije en de gemeenschappen die hen opvangen verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ongelukken met de SM-2 raket op Duitse en Amerikaanse oorlogsbodems

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about SM-2 missile incidents on the German frigate Sachsen (June 2018) and the US destroyer The Sullivans (2015), their causes, and whether the Dutch LC frigates' SM-2 missiles are safe to use. The government answered that the Sachsen damage is still being assessed, the 2015 cause was a motor defect, Dutch missiles are essentially identical, and Defence has paused SM-2 training firings as a precaution pending the investigation.
As a precaution, Defence has decided that no SM-2 missiles will be fired for exercise and training purposes until more clarity exists on the cause of the incident aboard the Sachsen.

Uit voorzorg heeft Defensie besloten dat geen SM-2 raketten voor oefen- en trainingsdoeleinden worden afgevuurd totdat er meer duidelijkheid is over de oorzaak van het incident aan boord van de Sachsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over twee Nederlanders die om politieke redenen de toegang tot Israël geweigerd is

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about two Dutch women refused entry to Israel at Tel Aviv airport over alleged BDS sympathies, including whether they were denied consular access and what the government would do. The minister confirmed the facts, said the embassy did not have direct contact with the women but followed up with Israeli authorities, and said the government raised concerns while stating that refusing entry is an Israeli prerogative.
However, it remains an Israeli prerogative to deny people entry into the country.
Het blijft echter een Israëlisch prerogatief om mensen de toegang tot het land te onthouden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bereiken van de allerarmsten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether development policy should explicitly target the poorest and how results would be measured across gender, location, age and income. The minister answered that the SDGs guide policy, fragility and conflict are a main focus, and that results are reported via existing indicators, though disaggregating data further would be too burdensome.

Further breakdown of data and indicators would place a disproportionate burden on people and resources, because much of this data is hardly or not at all available worldwide and the number of indicators would rise sharply.

Verdergaande uitsplitsing van data en indicatoren zou een onevenredig beslag leggen op mensen en middelen, omdat veel van deze data wereldwijd niet of nauwelijks beschikbaar zijn en het aantal indicatoren sterk zou stijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse projecten in bezet Palestijns gebied die door Israël zijn gesloopt
