An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether Israel's demolition of Dutch-funded water projects in occupied Palestinian territory, and its refusal to pay compensation, violates occupation law and what consequences the government will attach. The government condemns the demolitions, says Israel must justify any exception case by case, protested immediately, requested compensation which Israel refused, and favours a joint European response.
The Netherlands remains in discussion with Israel about this issue.
Nederland blijft met Israël in gesprek over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het toelatingsbeleid van Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of EU citizens being refused entry to Turkey on political grounds, how many Dutch nationals have been turned back, whether the government coordinates with other EU states, and whether it will condemn Turkey's practice. The minister said he lacks a full picture of scale or trend, that such cases are handled by foreign authorities, that there is no structural contact with other EU states, and that each country may decide on admission while Dutch citizens may file a complaint.
I do not have a complete picture of the scale, nor of any possible trend.
Ik beschik niet over een volledig beeld van de omvang, noch over een eventuele trend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de oorlog in Jemen

Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about recent airstrikes in Yemen with civilian deaths, the death toll, cholera risk, alleged coalition cooperation with Al Qaida, and Dutch initiatives in the UN Security Council including a ceasefire resolution. Minister Blok condemned the attacks in the Security Council, said exact casualty figures are hard to obtain, noted WHO vaccination efforts, said Nederland lacks information on the Al Qaida claim, and declined to launch its own ceasefire initiative so as not to disrupt the UN envoy's process.
The Netherlands does not wish to take its own initiatives that could disrupt this process.
Nederland wil geen eigen initiatieven nemen die dit proces kunnen doorkruisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de weigering van Israël om parlementariërs toe te laten tot Gaza

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel denied her access to Gaza for political reasons, what Israel's policy is on parliamentarians entering Gaza, and whether the government will press Israel to admit them. The minister confirmed she was not granted entry, said Israel rarely allows parliamentarians because it wants to avoid legitimising the de facto authorities, and said the Dutch embassy and Ramallah post have urged Israel to grant access, though entry remains at Israel's discretion.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is aware that you have not been granted permission to enter Gaza through the border crossings with Israel.
Het is het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken bekend dat u geen toestemming is verleend om Gaza in te reizen via de grensovergangen met Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een onbeantwoorde brief over Palestijnse kinderen in Israëlische detentie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a December 2015 letter from Military Court Watch about the transfer of Palestinian detainees to Israeli prisons, which had gone unanswered, would be answered. The minister said the Dutch embassy facilitated a meeting with the organisation and sent a written reply on 6 August 2018, citing Dutch support for international law and a recommendation made at Israel's UN human rights review.
The embassy provided Military Court Watch with a written reply on 6 August 2018.
De ambassade heeft op 6 augustus 2018 Military Court Watch alsnog schriftelijk van een antwoord voorzien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over de inning Eritrese diasporabelasting nadat de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde persona non grata is verklaard

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the dwangmatige inning of Eritrean diaspora tax has changed since the Eritrean chargé was declared persona non grata, whether reports and prosecutions have increased, and whether a central reporting point should be created. The minister answered that no new chargé has been appointed, that there are no indications of change in reports, that a study on banning diaspora tax is underway, and that a special reporting point is not considered necessary.
The cabinet is currently examining the possibilities for a ban on diaspora tax in the Netherlands, in line with the motion by MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden met betrekking tot een verbod op diasporabelasting in Nederland, conform de motie van de leden Karabulut en van Ojik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over een geliquideerde man in Almere

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked whether the man liquidated in Almere in 2015 was a Iranian-convicted attacker who had received a residence permit under an alias, whether Iran contacted the Netherlands, and whether the MKO is considered terrorist. The government said no signals of a different identity were known during the asylum procedure, that some indications later emerged in the criminal investigation and were reported to ministers, that no reason was seen to further examine the identification process, and that no Iranian correspondence was found.
In this case no reason is seen to further investigate the identification and registration process.
Er wordt in deze casus geen aanleiding gezien om het I&R-proces verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de handelsmissie naar India

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about sustainable palm oil and soy promotion with India and China, whether it would be on the agenda of the India trade mission, and whether the minister would meet palm oil industry and civil society groups. The minister says current policy continues, the palm oil issue was raised with the Indian agriculture minister, and no meetings with palm oil companies or NGOs took place, though sustainability and child labour were discussed.
No talks took place with companies or civil society organisations from the palm oil sector, nor with representatives of the Round Table on Sustainable Palm Oil.
Er hebben geen gesprekken plaatsgevonden met bedrijven of maatschappelijke organisaties vanuit de palmoliesector, noch met vertegenwoordigers van de Ronde Tafel voor Duurzame Palmolie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Karabulut over de Nederlandse deelname aan de Iran Oil Show

MPs Beckerman and Karabulut asked whether Dutch government support for Dutch firms at the Iran Oil Show, including RVO and Dutch Energy Solutions programmes for the Iranian gas market, is consistent with Dutch climate policy, and what support is given to the oil and gas sector. The minister answered that participation is a matter for individual firms, that no direct financial aid is given, that the support is mainly embassy networking and export instruments, and that the government sees no reason to stop it.
It is up to individual companies to decide which international events they wish to attend.
Het is aan individuele bedrijven om te bepalen aan welke internationale bijeenkomsten zij willen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de FMO een kolencentrale in Senegal heeft gefinancierd

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about FMO's financing of a coal power plant in Senegal, including the lack of community consultation between 2009 and 2014, pressure on the client, the complaints mechanism, compensation for residents, and how FMO's policy is enforced. The Minister acknowledged insufficient communication, said FMO has tightened its policy and publishes investment projects and complaint outcomes, and expressed confidence that FMO will follow up, while not committing to direct intervention or compensation.
FMO has committed to report publicly on the follow-up of the complaints.
FMO heeft zich gecommitteerd openbaar te rapporteren over de opvolging van de klachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de situatie in Nicaragua

The SP MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister whether he condemns the use of violence and repression against protesters in Nicaragua, whether he will press Nicaragua to implement the Inter-American Commission's recommendations and support an independent investigation, and whether he will call for UN human rights access. The minister condemns the violence, says the Netherlands and EU have urged implementation of the recommendations, and notes Nicaragua has invited the Inter-American Commission, the EU and the UN High Commissioner and asked for an expert mission.
Reports of violence against demonstrators by the police and by armed groups linked to the government are very worrying.
De berichten over geweld jegens demonstranten door de politie en door aan de overheid gelieerde gewapende groeperingen zijn zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de sloop door Israël van door Nederland gefinancierde watersystemen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm Israel demolished three Dutch-funded water systems in occupied Palestinian territory, what the consequences were, how Israel was challenged and whether it should face further consequences. The minister confirmed the demolitions (citing lack of permits and a military training zone), said Netherlands and the EU protested and requested compensation which Israel refused, and committed to continued bilateral and EU pressure to stop demolitions.
The Netherlands and the EU consistently make objections clear at various levels to the Israeli authorities against demolition of Palestinian property.
Nederland en de EU maken consequent en op verschillende niveaus de bezwaren duidelijk bij de Israëlische autoriteiten tegen sloop van Palestijnse bezittingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een veroordeelde Tibetaanse activist

Rep. Karabulut (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares Amnesty's view that the five-year sentence of Tibetan activist Tashi Wangchuk is unjust and whether he will press for his immediate release. The minister agreed the sentence conflicts with China's international obligations, said the Netherlands supports an immediate release and has raised the case with Chinese diplomats and will raise it at the human rights dialogue and in the EU statement at the UN Human Rights Council.
The Netherlands raised the conviction of Tashi Wangchuk in a conversation with the director of the China Tibetology Research Center and diplomats of the Chinese embassy in The Hague.
Nederland heeft de veroordeling van Tashi Wangchuk aan de orde gesteld in een gesprek met de directeur van het China Tibetology Research Center en diplomaten van de Chinese ambassade in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over misstanden in een Colombiaanse haven

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about alleged abuses (intimidation, killings, forced resettlement, poor labour conditions, harm to fishers) linked to the TC Buen port project in Buenaventura, Colombia, financed partly by FMO, and how the government verified these claims. The minister answered that the government and FMO monitored the project, found no evidence of the alleged abuses or of TC Buen's involvement in violence, noted that the loan had been repaid, and said FMO's safeguards were adequate.
I have no indications that there is an escalation of a conflict with TC Buen and those involved.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen waaruit blijkt dat er een escalatie is van een conflict met TC Buen en betrokkenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de uitspraak 201700522/1/A3 van de Raad van State en het bericht ‘Gevolgen van vernietiging IS door Nederlandse bommen blijven geheim’

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands' air strikes against IS can be traced in the weekly Defence overview alongside CENTCOM reports, whether more detail will be published, and whether the Dutch weapon deployments reported to the Public Prosecution Service will be shared with parliament. The minister replied that coalition strikes cannot be attributed to individual countries, that the Dutch weekly overview has been expanded in detail, and that parliament has been informed confidentially and openly, while assessment of investigations is for the prosecutor.
Attacks cannot be traced back to countries from this reporting.
Aanvallen zijn hieruit niet te herleiden naar landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de ebola-uitbraak in de Democratische Republiek Congo

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the 2018 Ebola outbreak in the DRC, covering case numbers, WHO funding and reforms, vaccine licensing and distribution, health systems, and whether a Dutch global health security strategy is needed. The minister answered substantively on each point, reporting case counts, funding, and vaccine rollout, and declined to commit to a new global health security strategy.
The mere fact of the recent Ebola outbreak is for me no reason for a Dutch global health (security) strategy.
Het enkele feit van de recente uitbraak van ebola vormt voor mij geen aanleiding voor een Nederlandse global health (security) strategie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de terdoodveroordeling van een Sudanese vrouw

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the death sentence against a 19-year-old Sudanese woman who killed her husband in self-defence, whether he shared Amnesty's call for a retrial, and whether he would raise the case with Sudanese counterparts. The minister confirmed awareness, said the appeal is pending, and described diplomatic démarches with the Sudanese ambassador, joint EU and Norwegian/Swiss statements, and monitoring through the embassy, with further steps to be considered after the appeal ruling.
Once it is clear what ruling the appeal court has made, the Cabinet will consider which follow-up steps are necessary and possible.
Nadat duidelijk is geworden welke uitspraak van de rechter in hoger beroep heeft gedaan, zal het Kabinet bezien welke vervolgstappen nodig en mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de arrestatie van tien activisten voor vrouwenrechten in Saoedi-Arabië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of ten women's rights activists in Saudi Arabia, the lack of lawyer access, sanctions, and whether the government would call for their release. The minister said Saudi reforms are a step forward but the government remains concerned about repression, raised the case with his Saudi counterpart, and will pursue EU and UN raising of the issue.
I am aware of the media reports, but I cannot confirm them.
Ik ken de mediaberichten hierover, maar ik kan deze niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over financiering van Nederlandse islamitische instellingen vanuit de Golfstaten

MPs Segers, Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked the ministers about Gulf state financing of Dutch Islamic institutions, including why the ministry withheld information from RAND researchers and from municipalities, and why Saudi and Kuwaiti information was kept confidential. The minister answered that the ministry fully cooperated with RAND, that the information was shared with other government bodies and municipalities, that the Saudi MoU would not be published at Saudi request, and that the government is exploring legal measures on transparency of funding flows.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to the best of its knowledge and belief, provided full cooperation to RAND during the research at the end of 2014 so that it could conduct research in complete freedom.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft naar eer en geweten tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek eind 2014 volledige medewerking verleend aan RAND om in alle vrijheid onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over verwaarloosde veiligheidsmaatregelen in en om munitieopslagplaatsen van Defensie

Karabulut (SP) asked why Defence's ammunition depots were not checked against the strictest lightning-protection norm, which tekortkomingen remain, whether fines were passed on to the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, and whether the DMO-RVB division of responsibility should change. The State Secretary said the norm was clarified on 23 April 2018, that remaining defects depend on RVB works with a plan due and inventory by July 2018, that fines were paid by Defence until the agreement was amended, and that no structural reorganisation is planned, only better cooperation.
To end this, it was decided on 23 April that all ammunition storage facilities must meet the newest standard.
Om hieraan een einde te maken is op 23 april jl. besloten dat alle munitiemagazijnen aan de nieuwste norm moeten voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een tot de dood veroordeelde man in Iran

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Kurdish man sentenced to death in Iran after an allegedly unfair trial, possibly involving torture, would be pressed to be spared execution and released. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no independent information on the case, shares Amnesty's concerns, endorsed UN experts' calls for abolition of the death penalty and a fair trial, and pursues ongoing human rights dialogue with Iran.
The Netherlands does not have its own information about the course of Mr Panahi's proceedings.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigen informatie over de procesgang van de heer Panahi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bijna helikoptercrash met tien militaire passagiers in Afghanistan in 2009

An SP MP asked the Defence State Secretary about a near helicopter crash in Afghanistan in 2009, including alleged gag orders, missing documentation and a 2015 TV appearance by the pilot. The government acknowledges that communication with passengers was wrongly handled and that the handling was regrettable, but denies a gag order and says there was no policy change.
Looking back, it must be concluded that the way passengers were then informed about releasing information wrongly gave the impression that they could not speak about the incident at all.

Terugkijkend moet worden vastgesteld dat de wijze waarop destijds richting de passagiers is gecommuniceerd over de vrijgave van informatie bij hen ten onrechte de indruk heeft gewekt dat zij helemaal niet over het incident zouden mogen spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het uitzetten van twee Russische inlichtingenmedewerkers

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister why the government judges Russia very likely responsible for the Salisbury nerve agent attack, whether Dutch intelligence verified British evidence, and how the expulsion of two Russian intelligence officers relates to other matters. The minister answered that the EU shares the UK's assessment, declined to comment on intelligence received from foreign services, said the expulsions rest on international law and are unrelated to Brexit, and reported that the OPCW has confirmed the UK's findings on the agent.
The cabinet makes no public statements about intelligence that Dutch intelligence and security services receive from foreign services.
Het kabinet doet geen publieke uitspraken over inlichtingen die Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten van buitenlandse diensten ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de handelsmissie naar China

An MP asked the Prime Minister about the content of his China trade mission, the deterioration of human rights there under Xi Jinping, and whether he had raised NGO legislation, Tibet, and specific detainees. The government listed the mission's programme, said it is concerned about shrinking civil society and individual human rights defenders, and said it will raise these issues, including religious freedom and NGOs, at the bilateral human rights dialogue in July and will also raise individual cases there.

In the talks with the Chinese leadership during this visit, the Prime Minister indicated that the Netherlands again wants to put both freedom of religion or belief and the role of NGOs on the agenda for the bilateral human rights dialogue with China, which China has confirmed for July.

In de gesprekken met het Chinese leiderschap tijdens dit bezoek heeft de Minister-President aangegeven dat Nederland zowel vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging als de rol van ngo's wederom op de agenda wil zetten voor de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China, die door China is bevestigd voor juli.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over een MIVD-operatie in Afghanistan

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Defence Minister about reports that former MIVD staff in Afghanistan fear for their lives after a major's public admission of a secret operation, and about protection, a years-long procedure, and a possible lawsuit. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to comment on intelligence operations and individual cases, and said no lawsuit has been filed, only a lawyer's letter that is being studied.
As you know, I do not make public statements about intelligence operations and individual cases.
Zoals bij u bekend is, doe ik over inlichtingenoperaties en individuele gevallen in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over kernwapenbeleid

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the Dutch government about US nuclear modernisation (B61 bombs, the F-35 nuclear role, transport and accident safety) and whether the Netherlands should refuse nuclear weapons. The minister declined to give locations, numbers and transport details on alliance grounds, said the F-35 will take over the nuclear-capable role from the F-16 in line with prior policy, and pointed to a forthcoming AIV advisory report.
As the House is aware, under alliance arrangements no information can be provided on the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht dat de EU meebetaalt aan dodelijke grensbewaking in Turkije

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked whether EU funds paid for armoured vehicles used in lethal border guarding in Turkey, how much Dutch money is involved, and whether non-refoulement is breached. The government answered that the IPA-funded surveillance project serves border security, that the vehicles are unarmed and restricted to surveillance by contract, that reports of killings could not be independently verified, and that Turkey's border management is understandable given the refugee burden.
However, there is currently insufficient support for suspension.
Voor opschorting bestaat momenteel echter onvoldoende draagvlak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Syrische kindvluchtelingen steeds vaker niet naar school gaan door armoede

Karabulut (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Syrian refugee children increasingly miss school due to poverty, and about work permits, school transport and book costs, donor funding, language of instruction and discrimination in the region. Minister Kaag acknowledged rising poverty, child labour and early marriage as causes, described work permit policies and donor programmes, gave funding figures, and said the cabinet will direct extra regional funds to education in the forthcoming BHOS policy note.
In the BHOS policy note that will be sent to your House soon, I will go into more detail on how the cabinet intends to give substance to this intensification.
In de BHOS-beleidsnota die uw Kamer binnenkort toegaat, zal ik nader ingaan op de manier waarop het kabinet invulling wil geven aan deze intensivering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over het afbreken van een inlichtingenoperatie naar aanleiding van de verklaring van een oud-commando

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked the Minister of Defence whether special forces were recalled early from a mission after a former commando's statement about a hostage incident, whether the operation was an intelligence operation under the intelligence services act, and whether democratic oversight of secret operations should be improved. The minister declined to comment publicly on intelligence operations, stated that no state secrets were disclosed and that officials assess their own statements, and referred to a separate letter on oversight of special operations; the Public Prosecution Service is investigating the statement.
Do you share the view that democratic oversight, given the major impact of such missions on society and the revelations of Major Kroon, should be improved?
Deelt u de opvatting dat de democratische controle, gezien de grote impact van dergelijke missies op samenleving alsmede de onthullingen van majoor Kroon, verbeterd dient te worden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het Israëlische geweld tegen demonstranten in Gaza

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Israeli lethal force against protesters in Gaza, whether he supports Amnesty's call for an immediate halt and an independent investigation, and how the Netherlands will press for this, including in the UN Security Council. The minister expressed serious concern and called for proportionality and independent, transparent investigations, but declined to condemn Israel's conduct yet, saying the facts must first become clearer.
In the government's view, however, the facts must first become clearer before a condemnation of Israel's conduct is on the table.
Naar mening van het kabinet moeten de feiten echter eerst duidelijker worden, voordat een veroordeling van het Israëlisch optreden aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een in Nederland opgepakte Marokkaanse Rif-activist

An SP MP asked whether a Moroccan Rif activist arrested in Rotterdam should be returned to Morocco given doubts about a fair trial there, and whether the government agrees. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said fair-trial concerns must be judged case by case, and noted the former foreign minister raised fair trial with Morocco.
As your House is aware, I in principle do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over bewapening, corruptie, illegale bedrijfsovernames en de opkomst van extreem-rechtse paramilitaire groepen in Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about US anti-tank weapons sales to Ukraine, far-right paramilitary groups such as the National Druzhyna, delays in Ukraine's anti-corruption court, and illegal corporate takeovers (raids) affecting Dutch and EU investors. The minister replied that the conflict must be solved politically, that the civilian Druzhyna has no state powers and is monitored, that the anti-corruption court will take time to set up, and that exact raid figures are unavailable, while support to companies is offered case by case.
It is not possible to give exact figures.
Het niet mogelijk exacte aantallen te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een VN-lijst met bedrijven die actief zijn in illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An MP asked whether five Dutch companies on a UN OHCHR list linked to Israeli settlements would be disclosed and whether the government would contact them. The government said the list is unfinished, the Netherlands opposes the database and will not seek its publication, and it reiterates its policy discouraging economic ties with settlement businesses while leaving companies to decide under OECD guidelines.
In response to the OHCHR note, the Netherlands again emphasised its own position on the database.
Nederland heeft in een reactie op de nota van OHCHR het eigen standpunt ten aanzien van de database nogmaals benadrukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Oijk en Karabulut over het bericht 'De onderkoning van Congo'

MPs Ploumen, Van Oijk and Karabulut asked about press reports on Dan Gertler, his listing on the US Magnitsky sanctions list, whether Dutch authorities investigated Fleurette Group, whether EU or Dutch sanctions are possible, and what Dutch measures exist against foreign corruption. The minister says the cabinet is concerned, is closely informed about the US investigation and sanctions, notes the EU has no Magnitsky-type regime, and describes the Dutch integrated anti-corruption approach with enforcement left to the OM and FIOD.
This matter now has the full attention of the Dutch enforcement authorities.
Deze kwestie heeft inmiddels de volledige aandacht van de Nederlandse handhavingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een door Indonesië gearresteerde Papua activist

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the treason trial in Indonesia of Papuan activist Yanto Awerkion over a referendum petition, his health, and Dutch efforts on repression in Papua. The minister confirmed the trial and the charge, said reliable sources report his health is good with no family visit restrictions, and described human rights raised in bilateral and EU dialogues while declining to comment on the pending verdict.
The case is before the court and the cabinet will make no statements on it pending the verdict.
De zaak is onder de rechter en het kabinet doet in afwachting van de uitspraak hierover geen uitlatingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de juridische basis voor militair optreden in Syrië

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the government still has a valid international-law basis for Dutch military action in Syria, given doubts about the collective self-defence claim tied to Iraq, and whether it would consult the external international-law adviser. Minister Blok replied that the legal basis of collective self-defence for Iraq still holds, though weaker than before, and declined to consult the external adviser, saying the government is sufficiently advised internally and externally.
No, I am not willing to do so because there is no need for it.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid omdat daar geen noodzaak toe bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van der Staaij en Karabulut over het personeelstekort bij de militaire luchtverkeersleiding

MPs asked the state secretary of Defence about staff shortages at military air traffic control, including suspended services, limited flight information, and whether flight safety is at risk. The government acknowledges chronic shortages and service suspensions, says safety is preserved by suspending services, and outlines training, retention and cooperation measures with LVNL, while rejecting a pay rise.
Air Operations Control Station (AOCS) has struggled with staff shortages for years. Currently 17 of the 73 established posts are vacant.
Air Operations Control Station (AOCS) kampt al jaren met een personeelstekort. Momenteel zijn 17 van de 73 organieke functies vacant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over twee laagvliegoefeningen in het oosten van Nederland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about complaints over noise and low-flying military helicopter exercises in eastern Netherlands, the timing and publication of the permit, possible violations of its conditions, whether such exercises should take place in the Netherlands, and communication with residents. The State Secretary defended the exercises as necessary for crew readiness, said conditions were not breached, promised earlier publication of major permits and better communication with farmers' organisations, but rejected that communication was deficient.
Decisions announcing large-scale exercises will from now on be published at the earliest possible stage and preferably at least 4 weeks before the start of an exercise.

Beschikkingen waarmee grootschalige oefeningen bekend worden gemaakt, zullen voortaan in een zo vroeg mogelijk stadium en bij voorkeur uiterlijk 4 weken voor de aanvang van een oefening worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over een nieuw rapport inzake Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeid in de EU en de betrokkenheid van Nederlandse bedrijven

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked about a report on North Korean forced labour in the EU, including Dutch firms' involvement in building ships, and the government's response on enforcement, the Polish role, and the Netherlands' legal jurisdiction. The minister answers that the situation could possibly qualify as forced labour or trafficking, outlines EU and UN measures, states that Poland has issued no new work permits since August 2017, and refers largely to company responsibility, the OECD guidelines, and the ILO process, without confirming the scale of Dutch firms' involvement.
How many companies and shipyards are involved, and over what period this occurred, cannot be established with certainty.
Om hoeveel bedrijven en werven het gaat, en in welke periode hiervan sprake was, valt niet met zekerheid vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een in Iran opgelegde doodstraf

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Iranian Supreme Court had definitively upheld the death sentence against Belgian-based academic Ahmadreza Djalali, whether confessions obtained under torture are a concern, and whether the minister would urgently raise the case with Iranian counterparts. The minister confirmed the ruling appears final but that the lawyer is considering further appeal, shares concern about torture-obtained confessions, and reports EU and personal representations on the death penalty, fair trial and torture.
I personally spoke with my counterpart on 21 February about human rights in broad terms and conveyed the Dutch positions on the death penalty, fair trial and excluding torture.

Zelf heb ik op 21 februari jl. met mijn counterpart in brede zin gesproken over mensenrechten en de Nederlandse standpunten overgebracht ten aanzien van de doodstraf, eerlijke rechtsgang en het uitsluiten van foltering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mogelijke arrestatiebevelen tegen Nederlandse Marokkanen

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Morocco is planning arrest warrants against Dutch-Moroccans involved in the Rif protests, whether the government shares concern about treatment of detained demonstrators, and whether extradition is ruled out given doubts about fair trials. The government replied that Morocco described the matter as summonses to testify rather than arrest warrants, that the Dutch embassy and EU partners monitor detainees and raised concerns with Moroccan ministers, and that there are no indications of an extradition request.
As indicated under 2, there are no indications that the Moroccan authorities intend to request extradition of the persons named.
Zoals onder 2 is aangegeven, zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de Marokkaanse autoriteiten van plan zouden zijn om uitlevering te vragen van genoemde personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse medewerking aan Amerikaanse modernisering van Saoedische tanks

An MP asked whether Dutch firms performed work after 28 February 2017 on the US contract modernising Abrams tanks for Saudi Arabia, Australia and Kuwait, and how this fits Dutch restrictive arms-export policy toward Saudi Arabia. The minister answered that no Dutch companies performed licensable work under the contract, that customs found no licensable Dutch deliveries or support since that date, and that the Netherlands applies a strict case-by-case policy to Saudi Arabia.
Inquiries with Customs show that since 28 February 2017 there have been no licensable deliveries or technical support from the Netherlands in relation to Abrams tanks.
Navraag bij de Douane wijst uit dat er sinds 28 februari 2017 geen vergunningplichtige leveringen of technische ondersteuning vanuit Nederland in relatie tot Abrams-tanks hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de levering van twee Fokker 70-toestellen die in het bezit van de luchtmacht van Myanmar zijn gekomen

Karabulut (SP) asked whether two Fokker 70 aircraft sold by KLM Cityhopper and acquired by Air KBZ had ended up with Myanmar's air force, and whether export permits were granted and the aircraft should be reclaimed under the arms embargo. The ministers answered that KLM sold the planes to a Singapore company, they were converted to VIP aircraft and are leased to Myanmar's government, no export permit was needed for civil aircraft, and that leasing civil aircraft to the air force falls outside the EU arms embargo even on a strict reading.
The Netherlands advocates strict compliance with the EU arms embargo against Myanmar.
Nederland pleit voor strikte naleving van het EU-wapenembargo ten aanzien van Myanmar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het optreden van de Iraanse autoriteiten tegen demonstranten in Iran

MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports of deaths of detained protesters in Iran, the number of arrests and whether political prisoners' release would be advocated. The minister said the Netherlands called for independent investigation, fair trials and release of detainees, and would keep monitoring the situation without committing to specific new steps.
The Netherlands will, together with European partners, closely follow the handling of the recent protests.
Nederland zal, samen met Europese partners, de afwikkeling van de recente protesten nauwgezet volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het optreden van de Israëlische autoriteiten in de bezette Palestijnse gebieden

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli detention of a 17-year-old Palestinian girl and her mother, the killing of a wheelchair-using protester, casualty and detention figures since the US Jerusalem decision, the number of Palestinian political detainees, whether Israeli force is disproportionate, and whether the government will press Israel to investigate and prosecute killings of unarmed demonstrators. The minister confirmed the detentions and killing, gave OCHA casualty and detention figures, cited B'Tselem's detainee count, stated the Netherlands and EU urge strict compliance with safeguards on administrative detention and proportionate force, and said he raised investigation, transparency and prosecution with both parties.

At the same time, the cabinet will continue to hold Israel to its obligation to act proportionately and press for the need for investigations into its own conduct, transparency of outcomes, prosecution of any perpetrators, and measures to prevent incidents in future.

Tegelijk zal het kabinet Israël blijven aanspreken op de verplichting proportioneel te handelen en aandringen op de noodzaak van onderzoeken naar eigen optreden, op transparantie van de uitkomsten, op vervolging van eventuele daders en op maatregelen om incidenten in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de verplaatsing van de Amerikaanse ambassade in Israël naar Jeruzalem

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the planned US move of its embassy to Jerusalem and whether the Netherlands would relocate its own embassy, and whether the government would raise its concerns with the US. The minister confirmed the government considers the move counterproductive, that the Dutch embassy stays in Tel Aviv until a comprehensive peace agreement settles Jerusalem, and that concerns were already conveyed to US authorities.
The Netherlands conveyed its concerns to the US, including at a lunch with Secretary of State Tillerson during the NATO ministerial meeting and in senior official contact with US authorities.

Nederland heeft de zorgen kenbaar gemaakt aan de VS, onder meer bij de lunch met Secretary of State Tillerson tijdens de ministeriële bijeenkomst van de NAVO en in hoogambtelijk contact met de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over reddingsmissies op zee

Two SP MPs asked the government whether Libya is unsafe for refugees, whether EU support for the Libyan coast guard makes the EU complicit in returns, and about rescue NGOs, corruption and an alleged Italian intelligence infiltration of a Save the Children ship. The government agreed Libya is unsafe, said it works with UNHCR and IOM on conditions and voluntary return, defended EU training with vetting, said rescued persons fall under Libyan jurisdiction, and declined to comment on foreign investigations.
The Netherlands cannot provide information about foreign investigations.
Nederland kan geen informatie verstrekken over buitenlandse onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Corrupte constructies: Shell in het nauw’

SP MPs asked the minister about a Vrij Nederland report on Shell's purchase of Nigerian oil block OPL 245 via a corrupt intermediary, questioning Shell's conduct, the alternative payment structure, and calling for corporate human rights rules and prosecution. The minister declined substantive comment because the OM and FIOD are investigating, pointed to Dutch integrated anti-corruption policy and the existing binding anti-bribery law, and said prosecution decisions rest with investigators and the prosecutor.
While this investigation is ongoing, no substantive response will be given.
Lopende dit onderzoek zal niet inhoudelijk worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over helikoptertaken in Mali

An MP asked the Defence Minister why the operational pause in Mali was extended, how long it would last, and about grounding and technical problems of the German NH-90 and Tiger helicopters used for medevac and escalation dominance, including why parliament was not informed sooner. The minister answered that full operations were resumed except in Kidal pending UN guarantees on medevac, and referred to a separate letter on the NH-90 for the technical details.
See the letter from the Minister of Defence 'NATO helicopter project NH-90' of 25 October 2017 (Parliamentary paper 25 928, no. 74) for the answers to questions 2, 3 and 5.
Zie de brief van de Minister van Defensie « Navo helikopterproject NH-90 » van 25 oktober 2017 (Kamerstuk 25 928, nr. 74 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse technologie in Zuid-Koreaanse fregatten die o.a. aan Egypte worden doorverkocht

MP Karabulut asked whether Dutch technology (Thales/Hollandse Signaal radar and C3 systems) aboard South Korean Po Hang-class corvettes resold to Egypt and other countries was authorised, and on what grounds. The ministers confirmed Dutch consent was given for transfers to Egypt, the Philippines, Peru and Vietnam based on EU criteria assessment, and that export licences apply to re-exports from third countries.
The Netherlands previously consented to the resale of South Korean ships with Dutch equipment on board to the Philippines, Peru and Vietnam.
Nederland heeft eerder ingestemd met de doorverkoop van Zuid-Koreaanse schepen met aan boord Nederlandse apparatuur aan de Filipijnen, Peru en Vietnam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de Nederlander die mogelijk 33 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

SP MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Dutch Jaitsen Singh, possibly wrongly imprisoned in the US for 33 years, and whether the Dutch state abandoned him, including the handling of a trust report and internal disagreement over transfer. The minister denies abandonment, says regular consular assistance was given, that the transfer request was rejected under the treaty framework, and that no new US requests are pending yet, while support would resume if they are filed.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has provided Mr J.S. with regular consular assistance since the start of his detention.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft aan de heer J.S. sinds aanvang van zijn detentie de reguliere consulaire bijstand verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bewapening van de Luchtverdedigings- en Commandofregatten (LC-fregatten)

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether NATO's missile defence and possible SM-3 acquisition for the LCF frigates disturb the strategic balance and could fuel proliferation. The Defence Minister replied that the NATO BMD system does not disturb the strategic balance, that the SMART-L radar software was tested in Formidable Shield, that no decision on SM-3 acquisition has been taken, and that proliferation is a different question.
The NATO BMD system therefore does not disturb the strategic balance in Europe.
Het BMD-systeem van de Navo verstoort het strategische evenwicht in Europa dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over een arrestatiebevel tegen een Turkse journalist

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether journalist Can Dündar had cancelled a Netherlands visit because of a Turkish Interpol arrest request, and how the Netherlands handles such requests. The minister answered that he could not confirm the cancellation, that Dündar has since visited, that no Dutch government view on the foreign conviction is given, and that foreign Interpol requests are assessed case by case before registration.

A foreign arrest request or alert that the Netherlands receives via INTERPOL channels is not automatically acted upon: each is assessed case by case before being entered in the national investigation register.

Aan een buitenlands aanhoudingsverzoek of signalering dat Nederland via INTERPOL kanalen ontvangt, wordt niet automatisch gevolg gegeven: deze worden per geval beoordeeld alvorens deze worden ingevoerd in het nationale opsporingsregister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over het bericht dat Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders in Europa zouden hebben gewerkt aan de bouw van een Deens marineschip

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked whether North Korean forced labour was used to build a Danish navy vessel, a NATO ally's ship, and whether this poses a security risk and has been raised in NATO. The government answered that the issue has not been discussed in NATO, that individual allies bear responsibility for ships they make available, that the Danish government cannot yet confirm or deny the reports, and that the EU has adopted measures to reduce North Korean workers in the EU to zero.
The matter has not been discussed within NATO.
De kwestie is niet in NAVO-verband besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de voorgenomen ontruiming van twee Palestijnse dorpen

MP Karabulut asks whether the government is aware of B'Tselem's claim that the planned evacuation of the Palestinian villages Susiya and Khan al-Ahmar is a war crime, and whether it will urge Israel to abandon the plan. The ministers confirm the threat, state that forced displacement and destruction of property under occupation law are prohibited, call on Israel to comply, and say the government keeps pressing Israel bilaterally and through the EU to drop the plans.
The cabinet calls on Israel to strictly comply with these obligations.
Het kabinet roept Israël op tot strikte naleving van deze verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Thieme over het referendum over onafhankelijkheid voor Iraaks Koerdistan

Six MPs asked whether the independent international law adviser should assess whether Iraqi Kurdistan meets the Montevideo criteria for statehood in light of its independence referendum, and how the government interprets such advice. The answer states that the questions were answered in a separate letter ('Situatie Koerdische regio') to parliament, so no substantive reply is given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij and Thieme, question number 2017Z12850, have been answered by means of the letter 'Situation in the Kurdish region'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Karabulut (SP), Van Ojik (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD), vraagnummer 2017Z12850 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Situatie Koerdische regio» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kwint over de 1,4 miljoen euro die Nederland steekt in een onderwijsbedrijf voor de allerarmsten

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether the indirect 1.4 million euro Dutch investment in Bridge International Academies, a profit-seeking school operator, is responsible given reported quality, pricing, teacher pay and transparency problems, and what action was taken. The minister defended the investment as supporting affordable private education, reported contact with Bridge and ongoing independent evaluations, and declined to withdraw the support.
The cabinet sees no reason to recover this indirect support.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze indirecte steun terug te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Karabulut over seksueel misbruik in het leger

MPs Diks and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister about alleged sexual abuse in the armed forces, including the handling of a 2015 report to the Inspector-General and the number of reports and prosecutions. The minister answered that a confidential investigation commission has been set up, that 54 reports of possible sexual misconduct were filed with the Royal Marechaussee since 2013 and 39 cases reached the prosecutor, and listed existing integrity and prevention measures.
Defence has meanwhile set up a commission of inquiry to establish the facts as far as possible.
Defensie heeft inmiddels een commissie van onderzoek ingesteld om de feiten zoveel mogelijk te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over martelingen in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he accepts reports of systematic torture and impunity in Turkey after the failed coup, and what pressure the Netherlands and the EU can apply. The minister said the individual reports cannot be confirmed but that the trend is worrying, and listed ongoing bilateral and EU efforts, including calls for CPT report publication and support for civil society.
The cabinet cannot confirm the individual reports from the cited reports.
Het kabinet kan de individuele berichten uit de aangehaalde rapporten niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inzet van vrijwilligers bij de jaarwisseling in Den Haag

An MP asked ministers about reports that Salafists were standing watch during New Year's Eve in The Hague's Schilderswijk and about cooperation between the city and the as-Soennah mosque, including whether a Chamber motion to end such cooperation would be implemented. The government replied that local triangle bodies decide on cooperation with organisations, pointed to a normative framework sent to Parliament, and said police and municipality maintain a dialogue with a wide range of organisations.
In the local context, it remains up to the municipality to organise the involvement of organisations when shaping its integrated security policy.
In de lokale context blijft het aan de gemeente om bij de vormgeving van haar integraal veiligheidsbeleid betrokkenheid van organisaties te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over migratie via Niger

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked the government about migration through Niger, EU missions, funding, smuggling laws and prosecutions, economic alternatives for smugglers, and migrants abandoned in the desert. The minister answered in detail on each question, describing EUCAP and EU funding, Niger's laws and arrests, and economic alternatives, but gave no firm new commitments.
The Netherlands is urging the Red Cross and IOM to register that information better, so that left-behind family members can also be informed.
Nederland dringt er bij het Rode Kruis en de IOM op aan om die informatie beter te registreren, zodat ook achtergebleven familieleden geïnformeerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de humanitaire crisissituatie in Gaza

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, including fuel and electricity shortages, sewage pollution, blocked medical referrals to Israel, and what the government is doing to ease access and fund relief. The minister acknowledged serious shortages and a combination of causes, described diplomatic efforts, a planned gas pipeline and trade-access support, and said an extra UNRWA contribution would be considered if budget room arises.
The cabinet does not have precise information on the refusal of seriously ill patients in Gaza to specialised hospitals in Israel.
Het kabinet heeft geen precieze informatie over de weigering van ernstig zieke patiënten in Gaza tot gespecialiseerde ziekenhuizen in Israël.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma c.s. inzake het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellinge

MPs Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked how Saudi Arabia and Kuwait share information via Notes Verbales about funding requests from Dutch religious institutions, when the Labour Minister was informed, and what action has been taken on earlier motions. The government answered that the information is shared confidentially, that since 2016 it goes to several agencies including SZW, and that only one case led to ended funding, with a convenant on transparency under discussion.
This information was obtained through diplomatic channels and is therefore confidential.
Deze informatie is verkregen via diplomatiek verkeer en daarmee vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over protesten in het noorden van Marokko

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and a court sentencing of Rif protest leaders in Morocco and about a meeting in Utrecht allegedly organised by the Moroccan state. The minister confirmed the arrests, described the charges and sentences, called the socio-economic demands legitimate, and said the government was not aware of Moroccan state involvement in the Utrecht meeting.
As indicated in the answer to the questions from MP Van den Hul, the situation is being closely monitored.
Zoals in antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van den Hul is aangegeven, wordt de situatie nauwlettend gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de handel in zand uit West-Sahara

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Dutch shipper Eemswerken transported sand from Western Sahara to Gran Canaria, whether this is illegal, and whether the minister contacted the company. The minister confirmed a Spanish inspection found such sand aboard, noted a local investigation is ongoing, saw no indication of Dutch or EU violations, and pointed to general CSR and investment-warning policy.
The government has currently received no indication from supervisory bodies or the Public Prosecution Service that there has been a violation of Dutch or European regulations.
De regering heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzingen ontvangen van toezichthoudende instanties of het Openbaar Ministerie dat er sprake is van een overtreding van Nederlandse of Europese regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ten Broeke, Knops, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over de arrestatie van een Turkse Nederlander in Turkije

MPs from six parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Turkey of Dutch-Turkish national Volkan Çalışkan over a banner, whether consular assistance was given, and about the travel bans on eleven Dutch citizens and wider rule-of-law concerns. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the Netherlands requested consular access and will ask the Turkish authorities for attention to the cases, and described diplomatic efforts on Turkey's rule of law.
The Netherlands will continue to request extra attention for these cases so that those involved can return to the Netherlands as soon as possible.
Nederland zal extra aandacht voor deze gevallen blijven vragen opdat betrokkenen zo spoedig mogelijk naar Nederland kunnen terugkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over activiteiten van de Turkse inlichtingendienst in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the Turkish intelligence service operates from The Hague, including compiling kill-lists of Kurdish activists, and what the government will do about it. The ministers declined to comment on the French prosecution and said they cannot publicly discuss investigations into foreign intelligence activity, only that the government takes measures when unauthorised activity is found.
No public statements can be made about investigations into such activities by foreign intelligence and security services.
Over onderzoek naar dergelijke activiteiten van buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders in Europa

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked the government about reports that North Korean workers in Europe, largely in Poland, are subjected to forced labour that funds the North Korean state, and about the government's knowledge, EU subsidies and NATO-ship links. Minister Asscher answered that Poland has found no illegal work or forced labour, that the matter has been raised in the UN, Council and International Labour Conference, that EU subsidy control lies first with member states, and that no North Korean workers were found working on Dutch navy ships at CRIST.
Precise amounts are not known and estimates vary.
Precieze bedragen zijn niet bekend en schattingen lopen uiteen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over uitreisverboden voor Nederlanders in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about a Dutch man arrested in Turkey and banned from leaving for allegedly insulting President Erdogan, about ten Dutch nationals reportedly barred from leaving over Gülen links, resumed extraditions to Turkey, and whether the government will press Turkey to lift the bans and tighten travel advice. The government confirmed one case but withheld details on privacy grounds, stated about ten persons had reported bans, defended case-by-case extradition review with Turkish guarantees, said the embassy has repeatedly raised the bans with Turkish authorities, and noted existing travel advice already warns of these risks.
Due to privacy protection, I cannot provide your House with further information about an individual case through this public letter.
Vanwege privacybescherming kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen verdere informatie verstrekken over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mogelijke toetreding tot de NAVO door Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Ukraine's wish to join NATO, including a Membership Action Plan, possible security risks from the Russia conflict, and the scope of NATO and Dutch support to Ukraine. The minister replied that MAP status or membership is not on the agenda, that NATO support focuses on security-sector reform under the Comprehensive Assistance Package, and that the Netherlands gives no bilateral military aid, only contributions to NATO trust funds.
Granting MAP status to Ukraine or NATO membership is not on the agenda.
Verlening van MAP-status aan Oekraïne of toetreding tot de NAVO is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Hijink over het gebruik van spyware in China

MPs Karabulut and Hijink asked whether China forces residents of Xinjiang to install surveillance spyware under threat of prosecution, and whether the government finds this unacceptable and will raise it with Chinese authorities. The Minister confirms reports of the mandatory app, calls the privacy intrusion serious, and says the government will raise it in the next bilateral human rights dialogue with China.
The use of the app to gain access to devices and the obligation imposed by the Chinese government to install it constitute a serious infringement of the privacy of the citizens concerned.
De inzet van de app om toegang te krijgen tot apparaten en de verplichting tot het installeren ervan door de Chinese overheid maakt ernstige inbreuk op de privacy van de betrokken burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de civielrechtelijke regeling naar aanleiding van standrechtelijke executies in het voormalige Nederlands-Indië

MP Karabulut asked whether the government would extend the deadline for claims by widows of people summarily executed in former Dutch East Indies and extend the scheme to children. The minister confirmed a further two-year extension of the claim window and declined to extend the scheme to children, citing pending court cases on limitation.
Given the special nature of the matter, however, the cabinet sees reason to extend the filing period by another two years.
Gezien de bijzondere aard van de zaak ziet het kabinet echter aanleiding de termijn voor indiening nog eens met twee jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inzet van witte fosfor in Syrië

MP Karabulut asked whether the US-led coalition used white phosphorus near Raqqa, whether that breaches international law, and whether the Netherlands will press for an immediate halt. The minister answered that international humanitarian law has no specific ban on white phosphorus, that the coalition uses it for marking and smoke screens rather than as an incendiary, and that the Netherlands will keep pressing for civilian-protection measures.
The Netherlands will continue to give particular attention within the coalition to measures to minimise the risk of civilian casualties.
Nederland blijft in coalitieverband bijzondere aandacht vragen voor maatregelen om de kans op burgerslachtoffers te minimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de cholera uitbraak in Jemen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the cholera outbreak in Yemen, Saudi-led coalition blockades that obstruct humanitarian aid, and Dutch arms exports to Egyptian and UAE navies involved in the blockade. The minister pointed to a EUR 4.5 million contribution, said the coalition and parties share responsibility, reported that Save the Children shipments were held, and stated arms export licences are checked case by case, with calls for lifting restrictions on aid but no commitment to halt exports.
The cabinet does not have data on other cases in which humanitarian aid was stopped at sea.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over gegevens over andere gevallen waarin humanitaire hulp op zee is tegengehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Karabulut, Van Raan, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de confiscaties door Turkse overheid van Aramese kerken en kerkbezittingen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's transfer of over 50 Aramaic churches and monasteries to the Diyanet amounts to confiscation, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification and urge EU partners to respond. The minister said the transfers stem from administrative reorganisation under Turkish law, that Diyanet denied receiving property and Mardin confirmed this, but that the Aramaic community has lost property it used for over a thousand years; the embassy will raise minority rights and a field visit with EU partners is planned.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Thieme en Van den Hul over een ter dood veroordeelde Amerikaan

MPs asked the minister whether he knows of claims that US inmate Clinton Lee Young was wrongly convicted and whether the government will contact the Texas governor to seek a stay of execution. The minister confirmed awareness, restated Dutch opposition to the death penalty, and said the EU ambassador and the Dutch ambassador in Washington will write to the Texas governor expressing objections.
In this case too, the European objections will be conveyed by a letter from the EU ambassador in Washington to the governor of Texas.
Ook in dit geval zullen de Europese bezwaren door middel van een brief van de EU-ambassadeur in Washington aan de gouverneur van Texas kenbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de voortgang van het opruimen van de Nigerdelta

MP Karabulut asks the minister about slow progress in cleaning up oil pollution in the Niger Delta, including the Nigerian and Shell responses to the 2011 UNEP report, funding, drinking water, the RENA method, Shell's claims of completed cleanups, Dutch support, and whether the OECD National Contact Point study will cover Shell. The minister answers that the Netherlands presses all parties for faster action, that progress is step-by-step but limited, that the polluter-pays principle applies to SPDC with NNPC funding, and that the NCP study is ongoing with conclusions to be shared with the Chamber.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het oppakken van onder meer de Turkse directeur van Amnesty International

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm the arrest of Amnesty International's Turkish director and other rights activists in Turkey, and whether the detainees should be released and what prior government efforts on rule of law in Turkey had achieved. The minister confirmed the arrests, condemned them, and described diplomatic steps (EU démarches, Council of Europe statement, Freedom Online Coalition, suspending pre-accession aid pressure) while stating that concerns on Turkey's rule of law remain serious but not directly answering whether the detainees should be released.
The cabinet condemns the arrests and the lack of protection for human rights defenders in Turkey.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de arrestaties en het gebrek aan bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over de mogelijke uitlevering van Saïd C.

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands arrested Saïd C. on a Moroccan extradition request, what guarantees Morocco gave on serving any sentence in the Netherlands and on a fair trial, and whether torture concerns and Dutch prosecution were considered. Minister Blok answered that Morocco agreed to transfer enforcement of any sentence to the Netherlands and to Dutch conversion of the sentence, that the request is now for a court to assess, that the minister declines to comment on the individual case, and that the Netherlands does not normally prosecute itself when another state requests extradition.
As is customary in individual cases, I exercise restraint in my statements about the case.
Er past mij, zoals gebruikelijk in individuele gevallen, terughoudendheid in mijn mededelingen over de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het oppakken van de directeur van Amnesty International in Turkije

MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister about the detention of Amnesty International Turkey's chair Taner Kiliç and 22 other lawyers after the 2016 coup attempt, and whether Netherlands will press for their release. The minister confirms the arrests on terrorism-membership charges, calls on Turkey to prove the charges quickly or release them, and says the Netherlands will raise the matter bilaterally, in the Council of Europe and the EU, and consider monitoring any trial.
The cabinet urgently calls on the Turkish authorities to quickly prove the accusations, in line with the standards of the European Convention on Human Rights.
Het kabinet roept de Turkse autoriteiten dringend op om de beschuldigingen spoedig te bewijzen, conform de standaarden van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het idee om een EU-missie naar het zuiden van Libië te sturen

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about a proposed EU mission to southern Libya, including its content, human rights safeguards and existing EU missions. The minister replied that Germany and Italy had only made a general call, no formal proposal exists yet, and that the government supports examining all options while stressing human rights and migrant protection in existing programmes.
Germany and Italy have not submitted a formal proposal.
Duitsland en Italië hebben geen formeel voorstel ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Turkse luchtaanvallen in Syrië en Irak

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reported Turkish airstrikes on Kurdish fighters in Syria and Iraq, including casualty figures, whether IS benefits, and whether Turkey lacks a legal mandate and should be condemned and asked to withdraw. The minister answered that Netherlands has no independent information to confirm the reports, that IS may benefit, that Turkey has a right to self-defence, and that restraint is appropriate, without committing to a concrete démarche.
The Netherlands does not have independent intelligence on the basis of which these reports can be confirmed or refuted.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige inlichtingen op basis waarvan deze berichten bevestigd of ontkracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over wapenexport naar landen die betrokken zijn bij de oorlog in Jemen

Two SP MPs asked the government about arms exports to Yemen coalition states (Egypt, UAE navies), Airbus's tax ruling, investments by pension funds and banks in Airbus, and tax facilitation of Airbus. The government said it refuses export licences for coalition states where goods may be used in combat in Yemen, declined to disclose sales volumes and tax ruling details citing confidentiality, and said banks and pension funds are addressed through due-diligence and OECD guideline frameworks.
However, under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information about individual taxpayers can be provided.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan echter geen informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Ojik over een hongerstaking van Palestijnen in Israëlische detentie

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares the UN rapporteur's view that Israel violates international law through mass administrative detention and transfer of Palestinian detainees, whether he will press Israel on treatment of prisoners, and whether he shares concerns about solitary confinement and denial of lawyers to hunger strikers. The minister answered that the government shares concerns about administrative detention, will raise prisoner conditions in regular human rights dialogue, and that the EU raised the issue with Israeli authorities and issued a local statement calling for full respect of prisoners' human rights.
The government shares concerns about the scale and duration of administrative detention.
Het kabinet deelt zorgen over de schaal en duur van administratieve detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kerstens over misstanden bij het ziekteverzuimbedrijf Acture

MPs Karabulut and Kerstens asked the minister about reports of abuses at sick-leave company Acture, including pressure on doctors and re-examinations declaring workers recovered. The minister answered that such pressure is unacceptable, strengthened occupational doctors' independence and a second-opinion right, explained UWV's oversight role, and declined to order an Inspectorate investigation on the broadcast alone.
Sick people may not be pressured to return to work if, for medical reasons, they are not yet able to do so.
Zieke mensen mogen niet onder druk worden gezet om weer aan het werk te gaan indien zij daar – wegens medische redenen – nog niet toe in staat zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over internationaal maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen

An MP asks how the government screens environmental effects, corruption links and water impacts of Dutch firms receiving subsidies, trade missions, export credit insurance and diplomatic support, and how rejections and evaluations work. The minister answers that firms are checked against OECD-based IMVO criteria, that some applications were refused for environmental reasons, that no applications were refused for bribery concerns, and that a standing evaluation system exists, while withholding firm-specific details for business confidentiality.
For reasons of business confidentiality, no firm-specific information can be provided about withdrawn or rejected applications.
Omwille van bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kan er geen (bedrijfs-) specifieke informatie worden verstrekt over ingetrokken of afgewezen aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over de concentratiekampen voor homoseksuelen in Tsjetsjenië

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government how it responds to reports of concentration camps for gay men in Chechnya, including casualty figures, contacts with Russian authorities, Kremlin statements, asylum treatment of LGBTI refugees and Dutch leadership on LGBTI rights. The minister condemns the reports, describes Dutch diplomatic and multilateral efforts (EU, OSCE, Equal Rights Coalition, talks with Lavrov and the UN) and notes that LGBTI asylum seekers from Russia are treated as a risk group, while resettlement is a UNHCR decision.
Precise figures are not known, but various media and NGOs speak of 160 persons detained and at least 3 men who died during or after their detention.
Precieze cijfers zijn niet bekend maar verschillende media en ngo's spreken van 160 personen die gevangen zijn gezet en minimaal 3 mannen die tijdens of na hun gevangenschap zijn overleden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Karabulut over de intimidatie van proefpersonen bij medicijntesten in ontwikkelingslanden door farmaceutische bedrijven

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about alleged intimidation of clinical trial participants in Egypt by pharmaceutical company Roche and about oversight of drug testing in developing countries. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies primarily with sponsors, that the Roche matter concerns publication rather than trial conduct, and that EMA-coordinated GCP inspections and the GCP IWG address oversight, without committing to new action.
Ultimately it remains the responsibility of the sponsor, usually a drug manufacturer, to decide where it has its clinical research carried out.
Het blijft uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de sponsor -veelal een fabrikant van geneesmiddelen- om te bepalen waar hij zijn (klinisch) onderzoek laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over export van trucks naar Soedan

MP Karabulut asked whether used military trucks exported by Dutch firms to Sudan, possibly still militarily equipped, were used in the armed conflict and whether this breaches the Sudan arms embargo. The government answered that the trucks were demilitarised and exported as civilian vehicles without licence requirement, that it lacks data on their use in the conflict, that the export does not breach the embargo, and that export criteria for ex-military vehicles were already tightened in 2016.
The ministry does not have independent information on the use of trucks in the armed conflict in Sudan.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over de inzet van trucks in het gewapend conflict in Soedan.
