Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Karabulut over de aandacht die corruptie krijgt in de convenantenaanpak

MPs Hijink and Karabulut asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a reported Shell bribery case in Nigeria, the handling of corruption in the convenant approach, aid and trade policy, and Dutch government support to Shell. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation, described existing anti-corruption policy, OECD guidelines and aid programmes, and said the energy sector convenant had not yet started.
While the Public Prosecution Service investigation is ongoing, no substantive response can be given.
Lopende het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie kan niet inhoudelijk worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat de politie aangiftes van huwelijkse gevangenschap niet in behandeling neemt

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether the government would look into police refusing to record complaints of forced marriage and polygamy, and how many such complaints exist, and whether the government would act further. The minister declined to comment on the individual case citing the ongoing investigation, said the registration cannot separate forced-marriage complaints, pointed to existing expertise bodies, and saw no concrete reason for additional measures.
This concerns an individual case. Caution is required here, in the interest of the investigation and the protection of the privacy of the person concerned.
Het betreft hier een individuele zaak. Hiermee dient terughoudend te worden omgegaan, in het belang van het onderzoek en bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Thieme, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Knops, Karabulut en Van Rooijen over repressieve maatregelen tegen de oppositie door de regering van Wit-Rusland

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about repressive measures against the opposition in Belarus, including arrests of demonstrators and Christian Democrat leaders around the 25 March protest. The minister said the Belarusian authorities' measures were disproportionate, that Nederland raised concerns via EU statements and with the Belarusian ambassador, and that the issue was discussed in the OSCE Permanent Council.
In the cabinet's view, the measures of the Belarusian authorities are not proportionate.
De maatregelen van de Wit-Russische autoriteiten zijn in de ogen van het kabinet niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over minima die bij de gemeentelijke kredietbank van Den Haag goedkoper kunnen lenen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Finance Minister about The Hague's municipal credit bank cutting interest for low-income borrowers from 11.5% to 2.3%, the resulting regional inequality, and whether the national maximum credit charge will be lowered. The government answered that municipal credit banks set rates within statutory limits, regional differences are inherent to decentralised powers, and the AFM will study consumer credit risks including the maximum charge, with results to be sent to parliament.
After this study is completed, the House will be informed of the outcomes.
Na afronding van dit onderzoek wordt uw Kamer over de uitkomsten geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Bommel over Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders

SP MPs asked whether hundreds of North Korean forced labourers work at a Polish shipyard of CRIST S.A. that repairs Dutch civil vessels, whether such labour occurs elsewhere in Europe or the Netherlands, what Dutch and EU action is taken, and how much of their wages go to the North Korean state. The minister replied that Polish inspections found no forced-labour indicators, that Dutch firms are expected to apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and the 2014 ILO Protocol, and that Netherlands has raised the issue in EU and UN fora.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir over schijnconstructies bij de aanleg van de Centrale As in Friesland

MPs Karabulut and Bashir asked whether sham self-employment and underpayment in building the Centrale As road in Friesland, and the Inspectorate's findings, would be addressed by enforcement, a review of provincial tendering rules, and back pay for workers. The minister replied that the courts must decide on employment status and back pay, that the Tax Authority will not comment on individuals, and that the province as main contractor can be held to account and has pledged to act.
The province of Friesland can be called upon in its role as main contracting authority to put matters in order.
De provincie Friesland kan in haar rol van hoofdopdrachtgever aangesproken worden om orde op zaken te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de schokkende uitkomsten van de door FNV Handel uitgevoerde Primark-enquête

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a FNV survey reporting humiliation, intimidation over sick leave and camera surveillance at Primark, and asked for enforcement action. The minister said the Inspectorate SZW will investigate at FNV's request, sick-leave questioning is limited by privacy law, and Primark has pledged to set up works councils, which the minister says is the employee's responsibility to enforce.
At FNV's request, the Inspectorate SZW will carry out a further investigation into working conditions at Primark in the coming period.
De Inspectie SZW gaat de komende periode op verzoek van de FNV een nader onderzoek uitvoeren naar de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Primark.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat uitzendbureaus bereid zijn louter 'wit' personeel te leveren

The MP asks the minister how the government will respond to reports that staffing agencies are willing to supply only white personnel, and whether agencies should be sanctioned or excluded. The minister says discrimination is unacceptable, outlines that the government will not contract discriminating firms only after a final criminal conviction, notes that no contracts have been terminated on that basis, and refers to existing campaigns and a Rijksbrede anonymous application pilot being rejected by a separate ministry.
The cabinet does not accept discrimination and therefore does not want to do business with companies that discriminate.
Het kabinet accepteert geen discriminatie en wil dan ook geen zaken doen met bedrijven die discrimineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Karabulut en Pieter Heerma over illegale huwelijken in moskeeen

MPs Van Nispen, Karabulut and Heerma asked about illegal religious marriages and forced marriage in mosques following an Undercover in Nederland broadcast, and what the government does about it. The minister says the scale is unknown, the Public Prosecution Service has found insufficient grounds for an investigation into the mosques named, and it is raising awareness among relevant parties while gemeenten handle victim care.
The Public Prosecution Service has judged that there are insufficient concrete grounds for a criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft geoordeeld dat er onvoldoende concrete aanknopingspunten zijn voor een opsporingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat bijstandsgerechtigden moeten werken zonder loon, zonder arbeidsrechten, zonder cao of baangarantie voor hun uitkering

MP Karabulut asked whether welfare recipients working for Flextensie without wages, labour rights or a collective agreement, while keeping their benefit, was acceptable, and about displacement of regular work and exploitation. The State Secretary said municipalities have discretion within the Participation Act, that a market-rate fee is charged to clients, that the Flextensie arrangement was checked against legal frameworks, and that municipalities bear responsibility for lawful implementation; she promised to report back on how municipalities apply the instrument.
I am not aware of what kind of work is performed and at which companies.
Het is mij niet bekend wat voor werk wordt verricht en bij welke bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over schoonmakers die werken bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse zaken

MPs asked whether the government will act on cleaners at the Foreign Affairs ministry who may lose jobs after the move to Rijnstraat 8, including whether the government as client will protect their security, alternative work, and a permanent post at the Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie. The minister says the contractor ISS has no legal obligation to take over staff, no specific employment requirements were set, a social plan with partial takeover (9 of 21) was contractually agreed, and the Social Affairs minister is examining priority placement in other government buildings.
I will have the implementation of this plan supervised.
Ik zal toezicht laten houden op de uitvoering van dit plan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep inzake ongehuwd samenwonenden, waarvan de één voor de ander zorgt, niet zonder meer mogen worden beschouwd als stel en de uitkeri

Karabulut (SP) asks how the government will respond to a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that unmarried cohabitants, where one cares for the other, should not automatically be treated as a couple and benefits cannot automatically be cut, and what legal changes will follow. The State Secretary replies that the Participatiewet must be amended, that municipalities must apply the ruling in individual cases meanwhile, and that the government will inform municipalities in the next letter.
The CRvB ruling of 6 December 2016 means that the Participatiewet must be amended.
De uitspraak van de CRvB d.d. 6 december 2016 heeft tot gevolg dat de Participatiewet moet worden gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat jongeren op basis van huidskleur of afkomst veelvuldig worden geweerd aan de deur in het uitgaansleven

An SP MP asked the minister how the government will respond to an Undercover in Nederland broadcast showing young people refused at club doors on the basis of skin colour or ethnic origin, and why municipal anti-discrimination measures have not curbed it. The minister condemned the practice, said municipalities are responsible for enforcement and that no national data on the effect of local measures exists, and promised a review of the municipal approach with the VNG and others in mid-2017 along with a repeated survey of experienced discrimination.
Municipalities bear responsibility for effective policy against discrimination in hospitality.
Gemeenten dragen verantwoordelijkheid voor een effectief beleid tegen horecadiscriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Sittard-Geleen uitkeringsgerechtigden gaat inzetten voor het schoonhouden van de stad

An SP MP asked whether using welfare recipients to keep Sittard-Geleen clean displaces paid work and what the government would do about it. The State Secretary answered that the pilot's tasks are supposed to be additional, that municipalities themselves decide how to prevent displacement, and that the council and existing guidelines cover the issue, without committing to new action.
Municipalities are responsible, within the legal framework, for shaping their own implementation of policy to prevent displacement.
Gemeenten zijn ervoor verantwoordelijk om, gegeven de wettelijke kaders, zelf invulling te geven aan de uitvoering van het beleid om verdringing te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Van Nispen en Karabulut over de aanhouding van demonstranten wegens belediging

Three SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether arrests at a November 2016 demonstration for detained Kurdish parliamentarians were made for insult, how the decisions were taken, what the insults were, whether local authorities banned slogans, whether arrestees will be prosecuted, and whether protest rights are protected. The minister answered that one person was arrested for refusing to hand over a sign reading 'Erdogan Terrorista' with a Hitler-moustache image, which the Public Prosecution Service deemed insulting, that seven others were arrested for violence, that no slogan ban is known, that prosecution of the violence arrestees is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that freedom of expression is not absolute.
The Public Prosecution Service deemed this expression punishable as insult (article 266 of the Criminal Code).
Het Openbaar Ministerie oordeelde deze uiting als strafbaar (belediging, artikel 266 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over “het bericht dat gemeenten mensen van 27 jaar en ouder, vier weken laten wachten bij aanvraag van een bijstandsuitkering”

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how she responds to complaints to the National Ombudsman about a four-week waiting period before applicants aged 27 and over receive social assistance, and whether this breaches the Participatiewet. The state secretary replied that municipal councils are primarily responsible for oversight, that the ministry does not systematically supervise individual municipalities, that an instruction power exists but is not warranted here, and that applicants can appeal and the advance payment obligation protects them.
The ministry of SZW does not exercise systematic supervision over the lawful implementation of the Participatiewet by individual municipalities.
Door het minsterie van SZW wordt geen systematisch toezicht uitgeoefend op de rechtmatige uitvoering van de Participatiewet door individuele gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid  Karabulut over het bericht dat de meeste gemeenten niet toetsen op het verdringen van betaalde banen door onbetaalde banen middels het laten werken zonder loon van uitkeringsgerechtigden

The SP's Karabulut asks the state secretary for Social Affairs how the government responds to FNV findings that most municipalities do not systematically check whether unpaid participation work displaces paid jobs, and about related municipal policy on the tegenprestatie and income supplements. The state secretary answers that municipalities bear responsibility for preventing displacement, points to existing rules and ongoing encouragement of municipalities, and says municipalities have wide discretion on income supplements.
Responsibility for adequately monitoring the prevention of displacement of paid work lies explicitly with the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het adequaat toezien op het voorkomen van verdringing van betaalde arbeid ligt uitdrukkelijk bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat werkzoekenden hondenpoepbakken moeten legen in ruil voor werkervaring

An SP MP asked whether unpaid work-experience placements in Putten, such as emptying dog-waste bins, displace paid work and breach minimum-wage norms, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answered that such placements are a local matter under the Participatiewet, that the municipality reports no displacement, and that the government relies on municipalities to prevent displacement without new national measures.
That is why responsibility lies with the local government to assess this.
Daarom ligt hier een verantwoordelijkheid voor het lokale bestuur om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Poolse vrouwen te maken hebben met scheldpartijen, bedreigingen en aanrandingen

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister of Social Affairs and Employment how the government responds to reports from Stichting Fairwork that Polish women working in factories and agriculture face insults, threats and sexual harassment, and whether the Inspectorate will investigate, check complaints, and bring the campaign on unwanted behaviour to migrant workers in their own language. Minister Asscher replied that the Inspectorate has a risk-based approach to these sectors and will report soon, that the campaign will not be translated but targets employers and includes a migrant worker testimonial, and that information for migrant workers will be provided in origin countries such as Poland.
She will report to me soon, after which I will inform your House.
Ze bericht mij hier binnenkort over, waarna ik uw Kamer zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat zwangerschapsdiscriminatie niet afneemt en dat de meldingsbereidheid is gehalveerd

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister for Social Affairs how to respond to reports that pregnancy discrimination is not declining and that women's willingness to report it has halved, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should be given powers to detect and sanction it. The minister says existing action plans are being given time, a roundtable with the Human Rights Institute and stakeholders was held, further measures are being explored, and the Inspectorate already has a role but individual cases are for the courts or the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Where necessary, additional measures will be taken.
Waar nodig zullen daarbij aanvullende maatregelen worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het afschaffen van de logeerregeling voor statushouders

SP MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about abolishing the guest-family arrangement for status holders, including usage numbers, costs, integration effects, and confusion over whether the scheme was ended. The State Secretary answered that the scheme remains open, the self-care arrangement ended by law, no data exists on integration effects, and the scheme's future is under review.
No data is available on the effect that a status holder's stay with a guest family has on their civic integration.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het effect dat het verblijf van een vergunninghouder in een gastgezin heeft op zijn/haar inburgering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Bommel en Karabulut over het bericht dat de Turkse staatsmedia een lijst met Gülen-organisaties in Nederland heeft gepubliceerd

Two SP MPs asked the government about a Turkish state media list of Gülen-linked organisations in the Netherlands, including whether agreements were made with Turkey to stop intimidation and political export, whether Zaman Nederland and HOGIAF are labelled terrorist, whether extradition or prosecution requests exist, and whether Dutch research was shared with Turkey. The minister replied that the government firmly rejects such lists, has conveyed that Turkish tensions must not be exported, has received no evidence of direct involvement of the named organisations, has received one extradition request under review, and has not directly shared the Dutch research with Turkish authorities.
The cabinet strongly disapproves of lists circulating, in whatever form and composition, and by whomever.
Het kabinet keurt het ten zeerste af dat er lijsten circuleren, in welke vorm en samenstelling dan ook, en door wie dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Turkse Grijze Wolven door de straten van Arnhem marcheren

MPs Karabulut asked whether an Arnhem Turkish festival parade linked to the Grey Wolves was acceptable, whether the municipality and a mosque were connected to the organisers, and whether the municipality should have known. The government answered that the parade had a folkloric character and a permit, that the municipality's only link was facilitating the festival, that free expression has limits but people are judged on conduct, and that the municipality chose to be present at the festival.
It is up to the municipality of Arnhem to decide whether it wants to be represented at a multicultural event in its municipality.
Het is aan de gemeente Arnhem om te bepalen of zij vertegenwoordigd willen zijn in een multicultureel evenement in hun gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Turkse Nederlanders en journalisten worden bedreigd

MP Karabulut asked the Dutch government about threats against Turkish-Dutch people and journalists after the 2016 Turkish coup attempt, including vandalism, boycott lists and calls by the Turkish consulate to support Erdoğan, and about integration policy. The government condemned threats, vandalism and boycott lists, said local authorities use an integrated approach, and referred to earlier letters and consultations for the rest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Bommel en Karabulut over een brief van de Turkse consul-generaal

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam to mayors on handling demonstrations by opponents of the Turkish government, and whether this amounts to political interference. The minister says the letter does not request a ban on demonstrations, that interference in Dutch citizens' choices is unacceptable, and that Turkish tensions should not be exported to the Netherlands, which was raised during his visit to Turkey.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly or covertly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk dan wel heimelijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat een 'Gülenschool' in Amsterdam wordt beveiligd

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked about extra security at Gülen-linked schools in Amsterdam, possible foreign funding of schools, and whether political conflicts should stay out of schools. The state secretary said extra security was temporary and local, that inspection found no sign of external funding, and that schools should not become a political arena, while supporting schools and municipalities.
I am aware that at various schools security was present at the beginning of this school year.
Het is mij bekend dat op verschillende scholen aan het begin van dit schooljaar beveiliging aanwezig was.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de stijging van topinkomens door bonussen aan de ene kant en de laagste loonkostenstijging van de afgelopen twintig jaar aan de andere kant alsmede het bericht dat de volgend

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about rising top incomes through bonuses, the lowest wage-cost growth in twenty years, a McKinsey claim that 70% of Dutch people lost disposable income, and inequality, asking about caps, the Corporate Governance Code, transitional law for the Wet Normering Topinkomens, flexibilisation and the labour income share. The minister answered that pay policy is primarily a company matter, pointed to works council powers and the WNT and financial-sector bonus caps, disputed the McKinsey figure, and said no further policy change was needed.
The fact that pay policy is primarily a matter for the company itself does not change that.
Het feit dat het beloningsbeleid primair een aangelegenheid is voor de onderneming zelf doet daar niets aan af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over een bezoek van een Turkse minister aan Nederland

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked whether a visiting Turkish minister made inflammatory remarks about Gülen supporters and whether he should be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister replied that the statements were the Turkish minister's responsibility, that the government had raised concerns with Turkish authorities and that it does not consider entry bans appropriate.
The cabinet does not share that view. We must remain in dialogue with the Turkish authorities.
Het kabinet deelt die opvatting niet. We moeten in gesprek blijven met de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellingen verstrekken

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Gulf states share information on financing of religious institutions in the Netherlands, including whether a list of Saudi-financed institutions exists and why it is withheld. The answer refers to the oral questions asked on the same topic, so no substantive answers to the written questions are given here.
The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) and Karabulut (SP) (question number 2016Z14749, submitted 13 July 2016) have been answered through oral questions.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Karabulut (SP) (vraagnummer 2016Z14749 , ingezonden 13 juli 2016) zijn beantwoord middels mondelinge vragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Bommel over het bericht dat bedienden van diplomaten uitbuiting op ambassades in Nederland melden

MPs Karabulut and Van Bommel asked whether exploitation of domestic staff of diplomats at embassies in the Netherlands is acceptable, whether further investigation and sanctions are possible, and whether staff are informed of their rights. The minister replied that Dutch labour law applies, but inspection and enforcement bodies lack legal competence on embassy premises, so BZ relies on semi-annual monitoring interviews, a sanction of withdrawing the domestic-staff privilege, and rights briefings.

Based on the Vienna Conventions on Diplomatic and Consular Relations and the headquarters agreements with international organisations, Dutch inspection and investigative services have no legal authority to investigate or enforce on the premises of embassies, consulates or international organisations.

Op basis van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake Diplomatiek Verkeer, het Verdrag van Wenen inzake Consulaire Betrekkingen en zetelverdragen tussen hier gevestigde internationale organisaties en Nederland hebben Nederlandse inspectie- en opsporingsdiensten geen wettelijke bevoegdheid om onderzoek te doen op het terrein van ambassades, consulaten en/of internationale organisaties of om daar handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Karabulut over het bericht dat de vrouwenopvang onveilig is

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about reports that women's shelters are unsafe, with reports of fear cultures, volunteer and flex staffing, bureaucracy, debt, high contributions and weak housing pathways. The State Secretary answered that no further signals of a fear culture were received, that the matters are largely for municipalities and ongoing projects, and promised continued monitoring and talks with the Federatie Opvang.
This concerns a limited number of anonymous sources.
Het gaat hier om een beperkt aantal anonieme bronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Moderne slavernij bij IJmond Werkt’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports of intimidation and exploitation of workers at the social work provider IJmond Werkt, including whether benefit recipients were forced to pack sex toys and whether the Labour Inspectorate would investigate. The State Secretary replied that implementation of the Participatiewet lies with the municipality, that the Inspectorate works risk-based and sees no reason to investigate now, while noting that workers can file complaints with the Inspectorate.
I therefore cannot go into the specific case.
Ik kan derhalve niet ingaan op de concrete casus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over het bericht dat extreem rechtse milities de buitengrenzen van de Europese Unie bewaken

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether Pegida Nederland members are hunting asylum seekers at the Bulgarian-Turkish border, whether such participation is criminal, how it is monitored, how many Dutch nationals are involved, and whether Dutch and Bulgarian justice have been in contact. The minister said he has no overview of Pegida members there, that Dutch criminal law could apply under article 7 Sr while Bulgarian authorities have primary responsibility, that the Dutch OM decides on opportunity to investigate, and that no contact with Bulgarian justice has taken place.
I have no overview of Pegida Nederland members who may be guarding the external borders of the EU in Bulgaria.
Ik heb geen overzicht van leden van Pegida Nederland die mogelijkerwijs in Bulgarije de buitengrenzen van de EU bewaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de mantelzorgers financiële problemen heeft

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the government how it views reports that over half of informal carers face financial problems, why carers were not informed about changes in care, and what concrete measures will be taken. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for supporting carers under the Wmo 2015, that the cited Nibud study should be qualified, and that no concrete measures were announced beyond pointing to municipal responsibility.
It is up to municipalities to translate this responsibility into policy and implementation.
Het is aan gemeenten om deze verantwoordelijkheid door te vertalen in beleid en uitvoering.

Vragen van de leden Smaling en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de actieagenda Schiphol de problemen niet oplo

MPs Smaling and Karabulut (SP) asked whether unfair competition from Gulf and Turkish carriers, social premium evasion, sham self-employment, slot allocation and Schiphol security threaten Schiphol and KLM and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that the position of Schiphol and KLM is still strong, pointed to EU mandates for aviation agreements and existing EU rules, and declined new legislation or changes to Schiphol's public status.
The cabinet sees no reason to change the current status.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de huidige status te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over huurverlaging bij inkomensdaling

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked why housing corporations need not reduce rents when tenants' incomes fall, and why the government does not expand rent reductions after income decline. The minister replied that the law already allows tenants with income falling after income-dependent rent increases to request a reduction, that he is not willing to widen this, and that he will survey corporations on how often reductions were granted.
In the committee debate of 25 May 2016 I committed to asking the housing corporations this autumn how often they have lowered the rent at the tenant's request due to income decline.

In het AO Diverse woononderwerpen van 25 mei 2016 heb ik toegezegd dat ik dit najaar bij de woningcorporaties ga navragen hoe vaak zij de huurprijs op voorstel van de huurder wegens inkomensdaling hebben verlaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Edese burgemeester die Marokkaanse autoriteiten inschakelt om jongeren onder controle te krijgen

Karabulut (SP) asked about unrest among youths in Ede's Veldhuizen district, reported involvement of Moroccan authorities, and integration policy. The minister relayed the municipality's account of the disorder and measures taken (emergency orders, dispersal bans, extra policing), said the Moroccan consul's involvement was addressed in an earlier answer, and stated that local integration policy is a municipal matter and no additional policy is needed for now.
Neighbourhood and district policy is a local matter.
Wijk- en buurtbeleid is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman over het bericht over een bedreigd Rotterdams gezin

MPs Karabulut and Kooiman asked whether honour-related violence against a Rotterdam family is being recognised and acted on in time, and whether knowledge should be strengthened at police units. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because a criminal investigation is ongoing, defended the existing police and LEC EGG structure, and agreed knowledge should be present in all regional units while saying existing arrangements already provide for it.
However, I cannot go into the details of an individual case, because of the privacy of those involved and in the interest of the criminal investigation that is still ongoing.
Ik kan echter niet ingaan op de details van een individuele casus, vanwege de privacy van betrokkenen en in het belang van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat momenteel nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over strafrechtelijke boetes in de schuldhulpverlening

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked about a Rotterdam court ruling forcing the CJIB into a debt-settlement arrangement, the inability to include recent versus nearly-expired criminal fines in voluntary debt schemes, and whether this would lead to more forced settlements. The State Secretary defended the enforcement of criminal fines, citing installment options, clemency, and the statute of limitations extension, and said he finds widespread final debt relief undesirable.
For Wahv sanctions, as stated in the answer to question 2, since 1 January 2016 further collection of outstanding Wahv sanctions is ended after a successfully completed voluntary debt settlement.

Voor de Wahv-sancties geldt dat, zoals in antwoord op vraag 2 gemeld, sinds 1 januari 2016 de verdere inning van openstaande Wahv-sancties wordt beëindigd na een succesvol afgeronde minnelijke schuldregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over de arbeidsomstandigheden van de beveiliging op Schiphol

Three MPs asked whether working conditions for airport security staff at Schiphol had improved despite earlier promises, whether TNO's dwell-time recommendations were implemented, and whether Schiphol as client should be held to account, including whether security should return to a public body. Minister Asscher answered that employers and CAO parties are responsible, that the Inspectorate has received no complaints, that a new TNO report recommends a 120-minute dwell limit under review by June, and that no public body is needed.

Schiphol and the security companies have indicated that, until the new TNO report's recommendations are translated into practical and feasible dwell-time agreements, the current CAO norm of a maximum dwell time of 150 minutes is strictly observed.

Schiphol en de beveiligingsbedrijven hebben aangegeven dat, totdat de aanbevelingen uit het nieuwe TNO-rapport zijn vertaald in praktische en haalbare afspraken over statijden, de norm die in de huidige CAO staat – een maximale statijd van 150 minuten – strikt wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat de afgelopen maanden 60 kindbruiden Nederland zijn binnengekomen

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked about reports that around 60 child brides had entered the Netherlands in recent months, the number of Syrian child brides, and how minors' safety and registration would be ensured. The state secretary confirmed roughly 60 married minor girls entered independently between September 2015 and January 2016, said the IND would not separately register child marriages, and described existing guardianship and reception measures while declining to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into the individual circumstances.
Vanwege privacyaspecten kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat schoonmakers uitgebuit worden in hotels

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that hotel cleaners are exploited and paid below the minimum wage, including at Bastion hotels, and what measures will be taken. The minister said fair pay is important, that the Inspectie SZW monitors compliance and inspectors are trained to spot signs of labour exploitation, while enforcement of the collective agreement is primarily the responsibility of the social partners.
When social partners suspect the collective agreement is not being complied with, they can, under article 10 of the AVV Act, submit a request to the Inspectorate SZW to investigate.
Wanneer sociale partners vermoeden dat de cao niet wordt nageleefd, kunnen zij op grond van artikel 10 van de wet AVV bij de Inspectie SZW een verzoek indienen om hier onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de stijging van topinkomens door bonussen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the 23% rise in AEX executive bonuses is excessive and whether the Corporate Governance Code should cap variable pay at 10%, and asked for research into top versus lowest incomes and action on ABN Amro's CEO pay. The minister called the trend a wrong signal but said pay is primarily for companies and shareholders, declined to research or impose a cap, and promised a Works Councils Act amendment requiring boards to discuss pay with the works council.
In principle shareholders, supervisory directors and executives decide on pay policy, not the cabinet.
In beginsel gaan aandeelhouders, commissarissen en bestuurders over het beloningsbeleid, niet het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders en de verwevenheid met incassobureaus

SP MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Minister of Justice about the independence of bailiffs (gerechtsdeurwaarders) and their ties to debt-collection agencies, including the role of legal insurer DAS and the use of 'incasso & gerechtsdeurwaarders' branding. The minister replied that the 49% third-party stake cap and participation ban in the current KBvG regulation adequately protect independence, that enforcement of these rules rests mainly with the KBvG and disciplinary court, and that misuse of the bailiff title will be addressed through the new register and criminal complaints.
It is primarily up to the KBvG to give form to independence in professional practice through its regulatory power.
Het is primair aan de KBvG om de onafhankelijkheid in de beroepspraktijk vorm te geven met haar verordenende bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Uitgehuwelijkt: ‘Teruggaan betekent mijn dood’

MPs Yücel and Karabulut asked about a report of women forced into marriage while on holiday abroad and what the government does about it. The minister says forced marriage is criminal, cites prosecution options, prevention and awareness campaigns, and an action plan, but says no hard data on the number of cases exists.
It is inherent in the nature of the problem that no hard data are available on this.
Het is inherent aan de aard van de problematiek, dat hierover geen harde gegevens beschikbaar zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat vijftig schoonmakers in Dordrecht worden ontslagen en dat hun werk wordt overgenomen door mensen met een uitkering en/of werkers van de sociale werkvoorzienin

An SP MP asked whether Dordrecht's outsourcing of cleaning work to people on benefits and sheltered-employment workers, replacing dismissed regular cleaners, amounts to displacement of paid work and what the government will do. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for preventing displacement, that the Inspectorate SZW supervises only aggregate municipal performance, and that municipalities may choose how to contract cleaning, without committing to new action.
Responsibility for adequately monitoring the prevention of displacement of paid work lies expressly with the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het adequaat toezien op het voorkomen van verdringing van betaalde arbeid ligt uitdrukkelijk bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat gemeenten in 2015 een half miljard euro tekort hebben op de bijzondere bijstand

Karabulut (SP) asks how the government reacts to reports that municipalities face a half-billion euro shortfall on special assistance in 2015, whether it will compensate municipalities for asylum-related costs and rising trusteeship costs, and whether it will compensate them for austerity-driven pressure. The state secretary rejects the premise of a earmarked budget, points to the reconstructed allocation in the municipal fund, and promises monitoring and a follow-up study without committing to new compensation.
The funds for special assistance form part of the general grant of the municipal fund and are therefore freely available for spending.
De middelen voor bijzondere bijstand maken onderdeel uit van de algemene uitkering van het gemeentefonds en zijn daarmee vrij besteedbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘gemeenten mensen met problematische schulden niet helpen’

MPs Karabulut (SP) asked the state secretary about a broadcast reporting that municipalities refuse debt help to people with problematic debts, asking about waiting times, incapable court-appointed administrators, and inequality. The government replied that the Wgs forbids categorical exclusion, pointed to guidance and an ongoing evaluation, cited new quality rules and centralised checks for administrators, and listed debt-reduction measures, mostly without new commitments or hard figures.
That is why the Wgs also sets a maximum waiting time of 4 weeks from request for help to first interview and an obligation to give the person seeking help insight into processing times.
Daarom kent de Wgs ook een maximumwachttijd van 4 weken van hulpvraag tot eerste gesprek en een verplichting om de hulpvrager inzicht te bieden in de doorlooptijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over de opbouw van schulden naar aanleiding van gedwongen opname in een ggz-instelling

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked why people compulsorily admitted to psychiatric facilities may lose benefits and face debts, and whether this gap was known and remains unfixed. The state secretary answered that such persons are eligible for special assistance (bijzondere bijstand) under the Participatiewet, which was amended in 2008 with retroactive effect, leaving municipalities to decide case by case; she did not provide figures on affected people.
I do not have figures on this matter.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat gevluchte Eritrese vrouwen zijn gedwongen tot seks

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Eritrean refugee women were forced into sex, including how many are pregnant and whether they are in asylum centres. The minister answers that about 25 women report unwanted pregnancy and three report rape, that COA took preventive measures and reported signals to police, and that no formal complaints have yet been filed and no criminal offences established.
COA cannot assess the seriousness and truthfulness of these signals and has reported them to the police and the Expertise Centre on Human Trafficking and Smuggling (EMM).
Het COA kan de ernst en het waarheidsgehalte van deze signalen niet inschatten en heeft deze signalen gemeld bij de politie en Expertisecentrum Mensenhandel en Mensensmokkel (EMM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Wajonger kan uitkering kwijtraken’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs whether Wajongers would be re-assessed after 2018 and lose their benefits, as reported by Trouw. The government answered that the reclassification only determines work capacity, that benefits drop from 75% to 70% of minimum wage for those with capacity, and that no benefit entitlement is revoked.
It is not correct that all Wajongers will be re-assessed from 2018.
Het klopt niet dat alle Wajongers vanaf 2018 opnieuw zullen worden gekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de Al Fitrahmoskee en daaraan verbonden organisaties leven als een profeet in Utrecht Overvecht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the Al Fitrah mosque and linked organisations in Utrecht Overvecht operate as a parallel community, including questions on financing, possible criminal investigation, and safeguards for children and residents. The government answered that local authorities agreed with Al Fitrah on greater openness and monitoring, declined to say whether a criminal investigation exists, and referred to a forthcoming letter on salafism and to local action plans against radicalisation and poverty.
The cabinet makes no statement about whether a criminal investigation is ongoing.
Over het al dan niet lopen van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek doet het kabinet geen mededeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat de Al Fitrah-moskee dubieus geld heeft ontvangen

MPs Karabulut and Van Raak asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque's funding from Kuwait, including ties to an entity once on a US sanctions list, was checked by intelligence and tax authorities, what the municipality knew, and what action the government would take. The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the municipality had known of the Kuwaiti funding since 2014, and deferred the mosque-funding question to a forthcoming letter on salafism.
In general, I do not make statements about specific cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper Van Dijk over studieschuld als nieuwe restschuld en zieke werknemers als gevolg van schuld

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked whether student debt reduces mortgage capacity, can be concealed when applying for a mortgage, causes problem debts among workers, and whether sickness absence linked to financial problems will be investigated and addressed. The government answered that student loans are weighted lower than consumer credit in mortgage assessments, that lenders' duty of care and applicants' disclosure duty suffice, that repayment is income-contingent with debt forgiveness after 35 years, and that it will await TNO research results and develop a website for employers on financial problems.
To verify the amount of the student debt, and thus as proof, the former student can simply print an overview from mijnDUO.
Ter verificatie van de hoogte van de studieschuld en dus als bewijsstuk, kan de oud-student eenvoudigweg een overzicht vanuit mijnDUO uitdraaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Eritreeërs in Nederland slecht integreren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Eritrean immigrants in the Netherlands integrate poorly under influence of the Eritrean regime, including questions on interpreters, Eritrean schools and organisations, trauma care and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that intimidation is unacceptable, that IND interpreters undergo vetting and can be replaced, that no Eritrean schools exist, that trauma is addressed in the asylum procedure, and that extortion would be investigated by police and prosecutors.
Intimidation, however, is unacceptable. Restriction of the freedom of Dutch citizens by the Eritrean government is not tolerated.
Intimidatie is echter uit den boze. Beperking van de vrijheid van Nederlandse burgers door de Eritrese overheid wordt niet getolereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘dat werkgevers veel minder banen voor mensen met een arbeidsbeperking hebben gerealiseerd’.

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that employers have created far fewer jobs for people with work disabilities than promised, including unfilled vacancies and temporary contracts. The state secretary replied that AWVN-supported employers have registered 7,653 workplace ambitions with 3,089 jobs realised among 120 employers, that most vacancies are adapted functions, and that the government will measure the banenafspraak results around summer 2016.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Dordrecht schoonmakers wil ontslaan om hun werkzaamheden uit te laten voeren door mensen met een uitkering en/ of werkers van de sociale werkvoorz

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Dordrecht's plan to dismiss fifty cleaners and hand their work to welfare recipients and sheltered-work employees is permitted under the Participatiewet, and whether displacement of paid work is acceptable and warrants an Inspectorate investigation. The state secretary answered that the GR Drechtsteden chose not to renew its commercial cleaning contract and reorganised the work internally, that displacement risk is a municipal matter for the council to monitor, and that the Inspectorate does not supervise individual municipalities.
However, the risk of displacement can only be assessed case by case and at local level; this is a municipal task.
Het risico op verdringing kan echter alleen per geval en op lokaal niveau worden beoordeeld, dit betreft een gemeentelijke taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat buschauffeurs worden vervangen door medewerkers van de sociale werkplaats"

An MP asked whether Meppel replacing bus drivers with social workplace and benefit recipients, including unpaid 'tegenprestatie' riders, is desirable and whether it displaces paid work. The government answered that the choice lies with the municipality and its council, that the Inspectie SZW will not investigate individual municipalities, and that displacement means unfair competition causing job loss.
No, it is not the task of the Inspectie SZW to supervise individual municipalities. The municipal council has a supervisory task here.
Nee, het is geen taak van de Inspectie SZW om toezicht te houden op individuele gemeenten. De gemeenteraad heeft hier een controlerende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut inzake de sluiting van leerwerkbedrijven

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked why the Werkartaal social-firm training provider for vulnerable youth and others is closing, whether the Participatiewet cuts are harming vulnerable groups, and what the government will do to preserve such pathways. The minister answers that the closure stems from lack of participants and falling employer demand, that the government cannot support individual private work-learning companies, and that gemeenten and other providers can take over.
The Ministry of OCW therefore cannot take measures to support an individual work-learning company that is in financial distress.
Het Ministerie van OCW kan dan ook geen maatregelen nemen om een individueel leerwerkbedrijf dat in financiële nood verkeert te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over enorme loongroei van topbestuurders

MP Karabulut asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a sharp rise in pay for top executives of listed companies in 2014, whether the 28% and 24% increases were excessive, how to reduce the pay gap with workers, and whether pay ratios and the Corporate Governance Code could be regulated. The minister said pay is a matter for shareholders and boards, that the government will widen works council powers and supports EU proposals for shareholder influence and pay-ratio transparency, but declined to disclose pay ratios or legally cap them.
With this legislative amendment the government wants to stimulate precisely this discussion and companies' awareness of it.
Met deze wetswijziging wil de regering juist deze discussie en het bewustzijn van bedrijven hieromtrent stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over de handelspraktijken van incassobureaus

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked about debt collection agencies' practices, including excessive pressure, threats of measures they cannot legally take, excessive collection costs and time-barred claims, and whether fines or consumer protection would follow the ACM report. The minister answers that no fines have yet been imposed, that the ACM and AFM will act jointly, that consumers can reclaim undue costs and seek legal advice, and that she rejects making excessive collection costs a tort, citing existing remedies.
At this moment, no fines have yet been imposed for the problems identified in the report.
Op dit moment zijn voor de in het rapport gesignaleerde problemen nog geen boetes opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over het bericht dat huurverhogingen leiden tot armoede

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked whether rent increases cause poverty and whether the government will curb rents and help affected tenants. The minister answered that income drops drive payment problems, that the rent-cap agreement and bill are in progress, refused a rent freeze, and pointed the tenant to rent reduction and housing-allocation options.
No, I am not willing to oblige landlords to freeze rents.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid verhuurders te verplichten de huren te bevriezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over misstanden in de vrouwenopvang in Heemskerk

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about alleged abuses (exploitation, hygiene, intimidation, prostitution) at a women's shelter in Heemskerk, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should investigate and whether the problems extend to other regions. The State Secretary answered that the responsible alderman and the operator are handling the signals, the Inspectorate had no role since the signals did not concern working conditions, the operator being the commissioner of the inquiry does not per se undermine independence, and the ministry passed on signals it received while the responsible municipalities supervise the shelters.
It is not directly for me to judge whether the alleged abuses have been sufficiently investigated in this way.
Het is niet direct aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de vraag of de vermeende misstanden op deze wijze voldoende onderzocht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut inzake het bericht 'Gülen runt nieuw lectoraat Inholland'

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked about reports that the Gülen movement runs a new lectorate at Inholland via the business association Hogiaf, and whether this is desirable and whether the school knew Hogiaf's background. The minister answered that Inholland guarantees the lectorate's independence, that the school will consider ending the cooperation if members actively promote Gülen ideology, and that the government has no overview of Gülen-linked organisations, with a parliamentary motion for further research pending.
The Dutch government does not have an overview of organisations operating under, or affiliated with, the Gülen movement.
De Nederlandse overheid beschikt niet over een overzicht van organisaties die opereren onder, of gelieerd zijn aan, de Gülen-beweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat vrouwen nog steeds minder verdienen dan mannen

MPs Karabulut and Siderius asked the ministers how they react to reports that women still earn less than men for equal work, why women over 35 earn less, what the pay gaps are, what agreements exist with social partners, and what role the government sees for itself. The ministers answer that pay discrimination is unacceptable, that much of the gap stems from different labour-market positions, cite CBS findings and ongoing actions and studies, and promise further updates in early 2016.
Nowadays it is not explainable that it still occurs that women earn less than men for equivalent work.
Het is heden ten dage niet uit te leggen dat het nog altijd voorkomt dat vrouwen minder verdienen dan mannen voor gelijkwaardig werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de procedure herindeling Wajong

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about the UWV procedure for reassessing young disabled people (Wajong), including people with a day-care indication and those who no longer meet Wsw minimum criteria, and whether they could go straight to Wajong without a new procedure. The government answered that people with an AWBZ day-care indication are presumed to have no work capacity and are not invited, that no data exist on those unknown to UWV because no legal basis for data exchange with CIZ exists, and that no one had been invited in the first two quarters of 2015.
On your question whether I have insight into the size of the group of Wajong recipients with a day-care indication of whom UWV is unaware, I must answer that no data on this are known.
Op uw vraag of ik inzicht heb in de omvang van de groep Wajongers met een indicatie dagbesteding zonder dat UWV hiervan op de hoogte is, moet ik u antwoorden dat hierover geen gegevens bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over het optreden van de Turkse politie en het leger in het zuidoosten van Turkije

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish military and police operations in southeastern Turkey, including civilian deaths, curfews and the Domestic Security Bill. The minister said the Netherlands lacks verified casualty figures, acknowledged concerns about proportionality and mobility restrictions, and said it raised the issue with Turkey and suggested an independent inquiry.
The Netherlands has brought the option of an independent investigation to the attention of the Turkish authorities.
Nederland heeft de optie van een onafhankelijk onderzoek onder de aandacht gebracht van de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over minderjarige Syrische bruiden

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked how the government will prevent forced child marriages of Syrian girls who come to the Netherlands to reunite with husbands, what steps follow arrival, how many child brides have arrived, and what support is offered. The government answered that the Wet Huwelijksdwang will set the minimum marriage and recognition age at 18, that Nidos, IND and COA watch for signs of forced marriage, that research on informal marriages is underway, and that tailored psychological support and specialist shelter are available.
Child brides are not separately registered in the IND registration system.
Kindbruiden worden niet apart geregistreerd in het IND-registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Rotterdamse bijstandsgerechtigden verplicht papier moeten prikken als tegenprestatie

Karabulut (SP) asked the State Secretary about reports that Rotterdam welfare recipients must do unpaid work such as paper-picking as a counter-performance, including SDW's costs, displacement risk, and the Rotterdam ombudsman's findings. Secretary Klijnsma answered that WerkLoont is a reintegration programme rather than a counter-performance, that implementation and oversight lie with Rotterdam's municipal council and mayor and alderman, and that the minister has no role to judge the local practice.
Given the decentralised character of the Participation Act, municipalities have considerable policy and implementation freedom to shape participation and reintegration policy.
Gemeenten hebben gezien het decentrale karakter van de Participatiewet een grote beleids- en uitvoeringsvrijheid om het participatie- en re-integratiebeleid vorm en inhoud te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘de gemeente Almere mensen in de bijstand dwingt om onderbetaald werk uit te voeren’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Almere forces welfare recipients into underpaid work, whether this displaces regular workers, whether the Participatiewet should be changed, and about JS Consultancy's earnings and EU subsidies. The government denies compulsion, describes the arrangement as a werkervaringstraject for higher-educated welfare recipients with a training and coaching phase, rejects displacement and any need to amend the law, and says it has no information on JS Consultancy's earnings.
Based on the information provided to me by the municipality of Almere, I cannot endorse your claim that the municipality obliges welfare recipients to perform underpaid work.
Op basis van de mij beschikbaar gestelde informatie van de gemeente Almere kan ik uw stelling dat de gemeente bijstandsgerechtigden verplicht om onderbetaald werk uit te voeren niet onderschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over knelpunten in de inkomensvoorziening voor jongeren met opgeschorte Wajong-2015

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked whether severely multiply disabled young people over 18 can continue learning and what support exists after the Wajong-2015 study allowance ended. The government replied that vso attendance is possible until age 20 with exemptions, that gemeenten may grant studietoeslag or bijzondere bijstand, and that it has no insight into how many municipalities provide bijzondere bijstand to this group.
I have no insight into the extent to which municipalities provide individual special assistance to severely multiply disabled young people aged 18 and over without labour market prospects.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de mate waarin gemeenten individuele bijzondere bijstand verstrekken aan meervoudig gehandicapte jongeren van 18 jaar en ouder zonder arbeidsmarktperspectief.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de Turkse premier Davutoglu mede namens zijn AK partij een brief heeft verstuurd naar Turkse Nederlanders over de Turkse verkiezingen van 1 november a.s.

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about a letter from Turkish PM Davutoglu to Turkish Dutch citizens urging a vote for the AK party, including how he obtained their data, Dutch data-protection concerns, and Turkish-language bilingual education. The government answered that political activity by foreign parties is permitted within legal limits, that the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) has requested information and its outcome awaited, and that Turkish-language primary education is not permitted.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) has sent a request for information.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft een verzoek om inlichtingen uitgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat minder nieuwkomers inburgeren

The MP Karabulut asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that integration of newcomers is stalling, including inadequate websites, unclear English-language information, and a falling pass rate. The minister replies that most integration obligees are actively pursuing their courses, that existing support via municipalities and Vluchtelingenwerk is adequate, that the pass-rate drop is partly due to the 2015 exam change, and that no additional measures are planned.
For now I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie vooralsnog geen reden om aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Koser-Kaya, Karabulut en Schouten over de brief ‘Eerste tussenmeting banenafspraak’

MPs asked about Wsw sheltered-employment placements, waiting-list trends, hours worked and job counts under the banenafspraak (jobs agreement) for disabled workers in 2013-2014. The state secretary answered with Panteia and UWV figures, showing a shift from sheltered workshops to external placements and an increase of 7,304 unique extra jobs, and said the 2015 results would follow around summer 2016.
You will receive the answers in advance of the General Consultation on the Participation Act of 29 October.
U ontvangt de antwoorden voorafgaand aan het Algemeen overleg Participatiewet van 29 oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Koerden in heel Europa en ook in Nederland worden belaagd

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of attacks and threats against Kurds in the Netherlands, the government's response to Kurdish appeals for protection, and its engagement with Turkish and Kurdish organisations to prevent tensions. The minister confirmed incidents at Kurdish association buildings in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, called violence and intimidation unacceptable (leaving enforcement to police and prosecutors), and described planned dialogue meetings with Turkish and Kurdish organisations.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to act on this.
Het is aan de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie om hierop te acteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een verlamde Haagse jongen gewoon moet solliciteren

An SP MP asked the state secretary how a paralysed, ventilator-dependent young man on a Wajong benefit could receive a preliminary notice that he has working capacity and must apply for jobs, and whether similar cases exist. The state secretary answered that the UWV's reassessment procedure relies on existing records, that the recipient can object and obtain a full assessment, that no comparable cases are known, and that the UWV has since started a reassessment of this case.
The UWV has since received a response form in which the person concerned states that he does not agree with the proposed classification.
Het UWV heeft inmiddels een reactieformulier ontvangen waarin betrokkene aangeeft niet akkoord te gaan met de voorgenomen indeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de vertrekregelingen van drie functionarissen bij Woonzorg Nederland

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about large exit payments to three executives of housing corporation Woonzorg Nederland, including whether one executive was moved to a lower post to escape the WNT pay cap. The Minister answered that the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties will investigate legality and enforce repayment if the rules were breached, and that the Aedes governance code is a matter for the sector itself.
The Autoriteit Woningcorporaties (Aw) supervises compliance with the WNT by executives and internal supervisors in the housing corporation sector.
De Autoriteit Woningcorporaties (Aw) ziet toe op de naleving van de WNT door bestuurders en interne toezichthouders in de woningcorporatiesector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht 'Gemeente Enschede frustreert aanvragen bijstand'

Karabulut (SP) asked the state secretary to respond to the Ombudsman's finding that Enschede imposes a four-week search period on benefit applicants aged 27 and over, and whether this breaches the Participatiewet and whether other municipalities do the same. The state secretary said the Ombudsman found Enschede's information about direct applications unclear, that the municipal council and ultimately the courts are responsible for oversight, that no signals exist of Rotterdam or other municipalities imposing the same term, and that no directive (aanwijzing) is warranted since the letter of the law is not breached.
It is up to the municipal council to monitor the implementation of Enschede's policy and, if there is reason to do so, to raise it at the council meeting.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om de uitvoering van het beleid van de gemeente Enschede te controleren en, indien daar aanleiding toe is, in de Raadsvergadering aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat éénvijfde van de oud-studenten wanbetaler is

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers whether one in five former students being in arrears on student loan repayment is worrying, what measures will prevent further debt, and whether enforcement and the draagkracht scheme work as intended. The minister answered that arrears are varied (many small), that the share has stayed around 20 percent, that new measures and stricter enforcement are being used, and that the government does not expect the new loan system to produce more defaulters, but no new concrete commitments beyond existing monitoring were given.
It is correct that 20.6 percent of former students with a repayment obligation have a payment arrear (as of 1 June 2015).
Het klopt dat 20,6 procent van de oud-studenten met een terugbetaalverplichting een betalingsachterstand heeft (stand per 1 juni 2015).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht “Bankieren duurder voor kwetsbaren”

Karabulut (SP) asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about ABN AMRO raising bank tariffs for professional debt administrators (bewindvoerders) managing accounts of vulnerable people, and whether the government would intervene. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that tariffs are a matter for banks themselves, that the government sees no reason for measures despite state shareholding, and that dialogue between banks and administrators is advisable.
That said, setting tariffs is a matter for which banks themselves are responsible.
Vooropgesteld moet echter worden dat de tariefstelling bij banken een aangelegenheid is waarvoor de banken zelf verantwoordelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over onbereikbaar zijn van duur MBO voor kinderen van minima

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about reports that expensive MBO vocational education is out of reach for children of low-income families, with some schools redirecting pupils who cannot pay to other options or to Leergeld foundations. The minister says the situation is unwelcome, that schools may require only tuition and not other fees, that the inspectorate monitors school-cost policy, and that she will ask the MBO Raad to promote instalment payment schemes and report back to parliament.
I will inform your House of this in writing.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover schriftelijke informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Potters aan over import van imams uit Marokko en Turkije en bondgenootschap met de Marokkaanse en Turkse overheid voor integratie en de-radicalisering

Two MPs asked the minister about importing imams from Turkey and Morocco, Turkish state links to mosque organisations, and cooperation with the Moroccan and Turkish governments on integration and de-radicalisation. The minister answered at length, defending continued contact with the foreign states, stating he is not in favour of foreign imams, and promising a follow-up letter on the Turkish organisations by 15 November.
I will inform you no later than 15 November about how the motion adopted at the integration debate of 2 July will be implemented, concerning follow-up research into these organisations.
Ik informeer u uiterlijk 15 november over de wijze van uitvoering van de motie die is aangenomen bij het VAO integratieonderwerpen van 2 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Karabulut over misstanden in de vrouwenopvang

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about reported abuses and poor living conditions in a women's shelter in Heemskerk, including hygiene problems, prostitution, intimidation, financial hardship and weak guidance, and asked for independent inquiry and permanent control. The State Secretary said a GGD emergency inspection found inadequate cleaning, Haarlem did not declare the location unfit, an improvement plan and an independent inquiry by J. Haanstra (results expected November) were launched, and that toezicht and shelter quality are the responsibility of centrumgemeenten, so no separate national investigation was ordered.
Before the results of this investigation are available, expected in November of this year, I refrain from giving a substantive judgment on this matter.
Voordat de resultaten van dit onderzoek beschikbaar zijn, naar verwachting in november van dit jaar, onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijk oordeel over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat het Hoogheemraadschap Delfland stopt met het kwijtschelden van waterschapsbelasting aan minima

MPs asked the government whether it supports municipalities' calls for Hoogheemraadschap Delfland to keep waiving water board charges for low-income residents, and about waterschap waiver policy generally. The state secretary answered that waiver decisions belong to each water board's democratically elected general board, that all water boards currently grant waivers, and that he plans to invite the Unie van Waterschappen to discuss poverty and debt.
Setting the level of water board charges and whether to waive them in whole or in part is decided in a democratic process.
Het vaststellen van de hoogte van de waterschapsbelastingen en het al dan niet (gedeeltelijk) kwijtschelden van waterschapsbelastingen wordt in een democratisch proces bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Integratiesubsidies weggesluisd’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that integration subsidies to FORUM were diverted to a account used for private spending, and whether fraud signals played a role in dismantling FORUM. The minister declined to comment on the fraud allegations pending a Public Prosecution Service investigation, described the timeline of the criminal complaint and the dismissal decision, and rejected a broader audit as not opportune.
Since this specific matter is under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, I refrain from commenting on the fraud allegations raised in this report.
Aangezien deze specifieke zaak onderwerp is van onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie onthoud ik mij van commentaar over de beschuldigingen van fraude die geuit zijn in dit bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Merkies over de toename van de kloof tussen arm en rijk in Amsterdam

MPs Karabulut and Merkies asked the ministers about a report showing rising rich-poor segregation in Amsterdam, the role of the state, housing liberalisation and possible action with the municipality. Minister Asscher answered that Amsterdam ranks relatively low on segregation among the 13 cities studied, that government focuses on equal opportunities in education and the labour market, and that the municipality shares responsibility for affordable housing.

Moreover, a further study into the spatial distribution and mixing of different groups in the Netherlands is currently being carried out on behalf of the Minister for Housing and Central Government Reform.
Overigens wordt momenteel, in opdracht van de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst, een nader onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de ruimtelijke spreiding en menging van verschillende groepen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Kerstens en Voortman over de risico’s voor het personeel als gevolg van de nieuwe beveiliging op Schiphol

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of dangerous situations, overtime breaches, and poor working conditions for security staff at Schiphol after a new central security concept, and whether the tender cut hours despite rising workload. The minister said working conditions are the employer's responsibility, the Inspectorate SZW saw no reason for project research, and that Schiphol decides on tendering and contractors while the private Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag and CAO partners handle enforcement.
The Inspectorate SZW has recently not conducted any investigation into security companies at Schiphol or elsewhere in the country.
Er heeft recentelijk geen onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW plaatsgevonden naar beveiligingsbedrijven op Schiphol of elders in het land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karalabut over het bericht dat ouderen afzien van zorg vanwege geldgebrek

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the ministers of health and social affairs about reports that elderly people forgo care due to money problems, including questions on rising out-of-pocket costs, dental care, municipal co-payments, and income losses for pensioners. The minister answered that no evidence shows growing numbers forgoing Wmo or Wlz care because of co-payments, that a study on care avoidance will be sent to parliament before the budget debate, and that income measures will be weighed in the August decision-making.
Research into the nature and extent of care avoidance is currently being carried out.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzoek verricht naar de aard en omvang van zorgmijding.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over ‘onduidelijkheden over de hoogte van de mobiliteitsbonus en het doelgroepenregister voor schoolverlaters van het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs, praktijkonderwijs

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether schools hesitate to register school-leavers for the target-group register because the mobility bonus is cut from 2016, and whether a school-leaver who has earned the minimum wage can still be on the register. The state secretary answered that UWV has received registrations, that a planned amendment will equalise the bonus at 2,000 euro for the whole target group, and that the register rule cannot be applied retroactively in the described case.
Partly in response to the question from these SP members, I intend to actively inform parties in the field in the short term.
Mede naar aanleiding van de vraag die deze leden van de SP hebben gesteld, ben ik van plan om partijen in het veld op korte termijn actief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over dat gehandicapten en mensen met een uitkering ingezet worden voor thuiszorg

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked whether the municipality of Kaag en Braassem replacing thuiszorg staff with disabled people and benefit recipients, and whether this displaces regular work and breaches Participatiewet rules. The state secretary answered that the programme pairs experienced home helps with trainees for activation purposes, denies that dismissals or displacement occur, and sees no reason for further inquiry or intervention.
From the available information it can be concluded that there is no question of job displacement.
Uit de beschikbare informatie kan worden geconcludeerd dat er geen sprake is van werkverdringing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een medewerker van de sociale werkvoorziening Hameland na ontslag met behoud van uitkering hetzelfde werk moet doen

An MP asked whether a sheltered-workshop employee who had to keep doing the same work after a fixed-term contract ended, while on benefit without cao wages or pension accrual, is acceptable. The State Secretary confirmed the case, said it is not desirable to convert paid work into benefit-based placements but that municipalities are responsible and the matter can be raised in appeal or the council, and said she has no data on such workers.
The municipality is responsible for the correct implementation of the reintegration policy and the use of the instruments, and can be held accountable for that responsibility.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor de juiste uitvoering van het re-integratiebeleid en de inzet van de instrumenten en is op die verantwoordelijkheid aanspreekbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de voorgenomen verkoop van sociale huurwoningen van Vivare in Velp, gemeente Rheden

An SP MP asks the Minister for Housing about the planned sale of social rental homes by Vivare in Velp, including objections from the tenants' association, the municipality's reversal to a positive opinion, rent risks under a British investment fund buyer, and conflicts with the local housing vision. The Minister replies that no application has yet been received, that the independent Autoriteit woningcorporaties will assess it, that tenants' objections will be weighed, and that existing rent rules continue to apply.
I have not yet received an application. The housing association must submit an application for approval of the planned sale to the Authority for Housing Associations (Aw).
