Ik heb nog geen aanvraag ontvangen. De corporatie moet een aanvraag om goedkeuring voor de voorgenomen verkoop indienen bij de Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht dat er grote onrust is onder schoonmakers van de Roeterseilandcampus (Universiteit van Amsterdam)

Two SP MPs asked ministers about reports of unrest among cleaning staff at the UvA Roeterseiland campus after a new contract with cleaning firm Hago, raising workload, intimidation, procurement quality and possible Arbowet violations. The minister says the UvA and the contractor are in constructive talks with staff, has added temporary cleaners and more time, sees no basis yet to judge Arbowet breaches, and says the Inspectorate would investigate any complaints received.
If the Inspectorate SZW receives complaints from the works council about violations of the Working Conditions Act, the Inspectorate SZW will investigate these complaints.
Als de Inspectie SZW klachten ontvangt van de OR vanwege overtredingen van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, dan zal de Inspectie SZW deze klachten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over automatische incasso en huurverhogingen bij huurders van Trudo, Eindhoven

MP Karabulut asked whether housing corporation Trudo may tie a reduced rent increase to automatic direct debit, why not all tenants qualify, and what Trudo's solvency is. The minister confirms the link, says landlords may set varying increases within the legal maximum and attach conditions or counter-performances, says it is up to the corporation whether direct debit saves costs, and reports Trudo's solvency has risen above 20%.
It is primarily up to the housing corporation itself to determine whether this is the case.
Het is primair aan de woningcorporatie zelf om te bepalen of dit het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de directeur van de sociale werkplaats in Delft een hoge salaris krijgt dan de minister-president

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the director of the Delft sheltered workplace earning more than the Prime Minister, and the poor pay of its staff, was acceptable and what measures would be taken. The State Secretary answered that the director's pay was below the WNT norm, that pay terms are for employers and employees, and that municipalities and their councils are responsible for implementation, declining to act or investigate.
I am not a party to that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat gemeenten niet klaar zijn voor de nieuwe Woningwet

The SP's Karabulut asks the housing minister how municipalities can be ready for the new Housing Act given reports that most are unprepared, with few consulting tenants, and about tenant organisation professionalisation, housing vision gaps, and oversight of corporations. The minister responds that implementation is primarily the municipalities' responsibility, supported by ministry guidance, helpdesks, and planned reports, while committing to publish agreements and include findings in the next State of Housing report.
It is up to the parties themselves to shape the cooperation at local level.
Het is aan de partijen zelf om op lokaal niveau vorm te geven aan de samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘vraagtekens bij sluiting sociale werkplaats’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the planned dissolution of the Hameland sheltered workshop, job security and contract renewals for temporary staff, whether sheltered workshops should be preserved under the Participation Act, suicidal signals among staff, monitoring of the Act's effects, and collective labour agreements for workshop employees. The State Secretary answers that municipalities decide and staff keep their legal rights, that workshops can keep a valuable role, that the Act's effects will be evaluated under the existing monitoring plan, and that collective agreements are not her responsibility.
I do not have the data for each individual sheltered workshop.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens van elk afzonderlijk sw-bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Rector Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam ziet Joods Armeens complot tegen Erdogan en AKP'

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about inflammatory statements by the rector of the Islamic University Rotterdam and what oversight bodies and the ministers would do. The minister says she has lost confidence in the rector, that the inspectorate's enhanced supervision continues, and that she will use a planned legal power to act once the bill takes effect, which is expected late this year.
At present I myself have no legal means to take further measures.
Zelf heb ik op dit moment geen juridische middelen om verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat sinds 2013 nog maar 2.000 garantiebanen zijn gerealiseerd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that only about 2,000 quota jobs for people with work disabilities had been created since 2013, and about vacancy-search and job-placement figures. The State Secretary said the first interim measurement was still underway, pointed to employer-led facilitators, instruments and regional Werkbedrijven, and gave vacancy statistics without committing to new measures.
It is not yet known how many jobs have been added for people in the target group of the jobs agreement since 1 January 2013.
Het is nog niet bekend hoeveel banen erbij zijn gekomen voor mensen uit de doelgroep van de banenafspraak sinds 1 januari 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat het toelatingsbeleid in Amsterdam scholen weer zwart maakt

Two SP MPs asked how the government responds to reports that Amsterdam admission policy is re-segregating schools, and about funding for parent initiatives to mix schools. The State Secretary answered that schools' quality matters, that existing disadvantage measures apply, that school mixing by ethnicity is not desired at national level, and that the only role for municipalities is the statutory annual consultation on segregation.
I see no further role for the national government.
Ik zie geen verdere taak weggelegd voor de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de sociale woningbouw in Den Haag die is ingestort

MP Karabulut asks the minister why social rental construction in The Hague fell sharply, whether the landlord levy prevents corporations from building, and about waiting times, success rates for large families, and safeguards against sales or liberalisation. The minister attributes the decline mainly to local corporations' financial constraints unrelated to the levy, says the levy is not a bar to new construction, and points to municipal housing targets and prestatieafspraken.
It can be said that the landlord levy is not an obstacle for housing corporations to make new construction investments.
Gesteld kan worden dat de verhuurderheffing geen belemmering voor corporaties is om nieuwbouwinvesteringen te plegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Enschede betaalt werklozenbegeleider in korte tijd kwart miljoen’

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether the municipality of Enschede should have paid a large sum, partly from the participation budget, to an external project manager for unemployment reintegration, and what the value was. The state secretary answered that reintegration policy is a municipal responsibility best debated in the municipal council, that the project manager's costs were paid from other municipal funds, and that the project reported 45 participants moving to regular employers.
The responsibility to reach adequate choices lies explicitly at the local level.
De verantwoordelijkheid om tot adequate keuzes te komen, ligt uitdrukkelijk op het lokale niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘gemeenten een half miljoen verdienen aan dwangarbeid’

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary whether municipalities profiting from unpaid work by welfare recipients (plastic flower folding) is acceptable, whether it constitutes unfair competition, and what tools exist to stop such practices. The state secretary replied that re-integration policy is a municipal responsibility, that the national government will not intervene in an individual municipality's policy, that the municipal council is the proper forum, and that recipients can object or complaints can be raised via the client council.
Given municipal policy discretion, it is not appropriate for the national government to pronounce on the policy of an individual municipality.
Gelet op de gemeentelijke beleidsvrijheid ligt het niet in de rede dat de rijksoverheid zich uitspreekt over het beleid van een individuele gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een bijstandsgerechtigde is veroordeeld tot een voorwaardelijke gevangenisstraf vanwege vrijwilligerswerk

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister whether it is acceptable that a welfare recipient doing unpaid volunteer work received a suspended prison sentence, and how this fits with the principle that recipients should influence their voluntary activities. The state secretary answered that welfare obligations such as the duty to inform apply, that the case appears to involve prolonged non-disclosure above the prosecution threshold for the public prosecutor and courts, and that fine levels should reflect severity and culpability, with the Fraud Act amendments to be submitted to the Council of State before summer 2015.
I am of the view that the height of the fine must be tailored to the seriousness of the violation, the degree of culpability and the circumstances of the case.
Ik ben van mening dat de boetehoogte moet zijn afgestemd op de ernst van de overtreding, de mate van verwijtbaarheid en de omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat gemeenten aandringen op meer beleidsvrijheid bij fraudebestrijding

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports that municipalities want more discretion in fraud enforcement and benefit sanctions, including whether national rules leave enough room for local judgement and whether sanction costs exceed benefits. The minister answered that the Participation Act and Fraud Act leave municipalities room for tailored decisions, that the Fraud Act is being amended to allow lower fines and warnings, and that individual cases are a municipal responsibility he will not intervene in.
The decentralised implementation of the Participation Act also means that I do not intervene in individual cases between a municipality and benefit recipients.
De decentrale uitvoering van de Participatiewet betekent ook dat ik niet treed in individuele gevallen die spelen tussen een gemeente en bijstandgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Potters, Oskam en Karabulut over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

MPs from ChristenUnie, VVD, CDA and SP asked ministers whether a controversial sheikh who was to visit Eindhoven had received a visa, how entry bans and SIS alerts work, whether the mayor and foreign partners were consulted, and whether a list of hate preachers exists. The government answered that the Italian visa was withdrawn so the sheikh may not stay in the Netherlands, that the mayor consulted the NCTV, that entry-ban and SIS procedures are explained in general terms, and that an alert list of preachers is in use but numbers are not disclosed.
I cannot provide any information on the number of persons on this list.
Over het aantal personen op deze lijst kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Sociaal rechercheurs slaan alarm: bijstandsfraude loont’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about social investigators' claim that benefit fraud pays and that large fraudsters go unpunished. The minister partly disagreed, pointed to existing civil and criminal sanctions, cited an Inspectorate report on uneven municipal enforcement, and described meetings with the LCSR and funding for municipal guidance and a national address-quality investigation.

Research by the Inspectorate SZW shows that some municipalities do this well and act in line with the Fraud Act, while a number give priority to terminating benefits and make no effort to recover overpayments.
Uit onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW 2 blijkt dat er gemeenten zijn die dat goed doen en conform de Wet aanscherping handhaving en sanctiebeleid SZW-wetgeving (Fraudewet) handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een beloningsanalyse door adviesbureau Focus Orange en het Financieel Dagblad

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp 2014 pay rise of listed-company CEOs compared with modest wage growth for average earners, and what could be done about it. The minister called the gap undesirable, urged firms to align top pay with shop-floor wages, and announced an amendment to the Works Councils Act requiring an annual pay-ratio discussion between board and works council, while declining to explain pay-setting decisions in firms.
The Works Councils Act (WOR) will be amended for this purpose.
De Wet op de ondernemingsraden (WOR) zal daartoe worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de problemen van het plaatsen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking op een extra baan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about reports that very few people with work disabilities are being registered for the target-group register, so few are eligible for guaranteed jobs, and about assessment costs, praktijkonderwijs pupils, and the flow from special education into benefits. The State Secretary answered that the register is already well filled, that the slow registrations are being monitored and processes changed, and that assessments will be reviewed in autumn, while giving no firm figures on placements.
It is not possible to state how many people registered between 1 January 2015 and 1 May 2015 have since been placed in an extra job.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel mensen die tussen 1 januari 2015 en 1 mei 2015 zijn aangemeld, inmiddels geplaatst zijn op een extra baan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bouw van een nieuwe moskee in Gouda

An SP MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs whether a 2014 meeting report on a mosque complex in Gouda showed the government helping segregate women in public space, and whether the report was removed from the municipal website. The minister answered that the report remains online, that segregation by sex is undesirable, and that the planned physical separation of the entrance was requested by a special school and day-care centre for their pupils, not to separate men and women.
The report of 8 May 2014 is known to me. The report was made public by the municipality of Gouda and can still be found on the municipality's website.
Het verslag van 8 mei 2014 is mij bekend. Het verslag is door de gemeente Gouda openbaar gemaakt en is nog altijd terug te vinden op de website van de gemeente Gouda
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Kritiek op aanpak radicalisering”

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government how it responds to criticism of its approach to radicalisation, the role of schools, the causes of radicalisation including discrimination, and whether schools can get specialist social workers. The government answered that schools play preventive, curative and repressive roles, describes existing support such as a hotline, training and the Stichting School en Veiligheid, rejects a dedicated social worker in every school as a matter of tailored support, and notes that research on causes is ongoing.
We have taken note of the criticism.
Wij hebben kennis genomen van de kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over de toekomst van leerlingen die het praktijkonderwijs succesvol hebben doorlopen

MPs Siderius and Karabulut (SP) asked about the prospects of praktijkonderwijs (practical education) leavers, including barriers from language and maths requirements, the Participatiewet, sheltered work and dagbesteding, and whether the government will monitor and support school-leavers. The State Secretary answers that most leavers find work or continue training, that municipalities are now responsible for support, and that additional measures and monitoring are planned, without accepting parliamentary demands for extended follow-up or compensation for reduced ESF funds.
The cabinet does not expect a negative effect of the Participatiewet on the successful outflow of praktijkonderwijs pupils.
Het kabinet verwacht geen negatief effect van de Participatiewet op de succesvolle uitstroom van leerlingen uit het pro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat er drie ultraorthodoxe sjeiks uit België in Utrecht komen spreken

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that three ultra-orthodox Islamic preachers from Belgium would speak in Utrecht, including whether a preacher had a criminal conviction, the visa status of speakers, the foundation alFitrah's role and its recognition as a training company, and its subsidies and ANBI status. The government answered that free speech is protected and the event was not licensable, that the preacher named was not present and visa/criminal information could not be checked under the Schengen rules, that alFitrah is recognised as a training company only by the vocational education centre and the placement is being reassessed, and that the foundation received no subsidies and has no ANBI status.
Requesting this information is only possible insofar as it is in the interest of combating future criminal offences
Het opvragen van deze informatie kan alleen voor zover dat in het belang is ter bestrijding van toekomstige strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Karabulut over het bericht dat de vermogensongelijkheid in Nederland recordhoogtes bereikt

MPs Merkies and Karabulut asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about reports that wealth inequality in the Netherlands had reached record levels, and whether the government would act to reduce it. The minister replied that the CBS figures show rising wealth concentration mainly due to falling house prices, that the government sees no need for action since social security cushions risks, and that it will keep monitoring wealth distribution.
The cabinet therefore attaches no consequences to the current development in wealth distribution, but will continue to follow wealth distribution in the coming years.
Het kabinet verbindt daarom geen consequenties aan de huidige ontwikkeling in de vermogensverdeling, maar blijft de vermogensverdeling de komende jaren wel volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ambtenaren worden verdacht van machtsmisbruik bij re-integratietrajecten en bijstandscliënten in de rol van slaaf worden geduwd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs how she views reports that Amsterdam civil servants were suspected of abuse of power in re-integration trajectories, whether she will act against such treatment, and whether she will order an independent inquiry. The State Secretary replied that she does not intervene in individual cases, that the municipality has investigated and taken measures, that complaints routes exist at municipal level, and that a national inquiry is not appropriate because the municipal council is responsible for oversight.
An investigation by the national government is not appropriate.
Een onderzoek door de rijksoverheid is niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een stadsparel een yuppengetto wordt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about a Utrecht housing corporation doubling rents on re-letting, pushing neighbourhoods toward gentrification, and whether the landlord levy creates incentives for liberalisation. The minister replied that rent adjustments and housing stock are local matters governed by municipal performance agreements, declined to intervene, and did not give substance on whether the levy creates perverse incentives.
The desired housing stock in a municipality is a local matter and is usually laid down in performance agreements between the municipality and housing corporations.
De gewenste woningvoorraad in een gemeente is een lokale aangelegenheid en wordt doorgaans in prestatieafspraken tussen de gemeente en corporaties vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Gesthuizen over een tekort aan woningen voor statushouders (opnieuw en nu met de nagezonden tabellen)

MPs Karabulut and Gesthuizen asked the government about a shortage of social rental housing for status holders and how municipalities are meant to house them. The Minister replied that no overview exists of municipalities reporting shortages or of housing waiting lists, that the 14-week housing norm is based on a 2012 agreement, and that no budget is available for new solutions such as converting the housing tax.
There is no overview of municipalities that indicate they have too few social rental homes to house asylum seekers with a residence permit (status holders).
Er is geen overzicht van gemeenten die aangeven dat ze te weinig sociale huurwoningen hebben om asielzoekers met een verblijfsvergunning (statushouders) te huisvesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over grote verschillen in inschrijfkosten voor Woningnet

An SP MP asked the Minister of Housing about large differences in registration and renewal fees for regional housing allocation systems such as Woningnet, and whether fees should be uniform. The minister answered that no rules govern cost allocation, that differences reflect local choices, that he prefers regional allocation but sees no need to impose uniform fees, and that the new housing law is not expected to change allocation systems.
In my contacts with Aedes and the Association of Dutch Municipalities I bring the usefulness of regional housing allocation systems to their attention.
Ik breng in mijn contacten met Aedes en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten het nut van regionale woonruimteverdeelsystemen onder de aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het stoppen van de woonvergoeding aan huurders door de inspectie

An MP asked why the housing inspectorate ILT ordered housing corporation Havensteder to stop a rent compensation scheme for low-income tenants, and whether the government will help such households. The minister answered that corporations may not grant income-related subsidies under the applicable rules, that the ILT was right to stop the scheme without requiring repayment, and that existing instruments like rent allowance and rent adjustments address affordability, while declining to cut the landlord levy.
Under the Besluit beheer sociale-huursector (Bbsh) and MG 2001–26, corporations are not permitted to provide 'subsidies' and/or take income-related measures.
Op grond van het Besluit beheer sociale-huursector (Bbsh) en de MG 2001–26 is het corporaties niet toegestaan «subsidies» te verstrekken en/of, inkomensgebonden maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bouw van een moskee in Gouda

An SP MP asked ministers about foreign financing, the role of imam Tarik ibn Ali, possible salafist involvement, and the mosque's gender separation and segregation effects in Gouda. The government answered that the municipality commissioned a PWC audit finding 0.05% of funds from two other Schengen countries, that the Bibob advice is pending, and that the mosque's size and related decisions are a local responsibility.
I cannot make statements about individual ongoing investigations.
Over individuele (lopende) onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Alle werklozen naar de sociale werkplaats’

MP Karabulut asked the State Secretary about Apeldoorn's policy of requiring welfare recipients to do simple production work, whether this is paid work, displacement risks, and how it fits with individual-only support rules under the Wwb. The State Secretary replied that the Direct Actief approach is a municipal reintegration method with individual assessment, that municipalities bear responsibility for oversight, and that no displacement is evident, while withholding financial and commercial details of the Werkplein Activerium arrangement.
This concerns a decentralised responsibility in which the municipal council and the college of mayor and aldermen make the decisions.
Het betreft een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid waarbij de gemeenteraad en het college van burgemeester en wethouders besluitvormend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over het bericht dat ex-daklozen hun huis verliezen door te hoge huren

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked about reports that ex-homeless people lose their homes due to high rents, including numbers, waiting times and rent subsidy gaps. Minister Blok answered that data on these cases is largely unavailable, pointed to reinstated fit-for-purpose rent rules and corporation and municipal measures against evictions, and did not commit to new concrete steps beyond existing motions.
No data is known about this.
Hier zijn geen gegevens over bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘de vrijwilliger van het jaar niet genoeg doet voor haar uitkering’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a municipality declaring a volunteer-of-the-year's welfare-related voluntary work insufficient as a counter-performance, and whether only local volunteering should count and whether the municipality may stop volunteering. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said municipalities decide the content and scope of counter-performance under their own by-laws, and noted that volunteering requires municipal permission with paid work prioritised.
I do not intervene in individual cases between a municipality and a welfare recipient.
Ik treed niet in individuele gevallen die spelen tussen een gemeente en een bijstandsgerechtigde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het leuren met Nederlandse sociale huurwoningen in Londen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether officials were promoting sale of social rental housing to British investors in London, what transactions occurred with foreign investors in 2012-2014, and how this fits the coalition goal of maintaining the social housing stock. The minister answered that no quantitative or qualitative targets apply, that only two foreign transactions occurred in 2014 (Vestia and Servatius sales), and that the Herzieningswet and municipal consent rights will guard the regional stock while sales are seen as aiding middle-segment supply.
It was made clear that the central government sets no quantitative or qualitative targets for the sale of housing association dwellings.
Daarbij is duidelijk gemaakt dat er vanuit het Rijk geen kwantitatieve of kwalitatieve doelstellingen gelden voor de verkoop van corporatiewoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een grootmoeder is beboet omdat ze op haar kleinkinderen paste

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that a welfare recipient was fined for babysitting her grandchildren, and whether this counts as paid work and fits the participation policy. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, which is subject to appeal and delegated to the municipality, said babysitting is only relevant to benefits if it amounts to paid work judged on nature, duration and structure, and promised to revise sanctions legislation after a court ruling.
I therefore cannot interfere in individual cases.
Ik kan mij dan ook niet mengen in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat er enorme ongelijkheid is ontstaan in de studietoeslag voor arbeidsgehandicapten"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about large municipal differences in the individual study allowance for disabled students, and whether a nationally enforceable individual study right should replace this. The State Secretary answered that municipalities set the allowance by ordinance within the legal framework, so variation reflects local democratic choice, and that no central rule or renegotiation with municipalities is planned.
Central prescription does not fit here.
Het centraal voorschrijven past hier niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de Wet schuldsanering natuurlijke personen

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the government about falling admissions to the debt rescheduling scheme (WSNP), rising use of guardianship (beschermingsbewind), and whether debt-assistance attempts should remain a precondition for admission. The state secretary answered that the decline reflects several factors, that a precondition of prior out-of-court effort will be kept, and that admission via guardianship is legally possible but subject to judicial assessment.
It is currently not known to what extent guardianship is imposed on people who do not qualify for debt assistance or are insufficiently helped by it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend in hoeverre beschermingsbewind wordt ingesteld voor mensen die niet in aanmerking komen voor schuldhulpverlening of er niet voldoende door geholpen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat bijna twee op de drie docenten in het voortgezet onderwijs getuige zijn van moslimdiscriminatie in de klas

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked about a report finding that 61% of secondary school teachers witnessed discrimination of Muslims in class, its rural-urban pattern, and whether more education on homosexuality and Islam is needed. The minister says discrimination is taken seriously, points to existing support tools (SLO, Centrum School en Veiligheid, teacher training efforts) and an ITS study on teacher needs, without committing to new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat deurwaarders veel te hoge nota’s sturen

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Staatssecretaris whether bailiffs were sending excessive invoices for evictions and whether the practice was widespread. The Staatssecretaris said the KBvG had filed a disciplinary complaint, that the four firms had adjusted their practice, that the KBvG was surveying members, and that overcharged tenants would be repaid through the bailiff and client.
I am following this case closely and will await the outcome of the procedure.
Ik volg deze zaak nauwlettend en wacht de uitkomst van de procedure af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over de ANBI-status van Stichting Rohamaa

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked why the ANBI status of Stichting Rohamaa was granted, whether it complies with transparency rules and international law, and whether it should be revoked and the ANBI list cleaned up. The government answered that the status was granted in 2011 under neutral criteria, declined to discuss the specific case citing legal confidentiality, said status can be revoked if an entity no longer serves the general interest, and stated the Tax Administration conducts risk-based supervision of about 65,000 ANBIs.
I cannot make any statements about the specific aspects of granting the ANBI status to Stichting Rohomaa on the basis of the statutory duty of confidentiality.
Over de specifieke aspecten van het verlenen van de ANBI-status aan Stichting Rohomaa kan ik geen mededelingen doen op grond van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut "over het bericht dat vijf gemeenten sociale werkvoorziening AM Groep willen sluiten"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about five municipalities' plans to close the AM Groep sheltered employment firm, including whether the Participatiewet caused the problems and whether they would negotiate to keep it open. The State Secretary said the councils have not yet decided, that gemeenten keep discretion over sw-bedrijven, and that she could not provide data on which municipalities decided to close and offered no commitment to intervene.
Municipalities have policy freedom in how they organise helping people with a work disability back to work.
Gemeenten hebben beleidsvrijheid bij de wijze waarop zij het aan de slag helpen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat steeds meer bedrijven onbetaalde stagiairs inzetten op een startersfunctie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unpaid interns doing the same work as paid staff are in fact employees entitled to minimum wage, whether a trend exists, and what action will be taken. The minister answered that the line between internship and work depends on the learning element and actual circumstances, that no sufficient evidence of a trend exists, and that workers can complain to the Inspectorate SZW or civil courts, with no new proposals planned.
Currently the Inspectorate SZW has four reports on record in which work may have been performed instead of a work-experience placement or internship.
Momenteel zijn er bij de Inspectie SZW vier meldingen bekend waarbij mogelijk sprake is van werk in plaats van een werkervaringsplek of stage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over het conflict over pensioengeld bij woningcorporaties

SP MPs asked whether housing corporations keep the pension premium reduction instead of passing it on to employees, and whether the government will ensure the reduction reaches workers. The minister replied that wage and pension arrangements are for social partners, that the government is not a party to the corporation-sector talks, and that the wider enquiry does not concern this matter.
Employers and employees, and their organisations, are themselves responsible for making working-conditions agreements.
Werkgevers en werknemers, en hun organisaties, zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het maken van arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Segers over het bericht dat de Turks-Nederlandse vereniging DIDF niet welkom is in een buurthuis in Zaandam vanwege kritiek op de Turkse president Erdogan

MPs Karabulut and Segers asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it was acceptable that a Zaandam community centre excluded the Turkish-Dutch association DIDF over criticism of President Erdogan, and whether such exclusion rules and the centre's contract clause on foreign politics were compatible with freedom of expression. The minister answered that this is a private dispute between two organisations, that the municipality mediated and has no formal responsibility, and that the conflict has been resolved by agreement.
This is a dispute in social-community relations. The two parties are independent organisations and will have to agree between themselves to reach a solution.
Dit is een geschil in sociaal maatschappelijk verkeer. De twee partijen zijn zelfstandige organisaties en zullen het samen eens moeten worden om tot een oplossing te kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over eerste deelnemer aan de “Meesterbeurs”

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked about the 'Meesterbeurs', a Tilburg work-with-benefit scheme for over-50s, including employer costs, insurance coverage, training, displacement of regular workers and whether a systematic study of work-experience placements should be commissioned. The State Secretary answered that re-integration policy and instrument choice lie with municipalities, that the scheme is lawful work-with-benefit without an employment contract, that vacancies are checked for displacement, and that she supports municipalities commissioning effectiveness research without committing to such a study herself.
Responsibility for re-integration policy lies with municipalities, as does the choice of instruments.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het re-integratiebeleid ligt bij gemeenten, net als de instrumentskeuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat de gemeente Tilburg het alternatief voor beschut werk doorzet”

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether Tilburg's decision not to realise sheltered work (beschut werk) and to offer alternatives such as volunteering and day care is acceptable, and whether the Participatiewet should be amended to require a minimum of sheltered jobs. The State Secretary answers that municipalities have policy discretion and that the 30,000 places will be realised, while declining to impose a statutory minimum and promising monitoring and evaluation.
I value this policy freedom and do not intend to restrict it in advance.
Ik hecht aan deze beleidsvrijheid en ben niet voornemens deze op voorhand in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat afgestudeerde jongeren voor 50 euro in de maand werken bij de gemeente Winterswijk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether having recent graduates work for 50 euro a month at the municipality of Winterswijk is good employment practice, whether it evades the minimum wage, and whether it displaces paid jobs. The minister said the distinction between internship and employment depends on the facts and that the Inspectorate SZW has taken the signal under review, so he could not judge the case himself.

Because the actual circumstances are decisive, I cannot judge whether in the case of the municipality of Winterswijk there is work or work experience without the learning aspect being central, and whether there is displacement or poor employer conduct.

Omdat de feitelijke omstandigheden leidend zijn, kan ik niet beoordelen of er in het geval van de gemeente Winterswijk sprake is van werk of werkervaring zonder dat het leeraspect centraal staat en of er sprake is van verdringing of slecht werkgeverschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de verkoop van sociale woningen aan een Duitse vastgoedinvesteerder

MP Karabulut asks why the government did not block the sale of Vestia social rental homes to German investor Patrizia despite objections from 32 municipalities, and how this fits with the new Herzieningswet strengthening local roles. Minister Blok answers that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) judged the sale in the interest of social housing after weighing municipal objections, that the sale followed existing rules, and that undoing it is premature while a second-package objection procedure is ongoing.
The ILT then decided that the planned sale to Patrizia is in the interest of social housing, giving heavy weight to the importance of the sale for Vestia and the sector as a whole.

De ILT is vervolgens tot het besluit gekomen dat de voorgenomen verkoop aan Patrizia in het belang van de volkshuisvesting is, waarbij het belang van de verkoop voor Vestia en de sector als geheel zwaar is meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Karabulut en Yücel over de invordering van belasting- en toeslagschulden door de Belastingdienst

MPs Schouten, Karabulut and Yücel asked whether the Tax Authority's recovery of tax and benefit debts ignores personal circumstances and the subsistence allowance (beslagvrije voet), pushing people deeper into debt, and how the motion on respecting the subsistence allowance will be implemented. The State Secretary acknowledged the Tax Authority cannot always account for personal circumstances, pointed to payment arrangements and the duty of debtors to act, exempted single parents from set-off against the child budget, and promised to discuss the report's recommendations with the LOSR and inform parliament.
The Tax Authority makes every effort to respect the subsistence allowance in line with the Schouten et al. motion.
De Belastingdienst spant zich maximaal in om conform de motie Schouten c.s. de beslagvrije voet te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "haperende ICT blokkeert inburgeren"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about failing ICT that prevented 716 people from taking the basic civic integration exam abroad, asking about compensation, reasons for delay, and structural fixes. The minister acknowledged the problem, described DUO and IND measures for affected people, and said offline laptop-based exams resumed from 1 December with an online solution in preparation.
Following this finding, various experts were deployed to work towards a technical solution.
Naar aanleiding van deze constatering zijn diverse deskundigen ingezet om tot een technische oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over tienduizenden huurders die huurtoeslag mislopen

An SP MP asked the minister about tens of thousands of tenants missing out on rent allowance (huurtoeslag) because rent increases are not reported, and who is responsible for reporting them. The minister answers that tenants are responsible for reporting changes, that about 75% of landlords already report, and that rent allowance can be recalculated retroactively once the correct rent is provided.
There is no exact information on the number of tenants who missed out on rent allowance over the past two years.
Er is geen exacte informatie over het aantal huurders dat de afgelopen twee jaar huurtoeslag is misgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat mensen moeten solliciteren op een huurwoning

Karabulut (SP) asks the housing minister whether municipalities may require prospective tenants to work or perform unpaid community service, or let residents choose who gets a social rental home, and how this relates to discrimination. The minister says only the Wbmgp allows excluding non-working applicants in designated areas, that no new legislation is needed to block such initiatives, and that enforcement lies with the province.
I do not consider it necessary to develop new legislation that would prevent such initiatives.
Ik acht het niet nodig nieuwe wetgeving te ontwikkelen die dergelijke initiatieven verhinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Karabulut over het bericht "Ontsnapt uit Islamitische schoot"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government would intervene with Saudi Arabia to protect Alya and secure her passport and Dutch naturalisation, and why the government is active in the Meriam Ibrahim case but not here. The minister declined to comment on individual cases for privacy reasons, said naturalisation without the usual requirements is only for exceptional cases, and provided figures on abandonment and forced marriage calls and consular assistance.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases, out of regard for the privacy of the persons concerned.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele zaken, vanuit het oogpunt van bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitzending ‘Altijd wat monitor’ over verdringing van betaald werk door werklozen

An MP (Karabulut, SP) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about displacement of paid work by welfare recipients, including a benefit-linked taxi project in Twente, social return numbers and dismissals, and how municipalities will be held to preventing displacement. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Work and Assistance Act and monitor such instruments, that she will not comment on specific cases, that national social return figures are not held centrally, and that the minister will discuss displacement with the VNG.
I do not have national figures on the use of social return by municipalities.
Ik beschik niet over landelijke cijfers ten aanzien van de inzet van social return door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Enschede aanvragers van een uitkering vier weken laat wachten alvorens de aanvraag in behandeling te nemen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the municipality of Enschede may delay processing benefit applications from people over 27 by a month, and whether the government will stop this practice and what sanctions apply. The State Secretary answered that the WWB requires an advance within four weeks, that municipalities are responsible under decentralised implementation with council oversight and only exceptional intervention by the national government, that the Inspectorate does not judge individual municipalities, and that complaints can go to the municipal complaints committee, ombudsman, objection or appeal.
Implementation of the WWB has been decentralised to the college of mayor and aldermen of a municipality.
De uitvoering van de WWB is gedecentraliseerd aan het college van burgemeester en wethouders van een gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat jihadist Jermaine W. een onderwijsorganisatie leidde

Two MPs asked whether a jihadist who reportedly left for Syria led an education foundation despite surveillance, whether extremist teachers are allowed to teach children, and whether such foundations receive subsidies or foreign funding and should be inspected. The government said it cannot comment on individual investigations, that private unrecognised education falls outside the Inspectorate's supervision, that foreign funding is not illegal, and that it will push for more transparency under its anti-jihadism action programme.
That does not alter the fact that we will intervene when there are signs of practices that are not acceptable.
Dat neemt niet weg dat wij zullen ingrijpen wanneer er tekenen zijn van praktijken die niet door de beugel kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat huurbemiddelaars een andere werkwijze hebben toegezegd

MP Karabulut asked the Minister for Housing about reports that rental agents would stop charging tenants brokerage fees, and what is being done for tenants already charged and for studentrooms. The minister welcomed the change, said the ACM enforces against unfair practices, announced a bill to ban two-sided brokerage fees for all housing by end 2014, and stated that recovering fees is a matter between tenant and agent, not the government's.
The cabinet intends to submit a bill to the House of Representatives in 2014 removing the exception for room rentals from the ban on charging brokerage fees to both sides.

Het kabinet heeft het voornemen om nog in 2014 een wetsvoorstel bij de Tweede Kamer in te dienen, waarin de uitzondering voor kamerverhuur op het verbod op tweezijdig bemiddelingskosten in rekening brengen uit de wet wordt geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Smaling inzake het wonen op antikraakcontracten

Two SP MPs asked why people on low incomes increasingly live without legal protection under anti-squatting (antikraak) contracts, and what the government will do about asbestos risks, oversight, the Wet Kraken en Leegstand, and tenant protection. The minister answers that he will not impose statutory requirements on antikraak contracts, sees the choice as voluntary, will evaluate the squatting and vacancy law in early 2015, and points to a voluntary keurmerk for vacancy managers.
For that reason I will not develop proposals to impose further statutory requirements on antikraak contracts.
Om die reden zal ik geen voorstellen ontwikkelen om verdere wettelijke eisen te stellen aan antikraakcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Enschede werklozen wil verplichten hun aanvullend pensioen op te eten alvorens zij recht krijgen op bijstand

An SP MP asked whether Enschede's plan to require welfare applicants to first draw down their supplementary pension was lawful and how it fits government policy protecting pension savings. The Secretary of State called the plan undesirable, said she will propose a legal change so municipalities cannot force early pension drawdown, and explained the Inspectorate's review of Enschede's financial recovery plan and regional job prospects.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer buschauffeurs worden vervangen door vrijwilligers

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether replacing bus drivers with volunteers constitutes job displacement and whether volunteers should be used on regular bus lines. The minister said displacement is only unacceptable when caused by unfair competition, that local and provincial governments are responsible for public transport, and that he is working with the UWV on defining volunteer work under the WW unemployment rules.
I speak of job displacement when employees lose their jobs through unfair competition.
Ik spreek van werkverdringing als werknemers door oneerlijke concurrentie hun baan verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Enschede een zoekperiode van vier weken voor de bijstand hanteert

An SP MP asked the Minister whether Enschede should stop its four-week job-search period before assessing welfare applications, which he argued causes debt and wrongful rejections, and whether the municipality's advance-payment practice and budget pressures should be addressed. The Minister answered that municipalities may impose a four-week search obligation but must process applications within it for people aged 27 and over, that he had informed the alderman, that he had no known cases of missed advance-payment deadlines, and that municipal budget shortfalls are a structural part of budget financing with mitigation measures available.
I have since informed the alderman for Social Affairs of the municipality of Enschede about this.
Ik heb de wethouder van Sociale Zaken van de gemeente Enschede hierover inmiddels geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Kerstens en Karabulut over het bericht dat een ondernemer een boete heeft gekregen van €12.000,- , omdat hij niet beschikte over de vereiste tewerkstellingvergunning

MPs Schouten, Kerstens and Karabulut asked why a Veenendaal employer was fined €12,000 for employing a Wajong beneficiary without a work permit even though UWV had mediated the placement, and whether the fine would be waived and the law changed. Minister Asscher explained the fine was reduced 100% on appeal, acknowledged UWV should have warned the employer, agreed measures with UWV, and promised a warning option in the Wav this autumn.
It would have been desirable if UWV WERKbedrijf had pointed the employer, in the July 2012 conversation, to the obligation to apply for a work permit.
Het was wenselijk geweest als UWV WERKbedrijf de werkgever in het gesprek in juli 2012 had gewezen op de verplichting een tewerkstellingsvergunning aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kerstens en Karabulut over overtredingen van de TNO-normen voor statijden bij de luchthavenbeveiliging op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether maximum standing times for airport security staff at Schiphol, based on TNO norms, are an adequate protection against health risks and whether the state as shareholder should press Schiphol after FNV found an average overrun of 81 minutes per worker per day. The minister said responsibility lies primarily with security firms as employers, that TNO norms are useful, and that he is exploring ways to encourage clients to consider safe work, promising further discussion with parliament.
I am exploring options to encourage clients to take healthy and safe working by contractors into account.
Ik ben bezig met een verkenning van mogelijkheden om opdrachtgevers te stimuleren om rekening te houden met gezond een veilig werken bij de opdrachtnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat er gigantische onrust heerst onder alleenstaande ouders met een bijstandsuitkering vanwege fors inkomensverlies in 2015

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the government would reverse the income losses for single parents on social assistance caused by the 2015 child benefit reform and how many would be affected. Minister Asscher answered that the reform removes the single-parent supplement, that about 78,500 single parents on benefits are affected, that the income effects will be shown in the 2015 budget, and that the reform is expected to have only small effects on poverty and to be monitored.
No figures are available on the realised purchasing power development of single parents on social assistance.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de gerealiseerde koopkrachtontwikkeling van alleenstaande ouders in de bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een stijgend aantal stagiairs fulltime werkt zonder enige vergoeding

MP Karabulut asked the minister whether unpaid full-time internships are increasing, what criteria define a stage, how many internships and pay levels exist, and whether rules or Inspectorate checks should follow. The minister said he lacks data to confirm the trend, set out criteria distinguishing a stage from work, declined to add new rules, and said the Inspectorate will act only on concrete complaints.
Performing an internship without any financial reward is as such not an offence.
Het verrichten van een stage zonder dat daar een financiële beloning tegenover staat is als zodanig geen overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat een manager van een sociale werkplaats een ontslagvergoeding van 300.000 euro heeft gekregen".

An SP MP asks whether a manager of the Amersfoort sheltered workplace RWA received a 300,000 euro severance payment from public funds, whether the payment is defensible, whether it will be reversed, and whether SW manager salaries should be capped. The State Secretary confirms a severance of about 294,476 euro under a social plan, says employment terms are not her responsibility, and refuses to reverse it, noting the WNT cap does not apply to this unit manager but the payment was publicly disclosed.
I am not a party to agreements on terms of employment.
Ik ben geen partij bij afspraken over arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het herkeuren van Wajongers

MP Karabulut asked why Wajong beneficiaries are not told when they will be reassessed, on what criteria, and how they can prepare, given uncertainty among beneficiaries. The State Secretary answered that UWV has informed beneficiaries, that timing per quarter is not yet known and will be communicated, that criteria are set in the Schattingsbesluit, and that UWV will inform beneficiaries later this year.
At this moment it cannot yet be said which Wajong beneficiary will be assessed in which quarter.
Op dit moment is nog niet te zeggen welke Wajonger in welk kwartaal beoordeeld zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘de zwakste gemeenten minder re-integratiegeld krijgen’

An SP MP asked whether the weakest municipalities lose more re-integration funding under the new Participation Budget allocation model, and whether the government would change the model. The state secretary acknowledged an 8 percent cut affecting all municipalities, argued the model is balanced and that weak-region municipalities' share rises slightly, and declined to amend the model.
In view of the above, in my judgment an amendment of the Participation Budget allocation model is not warranted.
Gelet op het voorgaande ligt een aanpassing van het verdeelmodel Participatiebudget naar mijn oordeel niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het herkeuren van Wajongers met een indicatie voor AWBZ dagbesteding"

Member Karabulut asked whether Wajongers with an AWBZ day-care indication were wrongly sent notices for reassessment, though such people are supposedly exempt, and how many are affected. The Secretary of State answered that all Wajongers received a letter, that about 10,000 Wajongers attend day care, and that those with AWBZ day-care from 2008 onward can be deemed to have no work capacity without further assessment, though incomplete files may require the person to provide proof.
All Wajongers have received a letter from UWV stating the possible consequences of the Participation Act.
Alle Wajongers hebben van UWV een brief ontvangen waarin is aangegeven wat de mogelijke gevolgen van de Participatiewet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat er geen banen zijn voor jongeren met een laag IQ

MPs Karabulut and Siderius asked the State Secretaries about warnings that closing sheltered workplaces and the Participatiewet will leave practical-education pupils without jobs, and about the cost-effectiveness of job coaches. The government answered that practical-education pupils are being steered to work through regional school-municipality networks and ESF funding, that the Participatiewet creates new instruments such as sheltered work, and that the job coach pilot was found to be expensive with limited effect on transitions to regular work.
The central government does not close sheltered workplaces (sw-bedrijven).
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Karabulut over onrust onder huurders door een fout van de Belastingdienst

MP Karabulut asked about unrest among hundreds of Welbions tenants after the Tax Authority wrongly demanded retroactive repayment of rent allowance, and how many such demands were issued and how the error happened. The State Secretary confirms the procedural error, says the demands were reversed and the allowance paid within days, that about 390 cases were affected through an error in the landlord administration, and that measures are being taken to prevent recurrence.
The wrongful reclaims have been reversed and the rent allowance, which had also wrongly been stopped, was paid out to the tenants concerned a few days after the original payment date.
De onterechte terugvorderingen zijn hersteld en de huurtoeslag, die eveneens ten onrechte gestopt was, is enkele dagen na de oorspronkelijke betaaldatum aan de betrokken huurders uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de gevolgen van de verhuurderheffing voor hofjeswoningen

MP Karabulut asks whether the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) should exempt historic hofjes run by foundations, citing the Essenhof in Haarlem, and whether the levy's small-landlord threshold could be raised from 10 to 50 or 70 homes. Minister Blok answers that the levy applies objectively to all landlords without distinguishing purpose, that the threshold change would be considered in the 2016 evaluation, and that no exemption is planned.
I therefore see no objective grounds to make such a distinction within the levy.
Ik zie daarom geen objectieve gronden om binnen de heffing een dergelijk onderscheid te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van der Linde, Verhoeven, De Rouwe en Baay-Timmerman over gouden handdrukken bij woningcorporatie Rochdale

MPs asked the Minister for Housing about severance payments of about 4.5 million euros at housing corporation Rochdale, including whether tenants were effectively paying for them and whether the sums could be reclaimed. The Minister answered that the payments were made under a social plan to five non-top employees, that no legal framework was breached, that no recovery is possible, and promised to look into comparable rules in Germany and Denmark later.
That possibility does not exist, because there is no question of excessive severance payments in relation to the Normalisation of Top Incomes Act or the Housing Act.
Die mogelijkheid is er niet, omdat er geen sprake is van te hoge ontslagvergoedingen in relatie tot de Wet Normering Topinkomens of de Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Eritreërs in Nederland onder grote druk staan van de Eritrese regering

Two SP MPs asked whether the government would back Eritrean residents pressured to pay a diaspora tax, enable anonymous reporting, investigate the tax, and close the Eritrean consulate. The government answered that the tax is not illegal per se if voluntary, that anonymous reporting is possible case by case, that the issue is being pursued at EU level, and that closing the embassy is not currently on the table.
To establish abuses, the public prosecution service and police depend substantially on reports and complaints from victims.
Om misstanden vast te kunnen stellen zijn het OM en politie in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de huren 10% zijn gestegen in twee jaar tijd en de huurtoeslag wordt gekort

An SP MP asked the minister whether rents rose about 10% in two years, whether a 2.7% annual rent increase above inflation is planned, and why housing benefit is being cut while promising affordable rents. The minister confirmed the rent rise figures, said the 2.7% refers to a maximum rent-sum increase under the housing accord, denied an extra cut beyond the announced 31 million euro, and defended the housing benefit policy.
I do not intend to make further cuts to housing benefit in 2015 beyond the 31 million euro reduction already announced in the Spring Memorandum.
Ik heb niet het voornemen om, naast de reeds bij Voorjaarsnota aangekondigde bezuiniging van € 31 mln., in 2015 verdere bezuinigingen op de huurtoeslag door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Amsterdamse huurders die hun huis uit moeten van woningcorporatie Ymere

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing about Ymere evicting 180 Amsterdam social tenants for renovation and sale, and whether this is lawful, whether rents will rise up to 100%, and whether housing policy should change. The minister confirmed the plans, explained that 'dringend eigen gebruik' renovation grounds are lawful but sale alone is not, said Ymere is responsible for its own choices and offered tenant protections, and declined to revise policy.
I do not have data on the rent-to-income ratios.
Over de huurquotes heb ik geen gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het faillissement van de private schuldbemiddelaar Bureau Integraal in Groningen

MP Karabulut asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of private debt mediator Bureau Integraal in Groningen, including whether it may invest client funds, whether current rules prevent such abuse, and whether private debt mediators should face quality standards and be allowed to charge fees. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said current rules are sufficient apart from better information, noted that a general measure allowing paid private debt mediation is in preparation and will be sent to parliament before the summer recess, and gave statistics on enforcement.
As is customary, I do not make specific statements about individual cases.
Zoals gebruikelijk doe ik over individuele gevallen geen specifieke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Gemeenten in Oost-Groningen failliet door werkvoorziening’

An MP asks the State Secretary about reports that municipalities in East Groningen face bankruptcy from growing deficits at sheltered-employment bodies, and whether national policy is to blame. The government replies that responsibility for the Wsw lies with municipalities, that the budget is sufficient, that efficiency gains are achievable, and that it has held and will continue consultations with the Groningen municipalities.
Responsibility for implementing the Wsw has been assigned to the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van de Wsw is belegd bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over het dwarsbomen van de kamerverhuur in verzorgingshuizen door de verhuurderheffing

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked whether the rental levy (verhuurderheffing) is pushing poorer elderly people out of care-home rooms, and asked for data on rents, vacancies and exemptions. The minister gave mostly data gaps and defended the Woonakkoord, promising only a future evaluation of the levy.
There is no overview of the amount of care real estate owned by care providers and the portion that is rented.
Er is geen overzicht van de hoeveelheid zorgvastgoed die in bezit is van zorgaanbieders en het deel dat wordt gehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de omstreden methoden van re-integratiebedrijf WorkFast

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about contested methods used by re-integration firm WorkFast, including pressure on benefit claimants with health conditions, demands for many job applications, and childcare and volunteering demands. The State Secretary declined to judge the firm, said municipalities are responsible for outsourcing and oversight, pointed to council control and complaint and appeal routes, and refused an Inspectorate investigation.
Investigation by the Inspectorate SZW is not at issue here.
Onderzoek door de Inspectie SZW is hier niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat slechts vijftien procent van de mensen die aankloppen bij de schuldhulpverlening daadwerkelijk wordt geholpen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a report claiming only 15% of people seeking debt help are actually helped, and about whether municipalities manipulate debt-assistance statistics and should be monitored. The State Secretary disputed the report's definition of success, said she lacks the requested figures, stated that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance and reporting, and declined to create a national complaints point, pointing to existing complaint and objection routes.
Within that division of responsibilities, it is not for me to oblige implementing parties to supply specific information.
Het is binnen die verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling niet aan mij om uitvoerende partijen te verplichten tot aanlevering van specifieke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over misstanden bij de Sociale dienst Midden-Drenthe

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about alleged abuses at the Midden-Drenthe social services, including a claimant's benefit cut, forced unpaid work, intimidation, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should investigate. The State Secretary replied that municipal implementation is a local responsibility, the municipal council has already ordered its own inquiry, and the Inspectorate has no competence over individual municipalities, while promising to send the answers before the WWB debate.
It concerns a local municipal responsibility and the factual situation is now being investigated by the municipal council.
Het betreft een lokale gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid en de feitelijke situatie wordt nu door de gemeenteraad onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over segregatie in het onderwijs

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Karabulut asked the government about falling school segregation, the end of the twelve city pilots, the lack of structural municipality-school consultation, and parents' initiatives for mixed schools. The Secretary of State answered that segregation is declining, the pilots' effects were modest so they will not be continued (municipalities may continue on their own), and that the matter is a decentralised municipal responsibility, so the outcome was passed to the VNG.

Vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over de vrees voor chaos om zorgvastgoed (ingezonden 27 mei 201

The SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister for Housing about a provincial report warning of chaos in care property, whether there will be a shortage of housing for elderly people needing care, and how municipalities and housing corporations cooperate. The government answered that regional and local cooperation should be strengthened, that the housing stock can largely accommodate older residents through adaptation and reallocation, and that a transition agenda with regional tables and a task force has been announced.
Through the regional tables and the task force announced in the earlier letter of 4 June 2014, the central government wants to stimulate and facilitate cooperation.
Via de in eerdergenoemde brief van 4 juni 2014 aangekondigde regiotafels en het aanjaagteam wil het Rijk de samenwerking stimuleren en faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat onverantwoorde leningen worden verstrekt aan huishoudens

Karabulut (SP) asked whether reports of rising problematic household debt and 210,000 households with risky loans are accurate, their causes, and how households are protected from unnecessary loans. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that over one in six households is at risk of or has problematic debt, that the figure rose between 2009 and 2012, and that credit rules have been tightened and the AFM enforces them.
That is why the rules for responsible lending have been tightened and this cabinet is focusing on strengthening people's financial self-reliance.
Daarom zijn de regels voor verantwoorde kredietverlening aangescherpt en zet dit kabinet in op het versterken van de financiële zelfredzaamheid van mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over de inzet van stakingsbrekers door de NS

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked whether the labour inspectorate is investigating alleged strikebreaking by NS (Dutch Railways) and whether it approved another firm cleaning trains. Minister Asscher answered that the inspectorate has received an FNV complaint but needs more information before investigating, that it never grants permission to break strikes, and that no strikebreaking by NS has been established.
The Inspectorate SZW received a report from the FNV that there would be strikebreaking.
De Inspectie SZW heeft een melding ontvangen van de FNV dat er sprake zou zijn van stakingsbreking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een verdubbeling van de verzoeken aan de Huurcommissie in 2013

An SP MP asked the Minister for Housing whether the doubling of rent-dispute referrals to the Huurcommissie in 2013, mainly caused by income-dependent rent increases, warrants revising housing policy, and raised burdens, landlord win rates, Belastingdienst capacity and the Huurcommissie's deficit. The minister said the increase was largely due to the income-dependent rise, that inflows were far below the 9,000 projected, and that no policy revision was warranted, while answering the other questions with explanations of cost-sharing, legal fees and risk-based referrals.
I see no reason, based on these inflow figures, to revise housing policy.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op basis van deze instroomcijfers het woonbeleid te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "een forse toename in het aantal klachten over de Rotterdamse Sociale Dienst"

An MP asked about a sharp rise in complaints about the Rotterdam social services department, its inability to process growing benefit applications, and whether this is a national problem. The State Secretary said responsibility lies primarily with the municipal executive and council, saw no signals of similar problems elsewhere, pointed to statutory deadlines and advance payments, and declined to take additional measures or order an inspection.

In this context I point out that the proper and lawful implementation of the WWB is primarily a matter between the executive college of mayor and aldermen and the policy-setting and supervising municipal council.
In dit kader wijs ik erop dat een juiste en rechtmatige uitvoering van de WWB primair een aangelegenheid is tussen het uitvoerende college van B&W en de kaderstellende en controlerende gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het groeiende verschil in inkomens tussen werknemers en bestuurders van bedrijven

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the growing pay gap between top executives and workers, whether smaller income gaps improve national performance, the absolute pay figures for several firms, and whether collective agreements should cover executive pay. Minister Asscher answered that executive pay is a matter for the social partners, that the government will strengthen works council involvement in executive pay via a WOR amendment and the Corporate Governance Code remains the main instrument, and that he has no company-level pay data, while citing the WNT pay cap for public and semi-public sector executives.
The cabinet will amend the WOR so that each year a conversation takes place between the executive and the works council about the development of pay ratios, including those of the board.

Het kabinet zal de WOR zodanig aanpassen dat jaarlijks een gesprek tussen bestuurder en de ondernemingsraad plaatsvindt over de ontwikkeling van de beloningsverhoudingen, inclusief die van het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de Werkkamer zegt dat een grote groep jonggehandicapten, straks onzichtbaar, verdwijnt achter de voordeur

MP Karabulut asked whether the Werkkamer chair's warning that many young disabled people will disappear behind the front door under the Participation Act is shared, and how the government will prevent it, including questions on job chances, the rules for municipalities and the 125,000 guaranteed jobs. The State Secretary rejects the picture of a large group disappearing, points to municipal instruments, the distribution model and the job agreement, but does not guarantee equal chances and refers largely to ongoing regional initiatives.
I cannot guarantee that, just as I cannot for every job seeker with full work capacity.
Dat kan ik niet garanderen, net zo min als ik dat kan voor iedere werkzoekende met volledig werkvermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over discriminatie van zwangere vrouwen op de arbeidsmarkt

MP Karabulut asked the Minister of Social Affairs what he would do about pregnancy discrimination in the labour market after the College for Human Rights called for action and 45% of pregnant women reported possibly discriminatory experiences. The minister answered that discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to information gaps among employers and employees, said the government will await an SER advisory report and then present an action plan that may include measures against pregnancy discrimination.
I indicated, including during the General Consultation on Integration of 12 March, that following the SER advice I will come with an action plan on tackling discrimination in the labour market.

Ik heb, onder andere tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Integratie van 12 maart jl., aangegeven dat ik naar aanleiding van het SER advies met een actieplan met betrekking tot de aanpak van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt zal komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman over het idee om agenten vrij te maken die zich alleen bezig moeten houden met criminaliteitsbestrijding onder Tilburgers van Marokkaanse en Antilliaanse afkomst

MPs Karabulut and Kooiman asked whether the government endorses a Tilburg VVD proposal to assign police specifically to crime-fighting among residents of Moroccan and Antillean descent, and whether there is a police capacity problem in Tilburg. The minister says targeted youth policy was used in the past and is now part of regular policy, stresses effectiveness and warns against unjustified ethnic distinction, and says he has no signals of a capacity problem in Tilburg, with the mayor able to request more capacity.
We must of course guard against a targeted approach toward these groups leading to unjustified distinction.
We moeten er uiteraard voor waken dat een gerichte aanpak op deze groepen zou leiden tot het maken van ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitspraak dat het aantal leerbedrijven met 10.000 gestegen zou zijn

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether his tweet about 10,000 new training companies despite the crisis accurately reflects the UWV/SBB report, and questions the causes of slower growth, the effect of youth unemployment policy and whether the report calls for intensified policy. The minister defends the tweet as accurate, notes 9,200 companies dropped out, attributes the shift to bol-track internships and states the policy will continue with concrete sector plans and monitoring.
I can imagine that confusion arose because at the same time more than 9,000 companies also dropped out.
Ik kan me voorstellen dat er verwarring is ontstaan omdat er tegelijkertijd ook ruim 9.000 bedrijven zijn afgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ontslag van schoonmakers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether hundreds of cleaners risk losing jobs because municipalities give cleaning work to sheltered workshops, and whether existing staff should be taken over and whether the 125,000 extra jobs pledge is being honoured. The State Secretary said municipal procurement is the municipality's own matter, that no evidence of hundreds of job losses was found, and that whether extra jobs materialise will be shown in future labour-participation data.
The choice in tendering by the municipality for suppliers and service providers is a matter for the municipality itself. I have no involvement in that.
De keuze bij aanbesteding van de gemeente voor leveranciers en dienstverleners is een zaak van de gemeente zelf. Ik heb daar geen bemoeienis mee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over "een groeiend aantal huisuitzettingen van gezinnen met kinderen".

SP MPs asked whether evictions of families with children and demand for emergency shelter are rising, whether this breaches the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether evictions involving children should be banned. The government confirmed 6,980 evictions from housing corporations in 2013 (up 8%) but said the rise is mainly single adults, not families, and that a ban is unnecessary because courts already weigh tenants' housing interests and a noodmoratorium exists.
A forced eviction will therefore only take place after judicial review; this is related to the special character of residential accommodation.
Een gedwongen ontruiming zal dus alleen plaatsvinden na een rechterlijke toets; dit heeft te maken met het bijzondere karakter van woonruimte.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de Gülen beweging in Nederland minimaal 100 studiehuizen heeft (ingezonden 4 februari 2014).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the Gülen movement runs at least 100 study houses where Turkish-Dutch youths live without supervision, and whether these are successors to Gülen boarding schools. The minister answered that the source of the 100 figure cannot be traced, that the houses appear to be small shared student homes for adults, that the state has no overview of Gülen-linked organisations, and that the study houses fall under local authorities and private initiative outside school inspection, so no new action was committed.
