The study houses fall under the responsibility of the local authorities.
De studiehuizen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat werkeloze jongeren de Nederlandse staat miljarden kosten

Karabulut (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that unemployed youth cost the state billions, including FNV Jong's claim that discouraged youth are leaving the labour market and that the state's response is too small. Minister Asscher answered that the government shares concern, explained how youth unemployment is measured and that discouragement and return to education explain part of the drop in labour force, disputed FNV Jong's cost assumptions, and listed the Aanpak Jeugdwerkloosheid measures.
The cabinet does not agree with the remark of the chairman of FNV Jong.
Het kabinet is het niet eens met de opmerking van de voorzitter van FNV Jong.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Hamer en Ojik over verslechterde arbeidsomstandigheden van schoonmakers bij de Belastingdienst

MPs asked whether the government would intervene after cleaners at several Belastingdienst sites complained of worsened working conditions, including higher workload, refused sick notices, and alleged intimidation, and whether the Inspectie SZW would investigate. The State Secretary answered that a yearly workload monitor and talks with contractors and cleaners will address the complaints, that Apeldoorn capacity was increased, and that no Inspectie SZW investigation is warranted.
Given the aforementioned measures, I see no reason to ask the Minister of SZW to involve the Inspectie SZW.
Ik zie, gezien de voornoemde maatregelen, geen aanleiding om de Minister van SZW te vragen de Inspectie SZW in te schakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ontslagen bij sociale werkplaats Novatec

An MP asks the State Secretary whether plans by sheltered workplace Novatec to cut 50 to 100 jobs, and the implied loss of Wsw rights and placement prospects, are acceptable, and how placement at regular employers can be guaranteed. The State Secretary replies that Novatec denies cutting jobs, that the workers stay employed and will be placed at regular employers under the Participatiewet, that Wsw rights are unchanged, and that municipalities decide how places are realised.
The statutory provisions under the Wsw remain applicable to the group of people who work under the Wsw with a Wsw referral when the Participation Act takes effect.
De wettelijke bepalingen op grond van de Wsw blijven van toepassing op de groep mensen die met de inwerkingtreding van de Participatiewet met een Wsw-indicatie in de Wsw werkzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Gerven over het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) dat jonge werkloze medische specialisten met behoud van uitkering aan het werk zet

SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that young unemployed medical specialists work unpaid at the AMC while keeping their benefits, and how many are underpaid, whether this is minimum-wage evasion or fraud, and how underpayment will be ended. The State Secretary answered that pay must meet legal and CAO obligations, that the number of unpaid specialists is unknown, that no complaints have reached the inspectorates so no investigation is under way, and that the government sees no underpayment under the specialists' terms of employment.
It is unknown how many medical specialists work unpaid. This is not registered.
Het is onbekend hoeveel medisch specialisten onbetaald werken. Dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Karabulut over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Spoorwegen vast personeel van de fietsenstallingen wil vervangen door werklozen

MPs Smaling and Karabulut asked whether NS was replacing permanent bicycle-parking staff with unemployed re-integration workers and whether it was negotiating with Halfords; the state secretary replied that the reports were largely inaccurate, NS had terminated nine parking contracts with a planned uniform national formula, and expects new operators to take over existing staff. The answers rely on NS's account and refuse to exercise any power over private operators' personnel policy.
I have no relationship with these operators and no authority to enforce that one operator rehires the staff of another operator in such cases.

Ik heb geen enkele relatie met deze exploitanten en ik heb geen bevoegdheid om af te dwingen dat de ene exploitant in voorkomende gevallen het personeel van de andere exploitant opnieuw in dienst neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de ramenwas-service in Arnhem

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Arnhem's window-cleaning project places welfare recipients on minimum-wage contracts below the glazier CAO, and whether it displaces regular work. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible, that the work is not comparable to the CAO, that 3 of 13 participants moved to regular jobs, and that the project will be evaluated in autumn 2013.
The municipality is responsible for monitoring the legal conditions of the various re-integration instruments.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken van de wettelijke voorwaarden van de verschillende re-integratie-instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een werkloze straatveger voor 400 euro minder salaris moet straatvegen

An SP MP asks whether it is acceptable that an unemployed street sweeper must sweep streets for €400 less per month under a municipal work-with-benefit arrangement, and whether this constitutes exploitation and displacement, and asks for legislative action. The state secretary replies that instruments are a municipal responsibility, that the council should supervise, that the specific case is for the alderman and council to judge, and that the inspectorate will study tegenprestatie implementation with results expected in autumn 2013.
The decision on the use of instruments to help people into work is for the municipalities.
De beslissing over de inzet van de instrumenten om mensen aan het werk te helpen is aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over “de schoolverlaterskorting in de bijstand”

An SP MP asks whether the six-month 20% reduction for school leavers claiming social assistance is fair, and whether single parents with minor children should be exempt. The state secretary defends the reduction as matching the lower living costs of students, says municipalities can account for family circumstances, and declines to create an exception under article 28 WWB.
The college can take the applicant's family situation into account.
Het college kan rekening houden met de gezinssituatie van de aanvrager.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de resultaten van het onderzoek van FNV naar het functioneren van Werk.nl

An MP asked the minister about FNV survey results showing dissatisfaction with the UWV website werk.nl, including low availability, sanctions for failing digital obligations, and reduced face-to-face service. The minister acknowledged shortcomings, defended the digital-service policy and budget cuts, described fixes and an extra check before sanctions, and said sanctions would not be imposed when the site was unavailable.
It cannot be that sanctions are imposed when benefit recipients could not meet their obligations because the website was not working.
Het kan niet zo zijn dat sancties worden opgelegd als uitkeringsgerechtigden niet aan hun verplichtingen hebben kunnen voldoen omdat de website niet werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over herkeuring van jonggehandicapten

An MP asks the state secretary why she publicly claimed Wajong beneficiaries would not be mass re-assessed, then announced re-assessments, and why figures on beneficiaries moving to welfare were given in the media but not in the letter to parliament. The secretary answers that re-assessment will follow the social accord, the detailed design is still being worked out, the figures are UWV projections, and the figures were disclosed later to avoid unrest.
Why did you omit to report this in the letter to the House of Representatives?
Heeft u verzuimd dit in de brief aan de Tweede Kamer te melden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over armoedebestrijding door Cordaid in Nederland

MP Karabulut asked the State Secretary about Cordaid's poverty projects in Dutch municipalities, whether poverty in the Netherlands should be compared with aid in developing countries, whether poverty reduction is a government task, and how the Participatiewet would avoid creating poverty. The State Secretary answered that Cordaid's projects are privately funded, that municipalities are primarily responsible for local poverty policy, that the government allocated an extra 20 million euro, and that work remains the best way out of poverty.
As I indicated in my letter of 3 July 2013 on intensifying poverty and debt policy, municipalities are primarily responsible for local poverty policy.
3 Antwoord 3 Zoals ik heb aangegeven in mijn brief van 3 juli 2013 over de intensivering van het armoede- en schuldenbeleid 4 zijn gemeenten primair verantwoordelijk voor het lokale armoedebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over de vergoeding van hoortoestellen aan mensen met een structurele functionele hoorbeperking

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked why people with a structural functional hearing impairment can no longer claim hearing aids from UWV for keeping their job, whether referral to health insurers is adequate, and whether the 25% co-payment and deductible burden is acceptable. The minister answered that since 2013 all necessary hearing aids fall under the Zvw, that the 25% co-payment applies to hearing devices, and that he is not willing to reverse the change, while providing UWV and insurer expenditure figures.
No, I am not willing to reverse the removal of hearing aid reimbursements from the UWV or to expand reimbursement of hearing aids in the basic package.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om het schrappen van de vergoedingen voor hoorhulpmiddelen vanuit het UWV ongedaan te maken of om de vergoeding van hoorhulpmiddelen in het basispakket te verruimen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over onrust in de sociale werkplaats

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary about unrest at sheltered workplace Delta in Zutphen, including the phase-out of sw-employment, a director's salary, mediation costs, inspection and detachment of workers. The state secretary answered that instruction will stop after 2014 while sheltered work stays in place, that the conflict was not caused by the director's salary, that mediation cost about 56,000 euro, and that the inspectorate has investigated working conditions.
I have made inquiries about this with the municipality of Zutphen.
Ik heb hierover navraag gedaan bij de gemeente Zutphen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de vermogensgrenzen bij kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belastingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether it is desirable that the extended municipal power to grant remission of local taxes is not applied to people receiving benefits, whether the asset test for remission should be aligned with the Wet werk en bijstand test, and whether a poorly timed asset assessment date should block remission. The minister replied that cabinet is still deliberating, declined to impose the Wet werk en bijstand asset test on decentralised governments as this would unduly limit their policy freedom, and explained that the reference date is the date the request is filed, which the taxpayer chooses, with no deadline set.
I do not intend to make the asset test for remission equal to the asset test used in the Wet werk en bijstand by imposing it as binding on decentralised governments.

Ik ben niet voornemens om een gelijkstelling van de vermogenstoets bij kwijtschelding aan de vermogenstoets die wordt gehanteerd in de Wet werk en bijstand, dwingend aan de decentrale overheden voor te schrijven.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de misstanden bij sociale werkplaats Berckenrode Groep Schiedam (BGS)

An SP MP asked the state secretary about misconduct, intimidation and structural integrity failures at the sheltered workplace BGS Schiedam, including whether gemeenten and the Inspectie SZW oversee such workplaces adequately and whether a national complaints body is needed. The government accepts the commission's serious conclusions, says the responsible gemeente must act and has asked the Inspectie to re-inspect BGS, but declines to publish lists or inspection reports and rejects new national rules and a national complaints point.
It is the responsibility of the municipality of Schiedam to respond adequately and implement improvements.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Schiedam om hier adequaat op te reageren en verbeteringen door te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut inzake scholen die allochtone leerlingen weigeren

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked about reports that schools refuse pupils of immigrant origin, and about a Forum study on admission barriers faced by migrant parents. The state secretary answered that the small-scale study cannot establish a clear pattern, that refusing pupils on ethnic grounds is unacceptable, and that desegregation is tackled locally, without a large-scale study.
Het tegengaan van segregatie is lokaal belegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het toepassen van een te lage beslagvrije voet voor mensen die wel willen maar niet kunnen betalen

MP Karabulut asks whether a reduced 81% attachment-free allowance (beslagvrije voet) applied to people who are willing but unable to pay, and whether the notorious-defaulter definition should be tightened. The government says the 90% allowance must be upheld for those unable to pay, that the 81% rate applies only to notorious defaulters, and that it will contact municipalities and water boards and clarify the interpretation of the term.
The ministries of BZK and I&M will contact municipalities and water boards to examine to what extent the situations described by the LOSR occur in practice and how they can be prevented.

De ministeries van BZK en I&M zullen met gemeenten en waterschappen in contact treden om te bezien in hoeverre de door de LOSR geschetste situaties in de praktijk optreden en hoe deze voorkomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over “de combinatie van bijstand en studiefinanciering”

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary whether municipalities treat the loan component of a student partner's studiefinanciering as a preceding provision that must be drawn before welfare benefits, and whether the six-month school-leaver reduction in the Wet Werk en Bijstand should be scrapped. The state secretary answered that municipalities' practice is not recorded, that case law treats studiefinanciering as a preceding provision regardless of loan debt, that only the living-cost component counts for the joint means test, and that she will not remove the loan from the preceding-provision rule or the school-leaver article.
How exactly municipalities deal with the loan portion of studiefinanciering of the partners of benefit recipients I cannot tell you.
Hoe gemeenten precies omgaan met het leendeel van de studiefinanciering van de partners van bijstandsgerechtigden kan ik u niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ondanks een gerechtelijke uitspraak bijstandsgerechtigden nog steeds 32 uur per week moeten werken als tegenprestatie voor een uitkering

An SP MP asked the state secretary about Orionis Walcheren continuing to require welfare recipients to work 32 hours a week as a return obligation despite a court ruling, and how this fits with earlier promises to adjust the rules. The state secretary answered that the municipality-level body will revise its rules and stop imposing sanctions for non-compliance, that enforcement is a decentralised matter for local authorities or the courts, and that the court ruling is to be followed.
This is a decentralised task. Oversight of it lies with the local authority or, as has already happened, the court.
Het betreft een gedecentraliseerde taak. Controle hierop is aan het lokale bestuur of, zoals reeds is geschied, de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inzet van fotoherkenningsapparatuur om op internet bijstandsgerechtigden op te sporen

An SP MP asked whether municipalities use photo-recognition equipment to trace welfare recipients' holiday photos online without suspicion of fraud, and on what legal basis, including proportionality and privacy (ECHR art. 8). The state secretary replied that this has not been found to happen, that municipalities only use public sources such as Suwinet, Hyves and Facebook, that no prosecutor's permission is needed for administrative checks, and that guidance for municipalities is being prepared.
The finding that municipalities hire or use photo-recognition equipment to trace welfare recipients' holiday photos on the internet is, as far as is now known, incorrect.
De constatering dat gemeenten fotoherkenningsapparatuur inhuren of inzetten om op het internet vakantiefoto's van bijstandsgerechtigden op te sporen, is voor zover nu bekend, onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitbetaling van langdurigheidstoeslag in Spijkenisse

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether Spijkenisse's payment of long-duration allowance and related benefits in four instalments contradicts the original legislative intent of a single lump-sum payment, and whether the minister would press the municipality to pay in one instalment. The state secretary confirmed the instalment practice, explained that since 2009 municipalities set the amount and number of instalments themselves, and declined to intervene.
Since then it is up to the municipalities to set, locally and for a period of 12 months, the amount of the long-duration allowance as well as the number of instalments in which it is paid.

Sindsdien is het aan de gemeenten om op lokaal niveau voor een periode van 12 maanden de hoogte van de langdurigheidstoeslag vast te stellen, alsmede het aantal termijnen waarin deze toeslag wordt uitbetaald.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het ongewenst toekennen van dubbele nationaliteiten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities automatically register Turkish nationality for children with a Turkish parent, bypassing the Turkish family register and making renunciation difficult. The minister answered that registration merely reflects foreign law, that municipalities do not grant nationality, and that the Brp bill will end registration of foreign nationality alongside Dutch nationality once in force.
It is not correct that children with at least one Turkish parent automatically acquire Turkish nationality as a second nationality upon registration in the municipal personal records database (GBA).

Het is niet juist dat kinderen, van wie in ieder geval één van de ouders een Turkse nationaliteit heeft, bij inschrijving in de gemeentelijke basisadministratie persoonsgegevens (GBA) automatisch de Turkse nationaliteit als tweede nationaliteit verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat PostNL mensen met een arbeidshandicap aan een baan gaat helpen als postbezorger

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked why PostNL, after reducing jobs for employees with disabilities, now plans to employ people with work disabilities as postal deliverers, and whether this replaces costlier staff. The government answered that PostNL denies disadvantaging disabled staff, that the job cuts stem from market changes, and that it sees no evidence of replacing employees with cheaper workers.
I have no indications that PostNL found its own employees with disabilities too expensive and is now replacing them with cheaper workers with disabilities.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat PostNL de eigen medewerkers met een beperking te duur vond en deze nu vervangt door goedkopere werknemers met een beperking.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘Tata Steel geen extra gehandicapten wil’

SP MP Karabulut asks the state secretary why Tata Steel offers only 10 work placements for young disabled people, whether this conflicts with the social accord's 125,000-job target, and whether the government will engage the company. The state secretary replies that the accord's targets are monitored with a quota backstop from 2016, that the cao negotiations are separate and Tata Steel has agreed to continue 10 Wajong placements, and points to a 2011 cao survey.
The social accord dates from 11 April. The elaboration of the agreements takes time and is not yet part of ongoing collective wage negotiations.
Het sociaal akkoord dateert van 11 april jongstleden. De uitwerking van de gemaakte afspraken vraagt tijd en maakt nog geen onderdeel uit van lopende cao-onderhandelingen.
Antwoord vragen De Wit en Karabulut over de toetredingsvoorwaarden van de Wet Schuldsanering Natuurlijke Personen

MPs De Wit and Karabulut asked why the ten-year bar on re-entering the Wsnp debt-restructuring scheme exists, how often the exceptions are used, and whether the government will introduce a shorter term or a general hardship clause after a Supreme Court ruling and Advocate-General conclusion criticising the rule. The state secretary answered that the rule was deliberately made mandatory in 2008, that at least 237 people were re-admitted within ten years, and that he sees no reason to shorten the term or generalise the hardship clause.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over "mogelijk misbruik van de tegenprestatie bij het aan het werk helpen van bijstandsgerechtigden"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about municipalities exceeding norms for the 'tegenprestatie' (required reciprocal work) for welfare recipients, following a court ruling, and whether the scheme should be scrapped, clarified, or tied to written agreements and works council information. The State Secretary refused to scrap the tegenprestatie, said the legal conditions are clear, and left implementation to municipalities without new rules or commitments.
In response to this case, I see no reason to take further steps.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus zie ik geen reden om verdere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat Post NL mensen met een arbeidshandicap aan een baan gaat helpen als postbezorger

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked whether PostNL's plan to employ about 500 people with work disabilities as part-time postal deliverers, via secondment from sheltered workshops or social assistance, risks displacing regular workers and serving as cheap labour. The state secretary called the initiative positive, said PostNL reports no displacement, and said no indications of exploitation exist, while declining to cancel planned cuts to sheltered workshops.
I currently have no indications that there is any displacement or exploitation.
Ik heb thans geen aanwijzingen dat er sprake is van verdringing en uitbuiting.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over in Turkije opgepakte vakbondsleden

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked about the arrest of trade union members in Turkey after the February 2013 embassy bombing, including KESK members, and about Turkish union and anti-terrorism law. The minister replied that 68 KESK members remain detained on terrorism membership suspicion without a known charge, that Turkey is reforming its laws, and that the Netherlands will raise the issue in dialogue but not interfere in Turkish legal proceedings.
The Netherlands does not interfere in the Turkish judicial process, but will follow the proceedings with interest.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de Turkse rechtsgang, wel zal Nederland de processen met belangstelling volgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het protocol bij sociale werkplaats Breed in Nijmegen als er geen werk is"

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary about a protocol at sheltered workplace Breed in Nijmegen for when there is insufficient work, including whether sending workers home and docking leave or pay is lawful. The state secretary replied that the document is not an adopted protocol, but that a formally adopted measure lets workers be sent home when work is lacking, with no docking of leave or pay.
Breed states that it concerns a protocol that has not been adopted.
Breed geeft aan dat het een niet vastgesteld protocol betreft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over werkloze Friezen die direct bij de sociale werkplaats aan het werk worden gezet

An MP asked the state secretary whether Frisian municipalities place welfare recipients directly into sheltered work with benefits maintained under threat of cuts, and about displacement, pay and outcomes. The government answered that the project is a voluntary municipal activation pilot, that no displacement occurs, that work with benefits is limited to a short trial, and that success is for municipalities to judge.
Municipalities have policy freedom in organising the implementation of the Wsw.
Gemeenten hebben beleidsvrijheid in het organiseren van de uitvoering van de Wsw.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de re-integratie bij sociale werkplaats IW4 voor bijstandsgerechtigden

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that Veenendaal requires benefit recipients to do monotonous work at sheltered workplace IW4 under threat of benefit cuts, and whether such work should instead match their skills. The state secretary replied that municipalities may activate recipients through work with benefit retention or require a counter-performance, that diagnosis and activation are often needed, and that sheltered workplaces may be used for these tasks without displacing Wsw-indicated persons.
Municipalities are free to engage companies for this, such as those that also carry out Wsw tasks for municipalities.
Het staat gemeenten vrij daarbij bedrijven in te schakelen die bijvoorbeeld ook de Wsw taken voor gemeenten uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut  over "een jonggehandicapte die - ondanks goed functioneren - na 3 tijdelijke contracten wordt ontslagen door een supermarkt "

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a disabled young worker dismissed by a supermarket after three temporary contracts despite good performance, and whether this fits the coalition goal of raising disabled participation and whether quota and job-coach rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that employers may freely decline to renew contracts, committed to a quota scheme and a policy note in spring, and rejected changing the three-year job-coach limit.
I am fully engaged in working out the quota scheme.
Ik ben volop aan de slag met de uitwerking van de quotumregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over ‘arbeidsmarktbeleid in Albert Heijn distributiecentra’

An SP MP asked the minister about a union dispute over workload and temp-agency practices at Albert Heijn distribution centres, including bonuses, conversion to permanent contracts, and intimidation. The minister declined to intervene in the dispute, called bonus and deployment policy an internal company matter, and pointed to employers' Arbo-law duties for intimidation.
As long as there is no reason for me to suppose that laws and regulations are being broken, I do not wish to interfere in this dispute.
Zolang er voor mij geen aanleiding is te veronderstellen dat wet- en regelgeving wordt overtreden, wil ik mij niet mengen in dit geschil.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over angst onder AOW’ers dat zij onbewust uitkeringsfraude plegen

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked the state secretary about widespread fear among AOW pensioners that they unknowingly commit benefit fraud through cohabitation rules, and asked for clearer criteria, suspension of sanctions, and an end to random checks. The state secretary replied that the SVB's objective criteria and case-by-case assessment are sufficient, that existing rules and sanctions will not change, and that the SVB will verify through administrative checks and home visits, which residents may refuse without consequence.
It is up to the person concerned to demonstrate how his actual situation is put together.
Het is aan de belanghebbende om aan te tonen hoe zijn feitelijke situatie in elkaar steekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat moskee internaten vaak niet veilig zijn en toezicht van de overheid ontbreekt

Karabulut (SP) asked about reports that mosque boarding schools were unsafe and that government oversight was lacking, including Rotterdam's inaction despite warnings. The ministers replied that Rotterdam found the schools fire-safe, that oversight of such boarding schools has shifted to provinces, that a quality framework with municipalities is being developed for pedagogical climate and safety, and that closure is not justified given current findings.

Therefore it has been agreed that central government and municipalities, in consultation with the boarding schools concerned and other parties, will develop a quality framework addressing among other things pedagogical policy, safety and the welfare of children at these boarding schools.

Daarom is afgesproken dat rijk en gemeenten in afstemming met de betrokken internaten en eventuele andere partijen zullen komen tot een kwaliteitskader met aandacht voor onder andere het pedagogisch beleid, de veiligheid en het welzijn van kinderen op deze internaten.
Antwoord op vragen Karabulut en Ulenbelt over arbeidsmarktbeleid in de Rotterdamse haven

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked minister Asscher about collective dismissals at Rotterdam Port Services, precarious temporary contracts for port workers, the ketenregeling, on-call work, and whether ILO convention 137 should be re-ratified. The minister answered that the ketenbepaling is not automatically circumvented, that the government is consulting social partners on flexible work protection, and that re-ratifying ILO 137 is not warranted, while many youth-employment answers were referred to municipalities.
The outcome of these talks will be presented to the House in a main-lines memorandum in the spring.
De uitkomst van deze gesprekken zal in het voorjaar in een Hoofdlijnennotitie aan de Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over problemen met het examen Toets Gesproken Nederlands (TGN) als onderdeel van het inburgeringsexamen

An MP asked the minister about problems with the computer-scored spoken Dutch test (TGN) in the civic integration exam, including candidates who are fluent enough but fail repeatedly, and proposed human examiners after three failures. The minister defended the test's accuracy, offered a route via an exemption for candidates with proven effort, and said he will examine whether results can be reassessed by human raters for repeat failures.

I will examine whether and how the results of a candidate who has failed the Spoken Dutch Test several times in the Netherlands can also, even if the speech computer was able to assess the answers directly, be reassessed by human raters.

Daarom zal ik onderzoeken of en hoe de resultaten van een kandidaat die meerdere malen voor de Toets Gesproken Nederlands is gezakt in Nederland, óók als de spraakcomputer de antwoorden van een kandidaat direct heeft kunnen beoordelen, alsnog door menselijke beoordelaars beoordeeld kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Karabulut over de uitwerking van amendement 32418, nr. 15 over de samenvoeging van vorderingen ter berekening van de vergoeding van buitengerechtelijke incassokosten

MPs Van Oosten and Karabulut asked whether the amendment on combining claims for extrajudicial collection costs leads to higher costs for consumers than intended, and whether repair is needed. The minister denies this, arguing the amendment means one reminder for multiple claims, lowering costs in the example given, and that the current rules balance creditor and debtor interests.
The image that the amendment leads to higher collection costs is therefore not correct.
Het beeld derhalve dat het amendement tot hogere incassokosten leidt, is niet juist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over "ontslagen bij sociale werkplaatsen Emco en Wedeka"

An SP MP asks the state secretary about dismissals of sheltered-workshop staff at Emco and Wedeka after reduced government funding, whether temporary-contract practices and cuts are acceptable, and whether dismissed workers can be placed in jobs. The state secretary answers that non-renewal of temporary contracts is a municipal policy choice, that courts handle individual disputes, that the government will set a quota and the Participatiewet changes apply, and that municipalities hold responsibility for placement.
The non-renewal of temporary contracts at Emco and Wedeka is a policy choice of the municipalities.
Het niet verlengen van tijdelijke contracten bij Emco en Wedeka betreft een beleidskeuze van de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de jacht op schoonmaaksters

MP Karabulut asks about a Zembla broadcast alleging that the Kennemerland aliens police stop cleaners based on skin colour, whether this is ethnic profiling, whether the police ignore Supreme Court rulings on the bus project, and what will improve domestic workers' position. The state secretary denies that skin colour alone triggers checks, says the police complied with the Council of State ruling, promises a general vision on aliens supervision, and points to a forthcoming advisory commission on domestic workers.
After the Council of State ruled that there were insufficient grounds for a reasonable suspicion of illegal residence in the case concerned, the police adjusted their approach on this point.

Nadat de Raad van State heeft geoordeeld dat er in de betreffende zaak onvoldoende gronden waren voor een redelijk vermoeden van illegaal verblijf, heeft de politie haar handelwijze op dit punt aangepast.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het spreekverbod met politici voor werknemers van Pantar

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether a directive by the director of sociale werkplaats Pantar telling staff not to share information with council faction representatives amounts to a gag order, and what measures would be taken. The state secretary answered that there is no gag order, only a request to exercise care when speaking on behalf of Pantar and regarding unadopted documents, and that no further measures are needed.
Pantar has indicated that the rights of the members of the works council are not in question and that every employee has the right to speak in a personal capacity.
Pantar heeft laten weten dat de rechten van de leden van de COR niet ter discussie staan en dat iedere medewerker het recht heeft om op persoonlijke titel te spreken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Smits en Karabulut over het bericht dat de pilot “In de buurt naar school“ in de gemeente Tilburg is stopgezet

MPs Smits and Karabulut asked the ministers about the city of Tilburg ending its 'In de buurt naar school' pilot against school segregation and whether the national government still funds integration in schools. The state secretary replied that Tilburg decided itself, that national pilot subsidies were phased out in 2011, that the government sees segregation as undesirable but prioritises quality and language support, and that municipalities retain local discretion.
The national government has no power to assess the content of the municipality's policy.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen bevoegdheid tot het beoordelen van het inhoudelijk beleid van de gemeente.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het bericht dat moskee-internaten vaak niet veilig zijn en toezicht van de overheid ontbreekt

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that mosque boarding schools for children are often unsafe and unsupervised, including a Rotterdam case of girls living in an unsafe attic and alleged corporal punishment. The minister said integration concerns exist, that municipalities are responsible for building permits, fire safety enforcement and dialogue, that no national register of such boarding houses exists, and that the Education Inspectorate and Youth Care Inspectorate have no supervisory role over them.
The number of children specifically staying in mosque boarding schools is not registered.
Het aantal kinderen dat specifiek in moskee-internaten verblijft wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over “het bericht dat de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen schoonmakers uit het zicht wil houden”.

Two MPs asked ministers whether the University of Groningen's plan to have cleaners work only when no one is present, and sanctions against a cleaner, were acceptable under the Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag. The minister reports that the university, union and cleaning firms reached an agreement that keeps working hours, lifts sanctions and commits the university to sign the Code, but largely declines to take further action against the board.
I am pleased that the RUG, as client, together with the other partners, has reached this agreement.
Ik ben verheugd over het feit dat de RUG als opdrachtgever, samen met de andere partners, tot dit akkoord is gekomen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht over misstanden bij de sociale werkplaats in Schiedam en antwoord vragen Karabulut over werknemers met een arbeidsbeperking die worden getreiterd in Schiedam

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about reported intimidation and mistreatment of disabled workers at a sheltered workplace in Schiedam, including when complaints arrived, what complaint channels workers have, whether similar abuses exist elsewhere, and whether budget cuts are linked. The state secretary answered that the municipality suspended the director and four staff, set up a complaint point and an investigation committee, and that workers can complain to the Labour Inspectorate, while declining to speculate on other workplaces and denying a link to budget cuts.
In appropriate cases, employees can file a complaint with the Labour Inspectorate, which will then conduct an investigation.
In voorkomende gevallen kunnen werknemers een klacht indienen bij de Inspectie SZW die daarop een onderzoek zal doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over "particuliere pensioenproducten en de bijstand"

MP Karabulut asked whether it is acceptable that people saving for retirement through private third-pillar products must deplete those savings before receiving social assistance, unlike second-pillar pension savers, and asked for numbers and financial consequences of changing the asset test. The state secretary answered that there is no legal inequality, that the government is studying self-employed pension saving and may consider exempting third-pillar pensions, but declined to give the financial consequences.
Based on the outcomes of this research, it may be considered to examine further whether it is desirable, and if so, how, to exempt third-pillar pension assets from the social assistance asset test.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek kan worden overwogen om nader te onderzoeken of het wenselijk is, en zo ja, hoe
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Karalabut over het bestemmen van de resterende middelen ten behoeve van Sinti en Roma

MPs Schouw and Karabulut asked how remaining funds for Sinti and Roma redress would be managed after the NISR liquidation and SARSR dissolution, including oversight, conflict-of-interest concerns and future representation. The state secretary answered that about EUR 4.39 million remains in a treasury account, the foundation's mandate continues past 1 January 2013 pending a new approach, she supervises the body, and she acknowledges the appearance of conflict of interest.
Ik houd toezicht op het zbo.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bodemloze put van re-integratie

An SP MP asked the state secretary about 10 billion euros spent on commercial reintegration firms with unclear job outcomes, and whether municipalities should instead provide placement themselves and whether the performance of firms like Fourstar will be investigated. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold broad discretion, gave rough CBS figures on about 367,000 people placed in work, rejected both the call to ban private providers and any national investigation into individual firms, and refused to discuss individual cases.
It is up to the municipalities to choose the most effective use of commercial parties.
Het is aan de gemeenten om de meest effectieve inzet van commerciële partijen te kiezen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Karabulut en Paulus Jansen over de voorgenomen sloop van woningen in de Van der Pekbuurt in Amsterdam door woningcorporatie Ymere

MPs Karabulut and Jansen (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior whether a housing corporation may demolish homes in the Van der Pek neighbourhood under the revised Building Decree, which requires only a notification, and whether demolition should halt while heritage protection as a townscape is being initiated. The minister answered that the demolition notification and permit concern nuisance and safety only, that protection of townscapes is the municipality's task, and that the cultural-historical concerns are being raised in consultation with the municipality and the corporation.
It is primarily the task of the municipality of Amsterdam to carefully weigh and protect the heritage values in Amsterdam.
Het is primair de taak van de gemeente Amsterdam om de erfgoedwaarden in Amsterdam zorgvuldig af te wegen en te beschermen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut en Van Bommel over het bericht dat het Eritrese consulaat Eritrese Nederlanders afperst

MPs Karabulut and Van Bommel asked whether the Eritrean consulate extorts Eritrean Dutch nationals through a 2% levy and threats, whether it obstructs integration and civil society in Amersfoort, and whether Dutch firms trade with Eritrea. The minister answered that the levy and festival fundraising are not illegal in themselves, that criminal conduct would be investigated on the basis of complaints, that the government will raise the issue in EU and bilateral channels, and that no data exist on Dutch trade with Eritrea.
To establish whether offences such as extortion are at issue, the police and the public prosecution service depend to a large extent on reports and complaints from the victims.

Voor het vaststellen of misdrijven als afpersing en soortgelijke delicten aan de orde zijn, zijn politie en het openbaar ministerie (OM) in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door de slachtoffers.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Karabulut over de leegstand van woningen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about reported vacancy of 77,000 social rental homes and 110,000 private rental homes and what action would be taken. The Minister found the 3% social rental vacancy acceptable, attributed it mainly to normal turnover and market reasons, could not provide a breakdown or regional data, and saw no reason for action.
As indicated in answer 2, the vast majority of vacancy at housing corporations is not related to their policy but is caused by regular turnover vacancy and vacancy for market reasons.

Zoals bij vraag 2 aangegeven is het overgrote deel van de leegstand bij woningcorporaties niet gerelateerd aan het door hen gevoerde beleid, maar wordt deze veroorzaakt door reguliere mutatieleegstand en door leegstand om marktredenen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Karabulut over bezoldiging van corporatiebestuurders en de algemene bedrijfslasten van woningcorporaties

Two SP MPs asked the minister about executive pay at housing corporations, the 2012 press-reported pay research, and a central public register of board and supervisory roles. The minister said pay disclosure is left to the sector code, a uniform reporting duty will follow under the WNT, nevenfuncties will be disclosed in annual reports, and no binding pay cap exists yet.
When the WNT is introduced a transitional regime will apply, through which remuneration will gradually be reduced to the applicable norms.
Bij invoering van de WNT gaat een overgangsrecht gelden, waarmee de beloningen geleidelijk naar de toepasselijke normen zullen worden teruggebracht.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over werkgevers die jonggehandicapten ontslaan, omdat er geen geld is voor de begeleiding

Karabulut (SP) asked whether it is acceptable that employers dismiss young disabled workers when job coach funding ends after three years, and what exceptions exist. The state secretary answered that extensions are only for temporary inability to work unaided, that the programme is meant to be temporary, and that no new measures will be taken.
How many young disabled people in 2012 faced the end of jobcoach support because the three-year term had expired?
Vraag 3 Hoeveel jonggehandicapten werden in 2012 geconfronteerd met het stoppen van de begeleiding via een jobcoach, omdat de termijn van drie jaar was verstreken?
Antwoord vragen Karabulut en Leijten over "de onrust naar aanleiding van plannen van wethouder Florijn te Rotterdam om bijstandsgerechtigden in de thuiszorg te laten werken"

SP MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked about Rotterdam alderman Florijn's plan to place welfare recipients in home care, including social return quotas, wage levels, qualifications, and single-provider contracting. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for local labour market policy and social return, that cao wages apply to such workers, and that the government gives no job or income guarantees.
Policy under the Work and Assistance Act is the responsibility of the municipality of Rotterdam.
Het beleid in het kader van de Wet werk en bijstand is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de klussendienst in Bergen op Zoom met bijstandgerechtigden

An SP MP asked whether Bergen op Zoom's pilot having welfare recipients do unpaid WMO household tasks (ironing, shopping) that paid care workers usually perform threatens regular jobs and wages. The State Secretary defended the pilot as re-integration support, said the municipality is responsible for quality, and confirmed there is no employment contract and thus no minimum wage.
As indicated, there is no employment relationship and therefore no statutory minimum wage either.
Zoals aangegeven is er geen sprake van een dienstverband en daarom ook niet van een wettelijk minimumloon.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het rapport meldpunt Donnerhuren

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister of Interior about a report on rent increases caused by 'Donnerpunten' (extra WWS points for renovated homes), including a 20% jump in social rents, rents for forced movers, and whether the measure should be scrapped. Minister Spies answered that rent increases for sitting tenants are limited to indexation and the annual maximum, that movers keep a choice, and that it is too early to draw conclusions, so the measure will not be scrapped.
Drawing conclusions about the effects of this measure now is not possible in my view.
Nu al conclusies trekken over de effecten van deze maatregel acht ik niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over een discriminerende vacature

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked why UWV and the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling could not act against a job advert excluding people on benefits, and what measures would prevent such adverts. The state secretary said exclusion on benefit receipt is not a protected ground, that CGB could act only if it constituted indirect discrimination on a protected ground, and that the government will ask the SER for advice on labour market discrimination.
The cabinet intends to request advice from the Social and Economic Council (SER) on labour market discrimination.
Wel kan ik melden dat het kabinet voornemens is om aan de Sociaal Economische Raad (SER) een advies te vragen over het onderwerp discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het schrappen van de langdurigheidstoeslag door de gemeente Schiedam

An SP MP asked whether Schiedam had stopped paying the long-duration allowance (langdurigheidstoeslag) in breach of the Work and Assistance Act and how the state would correct this. The state secretary replied that Schiedam still pays the allowance under a renamed 'inkomenstoeslag' regulated by its 2012 ordinance, so no breach exists and no further action is needed.
As regards the granting of the long-duration allowance, the municipality therefore meets the conditions set by the Work and Assistance Act.
Voor wat betreft de verlening van de langdurigheidstoeslag voldoet de gemeente derhalve aan de voorwaarden die de WWB stelt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over een directeur van sociale werkplaats Permar in Ede die meer verdient dan een minister

An MP asked the state secretary whether a director of the Permar sheltered workplace in Ede earning more than a minister is acceptable and whether the rules on pay for sheltered-work directors should be tightened. The state secretary said pay is a matter for employers and employees and municipalities (who form the board) have policy freedom, declined to investigate or legislate a salary cap, and noted the pay did not exceed the statutory top-income norm.
They form the board and are responsible for policy.
Zij vormen het bestuur en gaan over het beleid.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het mogelijk op straat belanden van gezinnen uit de Furmerusflat in Sneek

MP Karabulut asked whether families from the Furmerusflat in Sneek face homelessness when their temporary tenancies end on 23 August, and whether housing corporation Accolade should be held to account and a fair transition arranged. Minister Donner replied that the residents hold loan contracts with leegstandsbeheerder Carex, not leases, that most have found new housing, that Accolade has no legal relationship with them, that the corporation will not be called to account, and that no means are seen to prevent the end of the temporary occupancy.
Housing corporation Accolade has no legal relationship with the residents of the Furmerusflat.
Woningcorporatie Accolade heeft geen juridische relatie met de bewoners van de Furmerusflat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de ontbinding van het Nederlands Instituut Sinti en Roma (NISR) en het bestemmen van de middelen ten behoeve van Sinti en Roma

MPs Schouw and Karabulut asked why the Nederlands Instituut Sinti en Roma (NISR) was being liquidated after about 1.5 years, despite earlier approval of its 2012 plan and a planned five-year evaluation, and how funds and expertise would be protected. The state secretary answered that the NISR board decided to liquidate on the basis of its own quick scan, that SARSR approved the 2012 budget, that liquidation aims to be short and is following statutory procedures, and that SARSR will fund liquidation costs and inventory NISR's activities for a possible new approach.
I have no insight into the internal communications of the NISR foundation.
Ik heb geen zicht op de interne communicatie van de stichting NISR.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over "de gemeente Nijmegen die camera’s inzet tegen bijstandsfraude"

MP Karabulut (SP) asked whether it is acceptable for Nijmegen to aim observation cameras at welfare recipients' front doors without an objective suspicion of fraud, and how this relates to Dutch criminal procedure, proportionality, privacy (ECHR art. 8), and costs. The state secretary answered that municipalities decide their own methods, that camera observation requires a reasonable suspicion and subsidiarity, cited a 2005 Central Raad van Beroep ruling, and said no cost-benefit data is held and no study is planned.
It is therefore primarily up to the Nijmegen mayor and aldermen and the municipal council to determine which investigative methods they consider desirable for proper implementation.

Het is dan ook in de eerste plaats aan het College van Burgemeester en Wethouders en aan de gemeenteraad van Nijmegen om te bepalen welke onderzoeksmethoden zij voor een juiste uitvoering wenselijk achten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitreiking van de huisjesmelkerprijs 2012 door ROOD

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about a landlord award given by ROOD, the alleged neglect of rental homes, unlawful service charges and intimidation, and whether a licensing system for landlords would be introduced, plus a related student housing question. The Minister said tenants can use the rental commission and courts and police, declined a general landlord licensing scheme as bureaucratic, and promised new proposals for serious cases of landlord abuse, expected in spring 2013.
There are good legal possibilities for tenants to assert their rights.
Er bestaan goede wettelijke mogelijkheden voor huurders om hun recht te halen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het bericht dat in Amsterdam meer woningen worden gesplitst dan is toegestaan

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the 25 extra rent-points rule, which allows higher rents in sought-after areas, is behind unlawful flat-splitting and rent rises in Amsterdam, and whether it will be reversed. The minister replied that the rule does not affect sitting tenancies, that Amsterdam is responsible for enforcing splitting limits through its housing ordinance, and that there is no reason to reverse the measure.
Under the Housing Act, municipalities can steer on the splitting of dwellings at local level.
Op basis van de Huisvestingswet kan er op gemeentelijk niveau gestuurd worden op het splitsen van woningen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over uitblijvende nieuwbouw en verbouwingsprojecten door de problemen bij Vestia

An SP MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the Vestia financial crisis is halting housing construction and renovation projects in deprived Hague and Rotterdam neighbourhoods, whether the minister accepts responsibility, and what solutions exist for tenants. The minister acknowledges the halted investments, says he is consulting municipalities and Aedes on alternatives, accepts responsibility for the housing policy, and promises to inform the Chamber.
On both points, I therefore take my responsibility.
Op beide punten neem ik dus mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karalabut over de liquidatie van het Nederlands Instituut Sinti en Roma (NISR)

An MP asks why the Dutch Sinti and Roma institute NISR is being liquidated, which projects funds went to, and why the government stays at a distance while the remaining funds are re-allocated. The state secretary replies that NISR is a private foundation outside her direct control, that SARSR oversees the liquidation and reallocation of about 4.5 million euro, and that the government is following developments but has not changed SARSR's mandate.
I have no control over the NISR.
Over het NISR heb ik geen zeggenschap.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de toegenomen woonsegregatie in Amsterdam

MP Karabulut asked the ministers whether the reported growth of residential segregation in Amsterdam is a problem and what action will be taken, including talks with the Amsterdam council, and how segregation has developed in the other large cities. Minister Leers answered that the cited study concerns housing preferences rather than actual segregation, that segregation in Amsterdam has fallen since 2006-2007, that no action or talks are planned, and that segregation fell in 27 of 32 large cities between 2001 and 2011.
Contrary to the tenor of the Het Parool article, I do not find, based on the O&S report, that there is any sign of increasing segregation.
In tegenstelling tot de teneur van het artikel in Het Parool constateer ik op basis van het rapport van O&S niet dat er spraken is van toenemende segregatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het stopzetten van de voorbereidende werkzaamheden voor de Wet Werken Naar Vermogen

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary whether he would, in consultation with municipalities, rehire dismissed sociale werkvoorziening staff and prevent new dismissals. The state secretary replied that the Wsw is decentralised, that workers are employed by municipalities, and that the national government has no role in such decisions.
The national government has no role in this.
Het Rijk heeft daar geen rol in.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over dreigend woningtekort in de Metropoolregio Amsterdam

MP Karabulut asked the minister of Interior about a projected housing shortage in the Amsterdam metropolitan region, including the conclusion that 270,000 homes could not be built by 2040, that a catch-up to 12,500 homes per year is practically impossible, and the effect on students and starters. The minister called the conclusions premature, said the region sees room for 208,000 homes, committed to drawing up an implementation agenda with the region and to reviewing regulatory obstacles, while stressing housing supply is primarily a local and regional responsibility.
I guarantee, in cooperation with my colleagues of Infrastructure and Environment, that account will be taken of the spatial needs for functions of national importance.
Ik waarborg daarbij, in samenwerking met mijn collega's van Infrastructuur en Milieu, dat er rekening wordt gehouden met de ruimtebehoefte voor functies van nationaal belang
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het vertrek van een bestuurder van een sociale werkplaats

An MP asked whether a severance payment of around half a million euros to a former director of the sheltered workshop Novatec is acceptable, whether it is financed from sheltered-employment subsidies, and whether other board arrangements and cases of excessive pay will be reviewed. The state secretary answered that labour conditions are not his responsibility, that municipalities decide on sheltered-workshop finances and any investigation, that no subsidy funds are being withdrawn, and that no cases of concern are known from the top-pay reporting, so no further investigation is planned.
Your questions concern agreements on employment conditions to which I am not a party.
Uw vragen betreffen afspraken over arbeidsvoorwaarden waarbij ik geen partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over de vergoeding van orthopedische schoenen voor jonggehandicapten die deelnemen aan dagbesteding

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked whether disabled young people in day care can obtain orthopaedic work shoes, since the health insurance covers only everyday orthopaedic shoes and they may be forced to quit day care. The state secretary answered that forcing people to quit for lack of shoe reimbursement is undesirable, and that shoes needed for day-care activities are covered by the Zorgverzekeringswet if day care is indicated under the AWBZ, taking account of use in day care.
I do not consider it desirable that people are forced to give up their day care because they do not receive reimbursement for orthopaedic shoes.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk dat mensen genoodzaakt zijn hun dagbesteding op te zeggen, omdat ze geen vergoeding krijgen voor orthopedische schoenen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het verschenen rapport over Integratie in Rotterdam en Amsterdam

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Amsterdam and Rotterdam must invest in deprived neighbourhoods to prevent 'no go areas', and whether past demolition of affordable housing and cuts to welfare and integration were counterproductive. Minister Leers rejected that the approach was counterproductive, pointed to liveability data and existing regeneration and corporation obligations, and said the government meets regularly with both cities.
The cabinet does not share this view.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening niet.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Karabulut over de mishandeling van Koerdische kinderen in Turkse gevangenissen

Two SP MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of sexual abuse and beatings of Kurdish juveniles in the Pozanti detention centre in Turkey, and about related oversight and Dutch influence. The minister answered that the Turkish justice ministry has investigated, closed the youth wing, transferred detainees, and is preparing criminal measures, while stating that Dutch and EU pressure on Turkey continues through accession channels.
I will continue to follow this situation closely, also within the framework of the EU accession process.
Ik zal deze situatie, ook in het kader van het EU -toetredingsproces, met aandacht blijven volgen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over  “jongeren met een licht verstandelijke beperking die geen bijzondere bijstand krijgen”

Karabulut (SP) asked whether young people with a mild intellectual disability who turn 18 can go four to six months without income because their Wajong application is pending and municipalities refuse special assistance as the Wajong is treated as a prior provision. The state secretary answered that Wajong is not a prior provision for special assistance, that a separate WWB rule applies to 18 to 20 year olds, and that young people can apply for Wajong four months before their 18th birthday, which he considers sufficient to avoid the gap.
No, as indicated in the answer to question 1, there is a separate arrangement in the WWB for the granting of special assistance to young people aged 18, 19 or 20.
Nee, zoals in antwoord op vraag 1 is aangegeven geldt er voor jongeren van 18, 19 of 20 jaar in de WWB een aparte regeling voor de verlening van de bijzondere bijstand.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de vermogensgrenzen van de kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belastingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the expansion of asset limits for municipal tax remission is narrower than proposed, whether this was withheld from parliament, and whether a statutory expansion can be undone through lower regulations, and whether restricting asset limits would hurt elderly savers and recipients of special assistance. The minister said the executive rules are not yet adapted but a temporary arrangement exists, that the expansion is not currently being implemented for benefit recipients due to the poverty trap, and that the rules were recently amended to protect the existing remission level for AOW-only pensioners.
The letter I mention under answer 2 explains why the asset limits for remission of local taxes are not currently being expanded for individuals.
In de brief die ik noem onder antwoord 2 wordt uitgelegd waarom de vermogensgrenzen voor de kwijtschelding van decentrale belastingen nu niet worden verruimd voor particulieren.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de WOZ-beschikking voor huurders

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether her claim that tenants can have a direct interest in WOZ valuations conflicts with the WOZ Act, and how municipalities will be made to provide WOZ decisions to tenants, plus costs and burdens of the new rent-points system. The minister answered that tenants are legally interested parties under the WOZ Act, that no amendment is needed, that municipalities will supply decisions on request, and that cost figures are largely already covered by existing state funding, while also noting partial limits on tenant appeals.
Tenants are in fact interested parties under articles 24(3)(b) and 26 of the WOZ Act, and can therefore receive a decision and, if necessary, object to it.
Huurders zijn namelijk belanghebbenden op grond van de artikelen 24, derde lid, onderdeel b, en 26 van de Wet WOZ, en kunnen daarom een beschikking ontvangen en zonodig bezwaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut over het verstrekken van privacygevoelige informatie aan verhuurders door de belastingdienst

An SP MP asks whether it is proper for the tax authority to provide tenants' income data to landlords before the rent-increase law amendment has been debated in parliament, and whether this should stop. The minister defends the early provision as based on current law (art. 67 AWR exemption) to enable timely income-based rent proposals, and refuses to stop it.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut en Leijten over de vergoeding van orthopedische schoenen voor jonggehandicapten die deelnemen aan dagbesteding

SP MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked whether disabled young people in day care who work without wages should receive orthopaedic shoes, and whether UWV should provide them only with an employment contract. The government answers that day-care providers are responsible for enabling participation, that UWV support applies only to paid employment, and it does not wish to widen UWV's role.
Based on UWV's task of guiding people to the labour market, we do not consider it desirable to amend the law to make UWV responsible for such provisions in other situations as well.

Uitgaande van de taak van het UWV – toeleiding naar de arbeidsmarkt – vinden we het niet wenselijk de wet te wijzigen om UWV ook in andere situaties voor dit soort verstrekkingen verantwoordelijk te maken.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het onderwerp voortgang van het Nationaal Programma Kwaliteitssprong voor Rotterdam Zuid

MP Karabulut asks the minister about resident participation in the Rotterdam South development programme, including the promised follow-up after an earlier complaint, the role of residents' organisations, and the consequences of cutbacks. The minister replies that participation is being organised at district level, residents' organisations are being integrated with other resident groups from 2012, and the minister will monitor participation in consultation with the municipality.
Twice a year I hold administrative consultation with the municipality of Rotterdam. Resident participation will be a standing agenda item at these consultations.
Twee keer per jaar heb ik bestuurlijk overleg met de gemeente Rotterdam. De bewonersparticipatie zal een vast agendapunt van deze overleggen zijn.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het recordaantal dakloze jongeren (ingezonden 12

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked about a record number of homeless youths in shelters, rising child and youth admissions, debt, benefit levels, the four-week job-search period for young people leaving care or prison, and cooperation between municipalities, youth care and shelters. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, said the causes were not yet clear, pointed to municipalities' lead role and listed support programmes and handbooks, while declining to draw up a new action plan.
The cabinet has no intention of drawing up a new action plan.
Het kabinet heeft geen voornemens om een nieuw actieplan op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de voedseltekorten bij voedselbanken

MP Karabulut asks whether rising food shortages and waiting lists at food banks are acceptable, whether a national poverty plan is needed, and about the EU minimum-benefit scheme's status and Dutch contribution. The state secretary answers that food banks are a private initiative, that the benefits system is the proper remedy, that the Netherlands will not participate in the EU scheme, and that the Dutch share cannot be precisely determined.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat een Turkse moslimextremist asiel heeft aangevraagd in Nederland

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked about a Turkish national seeking asylum despite a Turkish conviction, and about the number of asylum seekers excluded under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention who remain in the Netherlands. Minister Leers answered that extradition is pending, that about 810 people have had 1F applied, around 240 are still in the country (about 200 for over ten years), and that no clear solution is planned for those who cannot be removed.
At this stage I do not consider it appropriate to provide information about the sentence imposed or the facts stated in the extradition request.
Ik acht het in dit stadium niet dienstig om mededelingen te doen over de opgelegde straf of over de feiten die in het uitleveringsverzoek worden genoemd.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de klopjacht op de negroï

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked whether police stopping and detaining cleaners based on their appearance, later judged unlawful by the Raad van State, was justified, what sanctions followed, and why no exploitation investigation or prosecution occurred. The minister answered that the checks were administrative, twelve persons were removed, the Openbaar Ministerie received no related cases, and the Inspectie SZW did not withdraw fines but found none applicable.
The investigation was an administrative-law investigation arising from the administrative task of the Aliens Police.
Het onderzoek is een bestuursrechtelijk onderzoek geweest dat voortvloeit uit de bestuurlijke taak van de Vreemdelingenpolitie.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over dat de bezuinigingen op de sociale werkplaatsen averechts werken (ingezonden 18 januari 2012).

Karabulut (SP) asks the state secretary how the government responds to an SP report arguing that cuts to sheltered workplaces and a waiting list of about 21,662 people harm employment and cost society more. The state secretary rejects the report's cost calculations, defends the Wet Werken naar Vermogen as the route to regular employment, and says the waiting list will be addressed through that law and municipal instruments.
I do not share the view that helping people directly into work at a sheltered workplace could save millions, as set out in the report 'Wachtlijst of Werk'.
Ik deel de opvatting niet dat door het direct aan het werk te helpen in de sociale werkplaats miljoenen kunnen worden bespaard, zoals uiteengezet in het rapport «Wachtlijst of Werk».
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het 600 banenplan van de gemeente Sittard-Geleen

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Sittard-Geleen is not taking part in the loondispensatie pilot and whether non-pilot municipalities may use wage dispensation, and what the government would do if the municipality breaks the law. The state secretary confirmed the municipality is not in the pilot, said only the 32 pilot municipalities may use wage dispensation, and reported the municipality uses work-with-benefit instead, without committing to new action.
Only the 32 municipalities selected for the wage dispensation pilot may use the wage dispensation instrument for the target group named in the Temporary Wage Dispensation Pilot Act.

2 Antwoord 2 Het klopt dat alleen de 32 gemeenten die zijn geselecteerd voor de pilot loondispensatie het instrument loondispensatie mogen inzetten voor de in de Tijdelijke wet pilot loondispensatie genoemde doelgroep.
Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het opeens stopzetten van toeslagen (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary of Finance why the Tax Service sent letters around 20 December 2011 stopping rent and healthcare allowances from 1 January 2012, when many recipients may still be entitled, and asked about reachability and urgent payments. The secretary answered that about 48,000 rent-allowance and 120,000 healthcare-allowance letters were sent, that around 600 people were wrongly stopped due to residence-status data and would be paid from 20 January 2012, and that the Tax Service would proactively contact people facing acute financial problems.
However, something went wrong this year with a group of about 600 allowance recipients.
Evenwel is er dit jaar iets niet goed gegaan met een groep van ongeveer 600 toeslaggerechtigden.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het feit dat 300 000 gezinnen klem zitten door de inkomensgrens voor sociale huurwoningen (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

Karabulut (SP) asks the minister to react to housing corporation Ymere's claim that about 300,000 middle-income households fall outside both the social rental and free-market sectors, and whether a second income should count for only a third in the social rent income limit as it does for mortgages. Minister Donner disputes the 300,000 figure, says counting a second income differently would amount to raising the EU-approved limit and cannot be done within the Commission decision, and promises a report in early 2012 on hardship cases and corporations' use of their 10% allocation room.
I expect to be able to report to your House on this in early 2012.
Ik verwacht hierover aan uw Kamer in begin 2012 verslag te kunnen doen.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de plannen van wethouder Ossel in Amsterdam (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

An MP asks the minister about Amsterdam's housing manifesto proposing higher rents in sought-after areas, arguing it punishes tenants and fuels segregation. The minister says the manifesto is an unadopted DenkTank recommendation, rent-setting is a landlord choice within legal limits, and the municipality's agreements already address income mix.
However, the Amsterdam college of mayor and aldermen has not taken a decision on these recommendations.
Inzake deze aanbevelingen heeft het college van B en W van Amsterdam echter geen besluit genomen.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Financien over verstrekkers van flitskredieten die de regels ontduiken (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister how flash-credit providers evade the Wft rules by charging no interest but high collection costs after seven days, and whether this justifies a ban. The minister answers that such providers now fall under the Wft and AFM licensing, that total costs including collection fees count, and that consumer protections and the pending collection-cost bill apply, but he declines to rule out further action or discuss specific providers.
I cannot tell you anything about the nature of contacts with specific flash-credit providers. I do not have access to supervision-confidential information.
Over de aard van de contacten met specifieke flitskredietaanbieders kan ik u niets mededelen. Ik beschik niet over toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over jonggehandicapten die vanwege kabinetsbeleid hun jobcoach – en daarmee hun baan – verliezen (ingezonden 11 november 2011

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether ending UWV-funded job coaching for young disabled workers after three years, which may cost them their jobs, is desirable and how it fits government employment goals. The State Secretary replies that the protocol change aims at more efficient coaching, that extensions can be requested on justified grounds, and that some claims about a TNO study were misleading.
It is undesirable if young disabled persons lose their jobs.
Het is onwenselijk als jongehandicapten hun baan verliezen.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het verkrijgen van de koopkrachttegemoetkoming oudere belastingplichtigen (KOB) in Duitsland (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

MP Karabulut asked whether elderly AOW recipients in Germany can get the KOB allowance, given that the German tax office must sign the SVB form and some may be unknown to it. The minister answered that the 90% income criterion can be verified via a signed declaration, that German tax offices in North Rhine-Westphalia were instructed on signing, and saw no reason to change the procedure.
I therefore have no reason to assume that the procedure in other German states would be different.
Ik heb daarom geen reden om aan te nemen dat de procedure in andere Duitse deelstaten anders zou zijn.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onterechte korting op de bijzondere bijstand van chroni

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked why Amsterdam cut special assistance for chronically ill and disabled people after a court ruling, whether the state knew, and whether people will be compensated and municipalities obliged to grant categorical assistance. The state secretary replied that special assistance is decentralised to municipalities, that he does not comment on individual cases, will not compensate affected people, and will not oblige municipalities to grant categorical assistance.
In this context it is up to the independent judge to assess the decisions the municipality of Amsterdam made in individual cases.
In dit kader is het aan de onafhankelijke rechter om een oordeel te geven over de besluiten die de gemeente Amsterdam in individuele gevallen heeft genomen

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Spijkenisse de grenzen sluit voor kansloze uitkeringsgerechtigden uit Rotterdam (ingezonden 2 september

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether the Spijkenisse alderman's plan to refuse welfare recipients from Rotterdam, and his description of benefit recipients as non-willing profiteers, is lawful and whether it stems from the Rotterdam law. The government replied that the municipality is bound by the regional housing ordinance, that the Rotterdam law cannot wall off a municipality, that it does not comment on a wethouder's statements, and that the Rotterdam law's effects will be seen in the municipality's evaluation.
This law does not offer the possibility to place a 'fence around the municipality', but can be applied to a few specifically named districts.
Deze wet biedt niet de mogelijkheid om «een hek om de gemeente» te plaatsen, maar kan worden toegepast voor enkele specifiek te benoemen wijken.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman, Karabulut en Paulus Jansen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het woningaanbod voor specifieke doelgroepen

SP MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health about housing supply for vulnerable groups, including homeless people, youth leaving youth care, ex-psychiatric patients, ex-prisoners, families living in anti-squat arrangements or campsites, and forced evictions by housing associations. Minister Donner answered that most data are unavailable, cited partial CorpoData figures, rejected stricter reporting requirements for associations, declined further research on campsite living, and said municipalities can use urgency declarations to prioritise these groups.
I am not in favour of an accountability obligation at this detailed level.
Ik ben geen voorstander van verantwoordingsplicht op dit gedetailleerde niveau.
Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het schrappen van duizenden ID en WIW-banen bij gemeenten (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).
