Amendment removes the possibility of list combinations (lijstverbindingen) in elections for municipal councils, provincial states, the House and the European Parliament.
makes it impossible for list combinations to be formed in elections for municipal councils, provincial states, the House of Representatives and the European Parliament
maakt het onmogelijk dat er bij verkiezingen voor de gemeenteraad, provinciale staten, de Tweede Kamer en het Europees Parlement lijstverbindingen
Amendement van de leden Schouw en Taverne ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het gebruik van zwart, groen of blauw schrijfmateriaal naast rood
Allows votes to be cast with black, green or blue writing material as well as red, following advice from the Kiesraad and VNG.
This amendment provides that votes may also be cast with black, green or blue writing material.
Dit amendement regelt dat ook met zwart, groen of blauw schrijfmateriaal een stem uitgebracht mag worden.
Motie van de leden Schouw en Taverne over intrekking van de Zondagswet
Asks the government to submit a bill repealing the Sunday Act, leaving Sunday rest rules to municipalities.
requests the government to submit a bill to the House of Representatives to repeal the Sunday Act
verzoekt de regering, bij de Tweede Kamer een wetsvoorstel in te dienen om de Zondagswet in te trekken
Amendement van het lid Taverne c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 18 over het gezamenlijk factureren door alle collectieve beheersorganisaties
Requires collective rights management organisations to issue a joint annual invoice and removes the ministerial-regulation basis for joint collection, with supervision by the College van Toezicht.
with all collective management organisations to which a payer owes a fee, draws up and issues a joint annual invoice
met alle collectieve beheersorganisaties aan wie een betalingsplichtige een vergoeding is verschuldigd een gezamenlijke jaarlijkse factuur opstelt en uitreikt
Amendement van het lid Taverne c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het gezamenlijk factureren door alle collectieve beheersorganisaties
Requires all collective management organisations to issue a joint annual invoice to payers and removes the collection-related reference in the supervisory provision.
with all collective management organisations to which a payer owes a fee, a joint annual invoice is drawn up and issued to that payer
met alle collectieve beheersorganisaties aan wie een betalingsplichtige een vergoeding is verschuldigd een gezamenlijke jaarlijkse factuur opstelt en uitreikt
Amendement van het lid Taverne over het gezamenlijk factureren door alle collectieve beheersorganisaties
Requires all collective management organisations to issue a joint annual invoice and removes the AMvB power to set conditions for joint collection of fees.
Motie Taverne c.s. over de rechtsprekende taak van de Raad van State
Asks the government to move the judicial function of the Council of State to another body, separating it from its advisory role.
requests the government to place the judicial task of the Council of State elsewhere
verzoekt de regering de rechtsprekende taak van de Raad van State elders onder te brengen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de EU-steun aan Afrika ten zuiden van de Sahara voor het genereren van inkomsten “nog niet doeltreffend” is.

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked about a European Court of Auditors report finding EU budget support to sub-Saharan Africa not yet effective for domestic revenue mobilisation, and about Dutch positions, EU budget support share, and Zimbabwe tax-training assistance. The minister answered in detail, accepting the report's six recommendations, defending budget support as broadly effective, and noting the Dutch stance and the ended training assistance.
The cabinet welcomes more information and evaluations on the contribution of budget support to domestic revenue mobilisation.
Het kabinet verwelkomt meer informatievoorziening en evaluaties over de bijdrage van begrotingssteun aan de mobilisering van binnenlandse inkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over het bericht 'Plasterk: laat links gecombineerde fractie vormen met Klaver als voorman'

An MP asked the Interior Minister how his call for left-wing parties to field joint lists in municipal elections fits with his bill abolishing list combinations. The minister replied that there is no conflict: list combinations only pool surplus votes for seat allocation, he never advocated them, only single lists, and he will support the bill in the Senate as he did in the House.
There is therefore no connection between the aforementioned bill and my plea in the Volkskrant.
Er is dus geen verband tussen voormeld wetsvoorstel en mijn pleidooi in de Volkskrant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Taverne over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over EU-bijstand aan Oekraïne

MPs Ten Broeke and Taverne (VVD) asked about the European Court of Auditors report on EU assistance to Ukraine, including reporting on indicators, repayment options, and measures to strengthen control over EU aid to Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine. The minister welcomed the Court's recommendations, explained the aid framework, conditionality and transparency, and said the EU Association Agreement does not affect member states' decisions on financial aid to Ukraine.
The Netherlands will use the Council discussion of the report to invite the Commission to place greater emphasis on conditionality in programming.
Nederland zal de bespreking in Raadsverband van het rapport aangrijpen om de Commissie uit te nodigen nog meer nadruk te leggen op conditionaliteit in de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over het gebruik van de Ondersteunende Software Verkiezingen (OSV)

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the Ondersteunende Software Verkiezingen (OSV), whether election results published as open data on data.overheid.nl are incomplete, and what would be done about missing municipal results. The minister answered that using software is optional and the Kiesraad's database receives municipal data via OSV, with the Kiesraad able to request missing data directly and the minister willing to urge municipalities to share data.
I am of course willing to urge municipalities to make election data available to the Kiesraad, insofar as they do not already do so via OSV.
Ik ben vanzelfsprekend bereid om gemeenten daarin aan te sporen om verkiezingsdata aan de Kiesraad beschikbaar te stellen voor zover zij dat al niet doen via OSV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de voortgang van de besprekingen inzake de Kiesakte betreffende de verkiezingen van de leden van het Europees Parlement

MP Taverne asked the ministers whether their earlier answer on the EU Electoral Act negotiations meant the government would accept the proposal in the Council even if Parliament rejected it, and asked them to confirm they would implement the Taverne motion requiring prior Parliament approval before a Council vote. The minister confirmed the motion is being implemented, noting it is not a formal parliamentary reservation under the Lisbon treaty approval law but will have that effect in substance.
In substance, however, it will have this effect. The motion is therefore being implemented.
Materieel zal het echter wel deze werking hebben. De motie wordt derhalve uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de test met internetstemmen voor kiezers in het buitenland

MP Taverne asked the Minister of Interior about how many participants the internet voting test for voters abroad needs, how many have signed up, what is being done to boost participation, and when codes will be sent. The minister answered that no fixed number of participants is required, that over 9,000 people had signed up after a mailing by The Hague municipality, and that codes are expected at the end of November with the test running 7 to 13 December.
No specific number of participants is necessary for this.
Hiervoor is niet een bepaald aantal deelnemers noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de voortgang van de besprekingen inzake de Kiesakte betreffende de verkiezingen van de leden van het Europees Parlement

An MP asked the ministers about progress on the EU Electoral Act revision for European Parliament elections, including which proposals were gaining Council support and whether the government would inform parliament before Council votes. The government replied that member states are sorting provisions into acceptable, unacceptable and undecided groups, that Dutch positions stay anchored in its 2015 standpoint, and that it will inform parliament of emerging majorities and not agree to a Council position parliament rejects.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kenia

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked whether the minister's earlier answers on the Dutch ambassador in Kenya's remarks were complete, and how a 'firm conversation' with the ambassador squares with freedom of expression. The minister answered that the remarks conflicted with aid and trade policy, that a talk with the ambassador took place, and that the matter is closed.
I consider the matter closed with this.
Ik beschouw de kwestie hiermee als afgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over het bericht “Government austerity policy a breach of international human rights, says UN report”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a UN committee report finding UK austerity policy breaches economic and social rights, and whether such committee judgments are appropriate for the Netherlands. Minister Koenders answered that the committee's recommendations are non-binding, that the Dutch parliament is better placed to judge Dutch laws, and that the Optional Protocol ratification is still under consideration.
The Committee was established by ECOSOC with the aim of supervising compliance with the ICESCR by states parties.
Het Comité is door ECOSOC in het leven geroepen met als doel toezicht te houden op de naleving van het ESC-Verdrag door de staten die partij zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Kenia

MPs Taverne and Ten Broeke asked the minister whether she would hold a firm talk with the Dutch ambassador to Kenya over remarks in a ViceVersa interview and whether ambassadors should fear such talks when their observations diverge from ministerial policy. The minister confirmed the interview, said ambassadors are the ministry's eyes and ears and may publicly promote policy, and admitted that remarks deviating from Dutch policy prompted a conversation with the ambassador.
In the interview you cite, various remarks were made that deviate from the Dutch position. This was the reason for a conversation with the ambassador concerned.
In het door u aangehaalde interview zijn diverse opmerkingen gemaakt die afwijken van de Nederlandse inzet. Dit is aanleiding geweest voor een gesprek met de betreffende ambassadeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Azmani over het bericht dat de ‘persvrijheid is beknot bij azc-informatieavonden’

MPs Taverne and Azmani asked whether excluding journalists from municipal information meetings on asylum centres amounts to prior censorship under Article 7 of the Constitution. The minister answered that press freedom is a great good protected by law, that only specific reasons such as safety or limited space could justify excluding the press, and that municipalities must judge this, with the issue to be raised at the national asylum taskforce including the VNG.
Only specific reasons, such as safety or limited venue space, can be grounds for excluding the press or not admitting everyone.
Alleen specifieke redenen, zoals veiligheid of beperkte locatieruimte, kunnen aanleiding zijn de pers te weren of niet iedereen binnen te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de situatie in Burundi

MP Taverne (VVD) asked the minister about the newly announced Burundian rebel group FOREBU, its aims, the risk of ethnic conflict, AU troop deployment, Rwandan involvement and whether Dutch and EU aid to the Burundian government should end. The minister answered that FOREBU's size is unclear, the conflict is political rather than ethnic, Nederland has no evidence of Rwandan support, and aid to the Burundian government was already suspended, while keeping the door open to dialogue.
The cabinet has repeatedly conveyed this message and clearly signalled it by suspending aid to the Burundian government.
Het kabinet heeft deze boodschap herhaaldelijk uitgedragen en een duidelijk signaal afgegeven door de hulp aan de Burundese overheid op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over een test met internetstemmen bij het referendum over de associatieovereenkomst tussen de EU en Oekraïne

An MP asked whether the minister would test internet voting for Dutch citizens abroad at the Ukraine association agreement referendum, and whether he would accelerate the timeline. The minister answered that the government is making voting easier abroad, that internet voting is not yet suitable, and that a security-focused test will be held in late 2016 rather than alongside the referendum to avoid confusion.
That is why I have promised your House to organise a test to examine how reliable voting services are that are used (in other countries) for elections to representative bodies.

Daarom heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd een test te zullen organiseren om na te gaan hoe betrouwbaar stemdiensten zijn die (in andere landen) zijn of worden gebruikt voor verkiezingen van vertegenwoordigende organen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de werkwijze van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO)

An MP asked the minister whether the WHO's Ebola response exposed structural weaknesses and what Dutch funding and policy changes would follow. The minister agreed the WHO needs reform, described ongoing hervormingsstappen, and declined to cut Dutch voluntary contributions, while reporting the mandatory and voluntary funding figures.
The Netherlands currently sees no reason to further reduce its voluntary contribution given the WHO's important system function.
Nederland ziet nu geen aanleiding om de vrijwillige bijdrage verder te verminderen gezien de belangrijke systeemfunctie van de WHO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Van Bommel, Teeven en Taverne over het bericht dat zes Russische leden van de OVSE Parlementaire Assemblee vanwege de voor hen geldende EU-inreisverboden geen visum voor Finland h

MPs asked whether Finland's refusal of visas to six sanctioned Russian OSCE Parliamentary Assembly members, who were barred by EU travel bans, and the absence of a clear exemption for interparliamentary meetings was acceptable and whether the government would seek a formal exception. The minister answered that Finland only had to inform other member states, that the EU travel-ban rules contain only limited exceptions, and that the government values parliamentary dialogue in the OSCE but offered no commitment to seek a new formal exception.
The cabinet cannot comment on any reactions other member states may have given within the confidential Council framework.
Op (eventuele) reacties die overige lidstaten in vertrouwelijk Raadskader hebben gegeven, kan het kabinet niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over het bericht ‘Oxfam: Afrika verliest miljarden door belastingontwijking’

An MP asked whether Dutch aid helping Zimbabwe's government improve its tax system, including a 2014 tax-treaty training, is compatible with not supporting the Mugabe regime, and whether budget support should be ruled out. The minister replied that assistance is limited and technical, involves no financial transfers, that no general budget support is given, and that the EU will consider budget support only after the 2017 mid-term review if public financial management improves.
The cabinet no longer provides bilateral general budget support.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen bilaterale algemene begrotingssteun meer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over het rapport van Oxfam Novib over investeringen van de Wereldbank

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Oxfam Novib report alleging misuse of International Finance Corporation (IFC) investment funds and lack of public disclosure. The Minister acknowledged the report, said it contains little new information, promised to raise its recommendations with IFC, and rejected the idea of reconsidering Dutch contributions.
I will closely monitor the results of that dialogue.
Ik zal de resultaten van die dialoog nauwlettend in de gaten houden.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Taverne en Van Oosten over een nieuwe vorm van paspoort-fraude gepleegd door Oost-Europeanen

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a newly discovered form of passport fraud by Eastern Europeans, including its mechanics, scale, damage, when the government learned of the police report, and measures taken. The government referred to its separate letter on the report on legal identity changes in the Balkans and Eastern Europe, which is the answer to these questions.

The written questions from MPs Taverne and Van Oosten (both VVD), question number 2014Z19791, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the report legal identity changes in the Balkans and Eastern Europe'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen de leden Taverne en Van Oosten (beiden VVD), vraagnummer 2014Z19791 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het rapport «legale identiteitswisselingen in de Balkan en Oost-Europa»» (Kamerstuk 17 050, nr.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat de heffing op hardware ten behoeve van de thuiskopieervergoeding, die lange tijd alleen gold voor cd’s en dvd’s, ook op digitale audio- en vid

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the Supreme Court ruling that the private-copying levy on hardware should have covered digital audio and video players, exposing the State to millions in back compensation, and whether the implementing decree must be amended. The government declined to estimate damages because a damages procedure is pending, and said the decree will be amended following the Court of Justice ruling and talks on appropriate tariffs.
I therefore refrain from estimating the amount of damages the State must pay to Norma et al.
Ik onthoud mij daarom van het maken van een inschatting van de hoogte van de schadevergoeding die de Staat aan Norma c.s. moet betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over ‘spookstemmen’ en onregelmatigheden bij de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen 2014

An MP asked the Interior Minister about discrepancies in 235 municipalities between voter turnout and counted ballots in the 2014 municipal elections, and whether electronic voting should be reintroduced sooner. The minister confirmed the discrepancies, referred to earlier answers on the cause of the counting errors, and said no faster timeline than the cabinet's stated plan for electronic voting is possible.
I see no possibility to follow a different timeline than the one set out in the cabinet position
Ik zie geen mogelijkheid om een ander tijdpad te volgen dan is weergegeven in het kabinetsstandpunt

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de storing op de website van de gemeente Den Haag waardoor Nederlandse kiezers uit het buitenland zich niet konden registreren voor de verkiezingen van het Europees Parlement

MP Taverne asked the Minister of Interior about a website fault in The Hague that prevented Dutch voters abroad from registering online for the European Parliament elections, asking how long it lasted, how to prevent recurrence, and whether the registration deadline should be extended. The minister answered that the form was unusable for a short period, a PDF alternative was posted, monitoring was intensified, and no extension was deemed necessary.
The municipality of The Hague has intensified monitoring of the web form on its website so that any new fault can be detected and resolved more quickly.
De gemeente Den Haag heeft de monitoring van het webformulierde website geïntensiveerd om zo een eventuele nieuwe storing sneller te kunnen detecteren en op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Verheijen en Taverne over de dreigende deportatie van een journalist uit Turkije

Three VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister why Turkey threatens to deport NRC correspondent Vermeulen as a security risk, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister said the government does not know what the alleged security problem is, that the ministry has raised the case with Turkish authorities and pressed for his right to return and work, and that the government is concerned about press freedom in Turkey.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has raised attention with the Turkish authorities for Mr Vermeulen and urges that he be able to enter Turkey, where he lives, and carry out his work as a journalist there.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft bij de Turkse autoriteiten aandacht gevraagd voor de heer Vermeulen en dringt er op aan dat hij Turkije – waar hij woont – binnen kan komen en daar zijn werkzaamheden als journalist kan verrichten.
Antwoord vragen Rutte en Taverne over de doorkruising van Nederlands gezondheidsbeleid door internationaal recht

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Health whether the WHO tobacco convention, in particular Article 8(2), can be directly applicable and override national law following a Hague Court of Appeal ruling in the CAN case. The State Secretary answered that the convention is not directly applicable in that sense, that Article 8(2) leaves states wide discretion, and that the State will appeal to cassation.

The Dutch government is of the view that Article 8, paragraph 2, of the convention is not a provision binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution, by which existing national legislation can be set aside.

De Nederlandse regering is van mening dat artikel 8, tweede lid, van het verdrag geen eenieder verbindende bepaling is in de zin van artikel 93 en 94 van de Grondwet waarmee bestaande nationale wetgeving terzijde kan worden geschoven.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Heijnen en Taverne over problemen bij het stemmen in het buitenland

MPs Timmermans, Heijnen and Taverne asked whether Dutch citizens abroad calling the DUTCHHELP line were given incorrect information, including that they could vote online, and why election information was not on all Dutch missions' websites and at counters. The minister answered that no online voting was mentioned, only registration (which can partly be done online), that election links were provided on embassy and consulate sites, and that posts promoted registration and displayed the website at counters.
No. There is no mention of casting a vote via the internet; however, information is provided on how and where one can register.
Neen. Er wordt niet gesproken over het uitbrengen van de stem via internet; wel wordt informatie verstrekt over hoe en waar men zich kan registreren.
Antwoord vragen Taverne over kiesgerechtigde Nederlanders in het buitenland

An MP asked how many Dutch voters live abroad, how many voted in 2010, and how the government will promote turnout abroad for the 2012 elections, including briefstembureaus, ID rules and electronic registration. The minister answered that the number living abroad is unknown, gave 2010 turnout figures, and described outreach campaigns, a reduced list of 22 postal-vote offices, and the electronic registration option.
The cabinet considers it important that Dutch voters abroad can cast their vote and wishes to promote this as far as reasonably possible.
Het kabinet acht het van belang dat Nederlandse kiesgerechtigden in het buitenland hun stem kunnen uitbrengen en wil dat voor zover redelijkerwijs mogelijk bevorderen.
Antwoord vragen de leden Taverne, Hennis-Plasschaert, Van der Steur en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de wet zou wijken voor religieuze regels

Four VVD MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice whether a reported court ruling in The Hague, that religious obligations could take precedence over statutory duties such as showing identification, accurately reflects the judgment and whether it has been appealed. The minister confirmed the press report matches the oral ruling, that an appeal has been lodged, and referred the question of general principle to answers given to other MPs' questions.
The ruling itself provides no basis for those consequences.
Daarvoor biedt de uitspraak zelf geen grondslag.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert, Taverne en Van der Steur (allen VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbeslagname servers door Stichting Brein (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Stichting Brein seized servers without a court order, accessed private data, and invoked Article 28 of the Copyright Act, and whether this amounts to vigilantism. The state secretary answered that the servers were handed over by the provider under Article 28, that a court later allowed judicial custody and seizure, that the parties dispute the legality and access issues and must resolve them or go to court, and that existing remedies suffice.
In the first instance it is up to the parties to resolve this.
Het is in eerste instantie aan partijen om hier uit te komen.
Vragen van het lid Taverne (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een nieuw stemsysteem (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the voting and counting process needs improvement in speed and fraud resistance, whether the government will investigate a new voting system (including verbeterd papierstemmen) for the next elections, and whether the minister personally examined that system. The minister answered that counting errors cannot be ruled out, a new ballot model is needed and is under study including electronic counting options, but declined to personally examine the verbeterd papierstemmen system, referring to earlier answers.
As previously promised to the House, I will also include in the research the question of whether there are possibilities to reliably count a new paper ballot with electronic tools.
Zoals eerder aan de Kamer is toegezegd, betrek ik bij het onderzoek ook de vraag of er mogelijkheden zijn om een nieuw papieren stembiljet betrouwbaar met elektronische hulpmiddelen te tellen.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Taverne (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de positie van Apple in de leveringsovereenkomst tussen uitgevers en abonnees (ingezonden 18 januari 2

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether Apple's new demands on publishers' iPad subscriptions were undesirable and whether the competition authority NMa should investigate. The minister said the exact Apple plans and their consequences were still unclear, that no complaints had been filed, and that the NMa was monitoring developments without opening a formal investigation.
If there is abuse of power, the NMa can act against it.
Indien er sprake is van machtsmisbruik, kan de NMa hiertegen optreden.

m: Motie Snijder-Hazelhoff/Koopmans over digestaat als kunstmestvervanger
Asks the government to persuade the European Commission to approve digestate as a permanent fertiliser substitute from 2013.
requests the government to persuade the European Commission to approve mineral concentrates (digestate) as a fertiliser substitute

Motie Koopmans en Snijder-Hazelhoff over de inzet van PAS-middelen
Asks the government to prioritise PAS funds for nitrogen reduction measures in feed, housing and manure application, and to use remaining funds only for necessary restoration measures.
requests the government to prioritise PAS funds for nitrogen reduction measures
verzoekt de regering ter realisatie van stikstofreductie de PAS-middelen prioritair in te zetten voor stikstofreductiemaatregelen
Amendement van de leden Snijder-Hazelhoff en Koopmans dat dient als een extra impuls om jonge ondernemers na bedrijfsovername de mogelijkheid te bieden het bedrijf te kunnen blijven ontwikkelen
Shifts €2,500 thousand within the agriculture budget to fund an extra boost for young farmers after business takeover.
This amendment serves as an extra boost to give young entrepreneurs after a business takeover the opportunity to keep developing the business.
Dit amendement dient als een extra impuls om jonge ondernemers na bedrijfsovername de mogelijkheid te bieden het bedrijf te kunnen blijven ontwikkelen.
Motie Koopmans en Snijder-Hazelhoff over toelatingsprocedures
Motion asking the government to make the EU marketing authorisation procedure for medicines as simple and cheap as possible.
requests the government to make the admission procedure as simple and cheap as possible
verzoekt de regering de toelatingsprocedure zo eenvoudig en goedkoop mogelijk te maken

Onze Minister verleent, op grond van bij algemene maatregel van bestuur te stellen regels, op aanvraag, en voor een periode van niet meer dan vijf jaar, ontheffing van het bepaalde in de vorige volzin

Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven c.s ter vervanging van nr. 18 over het door middel van een door de minister te verlenen ontheffing toestaan van ritueel slachten zonder voorafgaande bedwelming, mi

Amendment letting the minister grant time-limited exemptions allowing ritual slaughter without prior stunning, conditional on independently verified proof that animal welfare is not harmed more than in regular slaughter, with rules set by AMvB and a consultation procedure.
The Minister grants, on the basis of rules to be set by general administrative order, upon application and for a period of no more than five years, an exemption from the preceding sentence

Onze Minister verleent, op grond van bij algemene maatregel van bestuur te stellen regels, op aanvraag, en voor een periode van niet meer dan vijf jaar, ontheffing van het bepaalde in de vorige volzin

Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven c.s. over het door middel van een door de minister te verlenen ontheffing toestaan van ritueel slachten zonder voorafgaande bedwelming, mits is aangetoond dat de s

Amends the Animal Slaughter rules to allow the minister, by exemption on application for up to five years, to permit ritual slaughter without prior stunning if animal welfare is not harmed more than in regular slaughter, with consultation rules for the implementing decree.
The minister grants, under rules to be set by general administrative order, on application and for up to five years, an exemption from the prohibition
Onze Minister verleent, op grond van bij algemene maatregel van bestuur te stellen regels, op aanvraag, en voor een periode van niet meer dan vijf jaar, ontheffing van het verbod
Amendement van de leden Koopmans en Snijder-Hazelhoff ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het regelen van inspraak van de Staten-Generaal met betrekking tot de inwerkingtreding van de wet

Makes the entry into force of the act subject to parliamentary input: the royal decree cannot be proposed until two weeks after the bill is submitted to both chambers, and if either chamber rejects it, no proposal follows and a new bill can only be submitted six weeks later.
The proposal for the royal decree referred to in the first paragraph is not made until two weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.
De voordracht voor het koninklijk besluit, bedoeld in het eerste lid, wordt niet eerder gedaan dan twee weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koopmans c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 40 over het niet afwijken van de Europese beoordelingsmethode

Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een betere grenscontrole op Afrikaanse varkenspest door de Europese Unie (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An MP asked whether the EU should actively support Eastern European border states bordering Russia with inspection and controls against African swine fever, and whether animal movements should be registered with unique farm numbers. The state secretary answered that the EU shares the concern, existing preventive measures are considered sufficient, further EU support is not deemed opportune, and all intra-EU animal movements are already registered in TRACES.

Given the support the Commission already provides to the border states and the cooperation already taking place with neighbouring countries, I do not consider it opportune to request more support at European level.

Gezien de ondersteuning die de Commissie al geeft aan de grensstaten en samenwerking die er al plaatsvindt met de buurlanden, vind ik het niet opportuun om hier in Europees verband meer ondersteuning voor te vragen.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aansluiting van kleine, lokale netwerken zonder veiligheidsrisico’s op het digitale Klic-systeem

MPs Ziengs and Snijder-Hazelhoff asked whether enforcement under the WION underground utilities law still hits small recreational businesses with no safety risk, whether fines can reach 100,000 euro, and whether these networks should be exempt from the digital KLIC system given the costs. The minister answered that only one recreational operator was registered, which then withdrew after contact; the 100,000 euro is the statutory maximum fine; some exemptions exist but not for third-party supply; and he will review proportionality in the upcoming WION evaluation, with no enforcement in the meantime.
I am therefore willing to look at the proportionality of the current WION relative to recreational businesses.
Ik ben daarom bereid te kijken naar de proportionaliteit van de huidige WION ten opzichte van de recreatieondernemers.
Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over bedreiging voor de veeteelt (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

An MP asked whether the state secretary agrees that opening the EU market to cheap Brazilian pork and poultry under Mercosur talks is dramatic for Dutch farms, and what steps will protect them. The government answered that no concessions are yet known, that the talks are ongoing, and that imports must meet EU veterinary standards while the Commission will assess the agricultural impact.
It is not yet known to what extent the current access restrictions for meat to the European market will be reduced in the context of the negotiations with the Mercosur countries.
Het is nog niet bekend in welke mate de huidige toegangsbeperkingen voor vlees tot de Europese markt verminderd zullen worden in het kader van de onderhandelingen met de Mercosurlanden.

Vragen van de leden Snijder-Hazelhoff en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het voorkomen van onnodige aansluiting van kleine, lokale netwerken zonder veiligheidsrisico'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether small local networks without safety risks, such as recreation businesses, should be exempted from mandatory connection to the Klic-online system given high digitisation costs. The minister answered that existing exemptions under the RION already cover such private networks, that a further exemption is unnecessary, and that the ministry will communicate with the RECRON sector association.
Yes, I agree with that. The Kadaster and the Agentschap Telecom are the organisations that have informed me of this.
Ja, daar ben ik het mee eens. Het Kadaster en het Agentschap Telecom zijn de organisaties die mij hierover hebben geïnformeerd.

Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het budget voor milieuvriendelijke maatregelen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asked how many applications for the environmental investment subsidy could be funded with 6.4 million euro, how many were received and their total value, and whether the scheme would be adjusted to fund all of them. The state secretary estimated 130 to 140 fundable applications, 3,153 received, over 151 million euro requested, and refused to raise the budget, saying the scheme's future will be reviewed under the coalition agreement.
A possible budget increase is not on the table, because no extra budget has been made available for POP-new challenges for 2010.
Een eventuele budgetophoging is niet aan de orde, omdat vanuit POP-nieuwe uitdagingen voor 2010 geen extra budget beschikbaar is gesteld.

Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het onrechtmatig verklaren van de publicatie van de subsidiegegevens van de Europese boeren (ingezonden

The MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how he assesses the EU Court of Justice ruling that publishing the subsidy data of European farmers is unlawful, what consequences it has for Dutch publication, and what steps he will take. The secretary answers that the Commission must assess implementation, that the ruling only cuts the publication of data for natural persons while data for legal entities stays online, and that he temporarily suspends internet publication of CAP and CFP subsidy data pending further study.
Pending that study and further developments at EU level, I am provisionally suspending the internet publication of the CAP and CFP subsidy data.
In afwachting van dat onderzoek en nadere ontwikkelingen op EU-niveau schors ik voorlopig de internetpublicatie van de GLB en GVB-subsidiegegevens.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Snijder-Hazelhoff (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over Europees landbouwgeld dat naar kernfusie gaat (ingezonden 23 septe

Two VVD MPs asked why unspent EU agricultural money would be redirected to the ITER fusion project, and whether this breaches earlier agreements. The minister answered that the Commission proposal uses a mix of sources, that the Netherlands opposes it as undermining budget discipline and will seek a solution within category 1A instead.
Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit inzake de perceelsregistratie (ingezonden 2 augustus 2010)

Rep. Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) asked the Minister of Agriculture about progress and timing of checks on the parcel registration and whether farmers' objections have been handled carefully. The Minister replied that about 27,700 farmers were invited to review their parcels, that only limited downward adjustments (231 ha by 621 farmers) have been made so far, that no completion date can yet be given, and that about 98% of the roughly 100 disputed cases were resolved via the LNV helpline, with farmers retaining objection and appeal rights against final decisions.
In only three cases will Dienst Regelingen ask the new VWA to carry out an on-site inspection.
In slechts drie gevallen zal de nieuwe VWA door Dienst Regelingen worden verzocht om een controle ter plekke uit te voeren.

Vragen van de leden Snijder-Hazelhoff en Neppérus (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Visserij en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

MPs Snijder-Hazelhoff and Neppérus ask the government to react to a Flemish minister's remark that deepening the Westerschelde needs no dike work, and whether the Hedwige polder de-poldering will proceed despite doubts and lack of support in Zeeland. The minister says no alternatives to de-poldering were found, the government will proceed with compensating farmers, and sees no reason for further action.
The cabinet had extensive and exhaustive research carried out into alternatives to de-poldering the Hedwige polder and could find none that meets the set requirements.
Het kabinet heeft uitgebreid en uitputtend onderzoek laten doen naar alternatieven voor de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder en heeft er geen kunnen vinden die voldoet aan de gestelde eisen.

Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Q-koorts en melkschapenbedrijven (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

An MP asked whether the names of goat dairy farms that had not yet vaccinated against Q-fever could be released, and when all dairy goat farms would be vaccinated. The minister refused to release the names, citing the Dutch freedom of information and data protection acts, and estimated that the vaccination campaign on dairy farms would be completed by mid-July, with enforcement orders issued to non-compliant farms.
No, on the basis of the Freedom of Information Act and the Personal Data Protection Act it is not possible to release the names of these dairy goat farms.
Nee, op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens is het niet mogelijk om de namen van deze melkgeitenbedrijven vrij te geven.
Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over pluimveebedrijven die op slot zitten door besmet biologisch veevoer (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

An MP asked the minister how dioxin contamination in Ukrainian organic maize reached poultry farms before detection, what import and Ukrainian inspection procedures apply, the cause of the contamination, where the 2500 tonnes went, and why organic feed is imported from Ukraine. The minister answered that Ukrainian authorities did not test for dioxin, that the Dutch VWA's risk-based sampling missed the batch and a private lab's false-negative result, that the VWA and RIKILT are investigating, that the batch was traced, and that domestic feed production is insufficient.
The VWA, in cooperation with RIKILT, has started an investigation into this.
De VWA is, in samenwerking met het RIKILT, hiernaar een onderzoek gestart.

qa: Antwoord op vragen de leden Laçin, Paterenotte, Kröger, Van Brenk, Öztürk en Gijs van Dijk over de openstelling van de coronateststraat op Schiphol voor werknemers

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks, 50PLUS, DENK and PvdA asked why Schiphol workers who develop symptoms cannot be tested at the airport's test facility, whether the government will talk with the GGD and Schiphol, and how often the labour inspectorate checks Covid measures at Schiphol. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the Covid situation, so the substance is not answered in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter <Status of COVID-19> (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 1422).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken COVID-19> (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1422 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht 'NS schrapt 341 banen; station zonder personeel wordt de norm'

SP MPs asked the government about news that NS would cut 341 station staff jobs, questioning whether this conflicts with its stated view that staff are essential and whether volunteers or temporary agency workers are displacing paid work. The minister and state secretary answered that NS decides its own staffing, cites falling counter sales and online ticketing, says safety is covered by camera monitoring and concession obligations, and commits only to help affected staff find other work within NS.
It is up to NS to determine where NS can deploy its personnel most effectively, taking into account the changing needs of travellers.
Het is aan NS om te bepalen waar NS haar personeel het meest effectief kan inzetten, waarbij NS rekening houdt met de veranderende behoefte van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the ministers whether the government would honour the House's controversial declaration on Lelystad Airport and refrain from irreversible steps, including continuing the permit procedure, given the statutory decision deadline. Minister Schouten answered that the permit is a legally required individual procedure separate from political decision-making, that the deadline is an order term but binding and cannot be suspended, and that she will not pause the procedure.
A controversial declaration by the House of Representatives does not constitute grounds for me to invoke force majeure in the case of this permit application.
Een controversieel-verklaring door de Tweede Kamer vormt geen grond om mij te mogen beroepen op overmacht in het geval van deze vergunningaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Laçin en Van Kent over het vrijkomen van kankerverwekkend chroom-6 bij werkzaamheden aan de Onyxkolencentrale

MPs asked whether chromium-6 released during maintenance at the Onyx coal plant exposed workers, whether independent investigation and compensation are in place, and whether the plant closes on 1 January 2021 and how much subsidy goes to workers. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found no proven exposure but could not exclude it, ordered dust clean-up and tighter controls, said closure timing depends on subsidy conditions, and noted that employer liability and a planned hardship scheme for occupational disease are being developed.
That is not known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger, Moorlag, Schonis en Van Esch over het vervangen van de Paddepoelsterbrug en de aangenomen motie-Laçin c.s. (Kamerstuk 35570-A, nr. 30)

MPs asked the minister about the replacement of the Paddepoelsterbrug in Groningen, including whether agreements for a low movable bridge still stand after a 2021 motion. The minister said talks with residents and stakeholders continue, that a 2020 MIRT agreement provides for a fixed bridge at 9.10 metres with ramps and a €8.6 million federal contribution, and that the agreement is on hold pending the motion, while defending the drawbacks of a low bridge.
After concluding an administrative agreement, I will transfer the financial resources and implementation by the municipality of Groningen can begin.
Na het sluiten van een bestuursovereenkomst zal ik de financiële middelen overdragen en kan de uitvoering door de gemeente Groningen beginnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Esch over het bericht 'Bewoners op achterstand gezet in strijd tegen verbreding A27: ‘Hoort niet zo in een democratie’

MPs asked whether the A27/A12 Utrecht route decision was taken without updated traffic and nitrogen analyses, without the Commission for EIA's full review, and whether the Crisis- and Recovery Act's limits on local government appeals are compatible with democracy. The minister declined to discuss the substance because an appeal is pending, defended the procedure and the Act's restriction on decentralised appeals, and pointed to the publicly available reports.
Because the appeal procedure is still ongoing, I cannot go into the substance of the decision towards your House.
Omdat de beroepsprocedure nog loopt, kan ik richting uw Kamer niet op de inhoud van het besluit ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht “Milieuramp in de Berkel: Friesland Campina vervuilde, het Waterschap betaalde”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the 2018 contamination of the Berkel by Friesland Campina, which was partly paid for by Waterschap Rijn en IJssel, including the cost split, secrecy, liability, and environmental impact. The minister confirmed the facts, defended the waterschap's autonomous cost decision and the absence of liability findings, noted that the public prosecutor saw no grounds for prosecution, and reported that the ecosystem has recovered.
The water board has the autonomous authority to weigh the cost allocation itself.
Het waterschap heeft de autonome bevoegdheid om zelf een afweging te maken over de kostenverdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Houtkachels, blijken na opnieuw rekenen, grootste bron van fijnstofuitstoot’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that wood-burning stoves are now the largest source of fine particulate emissions, and why condensable particulates were previously excluded, what measures and timelines apply to smoke-free neighbourhoods and enforcement, whether a stove ban during RIVM smoke alerts is warranted, and how manufacturer standards could be tightened. The State Secretary explained the new reporting method, outlined the Clean Air Agreement pilots, a pending enforcement study and an alert-based approach, and noted tighter EU Ecodesign emission standards from 2022.
Therefore, following the TNO study, about which I informed you in June 2020 with a letter to the House, I commissioned a follow-up study.
Daarom heb ik naar aanleiding van het onderzoek door TNO, waarover ik u in juni 2020 heb geïnformeerd met een kamerbrief 5 , opdracht gegeven voor een vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Hijink over het bericht ‘KLM to resume SA flights to Amsterdam’

Two MPs asked whether KLM was resuming flights from South Africa to Amsterdam despite the travel ban and whether the government would act against it. The minister said airlines decide commercially, KLM screens passengers for exemptions, six passenger flights ran in late February, and airlines must check travellers' test results, with regional safety authorities checking on arrival.
It is up to the airlines themselves to assess whether flights to destinations under a flight ban are commercially attractive based on the estimated number of exempt cases.

Het is aan de luchtvaartmaatschappijen zelf om te beoordelen of vluchten naar bestemmingen waarvoor een vliegverbod geldt, commercieel interessant zijn op basis van het geschatte aantal uitzonderingsgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de FNV met stakingen dreigt op Schiphol

MPs Laçin (SP) asked the ministers whether they would respond to FNV threats of strikes at Schiphol, the number of ground handlers, wage competition, living wages and the motion on social establishment requirements. The minister answered that strikes are a legal right, that a study into social establishment requirements and handler numbers is underway with results expected in spring, and that wages and contracts are primarily the responsibility of companies and collective bargaining partners.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the study.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over blootstelling van werknemers aan vervuilde en schadelijke lucht op luchthaven Schiphol

Two MPs (Lacin and Van Kent, SP) asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Social Affairs about workers' exposure to jet exhaust and ultrafine particles at Schiphol, including use of Copenhagen-style push-back, single-engine taxiing, an inspectorate review, and worker involvement in the measurement programme. The ministers answered that employers are responsible for protective measures, that TNO's measurement programme was delayed by Covid-19 and will start in Q2 2021 with a worker sounding board, and that they decline to adopt the Danish approach or to ask the Inspectorate to investigate now.

The measurement programme that TNO, in consultation with RIVM, formulated on the basis of scientific insights and considerations, will be presented and discussed in this sounding board before the measurements are carried out.

Het meetprogramma dat TNO in overleg met het RIVM op basis van wetenschappelijke inzichten en afwegingen heeft geformuleerd, wordt vóór de metingen uitgevoerd in deze klankbordgroep gepresenteerd en besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht dat Maersk 24 Nederlandse werknemers op straat zet

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked ministers about Maersk removing 24 Dutch seafarers' ships from the Dutch flag and whether the company was replacing them with cheaper foreign workers. The minister regrets the reflagging but says it is an internal company matter, that the flag state governs crew conditions, and that social dumping through flag choice would be regarded as undesirable, while declining to comment on the union agreement or intervene with Maersk.
Since this concerns individual company policy, it is not for me to form a judgement on this choice.
Aangezien het hier om individueel bedrijfsbeleid gaat, is het niet aan mij om een oordeel over deze keuze te vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Laçin over het feit dat duizenden chauffeurs op dit moment stranden bij de grenzen van Duitsland, Tsjechië en Oostenrijk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about thousands of truck drivers stranded at the German, Czech and Austrian borders due to COVID-19 travel restrictions, and what was being done to resolve it and prevent recurrence. The minister answered that the government is concerned, is pursuing EU-level 'green lanes' for freight, has contacts with the sector and neighbouring governments, and that the number of stranded Dutch drivers is hard to estimate, pointing stranded Dutch nationals to the foreign ministry's consular help.
The cabinet was surprised by the decision on border restrictions from Germany, Slovakia, Czechia and Austria and finds the inconvenience truck drivers experience very unpleasant.

Het kabinet is verrast door het besluit over de beperkingen aan de grenzen van Duitsland, Slowakije, Tsjechië en Oostenrijk en vindt de hinder die vrachtwagenchauffeurs daardoor ondervinden bijzonder vervelend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk, Stoffer en Gijs van Dijk over reisbeperkingen

MPs from several parties asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Justice ministers about travel restrictions on non-essential trips, including how Finland and Belgium's border measures fit EU law, whether Dutch legal frameworks allow similar restrictions, and whether the OMT should be asked for advice. The government answered that it considers a ban on non-essential travel disproportionate, legally vulnerable and hard to enforce, has already adopted other measures, and that the OMT judged additional flight bans unnecessary, providing a country overview in an annex.
The cabinet therefore considers it currently not proportionate, legally vulnerable and difficult to enforce to prohibit non-essential travel.
Het kabinet acht het derhalve op dit moment niet proportioneel, juridisch kwetsbaar en moeilijk uitvoerbaar om niet-noodzakelijke reizen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over onderzoeken naar het veilig houden van asbestdakensanering

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked about the safety of the asbestos roof removal acceleration, the Arcadis exposure report, the TNO-based certification exemption and the Productenbesluit asbest. The government answered that certification for asbestos roofs is now proposed in the Arboregeling consultation, that the report was delivered on 1 February 2021 after delay, and that a revised Productenbesluit asbest is in preparation for 2022.

It is now known that the amendment to the Arboregeling put to internet consultation by the Minister of SZW proposes to include asbestos roofs among the asbestos applications subject to the certification requirement.

Inmiddels is bekend dat in de wijziging van de Arboregeling zoals door de Minister van SZW in internetconsultatie is gebracht, is voorgesteld de asbestdaken op te nemen bij de asbesttoepassingen waarvoor de certificatieplicht zal gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Laçin, Van Raan en Stoffer over de stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport

MPs asked whether the 2014 nitrogen calculations for Lelystad Airport were wrong, why a high heat content was used, and whether the 2015 airport decision and 2019 PAS notification should be voided. The minister acknowledges calculation errors, says the PAS notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under a verification procedure, and promises to share the project-specific assessment later.
As reported in the letter to parliament of 3 December, I will share the project-specific assessment with the House once it is completed.
Antwoord 3 Zoals gemeld in de Kamerbrief van 3 december 5 zal ik de project specifieke beoordeling met de Kamer delen zodra deze is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Kröger over het bericht ‘Asbest gevonden in make-up van Douglas en Hema’

MPs Laçin and Kröger asked whether the minister would act after asbestos was found in make-up sold by Douglas and Hema, and whether a broad investigation into talc use in cosmetics would be launched. The minister called asbestos in cosmetics unacceptable, said the NVWA is checking whether further investigation or enforcement is needed, but declined a broad new investigation, citing a 2018 study that found asbestos in only 2 of nearly 300 samples.
The NVWA supervises compliance with the legislation and enforces where necessary.
De NVWA houdt toezicht op de naleving van de wetgeving en treedt zo nodig handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over vrachtwagenchauffeurs die hun cabine niet meer uitkomen

SP MPs asked whether truck drivers confined to their cabins during COVID measures lack humane conditions, such as access to toilets and showers, and what structural fix the government will provide. The State Secretary answered that employers must cover rest facilities, that the government relies on calls to petrol stations and rest areas to keep sanitary facilities open, and that talks with the sector are ongoing, without committing to a structural solution.
In addition, the Ministry of IenW keeps a close watch on industry organisations, so that any signals about the availability of sanitary facilities for drivers can be picked up in time.
Daarnaast houdt het Ministerie van IenW de vinger aan de pols bij brancheorganisaties, om eventuele signalen over de beschikbaarheid van sanitair voor chauffeurs tijdig op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Laçin over onvoldoende mogelijkheden voor de politie om verkeershufters aan te pakken

MPs Van Nispen and Laçin asked how police could better catch extreme-speed drivers who post their offences online, including more trajectory controls, a speed limiter, platform takedowns and wider investigative powers. The minister said enforcement has been stepped up and trajectory controls are being installed on N-roads, but admitted investigation from video alone is hard and said that making Article 5a Wvw a provisional-detention offence is being prepared in a draft omnibus bill.
I expect the bill can be submitted to the Council of State for advice early next year.
Ik verwacht dat het wetsvoorstel naar verwachting begin volgend jaar ter advisering aan de Raad van State kan worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Laçin over de toekomst van Groningen Airport Eelde

MPs Van Raan and Laçin asked whether the Minister knows of Groningen Airport Eelde's weak traffic and financial position and whether the state will provide six to eight million euro per year, and about closure procedures. The Minister said the government sees airports as independent enterprises, structural state contributions do not fit aviation policy, no formal request was received, and shareholders must first decide on the airport's future; closure would require changes to regulations and the Aviation Act.
The cabinet sees airports as independent enterprises that are themselves responsible for financing their activities.
Het kabinet ziet luchthavens als zelfstandige ondernemingen die zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor de bekostiging van hun activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat op een bedrijventerrein in Doetinchem zo’n 1300 containers brandblusschuim met het ZSS PFAS staan opgeslagen in lekkende containers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports of about 1,300 containers of PFAS-containing firefighting foam leaking at a Doetinchem industrial estate, and about enforcement, PFAS levels, rules on processing such foam, and similar cases. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is the competent authority and is enforcing against the company, that the rules are adequate, that the national PFAS-foam stream is poorly tracked, and that the VTH system and the municipality's own investigation will be reviewed.
The competent authority in this matter is the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Doetinchem.
Het bevoegde gezag in deze is het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Doetinchem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Brenk en Laçin over de piek in legionellabesmettingen

MPs Van Brenk and Laçin asked the minister about a July 2020 peak in Legionella infections, whether the RIVM's weather explanation was sound, and whether the government would fund research, campaigns and clinician awareness. The minister answered that the peak is linked to weather conditions, that no common source cluster was found, and that existing prevention and testing guidance is adequate, while committing to continued monitoring and expanded source-tracing.
There are no indications that Legionella infections are being overlooked more often at this time.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat legionellabesmettingen in deze tijd vaker over het hoofd worden gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Laçin over de staatssteun aan KLM

MPs Alkaya and Laçin asked the Finance Minister whether the state will expand its influence in Air France-KLM as motioned, whether a capital injection is planned, and whether KLM may make lower-paid staff pay for the restructuring. The minister answered that state guarantees and a state agent give the state more influence, that a capital injection is not ruled out but cannot be discussed further for listed-company reasons, and that employment terms are part of the support conditions under assessment.
Because Air France-KLM is a listed company, I cannot share anything further on this at this moment.
Omdat Air France – KLM een beursgenoteerde onderneming betreft, kan ik hier op dit moment verder niets over delen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Onnodig veel gevaarlijke stoffen in rivieren: lozingsvergunningen flink verouderd’

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that hazardous substances such as benzene, lead and vinyl chloride still enter rivers under outdated discharge permits, asking about drinking water effects, how many permits are outdated, BBT compliance, monitoring, and Rijkswaterstaat's capacity and priorities. The minister answered that the three substances did not exceed EU water norms in 2017-2019, that about three quarters of roughly 800 permits need adjustment, that a multi-year structural approach with periodic review every 4 to 8 years will be implemented, and that the advisory report is attached.
In about 50% of the permits reviewed in the pilot, there were discharges of ZZS.
Bij circa 50% van de vergunningen die in de pilot zijn bezien, was er sprake van lozingen van ZZS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Gerven over de financiële consequenties van het Besluit activiteiten leefomgeving en het Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving voor waterspeeltuinen

MPs Laçin and Van Gerven asked whether the Omgevingswet and its AMvB's (Bkl and Bal) would impose disproportionate financial burdens on volunteer-run water playgrounds, and whether the government would investigate and remedy any such effects. The minister confirmed the rules apply, placed monitoring and safety duties on the operator, said costs are not expected to be disproportionate, and declined to commission a study, saying it will monitor implementation and discuss with the sector if problems arise.
I of course monitor the implementation of the new rules and my ministry is in contact with organisations in the field about it.
Ik volg de uitvoering van de nieuwe regels uiteraard en mijn ministerie heeft daarover ook contact met organisaties in het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het grotere aantal mensen met longkanker of borst- en buikvlieskanker in Beverwijk, Heemskerk en Haarlem

Dutch MP Laçin (SP) asked the state secretary about the higher incidence of lung cancer and mesothelioma in IJmond towns and Haarlem, and about the role of industry, Tata Steel, permits, monitoring and further research. The state secretary replied that the GGD study does not link causes to industry, that the provincial and municipal authorities are responsible for permits and enforcement, and that further research is planned by the province and RIVM, while declining to investigate the drafting of the report further.
Are you willing, in consultation with the GGDs and provinces, to make a substantial start toward obtaining this insight?
Bent u bereid om, met betrekking tot het verkrijgen van dit inzicht en in overleg met GGD’s en provincies, hiertoe een substantiële aanzet te geven?

Antwoord op vragen van de van de leden Kröger, Laçin, van Raan, Gijs van Dijk van Brenk over reizigers die vanuit Nederland met het vliegtuig naar gebieden vertrekken waarvoor een oranje reisadvies geldt

MPs asked how many travellers fly from the Netherlands to orange-advice destinations, how many are non-essential, and whether low fares undermine the advice. The minister reported about 39,928 non-transfer passengers from Schiphol in one week, said travel purpose is not recorded, and wrote to airlines and travel associations urging them not to promote such trips.
Under privacy regulations, transport companies do not record the intention or purpose of the traveller's journey.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving registreren vervoersbedrijven niet de intentie dan wel het doel van de reis van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de buurtbussen die niet rijden

An MP asked why community buses (buurtbussen) remain suspended during COVID-19 while other public transport runs, what measures and timeline would restore them, and what alternatives affected passengers have. The state secretary replied that buurtbus operators stopped in March over infection risk to older drivers, that TNO is assessing ventilation and protective options with results expected in October, and that regional authorities have found alternatives in most provinces.
I have asked the decentralised authorities to look carefully and creatively at the places where no alternative is yet available.
Ik heb de decentrale overheden gevraagd goed en creatief te kijken naar de plekken waar nog geen alternatief beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de mogelijke ontslaggolf in het openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a possible wave of layoffs and service cuts in public transport, including whether companies may reduce routes and frequencies, and whether operators should disclose their financial figures before receiving further support. The State Secretary answered that talks with operators and regional authorities are ongoing, that a availability fee covers part of 2020 costs, and that operator financial data is confidential, while stating that the crisis is no reason to change the functioning system.
However, this concerns company-confidential data that transport operators are not required to make public.
Het gaat hierbij echter om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke gegevens, die vervoerders niet openbaar hoeven te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat Qbuzz gaat inkrimpen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about Qbuzz shrinking due to the coronavirus crisis, including job cuts despite emergency support, the effect of the 'only necessary travel' campaign, whether commercial transport firms can unilaterally cut services, transparency of profits and cross-border cash flows, and whether this shows commercial public transport has failed. The State Secretary said concessions are managed by provinces and transport regions, the sector is being consulted in the NOVB, financial data is confidential, and the crisis is no reason to change a well-functioning system.
However, this concerns company-confidential data, which transport operators do not have to make public.
Het gaat hierbij echter om bedrijfsvertrouwelijke gegevens, die vervoerders niet openbaar hoeven te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over asbest in drinkwater

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about asbestos in drinking water: the share of asbestos-cement pipes, monitoring, a legal limit, health risks from ingestion and vapour, and whether asbestos victim numbers are underestimated. The minister answered that about 23% of the network is asbestos-cement, that monitoring is voluntary industry sampling with a second round due in 2021, that no legal limit is needed given very low concentrations, and that RIVM and the Health Council will be asked whether to update victim estimates.
RIVM will continue to follow future research.
Het RIVM zal het toekomstig onderzoek blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat plastic afval nauwelijks gerecycled wordt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether recycled plastic has few buyers and is piling up, and whether national mandatory recyclate content should be introduced. The State Secretary confirmed falling demand and prices, described roundtable and standard-setting efforts, but said a binding recyclate requirement should be set at EU level and would only press the Commission to act within a year.
I want to look together with all relevant parties at what can be done.
Ik wil samen met alle betrokken partijen kijken wat er gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat vliegtuigpassagiers van bron- en contactonderzoek worden uitgezonderd

An MP asked why air passengers were exempted from source and contact tracing for COVID-19 and whether this left a gap in controlling the virus. The minister answered that the exemption was based on RIVM advice, reduced air traffic by about 95%, and would end as traffic recovers, with contact tracing for all positive cases including passengers from 1 June 2020.
The current exception will be lifted because air passenger traffic is expected to increase again in the coming period.
De huidige uitzondering komt te vervallen omdat het personenluchtverkeer in de komende periode weer zal gaan toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Alkaya over de berichtgeving dat KLM-piloten aan belastingontwijking doen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether they would stop KLM pilots living abroad (reportedly Spain) from avoiding Dutch income tax, given state aid to KLM, and asked for data on how many such pilots there are and the revenue lost. The minister said he would raise the matter with KLM, that the data is not systematically available, and that state support will come with conditions on pay and bonuses, with details still to follow.
Conditions will be set, among other things, on working conditions and bonuses.
Er zullen o.a. voorwaarden worden gesteld op het gebied van arbeidsvoorwaarden en bonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de stikstofberekeningen inzake Lelystad Airport

Three MPs (Van Raan, Kröger, Laçin) asked 28 questions about stikstof (nitrogen) calculations for Lelystad Airport, including why new calculations were commissioned after the Council of State ruling against the PAS, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the MER 2018 was complete. The minister answered that the new work follows the PAS annulment, that the Chamber was informed in September 2019 and February 2020, that results are not yet final, and that the Commission for the MER and RIVM advice was obtained, while declining to share the commissioning assignments citing commercial confidentiality.
It is not customary to share commissioning assignments with the House of Representatives because of their commercially confidential nature.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om opdrachtverstrekkingen te delen met de Tweede Kamer vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijk karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het niet naleven van coronavoorschriften op vliegveld Eindhoven

Two SP MPs asked whether Eindhoven Airport charter flights carrying Eastern European workers were ignoring corona rules, whether this was an economic offence, and why the flights were not halted. The minister answered that the flights cannot be refused under EU free movement, that the airline and airport have taken measures such as multilingual information and extra staff, and that no economic offence applies.
There are no restrictions on air traffic from European member states, and therefore the flights to Eindhoven are not refused.
Er zijn geen beperkingen voor het vliegverkeer vanuit Europese lidstaten en daardoor worden de vluchten naar Eindhoven niet geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over het bericht ‘Natuurmonumenten voert betaald parkeren in’

MPs Futselaar and Laçin asked ministers whether they would intervene in or discuss with Natuurmonumenten its plan to introduce paid parking at its nature reserves, and whether it would reduce access or cause spillover parking and affect its financial health. The minister replied that the government has no view on the parking charge, that Natuurmonumenten sets its own parking policy, that no contact or talks are planned, and declined to assess the organisation's finances.
It is not for the cabinet to pass judgement on the financial management of the Natuurmonumenten association.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel uit te spreken over de financiële huishouding van de vereniging Natuurmonumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht 'Afhandelaars Schiphol eisen steunpakket van 25,5 miljoen euro'

Two SP MPs asked why five ground-handling companies at Schiphol, facing 3,000 possible layoffs, were not helped by the NOW wage subsidy, and whether the government would investigate market structure and wages in ground handling. The minister said NOW conditions prohibit layoffs for economic reasons, that losses may be too small and January payroll is used as reference, and declined a separate study of ground handling, citing the ongoing EU review of Directive 96/67.
Question 5: Are you willing to investigate the organisation of ground handling at Schiphol?
Vraag 5 Bent u bereid om onderzoek te doen naar de inrichting van grondafhandeling op Schiphol
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over opnieuw twee blazers bij ESD in Farmsum in Groningen

An SP MP asked the minister about repeated SiC-fibre emissions ('blazers') from chemical plant ESD-SIC in Farmsum, including what the province can do and health advice for residents. The state secretary answered that the province is the competent authority, has imposed a penalty order and a maintenance measure, that 2019 saw 52 blazers, and that monitoring and health advice are ongoing, without committing to closure.
The province therefore enforces and has imposed an order under penalty.
De provincie treedt daarom handhavend op en heeft een last onder dwangsom opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de werkzaamheden bij het CBR en de medische keuringen tijdens het coronavirus

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the coronavirus affects CBR driving-licence medical assessments and renewals for vital-occupation drivers, and what is being done about delays. The minister confirmed the delays, pointed to a temporary grace arrangement allowing expired licences to be used until 1 June, and said longer-term alternatives such as an emergency decree and EU consultation are being explored, though the answers largely restate measures without firm dates.
That is why a grace arrangement is now in force as described in the answer to question 2.
Daarom is nu een coulanceregeling van kracht zoals beschreven in het antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Taxibedrijven kunnen fluiten naar 4.000 euro tegemoetkoming’

An SP MP asked the ministers about the COVID-19 impact on the taxi sector, including whether a ban on taxi travel should apply, payment of school and medical transport, support for self-employed drivers, and protective equipment. The State Secretary answered most questions in substance, referring some to municipalities and health insurers, and said the answer to question 11 could not be given by the 7 April deadline.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat vrachtwagenchauffeurs nergens meer van voorzieningen gebruik kunnen maken
