An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that truck drivers could no longer use toilets and washing facilities during the COVID-19 period, and whether service stations, distribution centres and roadside restaurants would be asked to open them. The minister said he had repeatedly called on businesses to keep facilities available, noted that some still refused drivers, pointed to EU Green Lanes guidance, and said talks with sector parties were ongoing without committing to a specific new measure.
I have called on various platforms to keep these available to drivers and will continue to do so.
Ik heb op verschillende fora opgeroepen deze beschikbaar te blijven stellen aan chauffeurs en zal dat ook blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat een schippersechtpaar op de intensive care is beland na vergiftiging door lading

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a Dutch skipper couple hospitalised after exposure to fumigant gas from their cargo, asking about incident frequency, victim compensation, liability, port procedures, odour warnings and international bans on phosphine. The minister answered that the investigation is with the Public Prosecution Service, that compensation is a civil court matter, that port notification and procedure changes will be discussed in the Rijkshavenmeesteroverleg, and that no odour additive or international ban will be pursued.
At the time of writing, investigation into the accident is still being carried out by the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Op het moment van dit schrijven wordt nog steeds onderzoek gedaan naar het ongeval door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over het bericht dat Shell een enorme plasticfabriek in de VS laat bouwen

Two SP MPs asked the government about Shell's plan to build a large plastics plant in the US, its environmental and CO2 impact, and how it fits with the Plastic Pact and climate goals. The state secretary answered that investment decisions are Shell's responsibility, that Shell has not yet stated environmental or CO2 impacts, and that the government will promote recycling, pricing measures and EU-level rules, while agreeing to talk with Shell.
The investment decisions that Shell makes in the US are the responsibility of Shell.
De investeringsbeslissingen die Shell in de VS neemt, zijn de verantwoordelijkheid van Shell.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘FNV: ‘Luxe Schiphol-lounge met buffet nog open‘’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why a Schiphol airport lounge was still open and serving buffet food after restaurants were closed, who is responsible for it, and what protections exist for workers with fever. The government answered that the local safety region enforced the closure of buffets, that lounge operators (not Schiphol) are responsible for their activities, and it listed worker protection measures and a moral appeal to employers.
On 19 March the Kennemerland safety region received signals that a buffet was still being offered in lounges at Schiphol.
Bij de veiligheidsregio Kennemerland zijn op 19 maart jl. signalen binnengekomen dat er in lounges op Schiphol nog een buffet werd aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht “Hoe moeten verplegers nu naar hun werk?’’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how public transport can keep essential workers moving during the COVID-19 crisis, questioning reduced timetables by operators Keolis and others, the need for profit to yield to essential-worker transport, and whether bus drivers who report misconduct can be dismissed. The minister replies that regional authorities decide service levels with operators, that a weekend timetable was adopted to match demand and absenteeism, that the government consults operators weekly on the sector, and that employees may criticize business management without fearing dismissal unless it harms the employer.
The decentralised authorities, which are responsible for regional public transport, are best placed to determine which transport offer suits the region, including under current crisis conditions.

De decentrale overheden, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het regionale openbaar vervoer, kunnen het beste bepalen welk vervoeraanbod passend is voor de regio, ook onder de huidige crisisomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat platformmedewerkers op Schiphol geen longonderzoek krijgen

An SP MP asks the Minister whether platform workers at Schiphol can be included in the RIVM study of ultrafine particle health risks and whether a separate health study for them is possible. The Minister replies that existing registries cannot isolate these workers, that a separate study is being discussed with the RIVM with a Parliament update promised in Q3 2020, and that Schiphol will carry out measurements.
That is why I am consulting with the RIVM to examine whether a separate health study for platform workers can be set up.
Daarom ben ik in overleg met het RIVM om te bezien of een apart gezondheidsonderzoek voor platformmedewerkers kan worden opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Reisorganisaties annuleren vakanties voor deze maand: geen reizen bij Corendon, Sunweb Group, TUI en Prijsvrij’

An SP MP asked whether travellers whose package holidays were cancelled due to the coronavirus are entitled to a refund under the Civil Code, and whether travel organisers issuing vouchers instead comply with the law. The Staatssecretaris confirmed the refund right but encouraged acceptance of vouchers given exceptional circumstances, noting ANVR promises of some direct refunds and that the ACM monitors and will intervene if consumer rights are insufficiently respected.
The ACM will not hesitate to intervene if consumer rights are insufficiently respected.
De ACM zal niet aarzelen om in te grijpen als de rechten van consumenten onvoldoende worden gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de gevolgen van de nieuwe coronamaatregelen voor rijschoolhouders en rij-instructeurs

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the effects of new COVID-19 measures on driving schools, including the reported closure of most schools and the sector's survival prospects. The minister confirmed a ban on driving lessons for all vehicle types from 25 March to 28 April 2020, pointed to existing financial support schemes, and said the conditions of one scheme were under review.
From 25 March 2020 a ban on driving instruction applies to all types of vehicles.
Met ingang van 25 maart 2020 geldt een rijinstructieverbod voor alle typen voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de vergunning voor het storten van granuliet in het gebied ‘Over de Maas’ is uitgebreid

An SP MP asked whether the permit for dumping granulite at 'Over de Maas' was expanded from 250,000 to 750,000 tonnes, how it was decided, why it proceeds before parliamentary debate, and what will be done about residents' anger. The minister replied that the Soil Quality Decree works with notifications rather than permits, so no objectionable decision exists; Rijkswaterstaat found the material compliant, and she will commission a review of granulite's environmental quality and take extra sampling.
There is no decision within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act against which objection can be lodged directly.
Er is geen sprake van een besluit in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht, waartegen rechtstreeks bezwaar kan worden aangetekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Brenk over granuliet

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Brenk asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the classification of granuliet as soil and the use of granuliet with flocculant (polyacrylamide) in the Over de Maas project, including ecological and environmental risks. The minister answers that granuliet has been classed as soil since 2009 under the Soil Quality Decree, that tests show no harmful effects, and that an independent review will be carried out with the municipality and province.

To remove this concern, I will, in consultation with the municipality and province, have an independent study carried out into the consequences for people and the environment of using granuliet in the Over de Maas project.

Om deze ongerustheid weg te nemen zal ik, in overleg met de gemeente en provincie, een onafhankelijk onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de gevolgen voor mens en milieu van het gebruik van granuliet in het project Over de Maas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over brandgevaar in parkeergarages en onder woningen

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked ministers about fire risks from charging electric vehicles in underground car parks and under homes, and the government replied that NEN is drafting a new fire-safety standard for car parks (expected 2021), that no electric car or charger is known to have caused a car park fire in the Netherlands, and that it will update guidance and consider further measures without committing to specific Building Decree changes now. Several questions (sprinklers, mandatory fire detectors, charger placement) were deferred to the pending NEN standard.
The Dutch Normalisation Institute (NEN), at my request, is working on a new NEN standard for the integrated fire safety of car parks, expected to be ready in 2021.
Het Nederlandse Normalisatie Instituut (hierna NEN) werkt op mijn verzoek aan een nieuwe NEN-norm voor de integrale brandveiligheid van parkeergarage, die naar verwachting in 2021 gereed is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Miljoenen koffiebekers Rijk niet gerecycled maar verbrand’

MPs asked whether about 85 million government coffee cups were incinerated instead of recycled, contrary to policy ambitions, and what steps would prevent this. The minister acknowledged this breaches the contracts, said the contractor was contacted, and committed to new contracts from 2021 with direct recycler arrangements.
However, this is not in line with the concluded contracts.
Dit is echter niet in overeenstemming met de afgesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de verjaringstermijn voor nadeelcompensatie naar aanleiding van het luchthavenbesluit voor de luchthaven Lelystad

MP Laçin (SP) asked whether claims for noise-related compensation from the Lelystad Airport decision would be time-barred from 1 April 2020 under the five-year period, how many claims had been received, and whether claimants could be given time given that the airport is not yet open to commercial aviation. The minister answered that the statutory five-year limitation period in the Wet luchtvaart applies, so late claims must be declined, but that claimants can prevent the limitation by sending interruption letters; about 2,290 letters had been received, mostly such interruption letters, and a claim can be filed from 1 April 2015 regardless of opening date.
Requests for compensation submitted after this period must, under the Aviation Act, be left unprocessed.
Aanvragen om nadeelcompensatie ingediend na deze termijn, dienen op grond van de Wet luchtvaart buiten behandeling gelaten te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Laçin en Kröger over Emissieregistratie

MPs Bruins, Laçin and Kröger asked whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet must be reported as a memo item under the NEC Directive, and whether the Netherlands has reported them. The minister answered that such emissions fall outside the Directive's scope and need not be reported, so the Netherlands has complied.
The Netherlands has not reported aviation emissions above 3,000 feet, which the Directive also does not require.
Nederland heeft de emissies van de luchtvaart boven de 3.000 voet niet gerapporteerd, hetgeen op grond van de richtlijn ook niet verplicht is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Laçin over de berichten dat Ryanair passagiers toch een schadevergoeding moet betalen

MPs Paternotte and Laçin asked the minister about reports that Ryanair must still pay compensation to passengers, and about the ILT's role in enforcing EU Regulation 261/2004, including whether it can act on systematic refusal of claims. The minister confirmed the ILT is responsible for enforcement against systematic violations, explained that after the Ruijssenaars ruling it no longer rules on individual complaints (passengers go to civil courts), gave complaint statistics for Ryanair, and declined to share airline delay data from third parties as confidential.
Following the Ruijssenaars ruling, the ILT is not permitted to enforce on individual passenger complaints about compensation.
Het is de ILT als gevolg van de Ruijssenaars-uitspraak niet toegestaan te handhaven op individuele passagiersklachten over compensatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het ontsporen van de Hoekse Lijn over de kosten die gemoeid zijn met de ombouw van de spoorweg Schiedam Centrum – Hoek van Holland tot metroverbinding

MPs asked the minister how the cost overrun and delays of the Hoekse Lijn conversion could have been checked by elected representatives, and asked for a full cost overview, audit reports and the role of the regional audit office. The minister replied that since 2017 responsibility lies with the municipality of Rotterdam and the Metropoolregio Rotterdam Den Haag, that the Rijk was not involved in the works, costs or audits, and referred the MPs to the regional body and municipalities.
From 3 April 2017 the Rijk therefore bears no responsibility whatsoever for the so-called 'Hoekse Lijn'.
Vanaf 3 april 2017 draagt het Rijk dus geen enkele verantwoordelijkheid meer voor de zogenaamde «Hoekse Lijn».

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over de berichten ‘Zelfs grote bedrijven hebben geen natuurvergunning, dus weten we niet hoeveel stikstof in de natuur terechtkomt’ en ‘Uitstoot van Gelderse bedrijven o

SP MPs Futselaar and Laçin asked about reports that thousands of businesses, including large ones, lack the nature permits required under the Wet natuurbescherming, so nitrogen emissions are unknown. The minister answered that many firms need no permit for nitrogen, that enforcement is largely a provincial responsibility with no statutory inspection deadlines, that no active enforcement occurs until a collective legalisation scheme exists, and that a decision on the Schiphol enforcement request is expected by 1 April 2020.
It is not known how many businesses wrongly lack a permit under the Wet natuurbescherming.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel bedrijven er ten onrechte geen vergunning hebben in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat platformmedewerkers op Schiphol geen longonderzoek krijgen

An SP MP asked the minister why Schiphol ground workers are excluded from the RIVM ultrafine dust lung study given to nearby residents, and whether RIVM will be instructed to include them. The minister answered that the study targets the surrounding area, that workplace health is primarily the employer's responsibility under labour law, that RIVM says workers cannot be included without exposure data and registry categories, and that Schiphol will prepare an action plan and possibly a measurement programme.
RIVM has since indicated that it is not possible to include workers in the current design of the research programme.
Het RIVM heeft inmiddels aangegeven dat het niet mogelijk is om werknemers mee te nemen in de huidige opzet van het onderzoekprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Laçin over het bericht dat de lucht op achterstandsscholen vuiler is

SP MPs Kwint and Laçin asked the government about research showing children at disadvantaged schools breathe dirtier air, and about fine-dust zones, filtration, and school segregation. Minister Slob rejected the general conclusion, said data on fine-dust per school and filtration is not centrally available, and said responsibility for school housing lies with municipalities and school boards, while pointing to a planned integrated housing plan obligation.
No national data on fine-dust concentration per school are known to me.
Er zijn mij geen landelijke gegevens bekend over de fijnstofconcentratie per school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Minister houdt poot stijf: Zonder nieuwe vluchten geen Lelystad'

MPs asked the minister whether she was right that Lelystad Airport could never take over all flights from Schiphol, and why she only acknowledged unavoidable autonomous growth in December 2019 after earlier stating growth would be prevented. The minister replied that the European Commission's objections to the original scheme were known, that she withdrew the notification in December 2018 and resubmitted a more selective scheme, and that she informed parliament of the independent analysis on growth in December 2019.
From the very beginning it was clear that approval from the European Commission was necessary before a VVR could be deployed.
Vanaf het begin af aan is duidelijk geweest dat goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie (EC) noodzakelijk was alvorens een VVR in te kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Raan, Laçin  en Kröger over de correctiebrief op de brief Luchtvaart van 15 oktober

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a correction letter on the validation of noise-calculation appendices for regional airports, including when the error was found, why the correction came late, and whether the appendices were externally validated. The minister answered that the error was discovered on 17 October 2019, that there was no legal basis or regulation requiring external validation before 2010, and that external validation was introduced from 2010 and formalised in 2018, while declining to commit to re-validating the appendices for shielding and atmospheric attenuation.
After receiving the email, I unfortunately had to establish that the word 'geen' had been dropped from the relevant sentence in the Verzamelbrief.
Na ontvangst van de mail heb ik helaas moeten constateren dat in de Verzamelbrief in de betreffende zin het woord «geen» is weggevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over emissieregistratie

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Dutch emissions register, including whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet are omitted from reporting and what this means for air quality and deposition figures. The minister answered that reporting follows the NEC Directive, which excludes aviation emissions outside the landing and take-off cycle, that the guidebook does not determine reporting scope, and deferred the exact emission amounts pending follow-up on a motion, while the answer to one question was delayed by third-party input.
On how I will implement this motion, I will inform you further.
Over de wijze waarop ik deze motie uitvoer, zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van de Raad van State vragen ingediend over de uitspraak van de Raad van State inzake het PAS

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she meant a legal 'trick' (list) to get around the Council of State's ruling on the PAS, and how this squares with respect for the judiciary. The minister says the government is researching how to implement the ruling within legal requirements, without intending to evade it, and refuses to retract the remark, calling it a popular expression not to be taken literally.
Within the framework of the Council of State's ruling, executive choices must be made that do justice to both the letter and the spirit of the ruling.
Binnen het kader van de uitspraak van de Raad van State zijn uitvoerende keuzes te maken die recht moeten doen aan zowel de letter als de geest van de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan en Laçin over het handhavingsverzoek van Mobilisation for the Environment met betrekking tot Schiphol en de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the minister about an enforcement request by Mobilisation for the Environment claiming Schiphol lacks a Wet natuurbescherming permit and that about 100,000 flights are illegal. The minister answered that Schiphol holds no Wnb permit, that the ministry of LNV, as competent authority, will assess the request, and that details on emissions and nitrogen deposition will follow via a new calculation and the MER for the revised airport decree.
In the context of the enforcement request, the Ministry of LNV will gather the necessary information and request views.
Het Ministerie van LNV zal in het kader van het handhavingsverzoek de benodigde informatie verzamelen en zienswijzen opvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger en Van Raan over het bericht dat provinciale staten van Overijssel zich niet serieus genomen voelen door de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdD asked whether air traffic from 7 November 2019 must use the B+ routes to and from Lelystad Airport, why these routes are opened before expansion is certain, and whether the minister will heed Overijssel's call to drop low-flying routes. The minister confirmed that an inregelperiode starts on 7 November for existing small aviation only, stressed the B+ routes are the least noisy option, and declined to postpone, pointing to consultations and planned route improvements.
The routes are not open to commercial traffic because the political decision-making on that has not yet been completed.
De routes zijn niet open voor handelsverkeer want de politieke besluitvorming daarover is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het onderhoud aan de vuurtoren te Egmond aan Zee, waarbij mogelijk chroom 6 is vrijgekomen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about communication with residents and businesses during maintenance on the Egmond aan Zee lighthouse, where chromium-6 paint was removed, including dust clouds, the absence of notification, and the lack of a protocol. The minister acknowledged communication with the surrounding community was insufficient, said safety was never at risk, and committed Rijkswaterstaat to talks with residents via the municipality.
The residents and neighbouring businesses were not informed about the works.
De omwonenden en naastgelegen ondernemingen zijn over de werkzaamheden niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de buitensporige subsidie van de luchtvaartsector

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked the government about claimed excessive subsidies to the aviation sector, including tax treatment of kerosene, Schiphol's accessibility costs, WTO rulings on Airbus and Boeing, and airport charges. The minister disputed the subsidy calculation, provided partial figures and data on Schiphol-related spending, and promised a forthcoming overview of external costs of aviation.
Question 2: Do you endorse the subsidy of 86.29 euros per person calculated in this article?
Vraag 2 Onderschrijft u de in dit artikel berekende subsidie van 86,29 euro per persoon

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan, Laçin, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Bruins, Stoffer en Van Brenk over  het  bericht 'L’UE refuse d’abandonner sa souveraineté sur  les émissions de CO2 de l’aviation'.

Eight MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that the EU refuses to give up sovereignty over aviation CO2 emissions, and about the Dutch position and a draft ICAO resolution making CORSIA the only permitted global aviation emissions system. The minister confirmed Dutch support for the EU line, said the Netherlands will enter a reservation if the text could limit EU climate measures (including via the EU ETS), and said a kerosene excise is a fiscal measure outside the resolution's scope.

At the same time, the Netherlands will make a reservation against texts in the final resolution if they could politically limit the freedom in Europe to take the measures needed to achieve the climate goals.

Tegelijkertijd zal Nederland een voorbehoud maken tegen teksten in de uiteindelijke resolutie, wanneer die politiek gezien een beperking zouden kunnen betekenen van de vrijheid om in Europa de maatregelen te nemen die nodig zijn om de klimaatdoelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat Schiphol deals sluit met omliggende gemeenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Schiphol's agreements with neighbouring municipalities on noise and environmental nuisance were a divide-and-rule strategy that sidelined other municipalities. The minister replied that Schiphol was asked to work on a noise-reduction plan and an Omgevingsfonds with its surroundings, that the ministry is not involved in Schiphol's commitments to municipalities, and that it cannot judge their legal validity, promising to inform parliament later in the autumn.
My ministry is not involved in commitments that Schiphol does or does not make to the municipalities in the surroundings in that context.
Mijn ministerie is niet betrokken bij toezeggingen die Schiphol in dat kader al dan niet doet aan de gemeenten in de omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over het artikel in de NRC “Nederland betaalde miljoenen maar Tata bouwt in India”

Two SP MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister why a subsidised Hisarna blast furnace is being built in India rather than IJmuiden, and whether subsidy policy should change. The minister denies undue pressure from Tata Steel, says the scale-up plant was needed as an intermediate step, rejects leakage claims, and says the government will only take action on trade if needed.
The conversation with Tata Steel about subsidy options was not conducted in that way, and Tata Steel exerted no pressure, as is suggested here.
Het gesprek met Tata Steel over subsidiemogelijkheden is niet op die manier gevoerd en er is door Tata Steel geen druk uitgeoefend, zoals hier wordt gesuggereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de brandstofstoring bij Aircraft Fuel Supply (AFS)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the chaos at Schiphol caused by the July 2019 fuel supply failure, including communication with travellers, Schiphol's liability, passenger care and compensation. The minister answered that an independent TNO investigation is under way, that Schiphol will evaluate crisis communication and passenger care with sector parties, and that liability and compensation questions depend on the cause still unknown.
My ministry is in contact with AFS and Schiphol about this and is closely following developments.
Mijn ministerie staat hierover in contact met AFS en Schiphol en volgt de ontwikkelingen op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over de impact van de vernietiging van de PAS door de Raad van State op de besluitvorming omtrent Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the minister how the Council of State's annulment of the PAS nitrogen programme affects the status of Lelystad Airport as a priority project, the required permitting and studies, and whether new research is needed before any decision. The minister answered that the reserved development space for Lelystad has lapsed, that the Wet Natuurbescherming now applies and consequences are still being examined, and that careful study is needed, so opening in April 2020 is no longer feasible.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform the House.
Zodra hierover meer bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over het bericht dat er gevaarlijke stoffen zijn gelekt bij twee chemiebedrijven in Delfzijl

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reported leaks of hazardous substances at two chemical plants in Delfzijl, including whether residents should feel unsafe and for an overview of incidents and supervision. The State Secretary answered that the province of Groningen, via the Omgevingsdienst Groningen, is the competent authority, that no incidents in 2019 posed a danger to the surroundings, and that inspections found no violations except a warning to Lubrizol for late reporting.
Licensing, supervision and enforcement are carried out on behalf of the province by the Omgevingsdienst Groningen.
Vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving worden namens de provincie uitgevoerd door de Omgevingsdienst Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Laçin over "Een tankstationhouder die af wil van zijn "wurgcontract"

MPs Van Kent and Laçin asked whether franchise contracts between oil companies and petrol station operators can amount to disguised employment, and whether the Labour Inspectorate checks them. The minister answered that parties have full contractual freedom, the government has no view on the contracts, and the Inspectorate does not currently see franchising as a priority risk, though it will monitor reports.
These concern agreements between two private parties. I therefore have no view of them.
Dit betreffen overeenkomsten tussen twee private partijen. Daarop heb ik dus geen zicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over ongerustheid over een grote militaire oefenzone

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked about concerns over a large military exercise zone in the north of the Netherlands, its consultation, decision-making roles, environmental and Wadden Sea effects, and links to Lelystad Airport. The ministers answered that the zone is still being designed within the Luchtruimherziening programme, that participation and Plan-MER procedures will follow, and that the decision is due in 2020.
It is too early in the design process to give clarity on the positioning of the exercise area and the consequences for airspace use.
Het is te vroeg in het nog te doorlopen ontwerpproces om al duidelijkheid te geven over de positionering van het oefengebied en de gevolgen hiervan voor het luchtruimgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Reactie Expertise Centrum Asbest & Vezels op de commotie rondom de risico’s van blootstelling aan asbest’

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked the ministers about an opinion piece from the Expertise Centrum Asbest & Vezels criticising asbestos policy, including whether the debate has shifted towards cost, whether asbestos is dangerous only with long exposure, and whether the ministers will meet the centre on the roof-asbestos ban and certification of removal firms. The minister answered that health risks remain central, that asbestos is carcinogenic and removal is required where it poses a risk, that officials will make contact with the centre, and that the government will report on implementation this autumn.
However, I also placed an important caveat on the cost calculations made in this report.
Ik heb echter ook een belangrijke kanttekening geplaatst bij de berekeningen van de kosten die in dit rapport gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Laçin over het bericht dat er een kwart miljoen verkeersboetes zijn uitgeschreven voor 1 kilometer te hard rijden

MPs Van Raak and Laçin asked whether nearly a quarter million speeding fines for exceeding the limit by 1 km/h were issued since 2012, and whether this undermines support and resembles a fine quota. The minister confirmed the figure over seven years, explained measurement corrections and the 4 km/h threshold, rejected the quota claim since its 2011 abolition, and guaranteed fines serve road safety rather than revenue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over de 40dB-contour

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a changed departure route near Wezep affects the 40dB contour used as the MER study area, and whether the sensitivity analysis can legitimately substitute for assessing alternatives. The Minister replied that the 40 dB(A) contour is shown for information only without spatial restrictions, that the route variants differ in location not height, and that the effects on inhabitants were compiled and published, though the government did not commit to a new MER assessment of the altered route.
The aim of a possible route change is that less built-up area is overflown.
Het doel van een mogelijke routewijziging is dat er minder over bebouwd gebied wordt gevlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Ruim 39.000 klachten over Maastricht Aachen Airport’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sharp rise in noise and other complaints about Maastricht Aachen Airport, growth plans, property value effects, taxiing noise, air quality, provincial investment and the extra runway length. The minister answered that movements fell in 2018 while large cargo and passenger traffic rose, that the province has paused its growth plans pending a new licence application with a full environmental and economic assessment, and that the airport's compensation scheme and runway rules apply, while several questions (property values, the province's finances) were left to the province or not studied.
This is a matter for the province of Limburg and the airport operator, respectively.
Dit is een aangelegenheid van de provincie Limburg respectievelijk de exploitant van de luchthaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over de wijze waarop zal worden omgegaan met de constateringen van de Omgevingsraad Schiphol in het toekomstige luchtvaartbeleid

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how she will take into account the Schiphol Environmental Council's finding that there is no support for further growth before improvements are made, how she reconciles public statements about growth and Lelystad with that advice, and how safety, climate and the 50-50 noise/growth rule will be handled in the upcoming Luchtvaartnota. The minister answered that she is pursuing two amendments to the Schiphol airport traffic decree (one to legally anchor the 500,000 movement cap, one for post-2020 development), will send the Chamber a response before summer, and that safety and climate will be addressed through the planMER process with a draft Luchtvaartnota after summer.
In preparation, I will send the Chamber a response to the chair's report of the ORS before summer, including a proposal for how this LVB will be shaped and how the environment will be involved.

Ter voorbereiding daarop zal ik uw Kamer voor de zomer een reactie op het verslag van de voorzitter van de ORS sturen, inclusief een voorstel voor de manier waarop dit LVB wordt vormgegeven en de omgeving wordt betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Alkaya over Uber

The SP MPs asked the government about a series of accidents involving Uber drivers, driver age and insurance, and whether Uber's safety measures and competition rules are adequate. The state secretary answered that police investigations are ongoing, that SWOV research on taxi accidents was commissioned, that Uber's measures are a good first step, and that existing rules apply equally to all taxi operators.
The police are currently investigating the various accidents. We cannot anticipate the outcomes of that.
De politie onderzoekt momenteel de verschillende ongevallen. Op de uitkomsten daarvan kunnen wij niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over het bericht dat ‘de vliegroutes voor Lelystad Airport gewijzigd zijn tijdens de lopende zienswijzenprocedure’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why flight route changes for Lelystad Airport were made during an ongoing public comment procedure without involving municipalities such as Kampen, and whether residents' objections would be affected. The minister replied that the Wezep route is still only a proposal under consultation with neighbouring municipalities, that the amended MER already covers a possible route change without altering legal noise contours, and that no extension of the comment period is planned.
Partly on the basis of this advice, I will take a decision on a possible adjustment of the route.
Mede op basis van dit advies zal ik een besluit nemen over een mogelijke aanpassing van de route.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Raan over de online omgevingsanalyse die is opgesteld in opdracht van de Omgevingsraad Schiphol (ORS)

MPs Laçin and Van Raan asked about an online environmental analysis commissioned by the Schiphol Environmental Council, its purpose, cost, and GDPR safeguards. The minister explains it was part of a broad public consultation on Schiphol's future, costing €45,375, and states that the ORS as a foundation must comply with the GDPR under supervision of the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
The Schiphol Environmental Council is a foundation and as such, like any other natural or legal person, must comply with the rules and obligations of the GDPR.
De Omgevingsraad Schiphol is een stichting en moet als zodanig net als iedere andere natuurlijke of rechtspersoon voldoen aan de regels en verplichtingen van de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over het bericht 'Demonstranten in Harlingen willen sluiting afvaloven'

MPs Kröger and Laçin asked about frequent malfunctions at the Harlingen waste incinerator (REC), whether these threaten health and the environment, and whether monitoring, emission norms, or the permit should be tightened. The state secretary answered that emission rules and the 60-hour annual malfunction limit apply, that the province of Fryslân enforces the permit, and that new BAT conclusions and a RWS-Infomil study on malfunction management are forthcoming, but declined to pursue permit revocation.
I am having RWS-Infomil examine whether, when the final BAT conclusions are implemented, the obligation to draw up a malfunction management plan is feasible and desirable as a general rule.

Ik laat door RWS-Infomil onderzoeken of bij implementatie van de definitieve BBT-conclusies de verplichting om een management plan voor storingen op te stellen in algemene regels haalbaar en wenselijk is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Ministerie wil gevaarlijke stoffen over Twents spoor legaliseren’

An MP asks whether risk ceilings for hazardous goods on Dutch rail were exceeded and whether the government plans to relax the risk norms to legalise these exceedances. The state secretary confirms exceedances on some diversion routes, refers to annual reports and a separate letter for detailed figures and enforcement, and denies that the safety norm (1 in a million per year) will be relaxed.

No, the safety norm remains the same: this means no housing in places where the risk of death from an accident with a freight train carrying hazardous substances is greater than 1 in a million per year.

Nee, de veiligheidsnorm blijft gelijk: dit betekent geen woningen op plaatsen waar het risico op overlijden als gevolg van een ongeluk met een goederentrein met gevaarlijke stoffen groter is dan 1 op een miljoen per jaar
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de Merwedebrug nog maar 6 dagen restlevensduur had

An SP MP asked the minister how the inspection level of bridges can be guaranteed adequate after reports that the Merwedebrug had only six days of remaining service life, whether other bridges are in similar condition, whether funding for maintenance and replacement is sufficient, and whether inspections will be increased. The minister answered that safety standards keep risk very low though never zero, that other strategic bridges are under the regular inspection programme with no comparable cracking found, that budgets rise to around 350 million euros per year after 2020 with periodic updating, and that inspection regimes will be adjusted where needed.
Follow-up actions are carried out within the regular inspection and maintenance programme and within the Replacement and Renovation programme.
Vervolgacties worden uitgevoerd binnen het reguliere inspectie- en onderhoudsprogramma en binnen het programma Vervanging en Renovatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Remco Dijkstra, Van der Graaf, Von Martels, Gijs van Dijk, Van Aalst, Schonis en Laçin over de nieuwe prijsverhoging voor tachograafkaarten

MPs asked whether the government would accept a proposed 5% price rise for tachograph cards by Kiwa, how the Dutch price compares with neighbouring countries, and why the new fee system has not yet taken effect. The minister said the current card price stays at 95 euro while a new generation card is priced at 100 euro due to new EU requirements, promised a benchmark study and a letter later in the year, and refused to suspend the price increase despite a motion.
No, the tariffs for tachograph cards remain at the established price.
Nee, de tarieven voor de tachograafkaarten blijven op de vastgestelde prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over aanloopsteun voor luchtvaartmaatschappijen die opereren op luchthaven Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether state aid from northern provinces and municipalities to Groningen Airport Eelde (start-up aid and non-economic services costs) complies with EU state aid rules, including notification to the European Commission, discrimination between airports, and market economy investor tests. The Minister answered that responsibility for compliance lies with the airport's shareholders, declined to answer the substantive questions, and said the ministry would assess the economic basis when the airport applies for an airport decree.
Responsibility for compliance with and correct application of the state aid rules lies with the shareholders themselves.
De verantwoordelijk voor de naleving en correcte toepassing van de staatssteunregels ligt bij de aandeelhouders zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat gratis grond ProRail miljoenen kost

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that ProRail had to pay millions for land it earlier declined when NS offered it for free, and whether more such land could be sold to ProRail, and what the ministry advised. The state secretary confirmed the purchase, said the ministry had rejected acquisition in 2011 pending need, that no further problematic offers are known, and that ownership and land-transaction rules will be reviewed in the ZBO conversion.
Following ProRail's reported intention to buy the land, I indicated, given the situation that had arisen, that I could go along with the choice.
Naar aanleiding van de door ProRail gemelde voorgenomen aankoop van de gronden heb ik, gegeven de ontstane situatie, aangegeven de keuze te kunnen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Asbestvezels ontdekt op metrostation Stadhuis; voorlopig geen metro’s’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about asbestos fibres found at Rotterdam metro station Stadhuis, including exposure of passengers and staff, how the 2009 survey missed it, and the investigation scope. The government answered that the municipality found no health risk, exposure duration is unknown, RET has started a broader investigation, and certified contractors and the inspectorate oversee remediation.
Commissioning such an investigation is the responsibility of the competent authority or RET.
Het opdracht geven voor een dergelijk onderzoek is de verantwoordelijkheid van bevoegd gezag dan wel de RET.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan en Van Brenk over kritiek op motie Lelystad Airport

MPs Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan and Van Brenk asked whether completing the airspace redesign by 2023 is realistic, whether low-flying routes from Lelystad Airport will be gone by then, how low-flying routes are defined, and whether a plan MER is needed. The minister says the 2023 target stands, a start decision follows in spring 2019 and a preferred variant in 2020, but gives no guarantee that low-flying routes disappear by 2023, offers no definition, and leaves the plan MER question open.
As agreed in the Coalition Agreement, the Cabinet will implement the planned adjustment of the airspace by 2023.
Zoals is afgesproken in het Regeerakkoord gaat het Kabinet de voorgenomen aanpassing van het luchtruim per 2023 realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Tankers lozen elke dag illegaal kankerverwekkend gas vanaf de Waal’

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that tankers illegally vent carcinogenic gas from the Waal every day, asking what steps will stop it and how enforcement works. The minister responded that a national ban on venting is planned for 2020 pending ratification of an international treaty amendment, that enforcement lies largely with the provinces, and that a taskforce has been set up to design enforcement.
I have, together with the provinces concerned, set up a taskforce led by the province of Noord-Holland to enable effective introduction of the venting ban in 2020.
Ik heb samen met de betrokken provincies een taskforce ingesteld onder leiding van de provincie Noord-Holland om een effectieve invoering van het ontgassingsverbod in 2020 mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Gehandicapte in de kou door Brussel’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the EU exemption allowing heavier zero-emission vehicles on B licences covers goods transport but not school and disabled passenger transport, and what the government did to change that. The minister answered that Brussels rejected the extension on road-safety and passenger-volume grounds, that the exemption cannot be enforced nationally, and that conventional vehicles remain available, while talks with sector bodies continue.
Ultimately it was decided that an exemption for passenger transport will not come.
Uiteindelijk is besloten dat een ontheffing voor personenvervoer er niet komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Gerven over het onderzoek ‘Aanwijzingen voor herkomst onbekend deel plastic soep’ uitgevoerd door het Burgercollectief Dreumelse Waard

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about a citizen-collective study tracing orange plastic waste along the Maas to the Over de Maas project, and whether polluters should pay and verondiepingsprojecten be investigated. The State Secretary acknowledged the plastic likely came from the project, said the initiator cleaned up the banks, and promised a review of the rules and supervision by the regulators, with evaluation results due end of November.
I will ask the supervisory bodies Rijkswaterstaat, the water boards and the ILT to what extent there are problems with plastics and, if so, how they act against it under the duty of care.
Ik zal aan de toezichthouders Rijkswaterstaat, de waterschappen en de ILT vragen in welke mate er problemen met plastics zijn en zo ja hoe zij hiertegen op grond van de zorgplicht optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over blazers bij chemiebedrijf ESD-SIC in Delfzijl

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked the State Secretary about recurring 'blazers' (sulphur dust clouds released with a bang from smelting furnaces) at chemical company ESD-SIC in Delfzijl, and whether the government can end them, fine the company, and acknowledge local health and odour nuisance. The State Secretary answered that the province of Groningen is the competent authority responsible for permitting and enforcement, that Rijkswaterstaat-Infomil can advise it, that blazers are not prohibited under the current permit, and that the province adopted a maatwerkbesluit requiring a study into avoiding them, while acknowledging the nuisance for residents.
Naturally, the province remains responsible for granting permits and supervising the company.
Uiteraard blijft de provincie verantwoordelijk voor de vergunningverlening en het toezicht op het bedrijf.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Inspectie: kankerverwekkende stoffen gemengd in benzine voor West-Afrika’ en de brief naar aanleiding van het ILT-rapport ‘Stookolie voor zeeschepen – Autobrandstoff

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that carcinogenic substances were blended into fuels exported to West Africa, asking whether the sector is held sufficiently accountable and whether enforcement against the blending is adequate. The State Secretary said the government expects firms to implement UN and OECD due diligence standards, that the ILT found no illegal blending of waste substances, and that enforcement under REACH and waste law is applied with stricter measures for higher risk, while acknowledging the ILT's capacity is a recurring question.
The cabinet has asked the National Contact Point (NCP) for the OECD Guidelines to examine the extent to which the oil and gas sector complies with the OECD Guidelines.
Het kabinet heeft het Nationaal Contactpunt (NCP) voor de OESO-richtlijnen verzocht te kijken naar de mate waarin de olie- en gassector de OESO-richtlijnen naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de belevingsvlucht

An SP MP asked the minister about the evaluation of the Belevingsvlucht flight trial, the MER corrections for Lelystad and Schiphol, and the scope of environmental assessment, including whether measured noise deviated from modelled values. The minister deferred the substantive answers on the evaluation to a later letter, and gave assurances and procedural explanations on the MER work, denying any targeting of results.
I expect to be able to send this response to your House at the end of September.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer deze reactie eind september te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over uitbuiting van vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Laçin asked ministers about exploitation of truck drivers, including enforcement of the 45-hour weekend rest, the adequacy of ILT enforcement and fines, sham constructions with foreign subsidiaries, and truckers' hotel accommodation. The minister denies that the Netherlands has become Europe's parking lot, says enforcement is risk-based and targeted, defends the current fine policy, and refers to ongoing EU mobility package negotiations.
I do not consider it opportune to change the current fining policy.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om het huidige boetebeleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat buitenlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs oververtegenwoordigd zijn bij ongelukken en pechgevallen

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether foreign truck drivers are overrepresented in accidents and breakdowns, and what the causes, costs and measures are. The minister answered that the data cannot establish the nationality-linked causes or costs, that most incidents are technical or tyre-related, and that the new road safety plan will address freight transport risks.
To further specify the causes of the involvement of foreign drivers, detailed information on all incidents is necessary.
Om de oorzaken van de betrokkenheid van buitenlandse chauffeurs nader te specificeren is gedetailleerde informatie van alle incidenten noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de brief ‘Voortgang onderzoek asbest in cosmetica’ en het bericht ‘Johnson & Johnson moet schadevergoeding van 4 miljard euro betalen’

Lid Laçin (SP) asked whether the 296 talc-containing cosmetics tested for asbest should be retested with a more sensitive method (Fitzgerald method) and whether Johnson & Johnson products should be further investigated after a US damages ruling. The government declined to retest, saying the prescribed NEN 5896 method is adequate and it awaits an ISO decision, and said no further investigation of Johnson & Johnson products is warranted.
No, I am not willing to have the 296 products retested.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid de 296 producten opnieuw te laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat grote groepen gehinderden geen bezwaar meer kunnen maken tegen luchtvaartherrie

An SP MP asked whether residents outside the immediate noise contours around Schiphol, who experience aircraft noise, can be denied standing to object to ILT enforcement decisions, and how the 48 dB contour is applied. The minister replied that anyone may file an enforcement request, but only stakeholders (typically residents inside the contours, case by case outside) may object under the Awb, and pointed to complaint desks, including a planned one for Lelystad Airport.
Under the General Administrative Law Act, only persons who qualify as interested parties can object to this.
Op grond van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht kan hiertegen alleen bezwaar worden gemaakt door personen die als belanghebbende kunnen worden gekwalificeerd.
Antwoord op van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat het onderzoek naar de groei van het vliegveld Rotterdam rammelt

An SP MP asked the minister to respond to reports that the cost-benefit analysis supporting Rotterdam The Hague Airport's expansion is flawed, and whether a second opinion, dialogue with critical economists, and changes to the airport-commissioned analysis are warranted. The minister defends the current process, says the airport will update its MKBA addressing existing counter-expertise, that the draft airport decision will be submitted to parliament for pre-consultation likely in 2019, and declines a second opinion and meetings with the economists for now.

I will await that application and at that point make a substantive assessment based on all information available, and then prepare a draft airport decision that will be submitted to your House for pre-consultation.

Ik wacht die aanvraag af en zal op dat moment inhoudelijk een afweging maken op basis van alle informatie die er ligt en vervolgens een ontwerp luchthavenbesluit opstellen dat in voorhang aan uw Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Giftige stof PFOA gevonden in recreatieplas Berkendonk in Helmond’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about PFOA found in the Berkendonk recreation lake in Helmond, how it got there, whether swimming is safe given concentrations above the advisory standard, and what rules and transport checks apply to Chemours. The minister answered that the contamination is likely historical, that the municipality and water board will monitor it, that RIVM sees no swimming risk since exposure is far below the tolerable daily intake, and that no signals of rule violations by Chemours are known.
I will inform your House if there are relevant developments.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren indien er relevante ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Sterk verhoogde concentratie GenX in slootwater omgeving Chemours’

An SP MP asked the government about GenX and PFOA contamination found in ditch water near Chemours, including whether Chemours still discharges PFOA, health risks from garden produce and livestock watering, EU regulation, and enforcement against Chemours. The minister answered that RIVM is studying the contamination, the province has issued an order under penalty against Chemours and tightened discharge limits, and the government will propose GenX as a substance of very high concern.
On the basis of this finding, the province imposed an order subject to a penalty on Chemours on 23 April 2018.
De provincie heeft op basis van deze constatering op 23 april 2018 een last onder dwangsom aan Chemours opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Remco Dijkstra, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht 'Nederlands rijbewijs online te koop via Poolse website'

MPs from VVD and SP asked whether fake Dutch driving licences sold via a Polish website endanger road safety, how often forgeries are found and prosecuted, what is being done to take the site down, and whether employers check licences. The minister answered that forgeries are rare and prosecuted under existing law, that Poland lacks a legal basis to act against the site until a pending bill takes effect, and that the site's removal depends on Polish authorities.
The Polish Ministry said the relevant Polish authorities are aware of the site's activities, but without a legal expansion there is no basis to act against these practices.

Het Poolse Ministerie liet weten dat de relevante Poolse autoriteiten aandacht hebben voor de activiteiten van de bewuste site, maar dat zonder wettelijke verruiming er geen grond is voor optreden tegen deze praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een chauffeur 34 uur onderweg was zonder fatsoenlijke pauze

The SP MPs Laçin and Van Dijk asked the ministers whether a Dutch truck driver who drove 34 hours without a proper break reflects a wider problem with tachograph tampering and enforcement, and who bears responsibility. The minister calls it unacceptable, describes ILT and ISZW risk-based enforcement and cross-border cooperation, says such a case was not previously encountered, and places primary responsibility on the employer and driver.
Exceeding driving and rest times occurs more often, but the ILT has not previously encountered a driver who was 34 hours on the road without a proper break.
Overschrijdingen van de rij- en rusttijden komen vaker voor, maar een chauffeur die 34 uur onderweg is zonder fatsoenlijke pauze, is de ILT nog niet eerder tegengekomen.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk, Gijs van Dijk en Van Raan over geluidsnormen op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether the Schiphol noise criteria (the 'huizennorm' of 10,000 severely affected homes) were stretched to about 12,300 homes without justification, and whether enforcement uses flown routes. The minister acknowledges the criteria were actualised in 2007/2008 and 2013 after new insights, says enforcement now uses flown routes, and rejects the claim that the original limits were breached, while not fully explaining why the figure rose.
If an actualisation is carried out, the House of Representatives will be informed of it.
Indien een actualisatie wordt uitgevoerd, wordt Uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over eerlijke concurrentie in het vrachtvervoer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fair competition in freight transport: restricted-speed trucks on public roads near Rotterdam, enforcement of low-emission zones against foreign-plated trucks, chain liability for the minimum wage, comparison with neighbouring countries, and enforcement of weekend rest in truck cabs. The minister answered that police enforcement is not separately recorded, municipalities enforce low-emission zones and international data exchange is being pursued, chain liability applies since 2017, and ILT checks in 2018 led to 72 fines from 315 drivers checked.
No separate registration takes place of enforcement against the improper use of re-inspected tractors on public roads.
Er vindt geen afzonderlijke registratie plaats van de handhaving op het oneigenlijke gebruik van teruggekeurde trekkers op de openbare weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de afhandeling van de asbestbrand in Wateringen

An MP asked the state secretaries about how the 2015 Wateringen asbestos fire was handled, including whether inventory reports were public, whether areas were properly cleared and re-checked, and whether inspection capacity is adequate. The government answered mostly by pointing to COT and Wob-disclosed documents, concluding that municipal measures were lawful and that inspection capacity appears sufficient, while committing to no new concrete action beyond noting the 2016 guidance update.
I will therefore not press for publication of these documents because the municipality has already made a consideration under the Wob request.
Ik zal derhalve niet aandringen op openbaarmaking van deze stukken omdat de gemeente in het kader van het Wob-verzoek al een afweging heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over de berichten dat asbest in make-up is aangetroffen

MPs Kröger and Laçin asked how many shops sold make-up containing asbestos, how many products were sold, the health risk for children, why no consumer warning was issued sooner, which products tested clean, whether Claire's US test results would be shared, and the scope of a broader investigation. The government answered that 22 and 25 shops sold the two affected products, the health risk is probably limited though asbestos levels were undesirably high, a warning was issued within a reasonable time, the ILT obtained but cannot publish Claire's test results, and the NVWA and ILT are testing over 250 talc-containing cosmetics.
Claire's commissioned this research and is not obliged to make this research public.
Claire's is opdrachtgever van dit onderzoek en is niet verplicht om dit onderzoek openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht “OV-chipkaart op mobiele telefoon totaal mislukt”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the mobile OV-chip pilot failed, including its cost of 2.2 million euros, the complexity of the sign-up process and the lessons learned. The State Secretary answered that the pilot cost 2.2 million euros, that telecom costs are unknown because the companies cite confidentiality, that the pilot was an acceptable innovation investment, and that lessons were drawn for future payment methods.
I have no data on possible additional costs that the telecom companies KPN and Vodafone incurred.
Ik heb geen gegevens over mogelijk aanvullende kosten die telecombedrijven KPN en Vodafone hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over de bevindingen van de onderzoekscommissie Gezondheidsklachten Ter Apel

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Laçin asked whether the government would answer earlier questions on health complaints among COA staff at Ter Apel now that the investigative commission has reported, and whether it endorses its conclusions and what technical and psychosocial measures will follow. The Secretary of State endorses the commission's conclusions, reports that COA has begun cleaning, ventilation and lighting fixes with monitoring planned, and describes conversations with staff to restore trust.
I endorse the recommendations and conclusions of the investigative commission.
Ik onderschrijf de aanbevelingen en conclusies van de onderzoekscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat asbest is vrijgekomen uit een vrachtwagen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a spill of asbestos from a truck that closed the A4 motorway, including the rules for transporting asbestos and whether the transport complied. The State Secretary answered that the transport could not be traced to a private or professional carrier, that the waste was packed in suitable film, and that the rules and information are adequate.
By the time the report reached Rijkswaterstaat, it could no longer be determined which vehicle the asbestos came from.
Op het moment dat de melding binnenkwam bij Rijkswaterstaat was niet meer te achterhalen van welk voertuig het asbest afkomstig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat perfluorisobuteen (PFIB) is vrijgekomen bij Chemours

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the release of PFIB at Chemours, the adequacy of the reporting regime after supervision moved to DCMR, the safety of emissions near residential areas, worker exposure, and the status of municipal cost claims. The government answered that the release was very small and likely harmless outside the site, that the reporting regime was unchanged, that emissions meet the minimisation duty and MTR, and that no lawsuit yet exists.
The company has a few weeks to supply this data.
Het bedrijf heeft enkele weken om deze gegevens aan te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over asbest bij onderhoud en renovatie van huurwoningen

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked about tenants' rights during renovations of rental housing, including asbestos removal, relocation housing, and whether asbestos removal in Utrecht Overvecht was done without adequate protection. The government answered that tenants have a strong legal position, that landlords must ensure safety and assess asbestos, that disputes can go to court, and that it declines to share inspection reports, which the municipalities or housing corporation control.
It is up to the municipalities or housing corporation Portaal to share the reports with third parties.
Het is aan de gemeenten of woningbouwcorporatie Portaal om de rapporten met derden te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de geluidsoverlast van de A50 voor Ravenstein en Oss

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about noise nuisance from the A50 motorway for Ravenstein and Oss, including why no noise measures are planned there despite exceedance warnings and reports. The minister answered in detail that no exceedance of noise production ceilings is expected within five years at these locations, so no additional measures are planned, while citing the legal framework and planned measures elsewhere.
Because no exceedance of the noise production ceilings is expected in the short term, there is no reason to take (additional) noise measures.
Omdat er op korte termijn geen overschrijding van de GPP’s wordt verwacht, is er geen aanleiding om (aanvullende) geluidmaatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Laçin over de toegankelijkheid van het station in Winsum

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked why ProRail reversed its earlier plan for a ramp at Winsum station, which was presented in June 2017, and whether the higher cost estimate was credible. The state secretary replied that detailed design showed a ramp needed a costly new foundation (about €2 million), so ProRail chose a new lift (about €500,000) with similar accessibility, and that the cost estimate followed a standard, checked procedure.
ProRail therefore decided in September 2017 to improve accessibility at Winsum station by installing a new lift.
ProRail heeft daarom in september 2017 besloten om de toegankelijkheid van station Winsum te verbeteren door het plaatsen van een nieuwe lift.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Lacin over het bericht 'Chauffeurs moesten tijdens storm de weg op'

MPs Van Dijk and Lacin asked whether employers forced truck drivers onto the road during the January 2018 storm, whether sanctions, bans and fines should apply, and whether non-Dutch-speaking drivers were properly informed of the code red weather alert. The minister called the pressure unacceptable, said employers must inform drivers and that responsibility is shared, and promised to discuss measures with the transport sector and inform the House shortly, without committing to bans, fines or counting the affected drivers.
I immediately took the initiative to sit down with the transport and logistics sector to consider which measures could be taken in (expected) extreme weather conditions.
Ik heb meteen het initiatief genomen om met de transport- en logistieke sector om tafel te gaan om te bezien welke maatregelen bij (verwachte) extreme weersomstandigheden genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Kröger over de berichten dat make-up asbest bevat

MPs Laçin and Kröger asked the state secretary about reports that Claire's children's make-up contained asbestos, including whether ILT and NVWA had tested the products, how they relied on FDA and Health Canada data, and whether talc-related products are monitored. The government replied that ILT tested 28 Claire's products and found no asbestos, that NVWA relied on FDA findings and manufacturers bear primary responsibility, and that it would not request the private analysis reports but would act if asbestos-contaminated talc products were found.
I therefore see no reason at this time to request these reports.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om deze rapporten op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over Sweatshop Schiphol

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked about reports of precarious 'sweatshop' conditions at Schiphol, including rotating workers between contracts to avoid permanent employment, and the government's role. Minister Koolmees answered that such practices are undesirable but that employers are primarily responsible, pointed to planned contract-cost measures and existing research, and declined to take shareholder action or to answer in time for the committee debate.
I cannot make a statement about the situation at an individual company.
Over de situatie bij een individueel bedrijf kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het afsluiten van gas, water en licht

Two SP MPs asked whether households failing to pay energy bills will be cut off less quickly now that suppliers must first refer them to debt assistance, and how that works, plus questions on water cut-offs, health risks and a similar water rule. The minister confirmed the referral duty, described the winter-period procedure, said a summer extension is planned, and committed to amending the water cut-off regulation with the VNG and Vewin.
I am willing to draw up a similar kind of regulation.
Ik ben bereid eenzelfde soort regeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over het MAA-besluit

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the minister about the Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) decision to allow more cargo flights, including the effects on residents, noise and air quality, compensation for planning damage, and whether residents were misled about flight numbers and should get a new objection period. The minister answered that the corrected noise inputs will be assessed in an amended procedure with a new m.e.r. notice and a draft amendment placed before parliament, that damage claims will be handled under the existing compensation policy, and that residents were correctly informed about annual flight numbers, so no new objection period is planned.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Ja, daar ben ik toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat asbest is vrijgekomen bij een brand in Goeree Overflakkee

An SP MP asked about asbestos released by a warehouse fire in Melissant, the extent of spread, the municipal information efforts, demolition and sanitation, national registration of asbestos fires, and whether high costs of certified asbestos roof removal could cause evasion. The government said the spread was limited, the municipality followed guidelines and is supervising demolition, no national registration exists, and it does not share the fear of evasion given municipal enforcement powers and a subsidy scheme.
Such a national overview is not available.
Een dergelijk landelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de concurrentie op het spoor

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a Telegraaf report on German operator Arriva's call to liberalise all Dutch public transport, and how this squares with a 2011 study finding that splitting rail services from the main network harms passengers. The State Secretary answered that stakeholders may voice their interests, that the 2020 choice on rail market structure will be made carefully and in consultation, and that passenger interests come first while taxpayer interests also matter.
I view the Arriva director's statements as a wish from one of the stakeholders to liberalise public transport.
Ik zie de uitspraken van de directeur van Arriva als een wens van een van de belanghebbenden om het openbaar vervoer te liberaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Kent en Lacin over werklozen die bij de NS met levensgevaarlijke chroomverf moesten werken

Three SP MPs asked the ministers about unemployed Tilburg workers exposed to chromium-6 paint in an NS-linked re-integration project, including whether authorities intervened, whether victims get compensation, and whether a damages fund should be set up. The government said the Tilburg municipality remains ultimately responsible, an independent RIVM investigation is underway with results expected August 2018, and it will decide on compensation after that, while also tightening REACH and exposure rules.
I would first like to await the results of this investigation; these are expected at the end of August 2018.
Ik wil graag eerst de resultaten van dit onderzoek afwachten; deze worden eind augustus 2018 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat het kabinet zwicht voor chantage van Russen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the cabinet gave in to Russian pressure, linking KLM's Siberian overflight rights to AirBridgeCargo's slot shortage at Schiphol, and asked about the operational agreement, the government's role, and possible local slot rules. The minister answered that the government was not party to the KLM-ABC agreement, that no link exists between overflight rights and slots, and that a local rule for Schiphol and cargo measures are being explored, with some items deferred to later information.
I am not a party to the agreement myself and do not know its precise content.
Ik ben zelf geen partij bij de overeenkomst en ken de precieze inhoud daarvan niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Lacin over het bericht dat op station Amsterdam Centraal slimme reclameborden worden ingezet

MPs Hijink and Lacin asked about smart advertising boards at Amsterdam Centraal that reportedly track when and how long people look at them, including how many such boards exist, what data they collect, and whether companies and state holdings must obtain opt-in consent or seek advice from the Dutch data protection authority. The government answered that it cannot confirm whether personal data is processed, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (Dutch DPA) is looking into it and has jurisdiction, that the operator Exterion is itself responsible for legal compliance and has temporarily switched off the cameras, and that it sees no need to require DPA advice beyond what the law prescribes.
We do not know how many of the advertising boards referred to in the report are used by Exterion and other operators in the Netherlands, nor what data and techniques are used for this.

Het is ons niet bekend hoeveel van de in het bericht bedoelde type reclameborden worden gebruikt door Exterion en eventuele andere exploitanten in Nederland, noch welke data en technieken hiervoor worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het afsluiten van drinkwater

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether disconnecting a single mother and her three children from drinking water in Hoorn is acceptable, how often households were disconnected for water, gas and electricity, and what the government will do to prevent disconnections of vulnerable households and children. The minister acknowledged that disconnection is serious and must be avoided, announced a planned revision of the water disconnection regulation requiring a minimum water supply for four days, and otherwise defended the existing policy, declining to change the rules, to investigate the convenant, or to treat minors as vulnerable consumers.
I therefore see no reason to carry out the research you requested.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om het door u gevraagde onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over het incident bij het tankenpark van de NAM

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked about a leak of aardgascondensaat at the NAM tank park near Farmsum, its environmental and safety effects, earthquake resistance of tanks, incident history, and supervision. The government answered that SodM and ILT supervise the site, the leak was cleaned up with no reported fauna deaths, the tanks are on the priority list for earthquake-resistance review, and supervision of loading procedures is ongoing.
It is being examined whether preventive additional measures are needed in case an earthquake occurs that is stronger than any so far in the area.
Onderzocht wordt of preventief aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn voor het geval een aardbeving plaatsvindt die zwaarder is dan zich tot nu toe heeft voorgedaan in het gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de naleving van de Richtlijn Industriële Emissies (RIE) (2010/75/EU)

Mr Laçin (SP) asks about the Commission's letter on Dutch compliance with the Industrial Emissions Directive regarding the Afvaloven Nee case and the treatment of measurement uncertainty margins at the Omrin waste incinerator. The Secretary of State says the facts are unchanged, that exploitants set uncertainty margins under provincial supervision as upheld by the Council of State, that work on better and harmonised methods is ongoing, and that the Commission has not taken Netherlands to task, while promising to update guidance once better methods exist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat grond van een bungalowpark is vervuild met GenX

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that soil at a new holiday park in Papendrecht was contaminated with GenX and C8, and whether authorities should take stronger measures such as stricter permit conditions. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the contamination is consistent with earlier air-deposition findings, noted that no reuse standards yet exist for these substances, and stated that the emission permit is under legal challenge so she cannot judge the authority's conduct, while pointing to ongoing coordination and prior letters.
For that reason I cannot give a judgment on this matter.
Om die reden kan ik geen oordeel geven over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de relatie tussen Air France en KLM

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Air France KLM's plan to create a low-cost airline (Joon) would rely on weaker labour conditions, whether it would affect KLM routes and Dutch staff, and how the government reacts to a leaked report on the Air France-KLM relationship. The state secretary answered that labour terms are for employers and employees to agree within legal limits, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, that no effects on the Dutch labour market are expected, and that KLM and Air France will draw lessons from the report.
It is up to Air France KLM to decide which destinations it will fly to with the new airline Joon and to provide information about this.
Het is aan Air France KLM om te bepalen op welke bestemmingen men gaat vliegen met de nieuwe luchtvaartmaatschappij Joon en daarover informatie te geven.
