Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de berichten dat er een grote brand heeft plaatsgevonden bij de Esso-raffinaderij in het Botlekgebied

An MP asked the Minister about a large fire at the Esso refinery in the Botlek area, including the failure of the regional website, a delayed and incomplete NL-Alert, health risks and compensation for residents, and whether communication failures across recent incidents would be jointly investigated. The Minister replied that crisis communication is the responsibility of the safety region and its mayors, described the website outage and the corrected NL-Alert, said the GGD informed residents on health risks and Esso is compensating damage, and stated the region is evaluating the communication with the parties involved.
Responsibility for crisis communication lies under the Wet veiligheidsregio's with the mayor and, for incidents with regional effects, with the safety region board.

De verantwoordelijkheid voor de crisiscommunicatie ligt krachtens de Wet veiligheidsregio’s (Wvr) bij de burgemeester en, in geval van een incident met regionale effecten, bij het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het uitstel van de invoering van de Omgevingswet

An MP asked why the planned July 2019 start of the Environment and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) was postponed and reported in the media rather than to parliament, and how this squares with the minister's earlier rejection of a motion on enforceable revision permits. The minister confirmed the postponement is under review with no new date yet, said the transition end date stays 2029, and argued that existing law already allows permits to be tightened so a separate amendment is unnecessary.
As soon as there is more clarity about the new planning, both chambers will be informed about it.
Zodra er meer duidelijkheid is over de nieuwe planning, worden beide Kamers hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de aanpak van de drukte op Schiphol

An SP MP asked whether unexperienced, unarmed civilians would perform passport checks at Schiphol and how the €20 million reinforcement of the Marechaussee translates into extra staff. The government answers that border control is done by trained, armed Marechaussee, that a single unarmed military reservist is being piloted alongside an armed colleague, and that 200 extra FTE are being added from 2017/2018 with further policy options being drafted.
It is not correct that the border at Schiphol is now guarded by civilians.
Het is niet correct dat de grens op Schiphol nu bewaakt zou worden door burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de informatievoorziening rondom de incidenten bij Shell Pernis eind juli 2017

An SP MP asked the government about criticism from residents near Shell Pernis over information provided after two July 2017 incidents, including whether NL-Alert should have been used and whether causes would be shared. The state secretary answered that crisis communication lies with local and regional authorities (VRR, DCMR), that Shell and authorities used several channels, that NL-Alert was not used because no health risks were expected, and that causes will be reported to the province of Zuid-Holland which decides on disclosure.
It is up to the competent authority to share relevant information about the causes of these incidents.
Het is aan bevoegd gezag om relevante informatie omtrent de oorzaken van deze incidenten te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de berichten dat een toxicoloog meermaals alarm sloeg over gifgas bij Chemours

An MP asked the government to respond to reports that a toxicologist repeatedly warned about the toxic gas PFIB released by Chemours in Dordrecht, and to explain the health risks and detection levels. The state secretary answered that PFIB arises only as a minimal by-product, that the permit imposes strict controls and a shutdown obligation, that measured peaks stayed below RIVM norms, and described its serious inhalation health effects.

For that reason the substance has been designated a substance of very high concern, and the competent authority must impose strict requirements when granting permits to minimise risks to the surroundings.
Om die reden is de stof aangemerkt als zeer zorgwekkende stof en dient het bevoegd gezag bij vergunningverlening strenge eisen op te leggen om risico's voor de omgeving te minimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat meer mensen veteranenziekte krijgen

MP Laçin (SP) asked the minister about rising Legionnaires' disease cases, whether industrial and biological air scrubbers were investigated, the BRL 6010 revision, ILT compliance and whether a lighter inspection regime could follow. The minister said the rise has several possible causes, that research into scrubbers was limited to cases where there were indications, that BRL 6010 revision is underway, and that inspection compliance is improving.
No, the RIVM is closely monitoring developments.
Nee, het RIVM volgt de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen de vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat recent twee ernstige incidenten hebben plaatsgevonden op Schiphol

An SP MP asked the government about two reported serious incidents at Schiphol (a runway incursion involving a bird patrol and a tailstrike) and what was known about them, the status of OVV recommendations, whether the incidents were avoidable, and air traffic controller workload. The Staatssecretaris answered that investigations are ongoing, that the sector bears primary responsibility under the ILT's supervision, that a response to the OVV will follow in October, and that the ILT has not found workload to create uncontrolled risks.
The Aviation Incident Analysis Bureau (ABL) of the ILT does not conduct independent investigations into individual incidents.
Het Analyse Bureau Luchtvaartvoorvallen (ABL) van de ILT doet geen zelfstandig onderzoek naar afzonderlijke incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de ov-chipkaart op de mobiele telefoon flopt

An SP MP asked the state secretary about press reports that the OV-chip card on mobile phones had failed, the costs of the pilots, and whether the Bureau ICT Toetsing should review them. The government acknowledged the introduction was not smooth and that communication should have been better, but said the pilots are run and paid for by Translink, transport operators and banks, that no state funds are involved, and declined to refer them to the Bureau ICT Toetsing because they are not state projects.
No. The Bureau ICT Toetsing reviews large central government projects with an ICT component of more than €5 million.
Nee. Het Bureau ICT Toetsing toetst grote projecten van de rijksoverheid met een ICT-component van meer dan € 5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Futselaar over de incidenten bij Shell-Pernis

MPs Laçin and Futselaar asked the state secretary about two incidents at Shell Pernis in July 2017, including flaring, residents' odour complaints, monitoring, e-nose placement and whether an independent investigation would be held. The government answered that the company and the provincial competent authority (DCMR) are responsible, that a criminal investigation is underway, that measurements showed no health-threatening levels, and that the existing legal framework for crisis communication is adequate, while declining to draw conclusions on causes and health effects until the investigations finish.
As long as the investigations are ongoing, I cannot make statements about the causes, the connection between the incidents and the possible effects on workers and the surroundings.
Zolang de onderzoeken lopen, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de oorzaken, het verband tussen de incidenten en de mogelijke effecten voor werknemers en omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over de permanente bewoning van vakantieparken

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked the government about permanent residence on holiday parks, including the number affected, the burgemeester of Putten's call for a national approach, reviving a withdrawn bill, and provincial housing shortages. Minister Plasterk answered that no national count exists, that municipalities hold the primary responsibility, that the bill will not be revived, and gave provincial statistical housing shortage figures while noting affordability and elderly-suitable housing cannot be precisely quantified.
The municipality is responsible for its own enforcement and housing policy and therefore holds the lead role in giving shape to a solution.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen handhaving- en woonbeleid en heeft daarmee de regierol in handen om invulling te geven aan een oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over een pilot naar het besparingspotentieel bij een lagere minimumtemperatuur voor tapwater

An MP asked whether the minister still stands by the 2014 estimate that alternative legionella-prevention techniques could save considerable heat nationally, and what was done to promote pilots with suppliers, other ministries, and the SDE+ and VAMIL subsidy schemes. The minister reaffirmed the potential, reported that suppliers showed no interest in pilots and that the matter was passed to the industry body, and said a pilot could be run in a housing experiment if a supplier takes the initiative.
Following that, no proposals for carrying out pilots were received from the suppliers.
Naar aanleiding daarvan zijn er vanuit de leveranciers geen voorstellen ontvangen voor het uitvoeren van pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Laçin over oneerlijke mededinging in wegtransport

MPs Jetten and Laçin asked the minister about reports that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport struggles to keep road transport firms compliant as they devise new manipulation methods, and whether the inspectorate has enough knowledge and capacity. The minister acknowledges increasingly sophisticated manipulation, says inspectors receive ongoing training and equipment and that the ILT works with manufacturers and European partners, but gives no figures on the total scale of the problem.
Since these are targeted inspections, the number of detected manipulation cases says nothing about its total scale.
Aangezien het om gerichte inspecties gaat, zegt het aantal ontdekte gevallen van manipulatie niets over de totale omvang ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat GenX in meer drinkwater zit

MP Laçin (SP) asked the ministers how the government responds to reports that GenX has been found in drinking water at several locations, including whether permits should be tightened or a moratorium considered. The minister says concentrations are far below the provisional RIVM guideline, that the Chemours discharge is the source downstream of Dordrecht, that a court case on the permit is pending, and that research results will follow.
This is now before the court and therefore I cannot make further statements about it.
Dit ligt nu voor bij de rechter en daarom kan ik hierover nu geen nadere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat NS een miljoenenboete moet betalen

An MP asked the government about the ACM fine imposed on NS for abuse of market power in the Limburg tender, including the administrative costs, the effect on the dividend, whether the fine is tied to criminal proceedings, and whether tendering in public transport is viable. The minister answered that ACM is independent and costs are not known, the fine lowers the dividend by 35 percent, the fine is separate from criminal proceedings, and NS has taken steps to prevent recurrence with a letter promised.
ACM carried out the investigation in its responsibility as an independent administrative body (ZBO). A ZBO does not fall under the direct authority of a minister.
ACM heeft het onderzoek vanuit haar verantwoordelijkheid als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (ZBO) uitgevoerd. Een ZBO valt niet onder direct gezag van een Minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over schijnzelfstandigheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the government about alleged bogus self-employment among pilots at airlines with a Dutch base, citing VNV claims, the definition of 'home base', and comparisons with Germany. The government answered that the Tax Authority has adequate insight, that no labour-law violations were found, that the home-base definition does not affect the findings, and that no further investigation or talks with pilots are needed.
Furthermore, the inventory showed that there are no indications that labour legislation enforced under public law is being violated.
Verder is uit de inventarisatie gebleken dat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de arbeidswetgeving die publiekrechtelijk wordt gehandhaafd, wordt overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat tientallen medewerkers van het asielzoekerscentrum Ter Apel al maanden thuiszitten

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked why only parts of the former NAVO terrain at the Ter Apel asylum centre were remediated, whether soil was tested when the centre was built, and whether COA, IND and other bodies should be ordered to carry out medical research into sick staff. The State Secretary answered that earlier soil studies found no health-relevant contamination, that a recent survey found none either, that COA has set up an independent commission, and that no broader medical study is currently planned.
For now I see no reason to instruct all other bodies working in or around the asylum centre to carry out such a study.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen aanleiding om alle andere instanties die werkzaam zijn in of rondom het asielzoekerscentrum op te dragen een dergelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat Vlaanderen de binnenvaart gaat ondersteunen

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Netherlands would launch an initiative similar to Flanders' resolution promoting inland shipping, and about supporting sustainable transport. The minister said existing policy already covers these aims, citing the Goederencorridors Oost and Zuidoost study, the topsector Logistiek, and the Brandstofvisie.
The inland shipping initiatives mentioned in the article already fall within my policy.
De in het stuk genoemde binnenvaartinitiatieven passen reeds binnen mijn beleid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat Hongaarse vrachtwagenchauffeurs die voor een Nederlands transportbedrijf rijden niet betaald hoeven te worden volgens de Nederlandse cao

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether a Den Bosch appeals court ruling, that Hungarian truck drivers working for a Dutch transport firm need not be paid under the Dutch collective agreement, shows that the wage laws fail in court and whether the ruling opens the door to similar constructions, and what will be done to stop a race to the bottom. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, said equal pay for equal work remains the principle, pointed to existing laws and EU revisions, and said the case's specific facts allow no general conclusions while promising to await European Commission proposals.
As you know, I must be restrained in commenting on cases still under consideration; cassation can still be lodged against this ruling and the referring cantonal judge must still rule.

Zoals u weet moet ik terughoudend zijn uitspraken te doen over zaken die nog in behandeling zijn; tegen deze uitspraak kan nog cassatie worden ingesteld en ook moet de verwijzende kantonrechter nog uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Laçin over de ICT-storing in het systeem van Amadeus waardoor overal ter wereld reserveringssystemen voor de luchtvaart uitvielen

MPs Hijink and Laçin asked about a worldwide Amadeus reservation system outage, its cause, possible data exposure, economic damage and cybersecurity safeguards. The government answered that a local hardware fault, not a hack, caused a brief outage with no data loss, and pointed to contractual arrangements and the forthcoming NIS directive implementation.
Resolving outages is of course the responsibility of the owner of the systems concerned, such as Amadeus.
Het verhelpen van storingen is uiteraard de verantwoordelijkheid van de eigenaar van desbetreffende systemen, zoals Amadeus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de wachttijden bij het CBR oplopen

An SP MP asked the minister about rising waiting times for practical driving exams at the CBR, the causes, measures to curb them, safeguards against rijschool misuse, and a BOVAG proposal to prioritise well-performing driving schools. The minister acknowledged the overruns, attributed them to economic recovery and rule changes, described capacity expansion and booking rules, and said the CBR would advise on the BOVAG suggestion by autumn.
The CBR already recruited 60 examiners last year. This year another 60 will be added.
Het CBR heeft vorig jaar al 60 examinatoren geworven. Dit jaar komen er nog eens 60 bij

m: Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 5 over middelen voor het Klimaatfonds ten behoeve van het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie
Amendment restores 118 million euro to the Klimaatfonds in the energy budget so the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie can reopen this winter, reversing the cabinet's planned withdrawal.
With this amendment this choice of the caretaker cabinet is reversed.
Met dit amendement wordt deze keuze van het demissionaire kabinet teruggedraaid.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Stultiens en Van Oosterhout ter vervanging van nr. 4 over middelen voor het Klimaatfonds
Restores 118 million euros to the Climate Fund that the caretaker cabinet planned to withdraw in the Najaarsnota 2025, arguing there is no budgetary reason to cut it.
With this amendment this choice of the caretaker cabinet is reversed
Met dit amendement wordt deze keuze van het demissionaire kabinet teruggedraaid
Motie van de leden Van Oosterhout en Teunissen over in kaart brengen hoeveel schade de huidige mijnbouwactiviteiten toebrengen aan de natuur in de Waddenzee
Asks the government to map the damage current mining activities cause to Wadden Sea nature and assess the funding needed for compensation.
requests the government to map how much damage current mining activities cause to nature in the Wadden Sea
verzoekt de regering om in kaart te brengen hoeveel schade de huidige mijnbouwactiviteiten toebrengen aan de natuur in de Waddenzee
Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over gaswinning uit het gasveld Warffum beëindigen
Asks the government to end gas extraction from the Warffum gas field, implementing an earlier motion against new extraction there.
requests the government to implement the adopted motion by ending gas extraction from the Warffum gas field
verzoekt de regering uitvoering te geven aan de aangenomen motie door gaswinning uit het gasveld Warffum te beëindigen
Motie van de leden Van Oosterhout en Teunissen over in de Mijnbouwwet een afbouwpad voor gaswinning opnemen
Asks the government to include a phase-out path for gas extraction in the Mining Act update.
requests the government to include a phase-out path for gas extraction in the Mining Act
verzoekt de regering een afbouwpad voor gaswinning op te nemen in de Mijnbouwwet
Motie van het lid Van Oosterhout c.s. over vergunningverlening voor nieuwe mijnbouwactiviteiten in de Wadden pauzeren totdat de nieuwe Mijnbouwwet is behandeld
Asks the government to pause permitting for new mining activities in or affecting the Wadden until the new Mijnbouwwet has been treated by the House.
requests the government to pause permitting for new mining activities in or affecting the Wadden until the new Mijnbouwwet has been treated by the House
verzoekt de regering vergunningverlening voor nieuwe mijnbouwactiviteiten in, of met impact op, de Wadden te pauzeren totdat de nieuwe Mijnbouwwet door de Kamer is behandeld
Motie van het lid Teunissen c.s. over in de komende aanpassing van de Mijnbouwwet vastleggen dat mijnbouw binnen UNESCO-erfgoed niet is toegestaan
Asks the government to explicitly lay down in the upcoming Mining Act revision that mining is not permitted within UNESCO heritage sites, notably the Wadden Sea.
requests the government to explicitly establish in the upcoming amendment of the Mining Act that mining within UNESCO heritage is not permitted
verzoekt de regering om in de komende aanpassing van de Mijnbouwwet expliciet vast te leggen dat mijnbouw binnen UNESCO-erfgoed niet is toegestaan
Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over de lopende vergunningsaanvraag voor zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee afwijzen
Asks the government to reject the pending permit application for large-scale salt extraction under the Wadden Sea.
requests the government to reject the pending permit application for salt extraction under the Wadden Sea
verzoekt de regering de lopende vergunningsaanvraag voor zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee af te wijzen
Amendement van de leden Stultiens en Van Oosterhout over het afschaffen van enkele fossiele subsidies
Removes energy tax exemptions for metallurgical, mineralogical, chemical reduction and electrolytic processes, except hydrogen production, from 1 January 2026.
abolishes from 1 January 2026 the exemptions in the energy tax
schaft per 1 januari 2026 de vrijstellingen af in de energiebelasting
Amendement van de leden Stultiens en Van Oosterhout over het terugdraaien van de voorgestelde verlaging van het CO2-tarief voor broeikasgas- en lachgasinstallaties
Reverses the proposed cut in the CO2 tax rate for greenhouse gas and nitrous oxide installations, restores annual increases and indexation for 2026, and drops the reduction-factor moderation.
This amendment reverses the proposed reduction of the CO2 tariff for greenhouse gas and nitrous oxide installations and restores the annual tariff increase.
Dit amendement draait de voorgestelde verlaging van het CO 2 -tarief voor broeikasgas- en lachgasinstallaties terug en herstelt de jaarlijkse tariefstijging.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosterhout over de opname van scope 3 uitstoot in Nederlandse milieueffectbeoordelingen naar aanleiding van de recente Noorse rechtszaak hieromtrent

MP Van Oosterhout asked the minister about Norwegian and EFTA court rulings requiring scope 3 emissions in environmental impact assessments for oil and gas permits, and whether Dutch permitting should change. The minister said the rulings are still being studied, scope 3 is currently not systematically included, and results will be shared by end of Q1 2026, while noting no new gas extraction is allowed in the Wadden Sea.
By the end of the first quarter of 2026 at the latest, the results of the further analysis will be shared with the House.
Uiterlijk einde eerste kwartaal 2026 zullen de uitkomsten van de nadere analyse met de Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosterhout over het nieuws dat er een deal is gesloten tussen het kabinet en de NAM over de gaswinning bij Ternaard

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth how the deal with NAM over the Ternaard gas field was reached, how it was valued, whether it sets a precedent and what it means for other mining and the Wadden Sea. The minister answered that the deal was negotiated bilaterally, valued at 163 million euro as a market-conform transaction, withholds the negotiation records and legal advice, and promised a letter on sector agreements in January 2026.
No minutes were made of the meetings.
Van de overleggen zijn geen verslagen gemaakt.

m: Amendement van het lid Bushoff over middelen voor het opzetten van klinische studies bij post-COVID poliklinieken
Budget amendment shifting 6.3 million euro from long-term care to curative care for clinical studies on post-COVID treatment.
The budget statement is amended as follows
De begrotingsstaat wordt als volgt gewijzigd
Amendement van het lid Bushoff over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op de instellingssubsidie Ge-Bu
Amendment moves 762 thousand euro within the health budget to reverse the planned cut to the Ge-Bu drug bulletin subsidy for 2026.
This budget is freed up to reverse the announced cut to the institutional subsidy of the Ge-Bu drug bulletin for next year.
Dit budget wordt vrijgemaakt om de aangekondigde bezuiniging op de instellingssubsidie van het geneesmiddelenbulletin (Ge-Bu) voor komend jaar terug te draaien.
Motie van het lid Bushoff over de voorgenomen bezuiniging op zelfzorggeneesmiddelen niet invoeren
Asks the government not to implement the planned 70 million euro cut on over-the-counter medicines, to avoid penalising chronically ill patients.
requests the government not to implement the planned cut on self-care medicines
verzoekt de regering de voorgenomen bezuiniging op zelfzorggeneesmiddelen niet in te voeren
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op de instellingssubsidie Ge-Bu
Shifts 762,000 euro within the health budget from long-term care to curative care to reverse the planned cut to the Ge-Bu drug bulletin subsidy for 2026.
With this amendment it is proposed to add 762,000 euro to article 2 Curative Care
Met dit amendement wordt voorgesteld € 762.000 aan artikel 2 Curatieve Zorg toe te voegen
Motie van het lid Bushoff c.s. over afzien van de invoering van een eigen bijdrage in de jeugdzorg
Motion asking the government to refrain from introducing a co-payment (eigen bijdrage) in youth care.
requests the government to refrain from introducing a co-payment in youth care
verzoekt de regering af te zien van de invoering van een eigen bijdrage in de jeugdzorg
Motie van het lid Bushoff over de financiering voor longcovidklinieken zo lang als nodig continueren
Asks the government to guarantee funding for long COVID clinics beyond two years and make it part of regular Zvw insurance funding.
requests the government to guarantee funding for long COVID clinics for as long as needed
verzoekt de regering te garanderen de financiering voor longcovidklinieken zo lang als nodig te continueren
Motie van het lid Bushoff c.s. over afzien van het voornemen om de tegemoetkoming voor arbeidsongeschikten af te schaffen
Asks the government to abandon its plan to abolish the allowance for disabled people, which would cut contributions for WAO, WIA and Wajong recipients.
requests the government to abandon the plan to abolish the allowance for disabled workers
verzoekt de regering af te zien van het voornemen om de tegemoetkoming voor arbeidsongeschikten af te schaffen
Motie van het lid Westerveld c.s. over bij de nieuwe regeling het belang van patiënten en zorgverleners centraal stellen
Asks the government to put patients' and care providers' interests first in the new uninsured care scheme and ensure doctors are not burdened with extra tasks beyond their oath.
to guarantee that doctors can carry out their work in line with the oath and are not burdened with extra work
te garanderen dat artsen hun werk conform de artseneed kunnen uitvoeren en niet met extra werk belast worden
Motie van het lid Bushoff over pseudonimiseringsnormen aan de hoogste standaarden laten voldoen

regelt dat iedere gemeente, provincie en elk waterschap en openbaar lichaam voorwaarden bepaalt waaronder inwoners en maatschappelijke partijen taken van het bestuursorgaan kunnen uitvoeren
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 28 over een rechtmatigheidstoets bij de derde verlenging van de eindtermijn
Requires the supervisory division to examine the lawfulness of a minister's third consecutive extension of the deadline for bulk datasets.
This amendment provides an extra safeguard so that the supervisory division in any case subjects the third consecutive decision setting a new deadline to a lawfulness review.

Dit amendement voorziet in een extra waarborg zodat de afdeling toezicht in ieder geval bij het derde opeenvolgende besluit tot vaststelling van een nieuwe eindtermijn dat besluit nadrukkelijk aan een rechtmatigheidstoets onderwerpt.
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 29 over een extra waarborg voor gegevensdeling met buitenlandse diensten
Requires ministerial permission for sharing intercepted data with foreign intelligence services, notified to the CTIVD, with a five-day wait unless urgent.

Article 89(2) of the Wiv 2017 applies accordingly, except that the provision, barring an urgent and weighty reason, does not take place until five days after the oversight department has been informed of the permission granted.

Artikel 89, tweede lid, van de Wiv 2017 is van overeenkomstige toepassing, met dien verstande dat de verstrekking, behoudens een dringende en gewichtige reden niet eerder plaatsvindt dan vijf dagen nadat de afdeling toezicht omtrent de verleende toestemming is geïnformeerd.
Motie van de leden Bushoff en Westerveld over met een landelijke oplossing komen voor een toegankelijke tolkenvoorziening in de Jeugdwet
Asks the government to devise a national solution for accessible interpreter provision in youth care under the Jeugdwet.
requests the government to come up with a national solution for accessible interpreter provision in the Youth Act
verzoekt de regering om met een landelijke oplossing te komen voor een toegankelijke tolkenvoorziening in de Jeugdwet

Amendement van de leden Bushoff en Ellemeet over zeker stellen dat donorkinderen geïnformeerd worden over een genetische aandoening als het College niet beschikt over de contactgegevens van het donork

Clarifies in the law that providing the mother's details to the clinical geneticist aims to enable compliance with the professional guideline for actively informing at-risk relatives such as donor children.
This amendment clarifies that providing the mother's details aims to enable the clinical geneticist to comply with the guideline on informing relatives about hereditary conditions.

Met dit amendement wordt verduidelijkt dat het verstrekken van de gegevens van de moeder als doel heeft om de klinisch geneticus in staat te stellen te kunnen voldoen aan de «Richtlijn Informeren van familieleden bij erfelijke aandoeningen»
Motie van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over onderzoeken hoe het maximumaantal gezinnen ook van toepassing kan zijn op donoren die buiten de kliniek werken en hoe overtreding bestraft kan worden
Asks the government to study whether the maximum number of families for donors applies to donors working outside clinics and how such violations could be punished.
requests the government to investigate how the maximum number of families can also apply to donors working outside the clinic
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken op welke manier het maximumaantal gezinnen ook van toepassing kan zijn op donoren die buiten de kliniek werken
Amendement van de leden Bushoff en Ellemeet over een grondslag voor bewaring en verwerking van gegevens van het donorkind

Amendment creates a legal basis for the college to collect, store for at least eighty years and process data of donor-conceived children so they can be informed of their origins and donor genetic risks.
Donor children should not have to depend on their parents or care provider to obtain information about genetic conditions in their donor.
Donorkinderen zouden niet afhankelijk moeten zijn van hun ouders of zorgverlener voor het verkrijgen van informatie over genetische aandoeningen bij hun donor.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulusma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het vervallen van de leeftijdsgrenzen
Removes the age limits of 12 and 16 in the donor data act so donor-conceived persons can access donor information regardless of age.
the age limits of 12 and 16 years are to lapse
de leeftijdsgrenzen van 12 en 16 jaar komen te vervallen
Amendement van de leden Bushoff en Ellemeet over het informeren van het donorkind over erfelijke aandoeningen
Requires the executive's donor-register body to collect and keep identifying data of donor-conceived children so it can inform them of hereditary conditions.
With this amendment the College is obliged to provide the doctor with the identifying characteristics of donor children so they can be informed of a risk of a hereditary condition.
Met dit amendement wordt het College verplicht de arts de persoonsidentificerende kenmerken van donorkinderen te verstrekken om deze te kunnen informeren over een risico op een erfelijke aandoening.
Amendement van het lid Paulusma c.s. over het vervallen van de leeftijdsgrenzen
Removes the age limits of 12 and 16 in the donor data and artificial insemination law, so donor children can access donor information regardless of age.
With these proposed changes the submitters intend that the age limits of 12 and 16 years be dropped.
Met deze voorgestelde wijzigingen beogen de indieners dat de leeftijdsgrenzen van 12 en 16 jaar komen te vervallen.
Amendement van het lid van den Berg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het behouden van de wettelijke eis dat voldoende drogisten fysiek aanwezig zijn
Deletes the bill's change to the Medicines Act that would allow remote pharmacist advice, keeping the requirement that enough pharmacists be physically present.
Article III, part C, is deleted.
Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 49 over sanctiemogelijkheden voor het Huis voor klokkenluiders
Gives the Whistleblowers Authority power to impose sanctions, including orders under administrative coercion and administrative fines, on employers who harm whistleblowers.
Derde nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 50 over sanctiemogelijkheden voor het Huis voor klokkenluiders
Gives the Huis voor klokkenluiders' investigation department power to impose administrative sanctions and fines on employers who harm whistleblowers or mishandle internal reporting channels.
This amendment provides that the investigation department of the Whistleblowers Authority gets sanction powers.
Dit amendement regelt dat de afdeling onderzoek van het Huis voor klokkenluiders sanctiemogelijkheden krijgt.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 43 over sanctiemogelijkheden voor het Huis voor klokkenluiders
Gives the Huis voor klokkenluiders power to impose orders, administrative fines and sanctions on employers who mishandle internal reporting channels or retaliate against whistleblowers.
The House is authorised to impose an order under administrative coercion to enforce articles 2, 8(2), 17e or 17ea.
Het Huis is bevoegd tot oplegging van een last onder bestuursdwang ter handhaving van de artikelen 2, 8, tweede lid, 17e of 17ea.
Amendement van de leden Leijten en Bushoff ter vervanging van nr. 20 over een Fonds voor klokkenluiders

Amends the whistleblower bill to create a Whistleblower Fund providing legal and psychosocial support, with its rules set by general administrative order subject to a strong prior parliamentary review period.
A strong prior review was chosen so that parliament's democratic control over these conditions is secured.
Daarbij is er gekozen voor een «zware voorhang», zodat democratische zeggenschap van het parlement over deze voorwaarden geborgd is.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Leijten en Bushoff ter vervanging van nr. 22 over verduidelijking en verbreding van de term 'misstand'
Broadens the legal definition of 'misstand' in the whistleblower act so that serious public-interest concerns, not only those under a legal duty, qualify for protection.
This amendment provides that the definition of a misstand is clarified and broadened.
Dit amendement regelt dat de definitie van een misstand verduidelijkt en verbreed wordt.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Leijten en Bushoff ter vervanging van nr. 23 over sanctiemogelijkheden voor het Huis voor klokkenluiders
Gives the House for Whistleblowers power to impose administrative sanctions and fines on employers who obstruct or penalise reporters of wrongdoing.
The House is authorised to impose an order under administrative enforcement to enforce articles 2, 8(2), 17e or 17ea.
Het Huis is bevoegd tot oplegging van een last onder bestuursdwang ter handhaving van de artikelen 2, 8, tweede lid, 17e of 17ea.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Vliegenthart over de uitzending van Max Meldpunt Actueel aangaande ouderenmishandeling

MPs Bushoff and Vliegenthart asked the health ministry about under-reporting of elder abuse after a Max Meldpunt broadcast, including prevalence, prevention, GP detection, caregiver leave and a proposal to give Veilig Thuis court-petitioning powers. The state secretary acknowledged under-reporting, announced a Maastricht prevalence study due mid-2026, pointed to existing awareness measures, and rejected giving Veilig Thuis primary petitioner powers in court.
I do not share the view, however, that Veilig Thuis should be given more powers as primary petitioner before the court.
Ik deel de opvatting echter niet dat Veilig Thuis meer bevoegdheden als primaire verzoeker bij de rechter zou moeten krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vliegenthart en Bushoff over borstkankerscreening

MPs Vliegenthart and Bushoff asked about breast cancer screening in Zutphen, where screening was reduced amid staff shortages and cancer rates are higher. The State Secretary answered that routes were reorganised rather than units closed, staff shortages drive longer screening intervals, and access and comfort measures are being pursued.
In this case, fewer buses were not run; the route was adjusted instead.
Er zijn in dit geval niet minder bussen gaan rijden, maar de route is aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Vliegenthart over het bericht dat kraamzorg niet meer overal in Nederland gegarandeerd kan worden

MPs Bushoff and Vliegenthart asked the minister whether access to maternity care (kraamzorg) should depend on income or postcode, how many families miss out, whether private equity is causing withdrawal from deprived neighbourhoods, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says the causes are multiple and that a study and sector agreements are underway, points to NZa oversight of insurers' duty of care and planned legislation (Wibz, fusion test), and declines additional national funding for a free-care pilot in Amsterdam Zuidoost.
I am investigating which additional measures are necessary to structurally safeguard accessibility.
Ik onderzoek welke aanvullende maatregelen aanvullend noodzakelijk zijn om de toegankelijkheid structureel te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff en Armut over de gezondheid van scholieren na één van de zwaarste aardbevingen in Groningen

MPs Beckerman, Bushoff and Armut asked the State Secretary for the Interior about a report on the effects of gas-extraction earthquakes on Groningen schoolchildren's health, the pace of reinforcement and damage repair, restoring trust in government, mental health support, youth participation, and long-term monitoring. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to the school reinforcement programme, the Social Agenda, the equalisation of immaterial damage compensation for children, participatory youth projects and longitudinal research, while committing to further information in January 2026.
That is why I consider projects such as 'Lang verhaal kort' by the IMG important.
Daarom vind ik projecten zoals « Lang verhaal kort » van het IMG belangrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over afwijzingen bij subsidieregelingen

An MP asked whether residents whose subsidy applications for Groningen insulation and ventilation measures were rejected for lacking a written quote, despite meeting the conditions, were being treated fairly and in the spirit of Nij Begun. The minister confirmed rejections occur mainly for missing invoices or proof of payment or work ordered before the 25 April 2023 start date, with 874 of 7,427 processed applications rejected and about 31% of rejections appealed.
There is no specific insight into how often an application is submitted with a verbal quote.
Er is niet specifiek zicht op hoe vaak het voorkomt dat een aanvraag wordt ingediend met een mondelinge offerte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de immateriële schaderegeling tussen DeHaan en de NAM

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked the State Secretary about the immaterial damage settlement between DeHaan and NAM and why IMG's own scheme scores poorly, asking whether it creates unfair differences and whether it will be revised. The State Secretary welcomed the settlement, said IMG's scheme was carefully designed and court-tested, expects a loss-of-living-enjoyment scheme around 2027, and declined to ask IMG to revise its scheme.
I will not ask the IMG to revise the scheme.
Ik ga het IMG niet vragen de regeling te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Bushoff en Slagt- Tichelman over het bericht dat gemeenten zorgondernemers nauwelijks op criminaliteit toetsen

MPs Westerveld, Bushoff and Slagt-Tichelman asked the state secretary about reports that municipalities rarely screen care providers for criminal links under the Bibob Act, and about the size of care fraud and measures taken. The state secretary acknowledged limited use of Bibob by municipalities, said the size of fraud cannot be reliably estimated, pointed to pilot projects and a DUS-I review due end 2025, and promised a progress update this autumn.
Yes, I recognise the picture that municipalities to date make limited use of the possibilities offered by the Bibob Act to screen care providers.

Ja, ik herken het beeld dat gemeenten tot op heden beperkt gebruik maken van de mogelijkheden die de Wet Bevordering integriteitsbeoordelingen door het openbaar bestuur (Wet Bibob) biedt om zorgaanbieders te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over onnodig lang hogere verzekeringspremie na kankergenezing

MP Bushoff asks whether the 10-year maximum disclosure period under the schone-lei scheme for cancer survivors' insurance applications is still adequate, given research showing survival similar to peers after about four years, and whether it should be shortened or differentiated by age. The minister answers that the scheme is an important instrument, that terms are set jointly by patient federation and insurers, that the table was last revised in January 2025 and gives shorter terms for some cancers and young patients, and that he will consult stakeholders again on whether further age differentiation is warranted, without committing to a specific cut.
I will again enter into consultation in the coming period with the patient organisations, insurers and any other stakeholders.
Ik zal de komende tijd opnieuw in overleg treden met de patiëntenorganisaties, verzekeraars en eventuele andere betrokkenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over ‘therapie voor kinderen met uitputtingsziekte ME/CVS in twijfel getrokken’

MP Bushoff asked the Minister of Health about reports questioning cognitive behavioural therapy for children with ME/CVS, including concerns from parents and reported Veilig Thuis notifications. The Minister answered that treatment is a matter for medical professionals and Samen Beslissen applies, referred most questions to the medical field or other bodies, and pointed to ZonMw-funded research and encouraged constructive dialogue.
As Minister, I do not decide on the diagnosis or treatment of patients; that is the domain of the physician.
Als Minister ga ik niet over de diagnose of de behandeling van patiënten, dat is het werkdomein van de arts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Patijn, Bikker en Saris over de vertraging van het UWV-onderzoek naar de beoordeling van post-COVID-patiënten

MPs asked why the UWV study into how post-COVID patients were assessed for WIA benefits was delayed, and what is being done about knowledge gaps among insurance physicians and the duration-capacity standard. The minister acknowledged the delay, said the study is expected to finish in September, outlined a handbook and casuistry being developed with the NVVG, and rejected the view that the problem is structurally underestimated.
I regret that the study has been delayed.
Ik betreur dat het onderzoek vertraging heeft opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het bericht 'Vledder laat zich bijpraten over plannen gaswinning: 'Kansrijk om in beroep te gaan''

MP Bushoff asked the government about residents' concerns over a planned gas extraction near Vledder, including who is affected, consultation, a poll, the municipality's position, legal recourse and compensation. The minister answered that the ministry is bound by legal frameworks, residents are informed and consulted at formal and informal moments, the permit cannot be refused on political grounds, and compensation for subsidence damage is handled by the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, which takes over the burden of proof.
The cabinet is not willing to hold a survey, because its outcome cannot be decisive for the decision-making.
Het kabinet is niet bereid een enquete te houden, omdat de uitkomst daarvan niet doorslaggevend kan zijn voor de besluitvorming.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de berichten ‘Patiënten met een darmontsteking staan maanden op wachtlijsten: onverantwoord’ en ‘Manon wachtte 7 maanden op darmoperatie: impact van darmziekte wordt onderschat

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the health minister about reports of long waiting times (about 22 weeks on average) for surgery for chronic bowel inflammation (IBD) patients, versus the 7-week Treeknorm, and about registration, oversight and possible action. The minister acknowledged the problem and the concern, but said she has no insight into the number of affected patients, placed responsibility on providers, insurers and the NZa rather than the IGJ, pointed to existing agreements and a registry being developed by the medical society, and saw no further role for herself.
I have no insight into these specific numbers.
Ik heb geen inzicht in deze specifieke aantallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de berichten 'Grond schudt in Warffum door beving met kracht van 2.1: 'Dreun en trillingen door het hele huis'' en 'Hartenkreet van actievoerders om gaswinning Wa

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked about a 2.1 earthquake in Warffum and protests against continued gas extraction from the small Warffum field, pointing to SodM's refusal to tolerate extraction and the province's and municipality's appeal. The Minister answers that extraction can proceed safely based on TNO, SodM and Mijnraad advice, that the seismic risk management plan was tightened with an earlier shutdown threshold, that a Council of State interim ruling allowed resumption, and that no meeting with residents is planned.
SodM did not reject the extraction plan. In its advice on the extraction plan, SodM stated that extraction can technically take place safely.
SodM heeft het winningsplan niet afgewezen. SodM heeft in het advies op het winningsplan aangegeven dat de winning technisch veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over het bericht 'Wanhoop groot in versterkingsgebied: fouten in zeker 213 versterkingsdossiers'

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked about a Pointer report finding errors in 213 reinforcement files in Groningen and the government's handling of building and report errors. The State Secretary says ACVG found no errors affecting safety verdicts in regular assessments, but commits to NCG re-checking all assessments, extra building supervision, a one-government approach and a aftercare desk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over gedupeerde Groningers die nog wachten op compensatie voor de eigen gemaakte kosten bij de versterking

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked why Groningen residents who paid their own money for reinforcement works are still waiting for compensation or are being rejected, and whether the motion-Beckerman/Nijboer is being implemented properly. The State Secretary answers that a NCG reporting point is analysing claims with municipalities, that many rejections rest on the view that residents already received enough budget, that some older NAM/CVW settlements cannot be reopened except under the hardship clause, and that remedies for Batch 1588 rent-related exclusions are being explored with a report promised in autumn.
I will address the status of this investigation in more detail in my progress letter ahead of the committee debate on 2 July.
Ik zal in mijn voortgangsbrief voorafgaand aan het commissiedebat van 2 juli aanstaande nader ingaan op de stand van zaken van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Lahlah en Bushoff over de vergoeding van hulpmiddelen aan kinderen

MPs asked whether children's basic necessities and healthcare aids, such as incontinence material, glasses, braces and special learning materials, are being left to charities and whether insurers and municipalities are failing to cover them. The Minister says the government knows of rising requests, points to the basic insurance rules, municipal responsibilities and ongoing work on child glasses, but largely defers responsibility to insurers, schools and municipalities.
I consider it important that children have access to sufficient incontinence material when they need it due to a medical indication or disability.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat kinderen toegang hebben tot voldoende incontinentiemateriaal als ze die vanwege een medische indicatie of beperking nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over de vertraging bij de versterking en problemen met de schadeafhandeling en de psychosociale problemen als gevolg daarvan

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff ask the State Secretary about delays in reinforcement and damage settlement in Groningen, the psychosocial harm this causes, and related concerns including construction defects, IMG procedures, NAM-era settlements and compensation. The State Secretary answers that the timeline is being managed through NCG plans and diepteanalyse, acknowledges longer processing times, points to existing and planned measures (Nij Begun, psychosocial funding, bewonersbegeleiders), and in many cases defers details or promises further information before summer.
I cannot go into the precise situation and the solution being worked on.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de precieze situatie en de oplossing waar aan wordt gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Bushoff over de oproep van Stichting Donorkind tot persoonlijk geïnformeerd worden vanwege overschrijdingen aantal donorkinderen per donor

MPs Paulusma and Bushoff asked the state secretary about donor-limit breaches in Dutch fertility clinics and whether affected donor children, mothers and donors would be contacted personally, plus steps against cross-border donation. The state secretary confirmed 85 donors exceeded the 25-offspring guideline, said clinics and the CdkB are responsible for communication, promised a faciliterende role, and described the new Wdkb monitoring and planned BRP authorisations, while declining to know cross-border donor use.
The clinics and the CdkB are responsible for communication towards all those involved.
De klinieken en het Cdkb zijn verantwoordelijk voor de communicatie richting alle betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over problemen met de Persoonlijke Gezondheidsomgeving (PGO)

MP Bushoff asks the minister about the troubled Persoonlijke Gezondheidsomgeving (PGO) patient record system, including the redesigned tender, supplier bankruptcies, and spending. The minister acknowledges delays, explains the new regulatory approach, and answers most questions while promising a new public overview service.
In addition, I am working on improving awareness of the PGO in close cooperation with the Patient Federation of the Netherlands.
Daarnaast werk ik aan het verbeteren van de bekendheid van de PGO in nauwe samenwerking met de Patiëntenfederatie Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over een betere glucosesensor die niet vergoed wordt

Bushoff asks why closed-loop glucose sensors are not reimbursed for all diabetes patients, whether cost and benefit justify this, and whether DIY closed loop risks are known. Minister Agema answers that reimbursement depends on individual medical need and the Zorginstituut indication criteria, that long-term studies are lacking, and that DIY systems are undesirable.
It is up to the healthcare provider, in consultation with the patient, to indicate the medical necessity for a rt-CGM sensor.
Het is aan de zorgverlener om in overleg met de patiënt de medische noodzaak voor een rt-CGM-sensor aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het omzeilen van de wet door webwinkels die medicijnen verkopen

MP Bushoff asks the Health Minister about online shops selling prescription medicines without a prescription, foreign doctors prescribing without patient contact, the KNMP's earlier calls for law changes, IGJ's responsibility, online pharmacies, and IGJ capacity. The minister answers that online prescribing is desirable if good care is provided, that IGJ acts against illegal sales and has closed sites, that existing law suffices, that a clarification of professional norms for pharmacists is asked from the KNMP, and that IGJ has sufficient capacity.
The IGJ is currently investigating this. If it turns out that quality and safety are insufficient, the IGJ will take action against it.
De IGJ doet hier momenteel onderzoek naar. Wanneer blijkt dat de kwaliteit en veiligheid onvoldoende zijn zal de IGJ hiertegen optreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de berichten ‘Groningen schrikt wakker van aardbeving (2.2) bij Usquert: 'Het bed schudde'’, ‘Verzoek NAM om gas te winnen in Warffum afgewezen’ en ‘toezichthoude

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked about an earthquake near Usquert, the controversial extension of gas extraction at Warffum, and reports that the SodM supervisor had changed its advice. The government answered that the Warffum decision was taken after advice from TNO, SodM and the Mijnraad, that no new SodM advice exists, and that SodM's refusal to tolerate continued extraction was its own competence.
These advisers indicate that the extraction can take place safely.
Deze adviseurs geven aan dat de winning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over de versterkingsrapporten die gedupeerde Groningers krijgen

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked the State Secretary about reports of serious errors in Groningen earthquake reinforcement assessments and whether residents can trust that homes judged safe are safe, and asked about follow-up on SodM findings, the Van Geel report, and an amendment on appeal rights and legal aid. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to a two-track approach (NCG resident dialogue and independent ACVG research into the quality of assessments), declined to say whether homes were wrongly labelled safe pending that research, and described steps on legal aid and the amendment's implementation.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the independent investigation before answering that.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onafhankelijke onderzoek daarvoor af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over het uitsluiten triple glas en kozijnen bij isolatiesubsidie 'maatregel 29’ van Nij Begun

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked why triple glazing and window frames were excluded from the Groningen insulation subsidy (maatregel 29) and why this fits earlier promises of full subsidy. The minister answers that these measures are not necessary to reach the insulation standard, grants 50% or 100% retroactive coulance for those who already invested, and offers 30% under ISDE for new applications.
We have listened carefully to the responses to the internet consultation and have adjusted and supplemented the scheme on this point.
Wij hebben goed geluisterd naar de reacties op de internetconsultatie en de regeling op dit punt aangepast en aangevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over opnamestops op SEH’s door de overbelasting van ziekenhuizen

MP Bushoff asked the health minister about emergency-department intake stops caused by hospital overload, including risks to patients, the rising demand from ageing, and the effect of planned long-term care cuts. The minister answered that SEH-stops are a logistical tool to redirect patients, that regional coordination and transfer improvements are underway, and that staffing shortages are the top priority, though she gave no overview of patients waiting for follow-up care and no specific new commitment on SEH staffing.
I do not have an overview of patients in hospitals who are waiting for follow-up care outside the hospital.
Ik heb geen overzicht van patiënten in ziekenhuizen die wachten op vervolgzorg buiten het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de mogelijke sluiting van de buitenpolikliniek van het Medisch Spectrum Twente in Haaksbergen

MPs Bushoff asked the Minister of Health about the possible closure of the Medisch Spectrum Twente outpatient clinic in Haaksbergen and the concerns of GPs, residents and elderly patients about access. The minister answered that no final decisions have been taken, that the hospital is exploring reorganisation with consultation of residents and GPs, and that the hospital board, with insurers, must decide how care is organised.
It is up to the hospital to shape this process carefully, together with the insurer, and to involve all relevant parties.
Het is aan het ziekenhuis om dit proces – samen met de verzekeraar – zorgvuldig vorm te geven en alle relevante partijen te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over passend onderwijs aan kinderen met Long COVID en andere infectieziekten

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Health about schooling for children with Long COVID and other infections causing severe energy limitation, including lack of understanding, inadequate support, school ventilation and remote learning. The government answered that data on affected children are limited, it is investing in research, information and tailored education options, and is preparing legislation to expand flexible and digital schooling.
My goal is for digital distance learning to become a full part of the passend onderwijs system.
Mijn doel is dat digitaal afstandsonderwijs een volwaardig onderdeel wordt van het stelsel van passend onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over het verdwijnen van de restitutiepolis en de gevolgen voor ggz-patiënten

MPs Westerveld and Bushoff asked about the disappearance of restitution policies for mental health care and the effects on patients, including waiting lists and contracting. The minister answered that insurers may replace these policies with in-kind combination policies with a one-year transition period, and that insurers' own decisions and contracting are outside her direct control while the NZa supervises the duty of care.
However, it is not for me to change this decision by health insurers; health insurers themselves determine which policies they offer and which they do not.
Het is echter niet aan mij om iets aan dit besluit van zorgverzekeraars te veranderen; zorgverzekeraars bepalen zelf welke polissen zij aanbieden en welke niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de zorgelijke situatie van het ziekenhuislandschap in Friesland

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the strained accessibility of Frisian hospitals in light of the Gupta report and plans to reduce four hospitals to three, including staffing, acute care and finances. The Minister says the government will reform hospital financing and that the closure decision rests with providers and insurers under statutory procedures, with IGJ and NZa supervising, and promises a handreiking for regions and continued close monitoring.
I will continue to critically monitor the research into the feasibility of the Frisian plans.
Het onderzoek naar de haalbaarheid van de Friese plannen zal ik kritisch blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de aangespannen arbitragezaak tegen de Staat van ExxonMobil

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked the government about ExxonMobil's new arbitration claim against the Dutch state over the Groningen gas field closure, including whether talks with Shell and ExxonMobil would continue, whether the companies should pay for Groningen damage and the ereschuld, and whether levies on NAM could be widened. The minister answered that talks are under review and will not resume without prior notice to parliament, that the arbitration does not affect damage settlement, that levies on NAM are constrained by the constitution and ECHR, and that the answers were delayed.
The talks will not be resumed without informing the House in advance.
De gesprekken zullen niet hervat worden zonder de Kamer hierover vooraf te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over diverse post-COVID problematieken

An MP asks the ministers of health and social affairs about post-COVID problems: unfamiliarity and missing guidelines at agencies, Wajong eligibility for young people, bijstand rules, municipal Wmo support, occupational physicians' knowledge, and self-employed workers' income loss. The government answers that it funds research, guidelines and expertise centres, notes Wajong reassessment routes and fallback benefits, and sees no need for specific policy changes beyond ongoing knowledge-building with the VNG and C-support.
The cabinet regrets that post-COVID is still a (too) unknown condition to make a proper assessment during an investigation under the Wmo 2015.
Het kabinet betreurt het dat post-COVID nog een (te) onbekende aandoening is om tijdens een onderzoek in het kader van de Wmo 2015 een goede afweging te maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff, Kröger, Bamenga en Teunissen over een werkbezoek van Tweede Kamerleden aan Drenthe

MPs from SP, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66 and PvdD asked the government about damage handling for Groningen gas-extraction damage in Drenthe, including the vibration tool, expert independence, the presumption of causation, and the Norg gas storage and Schoonebeek projects. The government answered that improvements are underway, that the presumption of causation covers the Norg area, that the Raad van State ruling is under review, and that it will monitor implementation costs and review the Schoonebeek consultation process.
The cabinet considers it important to emphasise that the cabinet only consents if gas extraction can take place safely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om te benadrukken dat het Kabinet alleen instemt als de gaswinning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het bericht ‘Ingrijpen bij Co-Med bleef uit na waarschuwingen over wanbestuur’

An MP asked the Minister of Health why supervisors, inspectorates, prosecutors and insurers did not intervene for years at Co-Med despite warnings of fraud and mismanagement, and whether insurers' fear of collapse made the chain 'too big to fail'. The Minister answered that an evaluation with the IGJ and NZa is underway, acknowledged the insurers' concern about continuity of care, and pointed to planned legislation (Wmg, Wibz) and stronger NZa powers.
A situation like Co-Med must not happen again. That is why I am having what happened here evaluated.
Een situatie als met Co-Med mag niet meer voorkomen. Daarom laat ik evalueren wat hier gebeurd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en De Hoop over de hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Bushoff and De Hoop asked about high hospital parking fees, public transport access for low-income patients, parking outsourcing, and the Rover report on hospital accessibility. Minister Agema answered that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, pointed to existing transport and tax schemes, and committed only to forwarding the Rover report to sector bodies.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de compensatieregeling voor zorgmedewerkers met post-COVID

An MP asked the health minister why the post-COVID compensation scheme for care workers excludes those infected after 2020, whether the hardship clause could be used, how many applications were filed, granted or rejected, and why other essential workers are not covered. The minister answered that the cutoff is needed for legal consistency, the scheme is a gesture of recognition rather than compensation, employers are primarily liable, and figures on applications and budget are given, with a technical briefing planned.
Adopting this scheme is only possible with an objective delineation of the target group.
Het treffen van deze regeling is alleen mogelijk met een objectieve afbakening van de doelgroep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Bushoff over de stand van zaken omtrent seksuele gezondheid in Nederland

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Bushoff asked about the state of sexual health in the Netherlands, including falling condom and pill use, rising STIs, access to STI testing and PrEP, HPV vaccination, and sexual misconduct prevention. State Secretary Karremans answered largely by describing existing and planned measures, committing to a study of condom-promoting interventions and a review of the ASG subsidy, while declining to commit to reinstating Vrij Veilig campaigns yet.
I aim to inform the House early next year about the steps I will take to revise the system.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer begin volgend jaar te informeren over de stappen die ik ga zetten om te komen tot een herziening van het stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Bushoff en Kröger over gaswinning nabij de Wadden

MPs Chakor, Bushoff and Kröger asked about the gas drilling at field N05-A near the Wadden Sea, including the suspended German cable permit, alternatives to the cable, biodiversity impacts and UNESCO risks. The minister answered that ONE-Dyas is seeking an amended permit, that no alternative powering the platform is feasible in time, that the project is judged not to significantly affect the Wadden Sea, and that ONE-Dyas will proceed with preparatory work regardless of pending procedures.
The goal is still to be able to produce the first natural gas this winter.
Het doel is nog steeds om deze winter het eerste aardgas te kunnen produceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Bushoff over de ziekenhuiszorg in Curaçao

Two MPs asked the State Secretary and Minister about the financial distress of Curaçao Medical Center, the continuity and access of healthcare on Curaçao, and what Dutch support is available. The government answered that healthcare is Curaçao's responsibility, that Curaçao has not requested or used offered Dutch support, and that a supplementary financing package and structural reforms are planned.
I do not have sufficient information to make a full assessment of this.
Ik beschik niet over voldoende informatie om een volledige inschatting hiervan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Paulusma over de dreiging op een moedwillige uitbraak van het MPOX-virus door een agressor

MPs Bushoff and Paulusma asked the Minister of Health what underpins the claimed threat of deliberate spread of the mpox virus by an aggressor, and whether supporting documents exist and whether the threat has changed since the stockpile was built. The Minister corrects the framing to smallpox, says there is no specific threat of deliberate mpox spread, refers to the 2022 national security risk analysis for bioweapon threats, and states Dutch preparedness includes smallpox vaccine stocks and guidance on anthrax and plague.
Other services are responsible for assessing whether such a threat exists.
Voor een inschatting over het bestaan van een dergelijke dreiging zijn andere diensten verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Bushoff over het vogelgriepvirus dat overspringt van koeien op mensen

MPs Bromet and Bushoff asked the government about bird flu jumping from cows to humans, its receptor binding in human airways, and whether dense livestock farming in the Netherlands increases mutation and spread risks. Minister Wiersma answered that risks cannot be quantified, that no cow infections are known in the Netherlands, and that structural measures on poultry farms are still under impact analysis with results expected in 2025.
I expect the results of these analyses in the second quarter of 2025.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van deze analyses in het tweede kwartaal van 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Bushoff over het besluit van Nederland om vooralsnog niet in te gaan op de oproep van de WHO om mpox-vaccins naar Afrika te sturen

MPs Hirsch and Bushoff asked why the Netherlands is not donating mpox vaccines to Africa despite WHO's call and the international emergency, and how the risk trade-off was made. The Minister replies that the Netherlands keeps its national stockpile of about 100,000 doses, cannot donate because of its national safety buffer and expiring stock, and contributes EUR 3 million to WHO's response plan instead.
I am currently not making vaccines available for donation to other countries, because the stock in the Netherlands would then fall below the national safety buffer.
Ik stel op dit moment geen vaccins beschikbaar voor donatie aan andere landen, omdat de voorraad in Nederland daarmee onder de nationale veiligheidsbuffer zou zakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Chakor over de gaswinning boven Schiermonnikoog

MPs Bushoff and Chakor asked why the N05-A gas extraction permit above Schiermonnikoog was granted despite earlier refusal, why ONE-Dyas may proceed while appeals are pending, and about compensation, German permits and fossil-fuel planning. The minister answered that the permits were repaired after court rulings on nitrogen and harbour porpoise, that interim relief lifted the suspension so production can proceed pending appeal, and that the project is justified by supply security and lower emissions.
On 18 April 2024 the Hague District Court ruled that the environmental permit for the platform was insufficiently substantiated on two aspects and annulled the permit on those two points.
Op 18 april 2024 heeft de Rechtbank Den Haag geoordeeld dat de omgevingsvergunning voor het platform op twee aspecten onvoldoende onderbouwd is en heeft de vergunning op deze twee punten vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Gabriëls en Thijssen over het bericht ‘145 euro meer kwijt aan zorg bij zware industrie in de buurt: grote bezorgdheid bij experts’

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether they were concerned that residents near heavy industry face higher healthcare costs, why those costs are high, and what the government will do about health risks from industry. The government acknowledges industry can affect residents' health but says healthcare costs depend on many factors, points to ongoing studies and the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, and declines a new expert group and a large-scale costs study for now.
It is understandable that residents of these areas may be alarmed by this article, but there is a caveat to be made.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de inwoners van deze gebieden kunnen schrikken van dit artikel, maar er is hier ook een opmerking naast te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Bushoff over de problemen bij het aanvragen van de financiële ondersteuning voor zorgmedewerkers met post-COVID

MPs Dijk (SP) and Bushoff (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Health about problems healthcare workers with post-COVID face applying for the one-off financial support, including slow DUS-I handling, missed objection deadlines, lost-looking documents and difficulty obtaining medical statements. Minister Agema largely acknowledges the problems and some delays while defending the scheme, saying the second application round is better resourced and that the Regeling was amended to address earlier gaps.
To my regret, the processing period for these objection cases has in many cases been exceeded.
Tot mijn spijt is de behandeltermijn van deze bezwaarzaken in veel gevallen wel overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de overdracht van patiëntendossiers door de curator van Co-Med

MP Bushoff asked the health minister about the handover of patient files after the bankruptcy of Co-Med, which left a new GP in Breezand unable to access records, and whether such transfers can be enforced. The minister answered that the IGJ imposed enforcement on Co-Med, a 21 August agreement with insurers and curators provides for bulk transfer once a successor practice is agreed, and current law is sufficient, with patients able to request individual files.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) imposed enforcement on 27 June 2024 to arrange the transfer of patient files.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) heeft op 27 juni 2024 bestuursdwang opgelegd om de overdracht van patiëntendossiers te regelen
Antwoord op van de leden Bushoff en Patijn over het bericht ‘Erkenning van longcovid voor WIA-uitkering gaat vaak mis: “Beoordeling bij driekwart van de patiënten onvoldoende”

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked whether incorrectly prepared long-COVID WIA disability assessments by UWV, reported as unsound in about 75% of a preliminary sample, are acceptable and what remedies exist. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the sample is not representative, announced a follow-up study by UWV expected by year-end, and outlined training and capacity measures, while not committing to reopening decisions.
Because the preliminary study is not a representative sample, UWV is starting a follow-up study.
Omdat het vooronderzoek geen representatieve steekproef betreft, start UWV een vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het bericht ‘Faillissement dreigt nu ook voor zorg-bv huisartsenketen Co-Med’

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the threatened bankruptcy of the GP chain Co-Med, its effect on patient access, and whether private profit conflicts with quality of care and whether merger control should be tightened. The Minister says the insurers have terminated contracts, an alternative offer is in place, the IGJ imposed a penalty order, and the government will broaden the grounds for blocking concentrations.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Bushoff en Bikker over het bericht ‘Overheid wilde vooral niet te veel uitgeven aan compensatie ‘zorghelden’ met long covid’

MPs Dijk, Bushoff and Bikker asked whether the government deliberately limited compensation for healthcare workers with long COVID to contain costs, and why the claim process was so burdensome and so few were compensated. The minister answers that the scheme was a gesture of recognition rather than driven by cost or litigation, acknowledges the application process was strict, and announces a reopened application window with a higher amount and wider sick-leave period.
The cost aspect never played a central role in this.
Het kostenaspect heeft hierbij nooit vooropgestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Bushoff over gasboring in de Waddenzee

Two MPs from GroenLinks/PvdA asked the government why it cannot refuse the NAM's gas production drilling at Ternaard under the Waddenzee, citing the NAM's track record, the Mijnbouwwet grounds for refusal and withdrawal, and the UNESCO World Heritage status. The state secretary answered that existing permits cannot be refused under article 9, that withdrawal under article 21 is limited by property protection under ECHR Protocol 1, that article 36 grounds are limited, and that a decision on the winningsplan is still pending after new subsidence advice.
Withdrawing a production permit can, however, only take place if the requirements of Article 1 of the First Protocol of the European Convention on Human Rights are met.
Intrekken van een winningsvergunning kan echter alleen als is voldaan aan artikel 1 van het Eerste Protocol van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over oliewinning onder Rotterdam

A GroenLinks-PvdA MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the status of gas extraction under Rotterdam, the appeal by the city of Rotterdam to the Council of State, subsidence, residents' information, and revenue sharing. The State Secretary said the appeal is pending, promised to talk with residents and asked NAM to improve information, but declined substantive comment on the pending case and refused to propose a revenue redistribution, calling that a political choice for a new cabinet.
Since this appeal case is still before the court, I cannot go into the substance of the appeal petition and my defence further.
Nu deze beroepszaak nog onder de rechter is, kan ik verder niet inhoudelijk ingaan op de inhoud van het beroepschrift en mijn verweer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Kröger, Bromet en Thijssen over het Akkoord voor de Noordzee

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about Greenpeace leaving the North Sea Consultation, gas extraction acceleration versus the Paris Agreement, and delays in closing parts of the North Sea to bottom trawling. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the government stays within Paris-aligned targets, that accelerated extraction only shifts production forward in time, and that the 2023 trawling closure target was missed but will be pursued via an EU procedure with a proposal by end 2024.
I have told the NZO that our aim is to submit the joint recommendation (to reach 13.7%) to the European Commission by the end of 2024.
Ik heb aan het NZO aangegeven dat onze inzet is om de gezamenlijke aanbeveling (om te komen tot 13,7%) uiterlijk eind 2024 bij de Europese Commissie in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff over compensatie van gedupeerden die eigen geld hebben moeten inleggen voor de versterking of sloop-nieuwbouw van hun woning

MPs Beckerman and Bushoff asked about residents who paid their own money for Groningen house reinforcement or demolition-rebuilding and are still waiting for compensation, including the NCG complaint point, numbers, timing, payment method and confusion between NCG and municipalities.
