The Secretary of State answers that 186 reports totaling over eleven million euros have been received, individual assessment of first reports is done, Batch 1588 cases take longer, and the NCG will handle them with municipalities.
I have asked the NCG to take on the handling of these reports jointly with the municipalities.
Ik heb de NCG gevraagd gezamenlijk met de gemeenten de uitvoering van deze meldingen ter hand te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de ongelijkheid voor bewoners van de Stadsweg in Ten Boer

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked why residents of the Stadsweg in Ten Boer are treated unequally in reinforcement and insulation compared to neighbours, and whether the government will fix this. The State Secretary says a full insulation subsidy up to 40,000 euro with retroactive effect applies, that the municipality and NCG will address remaining differences via area-based planning, and that no parties are blocking a solution.
I will inform your House soon in more detail about the progress on this motion.
Ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort nader informeren over de voortgang op deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt- Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs asked the health minister about top salaries of healthcare executives, including interim managers exceeding WNT pay norms, unenforced expense-disclosure rules in the Governancecode Zorg, and whether a statutory duty or lobbying-register reform should apply. The minister said the WNT norms rightly apply by status rather than appointment form, that she prefers talks with sector bodies before legislating on expense transparency, and that a lobbying-register letter is forthcoming.
I will first talk with the BoZ, NVZ, NVZD and NVTZ to see how transparency around declarations can be promoted.
Ik ga eerst met de BoZ, NVZ, NVZD en NVTZ in gesprek om te kijken hoe transparantie rondom declaraties bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de druk op de spoedeisende hulpafdelingen in Friesland

An MP asked the health minister about frequent emergency department admission stops in Friesland, their effect on access to care, and the planned merger of hospitals in Sneek and Heerenveen. The minister said SEH stops are a logistical tool, that no worrying access signals currently exist, and that the RIVM accessibility analysis does not cover care networks, which falls to the regional body.
The LNAZ does not provide an overview at the level of provinces or individual hospitals.
Het LNAZ verstrekt geen overzicht op het niveau van provincies of individuele ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Bromet en Bushoff over het rapport ‘De Europees- en Internationaalrechtelijke status van de Waddenzee’

Opposition MPs Chakor, Bromet and Bushoff asked the government about the Waddenacademie report on the European and international legal status of the Wadden Sea, including whether the Ternaard gas extraction permit was tested against World Heritage obligations and the fragmentation of Wadden Sea governance. The Minister replied that the report is still being studied, that the permit is assessed under the Nature Conservation Act with only indirect World Heritage considerations, and that the landsadvocaat's advice cannot be shared because it could harm the state's litigation position.
I cannot share this advice with you now, because it could harm the position of the state in any future legal proceedings.
Dit advies kan ik nu niet met u delen, omdat dit de positie van de staat in een eventueel proces zou kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de aangespannen arbitragezaak tegen de Staat van Shell en ExxonMobil

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked the state secretary about the arbitration launched by Shell and ExxonMobil against the Dutch state, whether it could slow Groningen damage settlement and reinforcement, the costs of billing the companies, and whether other means exist to make them pay. The government answered that the arbitration does not affect damage handling or reinforcement, that the NAM has paid all damage invoices but about half of the reinforcement bill remains unpaid, and that it is still studying the arbitration's effect on talks and the options for a broader levy, to return to parliament soon.
I can assure you that the discussions between the NAM or Shell and ExxonMobil about the costs have no effect whatsoever on the implementation of the damage settlement and reinforcement operation.
Ik kan u verzekeren dat de discussies tussen de NAM of Shell en ExxonMobil over de kosten geen enkel effect hebben op de uitvoering van de schadeafhandeling en versterkingsoperatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked about high executive pay in healthcare, including a UMC Maastricht board chair above the WNT pay cap, interim manager exemptions, and municipal leverage over pay. The minister defended the exemption mechanism, said data on sector-wide pay totals and jeugdzorg management costs are not kept, and noted only seven exemptions were granted in healthcare.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over de afname van het aantal restitutiepolissen

MPs Westerveld and Bushoff asked the health minister about the decline in restitution health insurance policies, the effects on GGZ and district nursing care, contracting transparency and patient protection. The minister answered that the number of restitution policies fell from 25 in 2010 to 4 in 2024, attributed mainly to high declared costs, and defended natura and combination policies while promising improved contracting information via NZa.
The NZa will evaluate the contracting process for 2024.
De NZa zal het contracteerproces voor 2024 evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het besluit van Leiden, Amsterdam en Utrecht om hun kinderhartzorg te concentreren

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether he was aware of and how he judged the plan by Leiden, Amsterdam and Utrecht to concentrate paediatric heart care, and whether a three-centre option remained open given new US research on volume norms. The minister said he learned of the plan from media and a press release, reaffirmed concentration at two sites (Groningen and Rotterdam), rejected a three-centre option on structural grounds, and stated Groningen must stay open for acute care.
VWS was not informed in advance of this.
VWS is hier niet van te voren over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de verschaling van zorg in de Mijnstreek

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the planned reorganisation of acute care at Zuyderland hospital in Heerlen, including the risk of losing the SEH, promises made when Brunssum and Kerkrade lost their facilities, local influence under the AMvB acute care, ambulance response times, NZa oversight, and workforce planning. The Minister said the hospital and insurers are responsible for care organisation, promised to examine clarifying the AMvB acute care and the role of the Directeur Publieke Gezondheid, and gave no detailed figures on ambulance times pending a RIVM analysis if closure is considered.
As also promised to the House of Representatives during the plenary debate of 22 June 2023, I am willing to look at ways in which the AMvB acute care can be clarified.
Zoals ook toegezegd aan de Tweede Kamer, tijdens het plenaire debat van 22 juni 2023, ben ik bereid om te kijken naar manieren waarop de AMvB acute zorg kan worden verduidelijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de contractering van de zorg in aanloop naar de nieuwe overstapperiode

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the Martini Hospital budget being exhausted for planned care for Zilveren Kruis insured, waiting times, budget mismatches, and transparency on contracted care before the switching period. The minister replied that insurers must ensure timely accessible care under their duty of care, that NZa monitors this, and committed to evaluating contracting, clearer information via common definitions, an NZa study on the offer obligation, and reporting to parliament in spring 2024.
If insured persons cannot go to the Martini Hospital, the health insurer must ensure that this care is available elsewhere, in a timely and accessible way.
Als verzekerden niet terecht kunnen bij het Martini Ziekenhuis, dan moet de zorgverzekeraar ervoor zorgen dat deze zorg elders – tijdig en bereikbaar – beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het delen en opslaan van medisch dossiers

An MP asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that GP software copies and stores medical records of millions of patients for care-chain and insurer purposes without distinguishing necessary data, and how dependence on a dominant vendor can be addressed. The minister said the data-protection assessment is for the Dutch DPA, that GPs are responsible under the GDPR, and pointed to the ICT-market action plan and a planned product catalogue.
It is not for me to judge the lawfulness of the data processing at issue here.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de rechtmatigheid van de gegevensverwerkingen die hier aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over verbod op overnames door partijen die onderzocht worden door de inspectie

An MP asks whether the minister will allow a private equity-linked care provider under inspection to take over GP practices, and when the NZa will be given power to block such takeovers. The minister confirms the takeovers are ongoing, says a study on private equity in care is planned, and states that a legal basis to temporarily block takeovers during investigations is being examined, with information to Parliament by year-end.

At this moment I am examining the possibilities for such a power of the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) to (temporarily) prohibit takeovers by providers during investigations by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) and/or the NZa into those providers.

Op dit moment onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden voor een dergelijke bevoegdheid van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) om overnames door aanbieders (tijdelijk) te verbieden gedurende onderzoek dat de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) en/of de NZa doet naar deze aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de sluiting van ziekenhuizen in Friesland

An MP asks the health minister about the plan to reduce Friesland's hospitals from four to three, including municipal involvement, the AMvB acute care procedure, accessibility and ambulance response times. The minister answers that no decision has been taken, that the AMvB procedure applies with RIVM accessibility analysis and IGJ/NZa oversight, and that regional plans will be developed with stakeholders.
The two hospitals have informed me that the twelve scenarios will not be made public.
De twee ziekenhuizen hebben mij laten weten dat de twaalf scenario's niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de groeiende rol van private equity in de zorg

MP Bushoff asked the health minister about the growing role of private equity in healthcare, including its acquisitions outside NZa and ACM review, transparency, zzp use in care, and possible limits on takeovers of GP practices. Minister Kuipers answered that more transparency and a broader study are desirable, promised a wider investigation into private equity effects, but saw no current option to block GP practice takeovers.

For this reason, more transparency about this kind of acquisition is desirable, and in line with the motion adopted by your House from members Van den Berg and Dijk, I will commission a broader study into it.

Om deze reden is meer transparantie van dit soort acquisities wenselijk en ga ik, in lijn met de door uw Kamer aangenomen motie van de leden Van den Berg en Dijk 3 , een breder onderzoek uitzetten hiernaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het nieuws dat te veel Nederlanders niet naar de tandarts gaan omdat ze het niet kunnen betalen

An MP asked the Health Minister about evidence that many Dutch people, especially low-income adults, skip dental care due to cost, and asked about short-term fixes, municipal schemes, free acute care, and the recommendations of the Zwartboek. The minister answered that a progress report on reducing dental care avoidance is being sent, that municipal schemes are only part of a broader mix of solutions, and that structural options such as adding dental care to the basic package are costly and need further study before a next cabinet decides.
I am awaiting this further elaboration.
Ik wacht deze nadere uitwerking af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Bushoff over long covid bij de politie

MPs Mutluer and Bushoff asked about long COVID among police officers, including numbers reporting, sick-leave impact, whether it is treated as an occupational illness, and support measures. The minister answered that 378 police staff with post-COVID complaints are registered with the company doctor, that police treat COVID infection as an accident at work under conditions, and that general national post-COVID measures are in place.
From the standpoint of medical confidentiality, it is not known to what extent these colleagues are absent from work as a result of their post-COVID-19 complaints.
Uit het oogpunt van medische geheimhouding is niet bekend in welke mate deze collega's verzuimen als gevolg van hun post- COVID-19 klachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het per direct sluiten van de complete kraamafdeling in het ziekenhuis in Zutphen

An MP asks the Health Minister how she learned of the immediate closure of the Zutphen maternity ward, whether the closure can be reversed, whether the IGJ and ROAZ were properly involved, and about midwife staffing and continuity of care. The Minister answers that the hospital board decided on overmacht grounds, that the IGJ and ROAZ were informed in time, that the RIVM accessibility norm is still met, and that gemeenten are not formal ROAZ parties, while stating she sees no evidence of governance breaches and little loss of staff.
The hospital board of Gelre Ziekenhuizen is responsible for its own personnel policy and for staffing its departments.
De raad van bestuur van Gelre Ziekenhuizen gaat over haar eigen personeelsbeleid en is zelf verantwoordelijk om de bezetting op haar afdelingen rond te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de grote zorgen van 29 burgemeesters over de concentratie van acute zorg

An MP asked the health minister about 29 mayors' concerns over concentrating acute care, including whether hospitals must consult municipal executives before changing acute services, who supervises this, the role of the mayor on hospital boards, the composition of the regional acute care consultation body (ROAZ), and the role of the GGD and insurers. The minister answered that the Wkkgz requires consultation with municipal executives before such decisions, enforced by the IGJ, that municipalities are not formal ROAZ parties, and that the governance of ROAZ will be reviewed with the sector.
I will therefore involve the perspective of local government and residents in developing the alternative to the 45-minute standard.
Ik zal daarom perspectief van het lokale bestuur en de inwoners betrekken bij de ontwikkeling van het alternatief voor de 45-minutennorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het toestaan dat raadsleden voor een gemeenschappelijke regeling werken

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the 2023 amendment to Article 13 of the Municipal Act, which bars councillors from working as officials for joint arrangements in ways tied to their own municipality, has excluded councillors from such roles, and how it is interpreted. The Minister says the rule aims to keep councils and boards independent, is meant to stay narrow, has produced no confirmed cases of councillors forced out, and that interpretation will be clarified with the councillors' association and clerks' association.
I will consult with the Dutch Association of Councillors and the Association of Clerks to ensure a uniform interpretation and application of the amended Article 13 of the Municipal Act.
Ik ga in overleg met de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Raadsleden en de Vereniging van Griffiers, om een eenduidige interpretatie en toepassing van het gewijzigde artikel 13 Gemeentewet te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over zorgaanbieders die hun patiënten extra geld in rekening hebben gebracht

MP Bushoff asked the Minister of Health about care providers charging patients voluntary extra contributions, how many reports the NZa received, enforcement, informing patients, refunds, and whether tariffs are cost-covering. The Minister replied that the NZa has received some dozens of reports and is investigating, no formal measures yet, patients may reclaim payments and report to the NZa, and the NZa sets reasonably cost-covering tariffs while the outcome of the investigation will be awaited.
The NZa is still investigating whether in all these cases there is actually an infringement.
De NZa onderzoekt nog of het in al deze gevallen ook daadwerkelijk gaat om een overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over AED’s in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the number, growth, regional spread and standardisation of AEDs in the Netherlands. The minister answered with registration figures from HartslagNU, stated there is no formal national coverage target, and said the government subsidises that foundation but did not commit to a new study on uniformity.
No target has been formulated for the number of AEDs or their accessibility.
Er is geen doelstelling geformuleerd over het aantal AED’s of de bereikbaarheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de grote zorgen van 29 burgemeesters over de concentratie van acute zorg

Parliamentarian Bushoff asks the health minister how to respond to concerns of 29 mayors about possible closures of emergency departments and the lack of municipal involvement in acute care decisions. Minister Kuipers says no minimum number of emergency departments will be kept open, describes a forthcoming process to replace the 45-minute standard with municipal and resident input, and states that municipalities must be consulted under the procedure, which is not always followed in practice.

That is why it is good that the obligation to involve the municipal executives and residents has been included in the procedure for terminating or suspending acute care provision since 1 January 2022.
Daarom is het goed dat de verplichting om colleges van B&W en inwoners te betrekken sinds 1 januari 2022 is opgenomen in de procedure voor het beëindigen of opschorten van acuut zorgaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Van der Graaf over de afname van het aantal stembureaus

MPs Bushoff and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of the Interior about the reported reduction in polling stations, accessibility, turnout and the Van Raak motion. The minister answered that an evaluation of the provincial and water board elections is ongoing, that results on the number of polling stations per municipality will be sent in September, and that municipalities are legally responsible for designating polling stations.
An overview of which municipalities have set up fewer polling stations is not yet available.
Een overzicht van welke gemeenten minder stembureaus hebben ingericht is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de abrupte afbreking van een chemotherapie

An MP asked the health minister whether a chemotherapy cut off mid-treatment breached the Zorgverzekeringswet's continuity rule, how the NZa can enforce patients' rights, and whether insurers should be forced to finish contracting earlier or offer switching rights. The minister said the case was a misunderstanding about prior authorisation, now resolved, that continuity protections exist in law, and rejected a legal contracting deadline and an extra switching window while pointing to IZA agreements and planned NZa rule changes on twin policies.
I do not consider it desirable that someone during an ongoing care pathway should have to worry about the continuity of that care.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat iemand tijdens een lopend zorgtraject zich zorgen moet maken over de continuïteit daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Kathmann over de brief van artsenfederatie KNMG over het effect van armoede op ziekte

MPs Bushoff and Kathmann asked the government how it will respond to the KNMG's warning that poverty drives illness, including whether it will reduce health inequalities, target prevention where needed, and act on the KNMG's four recommendations. The state secretaries answered that health gaps are being addressed through existing agreements and programmes, that the KNMG recommendations are under discussion, and that legally anchoring health targets was rejected in a vote, leaving the response largely to policy programmes.
The cabinet is currently holding talks with the KNMG about these recommendations.
Het kabinet voert op dit moment gesprekken met de KNMG over deze aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over lobbyregels bij provincies

An MP asked the Interior Minister about lobbying rules at provinces, the lack of decentralised integrity research and whether minimum integrity standards should apply uniformly across provinces and match national rules. The minister said provinces share the same statutory integrity rules, that local integrity policy is their own responsibility, and that an integrity policy note with possible additional measures for local government will be sent to parliament soon.
In the announced integrity in public administration note, I will examine further the relationship between policy and the available figures.
In de aangekondigde nota integriteit openbaar bestuur ga ik nader in op de relatie tussen het beleid en de – beschikbare – cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het vertrouwen in het bestuur

An MP from the PvdA asks the Interior Minister and Prime Minister about declining public trust in local government, linking it to national failures on Groningen gas extraction, the childcare benefits affair and asylum reception at Ter Apel, and asks whether the Prime Minister's refusal to answer questions on 2030 government targets undermines accountability. The minister answers that local government still enjoys more trust than national institutions, that trust drivers include responsiveness and reliability, and that the government is working on participation and administrative reforms, while declining to give a direct answer on the 2030 targets, which were referred to the responsible ministers with a commitment to inform parliament before Accountability Day 2023.
Restoring trust between residents and government is a task for the entire cabinet.
Het herstel van het vertrouwen tussen inwoners en overheid is een opgave voor het gehele kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het mogelijk sluiten van de SEH, IC en verloskunde afdeling in Gelre Ziekenhuis Zutphen

An MP asked the minister about the planned closure of the maternity, emergency and intensive care units at Gelre Ziekenhuis Zutphen, including whether the board broke an earlier promise and whether governance rules were followed. The minister answered that the board must follow the statutory acute care procedure, that Zutphen remains open for low-complexity emergency care, and that the matter is primarily the provider's responsibility while the NZa and IGJ monitor it.
It is the responsibility of the care provider, in this case Gelre Ziekenhuizen, to decide on the organisation of the care organisation, provided this is within the applicable norms.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder, in dit geval Gelre Ziekenhuizen, om te beslissen over de inrichting van de zorgorganisatie, mits dit binnen de geldende normen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de financiële problemen van Flevoziekenhuis in Almere

An MP asked the Health Minister about the financial problems of Flevoziekenhuis in Almere, the sudden closure of acute obstetrics and the 24/7 emergency post in Lelystad, and whether this endangers acute care in Flevoland. The minister replied that the NZa sees no short-term risk to continuity of care, that responsibility lies with the hospital and insurers under the continuity policy, and that the Zorgtafel Flevoland and regional planning instruments are in place.
I am not aware of the specific financial situation of Flevoziekenhuis other than from the media.
Ik ben niet bekend met de specifieke financiële situatie van het Flevoziekenhuis anders dan vanuit de media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de nachtsluiting van de spoedeisende hulp in Meppel

MP Bushoff asked the Minister of Health about the overnight closure of the emergency department in Meppel, related closures elsewhere in Drenthe, staffing shortages and the effects on patients and the hospital's finances. The Minister answered that the temporary closure is acceptable to the inspectorate and the regional acute care network, that the hospital expects to reopen 24/7 in April, and that the NZa and insurers monitor finances, while committing to replacing the 45-minute norm and pursuing a shared acute care plan.
I share the view that the overnight closure of the emergency department in Meppel is undesirable.
Ik deel de opvatting dat de nachtelijke sluiting van de SEH in Meppel onwenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het nieuws dat steeds meer huisartsenpraktijken in commerciële handen komen

An MP asked the health minister about rising commercial takeover of GP practices and whether this increases patient complaints, profit pressure, and risks to care quality and access. The minister confirmed awareness, said data on commercial ownership is unavailable and the term is undefined, and noted that the IGJ and NZa are jointly investigating these new care chains with results expected before summer, promising to discuss possible additional measures afterwards.
I do not have these figures.
Ik beschik niet over deze cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de druk van de zorgverzekeraar op de huisarts voor het gebruik van een nieuw, onbekend en goedkoper spiraaltje

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about insurer VGZ pressuring GPs to use a newer, less familiar and cheaper hormonal IUD (Levosert) under its preference policy, and whether quality is sacrificed to cost. The Minister says preference policy is acceptable if quality is safeguarded, acknowledges the poor introduction, notes VGZ has revised the policy to a regional, phased rollout, and points to existing quality rules and the Integraal Zorgakkoord.
In this specific case, this initially did not go well; VGZ has since revised its preference policy for the hormonal IUD.
Dat is in deze specifieke casus in eerste instantie niet goed gegaan; inmiddels heeft VGZ het voorkeursbeleid voor de hormoonspiraal herzien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het mijden van (mond)zorg als gevolg van gebrekkige financiële middelen

Labour MP Bushoff asked the health minister about people avoiding dental care because of lack of money, whether supplementary dental insurance cover and special assistance rules could be expanded, and whether dental care in the basic package would save other medical costs. The minister acknowledged the problem and agreed access to dental care matters, but refused to widen special assistance for regular dental costs, refused to study savings from basic-package coverage, and pointed to a joint probleemanalyse with a spring 2023 outcome and municipal measures under exploration.
I consider it of great importance that everyone in the Netherlands has access to good dental care.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat iedereen in Nederland toegang heeft tot goede mondzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Bushoff over het mogelijk faillissement van de geneesmiddelenfabriek InnoGenerics

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister how the December 2022 letter on the InnoGenerics bankruptcy squared with the later decision to provide temporary support, and about the public-interest reasoning, supply security and dependence on non-EU producers. The minister defended the December position as based on the information then available, said the curator's request for a bridging loan was considered, reported that a restart is not possible with production ending 17 January 2023, and promised further information and inventories of production capacity.
I will inform your House as soon as there is more clarity about the consequences of the closure of the factory.
Ik informeer uw Kamer zodra er meer duidelijkheid is over de consequenties van de sluiting van de fabriek.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Heinen ter vervanging van nr. 5 over wijziging van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 inzake het uitdrukkelijk en deugdelijk motiveren van uitgaven vooruitlopend op goedkeurin

Amends the Comptabiliteitswet so that the minister must give a reasoned justification for spending ahead of budget approval, and Parliament must judge whether it is adequately informed before the spending can proceed.
By not having expenditures reviewed in advance by the House of Representatives and the Senate, parliamentary budget rights are weakened.
Door uitgaven niet vooraf te laten toetsen door de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, wordt het parlementaire budgetrecht verzwakt.
Amendement van het lid Heinen over wijziging van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 inzake het uitdrukkelijk en voldoende motiveren van uitgaven vooruitlopend op goedkeuring door de Staten-Generaal
Amends the Comptability Act so that spending started before budget approval requires a reasoned justification and a sufficiency finding by the States General before implementation.
in the immediate judgment of the States General sufficient
naar het onverwijlde oordeel van de Staten-Generaal voldoende
Motie van de leden Heinen en Inge van Dijk over de onbelaste reiskostenvergoeding per 1 januari 2023 al zo veel mogelijk verhogen
Asks the government to raise the untaxed travel allowance as early as 1 January 2023, funded by shifting a previously cut budget item.
requests the government to raise the untaxed travel allowance as much as possible already from 1 January 2023
verzoekt de regering de onbelaste reiskostenvergoeding per 1 januari 2023 al zo veel mogelijk te verhogen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Grinwis en Heinen ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een horizonbepaling
Adds a sunset provision to the Growth Fund Act so that after six years no new investments can be funded without a new law.
With this amendment a sunset provision is added to the National Growth Fund Act.
Met dit amendement wordt een horizonbepaling toegevoegd aan de Wet Nationaal Groeifonds.
Motie van het lid Heinen c.s. over in lijn met het advies van het Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk ondersteuning bieden aan het mkb
Motion asking the cabinet to support SMEs in jointly preparing subsidy applications for the National Growth Fund, in line with a regulatory-burden advisory body's advice.
requests the cabinet, in line with the advice of the regulatory burden advisory body, to provide support to SMEs
verzoekt het kabinet om in lijn met het advies van het adviescollege regeldruk ondersteuning te bieden aan midden- en kleinbedrijven
Motie van de leden Grinwis en Heinen over de subsidieregeling gereed hebben vóór openstelling van de toegangspoort voor de derde ronde
Asks the government to have the subsidy scheme for field parties to access the National Growth Fund ready before the third round opens.
requests the government to have the subsidy scheme ready before the gateway opens for the third round
verzoekt de regering de subsidieregeling ... gereed te hebben voor openstelling van de toegangspoort voor de derde ronde
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Heinen over een horizonbepaling
Adds a sunset clause to the National Growth Fund law so that after six years no new investments can be funded, with extension requiring a new law; makes repeal occur by royal decree.

Because of this six-year period, within one year after the planned time of the first evaluation in article 11, it must be determined by law whether the National Growth Fund Act is to be extended to allow new investments.

Door deze periode van zes jaar dient binnen een jaar na het voorziene tijdstip van de eerste evaluatie, zoals genoemd in artikel 11, bij wet bepaald te worden of de Wet Nationaal Groeifonds wel of niet dient te worden verlengd om nieuwe investeringen te kunnen doen.
Motie van de leden Heinen en Grinwis over rapporteren in hoeverre veldpartijen het initiatief nemen bij aanvragen via de departementale route

Asks the cabinet to report in the mid-term evaluation of the National Growth Fund on whether field parties take the initiative in applications via the departmental route, and how accountability for spending transferred to other departments can be organised.
requests the cabinet to report in the interim evaluation on the extent to which field parties take the initiative in applications via the departmental route
verzoekt het kabinet om in de tussentijdse evaluatie te rapporteren over in hoeverre veldpartijen het initiatief nemen bij aanvragen via de departementale route
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Heinen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het terugdraaien van het afschaffen van het verlaagde accijnstarief en latere inwerkingtreding wijziging heffingsgrondslag
Restores the reduced beer excise rate for small independent brewers and postpones the change in the excise base to 2024.
By reversing the abolition of the reduced excise rate for small independent breweries, the 7.5% discount on the regular beer excise rate is preserved.
Door het terugdraaien van het afschaffen van het verlaagde accijnstarief voor kleine onafhankelijke bierbrouwerijen, blijft de korting van 7,5% op het reguliere bieraccijnstarief behouden.
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over met de sector in gesprek gaan over de gevolgen van de wijziging van de grondslag voor alcoholaccijns op bier
Asks the cabinet to use the postponed introduction period to consult the brewing sector on disproportionate effects of the beer excise base change on small brewers and propose mitigation.
requests the cabinet to use the time before introduction to talk with the sector and especially small brewers
verzoekt het kabinet de tijd voor invoering te gebruiken om met de sector en met name de kleine brouwers in gesprek te gaan
Amendement van het lid Heinen over het terugdraaien van het afschaffen van het verlaagde accijnstarief en latere inwerkingtreding wijziging heffingsgrondslag
Amendment reinstating a reduced beer excise rate for small independent brewers and postponing the change of the excise base to alcohol content to 2024.
By reversing the abolition of the reduced excise rate for small independent breweries, the 7.5% discount remains.
Door het terugdraaien van het afschaffen van het verlaagde accijnstarief voor kleine onafhankelijke bierbrouwerijen, blijft de korting van 7,5% op het reguliere bieraccijnstarief behouden.
Motie van het lid Heinen c.s. over aangeven hoe goedgekeurde projecten passen binnen de bredere groeistrategie
Asks the government to explain in future assessment rounds how approved Growth Fund projects fit the broader growth strategy.
to indicate in future assessment rounds also how approved projects fit within the broader growth strategy of the cabinet
om bij volgende beoordelingsrondes ook aan te geven hoe goedgekeurde projecten passen binnen de bredere groeistrategie van het kabinet
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over de berichten 'Fraud-busters swoop on Greek contracts involving € 2.5B of EUrecovery funds' en 'Lamborghini and Rolexes seized in massive EU policeraid over € 600M Covid fraud'

MP Heinen asked the Finance Minister about reports of fraud involving EU Recovery and Resilience Facility funds in Greece and Italy, and about the adequacy of EU oversight. The government, answering on behalf of the Finance Minister, said it cannot yet judge fraud levels relative to other EU funds, pointed to ECA and Commission reports, said defrauded funds should be recovered under the RRF regulation, and promised to raise fraud prevention in the Ecofinraad and in the Commission's annual report.
The cabinet cannot currently establish how the amount of fraud and the effectiveness of fraud control at the RRF compare with those of other EU funds.

Op basis van deze informatie kan het kabinet op dit moment niet vaststellen hoe de hoeveelheid fraude en de effectiviteit van de fraudebestrijding bij het HVF zich verhoudt tot die bij andere EU-fondsen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over de berichten 'Beleggers verliezen €5 mln op platform, na promotie door 'finfluencers' en 'Meesters of misleiders? Finfluencers maken vaak vooral zichzélf rijk'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance about reports that investors lost money on a platform promoted by finfluencers, the AFM's 2021 exploration of finfluencer risks, EU rules on promotion, and whether finfluencers should fall directly under the commission ban. The Minister answered that the AFM has enforced against some finfluencers, that the EU proposal makes investment firms liable for finfluencer promotion, that finfluencers fall indirectly under the existing commission ban, and that no separate national rules will be considered while EU negotiations continue.
The supervisory authority cannot give insight into all measures taken due to the statutory duty of confidentiality and cannot comment on ongoing investigations.
De toezichthouder kan geen inzicht geven in alle genomen maatregelen vanwege de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht en kan ook geen uitspraken doen over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht ‘Brussel zint op nieuwe Europese belastingen’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the EU's Recovery Fund faces interest-rate shortfalls prompting new own resources, and whether spending shortfalls should be absorbed within expenditure. The minister acknowledged that reserved interest funds may be insufficient, said the Commission will report in its mid-term review, and stated the Netherlands will assess any new own-resource proposals on their merits.
After publication of the MTR, the House will be informed about this, including a cabinet appraisal.
Na de publicatie van de MTR zal de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd worden inclusief een kabinetsappreciatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Heinen over de berichtgeving in de media naar aanleiding van het omvallen van de Amerikaanse banken SVB en Signature

MPs Slootweg and Heinen asked the Finance Minister about media coverage of the failures of SVB and Signature Bank, their exposure to Dutch savers, pension funds and banks, and systemic risks from interest rate policy. The minister answered that Dutch exposure is small, that the US banks had specific business-model weaknesses and lighter US regulation, and that Dutch banks are well capitalised, while acknowledging some global vulnerability and defending existing bank regulation.
I do not know how many Dutch savers and businesses held money at Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) or Signature Bank.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse spaarders en bedrijven geld bij Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) of Signature Bank hadden staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht dat BKR actief hypotheekgegevens wil registreren

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Finance whether the credit registration body BKR's plans to register mortgages at origination, not only at payment arrears, go beyond the law, are disproportionate, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister confirms BKR is consulting on positive registration for specific mortgage types, says she is preparing a bill giving public guarantees and a statutory role for the Minister of Finance over credit registration, and that she sees no reason to register all owner-occupied mortgages.
The bill I am preparing provides for more public safeguards for data processing in credit registration and regulates which agreements are registered.
Het wetsvoorstel dat ik in voorbereiding heb regelt meer publieke waarborgen voor gegevensverwerking bij kredietregistratie en regelt welke overeenkomsten worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over de uitspraak van het Hof van justitie van de Europese Unie over het UBO-register

An MP asked the Finance Minister how the government would respond to the EU Court of Justice ruling invalidating public access to the UBO register, and whether fines would be lifted and information sharing limited. The minister answered that the register was closed to information requests, that a legal analysis is underway, that competent authorities will be reconnected first, and that risk-based enforcement continues pending a decision.
As soon as the ruling became known, it was decided to close the register to information provision.
Zodra de uitspraak bekend werd, is besloten om het register te sluiten voor informatieverstrekkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Heinen over de uitspraken over mogelijk loslaten unanimiteitsbeginsel en de ontwikkelingen rondom 'Pijler 2' van de OESO

MPs Idsinga and Heinen asked the State Secretary of Finance about statements on possibly dropping unanimity for tax decisions and developments around OECD Pillar 2, and why the joint declaration with four other states was signed by only five countries. The State Secretary answered that the cabinet position is unchanged, that Pillar 2 should ideally be agreed by all 27 member states, and that alternatives such as enhanced cooperation or coordinated implementation are being explored while unanimity remains required.
The cabinet's position on this point has not changed.
Het kabinetsstandpunt is op dit punt niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Banken blokkeren meeverhuizen lage hypotheekrente'

MPs Heinen and Peter de Groot asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks block portability of low mortgage rates when homeowners move, causing higher monthly costs. The government answered that the portability rule and a 5% test rate for shorter fixed periods explain the situation, that rate-averaging is optional for lenders, and that it sees no need to mandate it, relying on consumer advice and a competitive market.
I consider it important that consumers who do not need or want the flexible conditions of a mortgage can still take out a suitable mortgage (with a correspondingly lower price).
Ik vind het belangrijk dat consumenten die de flexibele voorwaarden van een hypotheek niet nodig hebben of willen, toch een passende hypotheek (met bijbehorende lagere prijs) kunnen afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens, Heinen, Tielen en Grinwis over het artikel 'Al 20 jaar geregeld tekort aan isotopen voor kankerbestraling: waarom het probleem maar niet wordt opgelost'

MPs from VVD and ChristenUnie asked about the status of the PALLAS isotope reactor in Petten after an EenVandaag report on chronic shortages of medical isotopes, and whether government pre-financing or a first-loss facility could fund such projects. The minister described reserved funds of 1.29 billion euro, remaining conditions, expected production around 2030, and said the final decision on the 330 million euro gap is expected in spring 2023, with the Growth Fund also considered.
The cabinet expects to make a definitive decision on the investment in the PALLAS project in spring 2023.
Het kabinet zal naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2023 een definitief besluit nemen over de investering in het PALLAS-project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het ECB-persbericht 'The Transmission Protection Instrument'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the ECB's new Transmission Protection Instrument, its conditions, and whether it weakens fiscal discipline and the ECB's independence. The minister answered at length, stressing ECB independence, the instrument's conditions, the continued role of OMT, and that fiscal discipline remains a national responsibility, while offering no concrete new national action beyond supporting SGP modernisation.
Let me start by stating that the ECB is independent in determining monetary policy in the euro area.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat de ECB onafhankelijk is in het bepalen van het monetaire beleid in de eurozone.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht dat de ECB Zuid-Europese lidstaten met hoge schulden gaat helpen

An MP from the VVD asks the Finance Minister whether the ECB's planned instrument to curb euro-area spread divergence fits its mandate under the TFEU, and whether an independent legal review will be commissioned. The minister replies that the instrument's design is not yet known, that the Court of Justice (Gauweiler, Weiss) sets the legal test, and that she sees no reason to commission her own legal analysis given the need for national restraint toward ECB policy.
It is the exclusive role of the Court to review ECB decisions against its treaty mandate.
Het is de exclusieve rol van het Hof om besluiten van de ECB aan haar verdragsrechtelijke mandaat te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas, Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht "Sanctie-experts: Nederland niet doeltreffend met opsporen Russisch vastgoed"

VVD MPs asked the government why sanctions enforcement on Russian-linked real estate in the Netherlands was unclear, whether other countries were more effective, and when concrete results would be reported. The minister answered that roles are divided among ministries, the Kadaster checks found no sanctioned persons as registered owners so far, and the government will continue reporting on progress.
From time to time the cabinet will continue to do this.
Op gezette tijden zal het kabinet dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht topman Air France-KLM pakt 3 miljoen aan bonus

Heinen (VVD) asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about a reported 3 million euro bonus for the Air France-KLM chief executive despite state aid and staff wage concessions, and what the government did after its earlier motion to tighten the EU temporary state aid framework on bonuses. The ministers say they pressed the European Commission to tighten bonus rules, which the Commission did not change, and that they will keep opposing the bonus at the shareholder meeting while the state holds 9.3% of shares.
I, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, have argued that in addition to paying out bonuses, it should also not be possible to promise bonuses as long as the state aid has not been repaid.

Ik, de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat, heb ervoor gepleit dat naast het uitbetalen van bonussen het ook niet mogelijk moet zijn om bonussen toe te zeggen zolang de staatssteun niet is terugbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht dat 45 miljard euro Russisch vermogen van personen en organisaties op sanctielijsten in Nederland staat

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the government about a report that EUR 45 billion of Russian assets held by sanctioned persons and entities sits in the Netherlands, and why freezes have been limited, how other countries compare, what has been done to clarify sanctions implementation, and how evasion is prosecuted. Minister Hoekstra rejected the EUR 45 billion estimate as overstated because ownership runs through layered foreign structures, stated that over half a billion euro has been frozen and that prosecutors and the FIOD act on evasion, and described outreach to businesses and a new steering group, while noting that some implementation questions remain.
Twenty yachts under construction are also under enhanced Customs supervision.
Ook staan er twintig jachten in aanbouw onder verscherpt toezicht van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht 'Banken weren contant geld, bedrijven radeloos'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks are restricting cash for small businesses, whether digital payment is being forced, the legal basis for cash limits, and the state of cash deposit networks. The minister answered that no law requires cash restrictions, banks may apply proportionate AML measures under the Cash Convenant, and she will raise the concerns with banks.
I will emphasise in the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer that I expect banks to apply proportionality when implementing mitigating measures under the Wwft.

Ik zal in het Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer benadrukken dat ik van banken verwacht dat zij proportionaliteit toepassen bij het implementeren van mitigerende maatregelen in het kader van de Wwft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht "Tuchtraad zet morrend punt achter schending bankierseed"

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a report that the banking disciplinary board could not fully judge a breach of the banker's oath because of limited insight into conduct, and about strengthening that regime. The minister said banks should cooperate with investigations, that the sector itself should shape the disciplinary and code framework under DNB supervision, that suitability vetting is confidential, and that the anti-money-laundering bill will be submitted soon.
Because of supervisory confidentiality, the competent supervisor (DNB, AFM or ECB) may not disclose anything about suitability and reliability assessments of policymakers in the financial sector.

In verband met de toezichtsvertrouwelijkheid kan en mag de bevoegde toezichthouder (DNB, de AFM of de ECB) geen mededelingen doen over toetsingen op geschiktheid en betrouwbaarheid van beleidsbepalers in de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht dat er geen uitstel komt voor UBO-registratie ondanks protesten van werkgevers

An MP asked the Finance Minister why answers on postponing the UBO register deadline came only a week before the deadline, whether many UBOs were still unregistered, whether registration problems and enforcement warranted a moratorium, and whether the questions could be answered before the deadline. The minister replied that the register has run since 2020 with an 18-month period, that about 36.75% of entities had registered by 24 March with a large backlog, that enforcement will be risk-based and no moratorium is planned, and that Parliament will be informed further after 27 March.
I hereby repeat the commitment to inform your House by letter after 27 March about the status of the UBO register.
Bij dezen herhaal ik de toezegging om na 27 maart uw Kamer per brief te informeren over de stand van zaken van het UBO-register
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Heinen over ‘Defensie-industrie vangt vaker bot bij banken die reputatieschade vrezen’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Heinen asked why banks refuse defence-industry firms accounts over reputational risk, whether the government will talk to banks and industry, whether firms can be exempted from ESG rules, and whether the EU has discussed clashes between sustainability and defence capacity. The minister says banks set their own client policy, the government will first meet the defence sector and then the Dutch Banking Association, has no data on closed accounts, will push for ambitious EU sustainability standards while noting the special position of defence, and reports EU discussion of the issue.
Enquiries with the NVB show that it does not have these figures at its disposal.
Navraag bij de NVB leert dat zij deze cijfers niet tot hun beschikking hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Rahimi over het UBO-register

MPs Heinen and Rahimi asked the Finance Minister about privacy and safety concerns for UBOs in the public beneficial ownership register, the pending CJEU case and Advocate General Pitruzella's opinion, and whether the registration deadline should be postponed. The minister acknowledged the concerns, defended the existing privacy safeguards, said the AG's points largely align with Dutch practice and that no postponement is warranted, while promising to follow the final CJEU ruling.
In view of the AG's conclusion, which largely aligns with the Dutch implementation, I see no reason to postpone the registration deadline.
Gelet op de conclusie van de A-G, welke in belangrijke mate in lijn ligt met de Nederlandse implementatie, zie ik geen aanleiding tot uitstel van de deadline tot registratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het toezicht op uitgaven uit het Europees herstelfonds

An MP asked the Finance Minister how the EU Recovery Fund plans were checked for fraud risk, including Italy's fraud-prone superbonus, and whether the Commission's refusal to release documents is acceptable. The minister answered that member states and the Commission carry fraud-control duties, that no Ecofin discussions arose over fraud risks, and that transparency of EU documents should be modernised, but the answers largely restate existing frameworks and leave several questions unanswered.
The cabinet considers it very important that transparency of governance, including access to documents, is further increased at EU level.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat ook in EU-verband de transparantie van bestuur onder meer d.m.v. toegang tot documenten verder wordt vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Aanscherping leenregime banken zet boeren in de kou’

MPs Heinen and Van Campen asked whether the planned Basel IV bank capital rules would make financing agricultural investment harder, and what the government was doing about it. The Finance Minister answered that the impact depends on how the EU implements the rules and on banks' choices, that talks with banks and DNB have taken place, and that the Commission's proposal and impact analysis will be awaited before the government sets its position.
The cabinet acknowledges the importance of ensuring that agricultural sector financing remains guaranteed now and in the future.
Het kabinet erkent het belang dat de financierbaarheid van de agrarische sector nu en in de toekomst gewaarborgd blijft
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Wordt Evergrande China’s Lehman Brothers’

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the risks of the Evergrande debt problems for Chinese and global financial markets, Dutch institutions and Dutch crisis scenarios, and about contact with China. Minister Hoekstra answered that risks are mainly contained in China with limited direct Dutch exposure, outlined DNB and CPB scenario analyses, and said there was no reason yet to contact China beyond FSB discussions.
My ministry has no insight into individual (foreign) exposures of Dutch institutions.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen inzicht in individuele (buitenlandse) blootstellingen van Nederlandse instellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Heinen over het bericht dat Belarus bijna USD1 miljard krijgt toegekend van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds (IMF), in de vorm van speciale trekkingsrechten

MPs Brekelmans and Heinen (VVD) asked why Belarus would receive nearly USD 1 billion in IMF special drawing rights when countries like Venezuela and Myanmar do not, and whether the government would oppose or block this allocation given sanctions. The government answered that the SDR allocation was generic, proportional to quota, and followed IMF procedures recognizing the Belarusian executive, so Belarus is eligible; it said it cannot revoke the allocation for one country and would instead work with partners to limit Belarus's ability to convert SDRs into hard currency, though it made no firm commitment to block conversion.

In contacts with the EU, the US and other international partners, the Netherlands is working to limit as much as possible Belarus's options for converting SDRs, in line with existing sanctions policy.
Nederland zet in contacten met de EU, de VS en andere internationale partners erop in om, in lijn met het staande sanctiebeleid, de mogelijkheden daartoe voor Belarus zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het Paper ‘Common views on the future of the Stability and Growth Pact’

MP Heinen asked why the position paper on reforming the Stability and Growth Pact, co-signed by the Netherlands, was not in the agenda and was sent only after the debate, and what concrete changes the government considers. Minister Hoekstra answered that the decision to co-sign was taken late once co-signatories were clear, that the paper keeps the same Dutch position, and that the government will inform parliament before deviating from its line.

Should the cabinet intend to take a line in the European debate that deviates from the existing Dutch position, I will of course inform the House Chamber in advance, so that there is an opportunity to exchange views on it.

Mocht het kabinet voornemens zijn om in het Europese debat een lijn te kiezen die afwijkt van de bestaande Nederlandse inzet, dan zal ik de Tweede Kamer vanzelfsprekend voorafgaand hierover informeren, zodat er gelegenheid is om daarover van gedachten te wisselen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht in de Financial Times dat uit onderzoek in opdracht van de Wereldbank blijkt dat de huidige IMF MD personeel heeft gepusht om de ranglijst van China te verbeteren

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the World Bank inquiry finding that IMF chief Georgieva pressed staff to boost China's Doing Business ranking, and whether she should remain in post and whether the Netherlands would raise this in the IMF board. The minister said the methodology allowed outcomes to be adjusted in favour of individual countries, endorsed the report's recommendations, called the allegation serious, and said the IMF Ethics Committee and board would review it, while contact with Dutch constituency countries takes place at the constituency office.
I consider it important that the matter is examined thoroughly by an independent body, and that the Managing Director herself is given the opportunity to respond substantively to the matter.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat grondig naar de zaak wordt gekeken door een onafhankelijk orgaan, en dat Managing Director zelf ook de gelegenheid krijgt om inhoudelijk te reageren op de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht ‘ECB geeft zichzelf hoger inflatiedoel’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the ECB's revised inflation target and whether it means longer negative rates, more bond purchases, and effects on Dutch pensions, housing and financial markets. The minister answers that the ECB adopted a symmetric 2% target, that the effects of a looser policy are uncertain, and that the government expects low long-term rates and rising inflation in the Netherlands, with the ECB's policy left to its independent decision.
It is up to the ECB to independently determine which instruments it uses to achieve its price stability mandate.
Het is aan de ECB om in onafhankelijkheid te bepalen welke instrumenten zij inzet om haar mandaat van prijsstabiliteit te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht ‘DNB: Amerikaanse BigTech vormt gevaar voor Europese financiële stabiliteit’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about DNB's warning that US BigTech firms threaten European financial stability, including risks from Chinese tech firms, the digital yuan, privacy, cooperation between supervisors, and whether banks must innovate. The minister acknowledged concentration and lock-in risks, pointed to EU proposals (Digital Markets Act, DORA, MiCA) and possible EU-level supervision, but gave no concrete new national oversight step.
The cabinet shares the concerns about the possible concentration of market power of large tech firms in the financial sector as described in both the DNB report and the ACM report.
Het kabinet deelt de zorgen omtrent de mogelijke concentratie van marktmacht van grote techbedrijven in de financiële sector zoals omschreven in zowel het rapport van DNB, als het rapport van de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Aartsen over het bericht 'Booking paste bonusregels aan voor miljoenenbeloning top'

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary about plans for a reception centre for 200 asylum seekers and housing for 400 labour migrants in Deelen, questioning whether residents' concerns about nuisance and crime would be taken into account and whether the plan would be stopped. The State Secretary said talks with the municipality of Ede, COA and the owner are ongoing, that residents' concerns are being addressed in operating agreements, and that she rejects generalising asylum seekers as criminals while welcoming the extra reception capacity.
I dissociate myself from the suggestion that all asylum seekers are guilty of nuisance, crime or terror.
Ik neem afstand van de suggestie dat alle asielzoekers zich schuldig maken aan overlast, criminaliteit of terreur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht ‘Witwasboete van €480 miljoen voor ABN AMRO’

MPs Heinen (VVD) asked the Finance Minister about the status of the anti-money-laundering action plan, bank obstacles to data sharing and privacy limits, TMNL transaction monitoring, and whether the ABN AMRO fine would hit dividends and taxpayers. The minister answered that the 49-measure plan is largely implemented but remains ongoing, outlined data-sharing legal bases and the AP's limits on UBO-register access, described TMNL as a private initiative, and said the fine goes to the treasury though dividend impact cannot be guaranteed.
The plan cannot in addition be seen as a conclusion of the anti-money-laundering policy.
Het plan kan daarnaast niet gezien worden als een afronding van het anti-witwasbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Miljoenenbonus topman Air France KLM, ondanks recordverlies en staatssteun’

MPs Heinen and Michon-Derkzen asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether a large bonus for the Air France-KLM chief, despite record losses and state aid, conflicts with state-aid conditions and their own letters suspending bonuses. Minister Hoekstra answered that the bonus is not linked to arranging wage support, that bonuses are unacceptable in this crisis, that the suspension applies to KLM as recipient, and that the European Commission must enforce the Temporary Framework, with the Economic Affairs minister to probe for possible further tightening.
I have informed the company that I am not happy with the suggestion created and that this gives an incorrect picture.
Ik heb aan de onderneming laten weten niet gelukkig te zijn met de gewekte suggestie en dat dit een onjuist beeld geeft.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de aanpak van speculatieve grondhandel en de uitkomsten van het ambtelijk onderzoek hiernaar

An MP from the SGP asks why the outcome of a promised ministerial study into speculative land trading in split agricultural plots has not yet been shared, and raises consumer rights, fragmentation, cadastral registration, supervision by the AFM, and proposals on notaries and the Kadaster. The minister replies that the findings were sent to parliament on 20 November 2025, outlines consumers' private-law remedies, announces an exploration of a statutory cooling-off period, and says existing supervision and notarial duties are considered sufficient while the government keeps monitoring.
Your House was informed by letter of 20 November 2025, jointly on behalf of the Minister of Finance and the State Secretary of Justice and Security, about the outcome of the official study
Uw Kamer is op 20 november 2025 bij brief, mede namens de Minister van Financiën en de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid, geïnformeerd over de uitkomst van het ambtelijk onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht ‘Nederland is een ontbossingsland’

MP Teunissen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands contributes to global deforestation via finance, ports and consumption, including Rabobank's ranking and the adequacy of EU deforestation rules. The minister answered that companies and financial institutions must follow OECD and UN standards, that existing EU sustainability rules apply but are being simplified, and that the EUDR enforcement details remain uncertain pending final EU text.

How a financial institution gives effect to compliance with these international guidelines, and what choices it makes regarding investments or engaging with companies, is the responsibility of the institutions themselves.

Hoe een financiële instelling invulling geeft aan de naleving van deze internationale richtlijnen, en welke keuzes zij maakt ten aanzien van investeringen of het aangaan van gesprekken met bedrijven, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat bijna een kwart van het personeel weg moet bij ABN AMRO

PVV MP Tony van Dijck asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO's plan to cut about a quarter of staff, the reasons for it, the NIBC takeover, possible effects on state dividends, and the timing of further share sales. The minister said the state had no influence on the strategy or the NIBC deal, that it is for the bank to disclose such information, and that the remaining stake sale is ongoing without disclosing timing or size.
I can therefore only inform your House afterwards, based on the information the company has already provided.
Ik kan uw Kamer daardoor alleen achteraf informeren op basis van de informatie die de vennootschap al heeft verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Kabinet trekt toch 700 miljoen euro extra uit voor Oekraïne'

MP Vermeer asked whether using 700 million euros of underspending to fund extra Ukraine aid breaches budget rules, how this fits the cabinet's earlier position, and for overviews of Dutch and EU aid, refugee costs and oversight of aid spending. The government answered that underspending may be redirected, that it is a first step on the Chamber's motion, and provided aid tables, EU instrument details and an account of the procurement and audit controls in place.
The cabinet will then consider at the beginning of the new year how further follow-up to the motion can be given.
Het kabinet beziet vervolgens in het begin van het nieuwe jaar hoe verdere opvolging aan de motie gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kouwenhoven en Saris over het bericht 'Terugbetaling toeslagen leidt steeds vaker tot problemen bij burgers'

MPs Kouwenhoven and Saris asked the Dutch government about reports that repayment of childcare and other benefits is causing growing problems for citizens, including the scale of repayments and debts, the complexity of the system and its social and economic costs. The state secretary answered that the system is not bankrupt but needs fundamental reform, pointed to recent simplification measures and planned bills, and acknowledged that repayments cannot always be avoided under the current design.
To prevent that, it is necessary to fundamentally revise the system of allowances.
Om dat te voorkomen is het nodig om het stelsel van toeslagen fundamenteel te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Finance Ministry units indirectly use Palantir software or data-sharing channels, and whether sharing data with partners discharges GDPR responsibilities. The minister replied that FIOD officers with police-provided workstations can access Palantir under police responsibility, no other indirect use was found, and sharing data does not transfer GDPR responsibilities; other ministries answer for RIEC/LIEC/iCOV.
In chain cooperation there may be shared or joint responsibility.
Bij ketensamenwerkingen kan sprake zijn van gedeelde of gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de afhankelijkheid van de financiële sector van Amerikaanse techgiganten

An MP asked the government about the financial sector's dependence on American tech giants, including DNB and AFM warnings, scenario analysis, European coordination, and procurement exclusion. The minister acknowledged the risks, pointed to DORA, the vifo screening law, EU-level digital autonomy efforts and cloud policy, but said procurement exclusion of non-European firms is constrained by non-discrimination rules and the cloud policy review is delayed.
I will discuss with the supervisors how we can follow up on the recommendations.
Ik ga met de toezichthouders in gesprek hoe we opvolging kunnen geven aan de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de exportkredietverzekeringen voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about export credit insurance for the Mozambique LNG project, including resumed dredging by Van Oord, security risks in Cabo Delgado, monitoring of harms and whether the state's obligations are fulfilled. Minister Heinen answered that the state is bound by the issued policies under Dutch insurance law, that the dredging was Total's own decision, that the government sees no breach of environmental and social standards, and that Total has since dropped the Dutch-insured financing so no reassessment remains.

As previously set out in answers to parliamentary questions of 1 and 29 September 2025 and in my letter of 11 November 2025, it is correct that Van Oord, on behalf of Total and anticipating a project restart, carried out preparatory dredging works.

Zoals eerder uiteengezet in de beantwoording van Kamervragen op 1 en 29 september 2025 en in mijn brief van 11 november 2025 klopt het dat Van Oord in opdracht van Total, anticiperend op een herstart van het project, voorbereidende baggerwerkzaamheden heeft uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Dassen over “de gelekte brief waarin Tata Steel 685 miljoen euro moet betalen vanwege trage verduurzaming”

MPs Teunissen and Dassen asked about a leaked letter saying Tata Steel must pay 685 million euros for emissions rights due to slow decarbonisation, and whether subsidies undermine the ETS incentive, the company's risks and competitiveness, and the financial prudence of the support. The minister answered that the costs were foreseeable but affected by delayed Hoogoven 6 work, that the Dutch policy mix is intended, that the business case uses current 2025 forecasts validated by the state and the European Commission, that subsidies are tranched with clawback, and that the Chamber will be informed about maatwerk talks.
Because of commercial confidentiality, no statements can be made about specific figures or, in this case, provisions.
Vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over specifieke cijfers of, in dit geval, voorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Stultiens over het bedrijf Pluspetrol

MPs Hirsch and Stultiens asked the state secretaries about the OECD NCP final statement on Pluspetrol, including trade support, tax transparency and OECD Guidelines uptake. The government answered that Pluspetrol cannot claim trade-instrument support under fossil-fuel phase-out agreements, that tax secrecy prevents disclosing individual firms' tax data beyond new country-by-country reporting, and that the 2023 target of 90% OECD Guidelines endorsement was missed at 41%.
The cabinet does not see the possibility for the government to make more information public about the tax position of individual taxpayers given the fiscal secrecy obligation.
Het kabinet ziet niet de mogelijkheid om vanuit de overheid meer informatie openbaar te maken over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en over exportkredietverstrekking aan LNG-project Cabo Delgado, Mozambique

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked why an export credit insurance policy for Van Oord covers preparatory dredging work at the Cabo Delgado LNG project while the government has said the project is on hold pending a re-assessment and an independent study. The minister replies that the Van Oord exporter policy is legally separate from the frozen financing policy, that it remains in force and cannot be cancelled absent fraud or negligence, and that the independent study is a condition for the re-assessment of the financing policy.
On the investigation or the decision-making process of the British UKEF, I cannot make any statements, as previously indicated.
Over het onderzoek of het besluitvormingsproces van het Britse UKEF kan ik, zoals eerder aangegeven, geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het weglaten van € 200 miljoen onderwijsbezuinigingen in de laatste OCW begroting

An MP asks why a €200 million education cut (half of the 2025 price adjustment) was dropped from the 2026 OCW budget's cuts table, and whether the total education cuts were fully disclosed. The minister answers that the halving remains in place, was included in the explanation of budget mutations, and provides a table of all cuts including the €171.6 million structural halving.
The nationwide halving of the 2025 price adjustment tranche is not off the table.
De rijksbrede halvering van de prijsbijstelling tranche 2025 is niet van tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verouden over de berichtgeving van de ACM dat boodschappen in Nederlandse supermarkten duurder zijn dan in omringende landen

MP Verouden asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about the ACM investigation into higher supermarket prices than in neighbouring countries, including territorial supply restrictions, market concentration, and whether New Competition Tool-style monitoring is desirable. Minister Karremans answered that the ACM investigates independently, that the government is pushing for EU action on territorial supply restrictions, is exploring a New Competition Tool with a letter to follow, and that Dutch food prices were below the EU and eurozone averages in 2023.
The ACM, as an independent supervisor, carries out the investigation independently. The ministry plays no role in it.
De ACM voert als onafhankelijke toezichthouder het onderzoek zelfstandig uit. Het ministerie speelt daarin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Nispen over het (demissionaire) kabinetsstandpunt inzake het initiatiefwetsvoorstel Centraal Aandeelhoudersregister (CAHR)

MPs Van der Lee and Van Nispen asked the government about its position on the initiative bill for a central shareholders register (CAHR), including the KPMG report, the UBO register's 25% threshold, and notary and Chamber of Commerce feasibility. The acting government declined to pre-empt parliamentary handling, said it would give its appraisal when the bill is debated, and stated the UBO register and CAHR are complementary.
The cabinet does not anticipate the parliamentary handling of the initiative bill for a central shareholders register (CAHR).
Het kabinet loopt niet vooruit op de behandeling van het initiatiefwetsvoorstel voor een centraal aandeelhoudersregister (CAHR) door uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Zorgvuldige nieuwe wetgeving kan regelbrij voorkomen'

Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about a PwC report showing rising rules for implementing agencies, and about whether the cabinet will act on simplification, stricter upfront scrutiny, IT modernisation and temporary measures. The government largely agrees with the diagnosis, points to ongoing simplification programmes and planned letters, but declines to commit to new specific reviews, provides no Rijksbreed overview of temporary measures, and says it will not in principle reduce the number of laws.
There is currently no government-wide overview of temporary measures or measures with a sunset clause.
Er is op dit moment geen Rijksbreed beeld van tijdelijke maatregelen of maatregelen met een horizonbepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An FvD MP asked the Finance Minister which departments use or have access to Palantir software, including the 'Raffinaderij' project, and which bodies share data with it. The minister answered that no Finance units use or access Palantir directly, that data sharing with partners falls outside Finance's responsibility, and that partners select their own software.
Finance Ministry units receive and share information and signals with chain partners within the applicable legal framework, but this supply does not take place directly in Palantir.

Organisatieonderdelen van het Ministerie van Financiën ontvangen en delen informatie en signalen met ketenpartners binnen de geldende wettelijke kaders, deze levering vindt niet direct in Palantir plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Ceder over het bericht dat investeren in ontwikkelingssamenwerking gunstig is voor de Nederlandse economie

MPs Hirsch and Ceder asked the government about a study claiming Dutch aid boosts exports and jobs, whether cuts to development cooperation were properly assessed, and whether it will commission research on the broader costs and benefits. The Staatssecretaris called the econometric findings a reasonable but non-conclusive indication, said the cabinet sees no added value in a new study of the cuts, and gave no answer on commissioning research on wider effects beyond referring to an OECD report and a letter.
For the aforementioned reason, the cabinet sees no added value in a study of the broader societal costs and benefits of the recent cuts to development cooperation in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet ziet om voornoemde reden geen toegevoegde waarde van een onderzoek naar de brede maatschappelijke kosten en baten van de recente bezuinigingen op ontwikkelingssamenwerking in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de tijdelijke accijnsverlaging op brandstoffen.
