An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister how the expiry of the temporary fuel excise cut on 1 January 2026 would affect fuel stations, especially in border regions, and whether the government would limit the effects or stop indexation. The government answered that it proposes extending the temporary cut by one year in the Belastingplan 2026, while deferring options for later years and keeping indexation suspended only partly, citing budgetary revenue needs.
As included in the Belastingplan 2026, the cabinet proposes to extend the temporary reduction by another year.
Zoals in het Belastingplan 2026 opgenomen, stelt het kabinet voor om de tijdelijke verlaging nog met een jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

Two MPs asked the government about growing dependence on US tech giants for cloud services, including whether DNB and other agencies will reconsider migrations, which data and processes are already in US clouds, and the risks from US laws such as the CLOUD Act. The government answered that existing cloud policy already weighs market concentration and continuity risks, that some migrations were reconsidered, that a sovereign government cloud is being explored, and that it cannot give a blanket commitment to halt dependence.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful deliberation on cloud migrations is of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over belastingheffing op pensioenen opgebouwd in Duitsland

MP Joseph (BBB) asks the Finance Minister about Dutch income tax on small German pensions since 2016, the roughly 57,500 affected people, the choice of the 15,000 euro threshold, the pending Supreme Court case, and whether relief will be given before a ruling. The State Secretary answers that the treaty rule is intended to reduce administrative burden, that the Hoge Raad has not yet ruled so no action will be taken beforehand, and that the EU ruling was implemented via the Overige fiscale maatregelen 2025 law.
There is an ongoing cassation procedure. I therefore await the judgment of the Supreme Court.
Er is sprake van een lopende cassatieprocedure. Ik wacht derhalve het oordeel van de Hoge Raad af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over onrust onder gepensioneerden over nieuw verwacht belastingverdrag met Spanje

An MP asked the Finance Minister about unrest among Dutch pensioners in Spain over a planned new tax treaty, and asked whether income-effect calculations for example households would be published. The state secretary said he knows of the concern, is willing to illustrate effects for some stylised cases and will inform the House when the treaty is published, while noting a full general estimate is not feasible.
I am willing to map out, as requested, the effects on the tax burden for a number of example cases.
Ik ben bereid om, zoals gevraagd, voor een aantal voorbeeldgevallen in kaart te brengen wat de gevolgen voor de belastingdruk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een baggerproject in de Filipijnen

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked about the 1.5 billion euro export credit insurance for Boskalis's Manila Bay land reclamation, environmental impact reports, harm to fishers and coral, and compensation. The minister answered that the insurance was approved with conditions, that monitoring and an independent second opinion found the project adequate, and that compensation is primarily the project owner's responsibility, while refusing to comment on unrelated projects.
Export credit agency Atradius Dutch State Business (ADSB) only takes note of environmental impact reports for projects for which an insurance application has been submitted.
Ekv-uitvoerder Atradius Dutch State Business (ADSB) neemt alleen kennis van de milieueffectrapportages voor projecten waar een verzekeringsaanvraag voor is ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de toekenning van de extra middelen voor het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

An MP asked how the €50 million amendment for the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie would be implemented, how many of the 227,000 applications could now be honoured, what budget remains, and whether the amendment would be carried out in 2025 respecting parliament's budget right. The government replied that adding public money to the private-public fund is legally and financially risky, so it is exploring whether the €50 million can go to a planned public energy fund under the Social Climate Fund instead, and that nearly all of the €56.3 million has been paid out.
It is being explored whether the €50 million can be added to the available funds for the planned public energy fund supporting households with their energy bills.
Er wordt verkend of de € 50 miljoen kan worden toegevoegd aan de beschikbare middelen voor het te ontwikkelen publieke energiefonds voor de ondersteuning van huishoudens op de energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'De transformatie van Volksbank naar ASN Bank is niet goedkoop'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the ASN Bank (former Volksbank) reorganisation is aimed at a sale, how much it costs, and whether it conflicts with the House's wish to halt privatisation. The minister answered that the transformation is an operational decision of the bank in its commercial strategy, that the state and NLFI may not influence it under ACM measures, and that no sale decision has been taken yet.
Neither I nor NLFI have been involved in this operational decision.
Noch ik, noch NLFI zijn betrokken geweest bij dit operationele besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de voortgang van de hersteloperatie toeslagen

MP Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Finance about the progress of the childcare benefits scandal recovery, including whether faster claim processing would be available from September, whether all parent files were handled in August, and whether a government commissioner should be appointed. The State Secretary said two routes for additional damages are being finalised and SGH arrangements were made, but MijnHerstel cannot go live in September, that all files are being assessed and will be completed by year-end, and the cabinet chose continuity over appointing a commissioner.
Precisely to ensure progress in the childcare benefits recovery operation and to minimise unrest among victims, the cabinet has chosen continuity in the Recovery and Benefits portfolio.
Juist om te zorgen voor voortgang in de hersteloperatie toeslagen en om onrust bij gedupeerden te minimaliseren heeft het kabinet gekozen voor continuïteit op de portefeuille Herstel en Toeslagen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zakenmannen verkopen voor tientallen miljarden aan Israëlische wapenindustrie’

MP Van Baarle asked ministers about reports that Dutch businessmen supply electronic components via SASMOS to Israeli arms firms, raising prosecution, export control, and complicity questions. The government mostly declined to comment on individual companies, stated that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and reaffirmed Dutch export control and the 2025 measures on Israel.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether conduct that may be criminal and over which the Netherlands has jurisdiction is involved.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of sprake is van gedragingen die mogelijk strafbaar handelen opleveren en waarover Nederland rechtsmacht heeft.
Antwoord op de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de stand van zaken omtrent een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs asked about the status of an independent review of security and human rights risks behind an export credit guarantee for the Mozambique LNG project, whether Van Oord resumed work under force majeure, and related questions on Rwandan troop payments, UK Export Finance, NGO involvement, UN investigation and corruption. The Minister says the external analysis is not yet complete and expected after summer, the Dutch decision on amending the financing policy is pending, the export policy remains in force for Van Oord's exporter policy, and the government will not commit to a UN-led investigation, referring to Mozambique's own prosecutor.
I expect to be able to share the final report with your House after the summer, except for any confidential elements.
Ik verwacht het definitieve rapport, behoudens eventuele vertrouwelijke elementen, na de zomer met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over piramideschema’s van multi-levelmarketingsbedrijven

Van der Lee (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about young people being drawn into multi-level marketing schemes resembling pyramid games, the B:hip case, and whether the law should be changed. The minister, answering on behalf of economic affairs, said MLM is legal as such, that enforcement lies with the ACM, Ksa and AFM, declined new research and a reporting obligation, and said no change to the definition of pyramid games is needed.
There are no representative figures on the extent of MLM in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen representatieve cijfers over de omvang van MLM in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de uitvoering van een aantal aangenomen moties

An MP asked the Finance Minister why several adopted motions on savings markets and the Volksbank remain unimplemented, including a ban on tied sales (koppelverkoop). The minister answered that a PwC study found mandatory standalone savings accounts not in consumers' interest, contrary to the ACM recommendation, that a verkenning on direct savings-rate regulation is ongoing, and that a letter with an integrated response will follow in autumn.
I consider it important to weigh the findings of the study carefully and to discuss them with the ACM, in conjunction with the follow-up to its other recommendations, before I decide on them.

Ik vind het van belang om de bevindingen van het onderzoek zorgvuldig te wegen en in samenhang met de opvolging van haar andere aanbevelingen te bespreken met de ACM, voordat ik daarover een besluit neem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘accountantsbestuur NBA wendt revolte onder leden af’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the NBA's revised accountancy professional profile and its effects on SME access to audits, supply of accountants, and prices. The minister answered that the profile is the NBA's responsibility, expects the change to widen the supply of certified accountants, and commits to continued dialogue with the sector.
The new professional profile gives the accountant the choice whether to be authorised to perform statutory audits.
Het nieuwe beroepsprofiel geeft de keuze aan de accountant of deze certificeringsbevoegd wil zijn voor de uitvoering van de wettelijke controle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'Uitbreiding stroomnet trekt door TenneT spoor van vernieling bij boeren: je moet instemmen anders kun je worden onteigend'

MP Vermeer asked the Minister of Finance to specify how often TenneT reaches agreement with landowners, how often easement orders, mediation and expropriation were used, and what can prevent legal proceedings. The minister answered that over 3,000 contracts were concluded, about 40 landowners faced easement orders, mediation was used five times, and expropriation once, and that he will keep urging careful conduct by TenneT as shareholder.
Between 2020 and 2024 an easement obligation was imposed on about 40 landowners (in 12 procedures).
Tussen 2020 en 2024 is een gedoogplicht opgelegd aan circa 40 landeigenaren (in 12 procedures)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rep over aanbesteding Exportkredietverzekeringen (EKV)

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Finance about the tender of export credit insurance (EKV) services, including which bidders have registered, which stakeholders are involved, and the effects on users and long-term implementation. The Minister answered that the tender documents will be consulted on in September 2025, publication is aimed for end 2025, award is targeted for summer 2026, and the Chamber will be informed again in autumn.
The Chamber will be informed again about the state of affairs after the market consultation is completed and before the final tender documents are published.
De Kamer zal na afronding van de marktconsultatie en voor de publicatie van de finale aanbestedingsdocumenten opnieuw geïnformeerd worden over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Hirsch over het bericht 'FNV-economen: Europese bedrijven in de knel? De winsten zijn nog nooit zo hoog geweest'

MPs Thijssen and Hirsch (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about a newspaper report claiming European regulation harms productivity, citing the Draghi report, EIB investment survey data, OECD PMR benchmarks and productivity gaps with the US. Minister Karremans answers that regulation is one factor among several, that EU-level regulation and market fragmentation are a real burden, and that the cabinet pursues a competitiveness agenda while defending the value of proportionate regulation.
I intend to take further steps in this area in the coming period.
Ik ben voornemens om hier de komende periode verdere stappen op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Idsinga over het nieuwsbericht 'Brussels approves Poland's use of post-COVID funds for defence'

MPs Kahraman and Idsinga asked the Finance and Foreign Ministers about the Commission's approval of Poland reallocating nearly EUR 6 billion of recovery fund money to defence and whether the Netherlands would seek similar changes. The minister answered that the Dutch plan contains only already-budgeted defence spending, that no contact on reallocating funds to defence has taken place with the Commission, and that remaining payments face implementation risks.
So far, Poland is the only member state that has explicitly added a measure to its original plan allocating funds to defence-related purposes by amending its recovery plan.

Tot op heden is Polen de enige lidstaat die middels een aanpassing van het HVP expliciet een maatregel heeft toegevoegd aan het originele plan om middelen toe te wijzen aan defensie-gerelateerde doeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Boskalis ziet geen toekomst meer in Nederland: “We moeten niet verzwakt worden door doorgeschoten milieueisen”

Two VVD MPs asked the government how it views Boskalis considering leaving the Netherlands over strict environmental rules, and about the effects of CSRD, CSDDD, WAMCA, EU procurement and export credit policy on Dutch competitiveness. The government answered that it regrets any departure, is working on a business climate pact, supports raising the CSRD threshold but not abolishing it, is awaiting the WAMCA evaluation, and defends Dutch export credit policy as broadly in line with peers.
I aim to have this Pact ready for signing by mid-June.
Ik streef ernaar dit Pact medio juni gereed te hebben voor ondertekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma, Holman en Six Dijkstra over (cofinancierings-)aanvraag AI-fabriek en aangeven interesse AI-gigafabriek

Three NSC MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would express interest in an EU AI gigafactory before the Friday deadline, whether EU cofinancing could draw on Nij Begun funds for a Groningen AI factory, and the status of that application due 30 June. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports Nederlandse interest via a letter to the Commission without formally responding to the call, that no funds are reserved for a gigafactory, and that reallocation within departmental budgets is being explored to meet the 30 June requirement.
Via a letter to the European Commission, the Ministry of Economic Affairs will then shortly support the importance of AI gigafactories and Dutch interest.
Via een brief aan de Europese Commissie zal het Ministerie van Economische Zaken vervolgens op korte termijn het belang van AI-Gigafabrieken en de Nederlandse interesse ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'IMF maakt in analyse gehakt van Nederland koopkrachtfetisjisme'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he agrees with the IMF that Dutch policy should shift from purchasing-power support toward investment, and asked about long-term growth, capacity bottlenecks, and follow-up on a motion on high-leverage investments. The minister answered that the cabinet supports structural investment, will assess purchasing-power measures in August, points to existing long-term policy in the Miljoenennota, and committed to address the motion in the Miljoenennota 2026.
The caretaker cabinet endorses the importance of structural investments in the Dutch economy.
Het demissionaire kabinet onderschrijft het belang van structurele investeringen in de Nederlandse economie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP from JA21 asked ministers across many departments how much money, which diversity, gender and inclusion policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and consultants their implementing agencies use. The government answered that spending is mostly embedded in general HR policy, lists the agencies' trainings and monitoring tools, and provided the requested figures per organisation where available.
There is a large number of implementing and sui generis organisations.
Er is sprake van een groot aantal uitvoerings- en sui generis organisaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de weigering van een stichting om openheid van zaken te geven over de financiële afwikkeling van de stichting en het vermogen dat mede bestaat uit giften van derden

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers how a dissolved foundation (Stichting Kanjer Wens) can refuse to disclose how its assets, including donations, were wound up, and whether transparency rules should be tightened. The government answered that existing rules (Civil Code liquidation and turboliquidatie registration at the Chamber of Commerce, tax reporting for former ANBIs, and donor inspection rights through courts) provide adequate transparency, and it saw no need to change the law at this stage.

On the obligation to register information at the Chamber of Commerce during the winding-up of a foundation, reference is made to the answer to question 3, so that they can check what happened to the assets.

Voor wat betreft de verplichting tot registratie van informatie in het handelsregister bij financiële afwikkeling en/of vereffening van een stichting wordt verwezen naar het antwoord op vraag 3 en kunnen zij nagaan wat er met het vermogen is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nordkamp over het artikel ‘Vechten om te overleven middelgrote defensiebedrijven in Nederland dreigen ten onder te gaan’.

An MP asks whether medium-sized defence firms are being squeezed out by large contracts, tiering of suppliers, and strict down-payment and bank guarantee rules. The Minister of Defence replies that there is no preferential policy, that large firms win complex and framework contracts on capability and supply security, that alternatives to bank guarantees are being examined case by case, and that government support for failing firms is considered only in exceptional, conditional situations.
There is no question of a preferential policy in this scale-up.
Bij deze opschaling is geen sprake van een voorkeursbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de investeringsplannen van staatsdeelneming Schiphol en het besluit om geen dividend uit te keren aan de Staat over het jaar 2024

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Finance Minister about Schiphol's investment plans, whether shareholder approval was required, and the decision not to pay a dividend for 2024. The Minister said the investment thresholds are €200 million, that no shareholder approval has yet been given for the planned investments, that the dividend policy change was agreed unanimously with shareholders, and that a 30% payout applies for five years, with fiscal impact considered limited.
Schiphol's concrete investment plans are classified as commercially confidential information and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
De concrete investeringsplannen van Schiphol worden aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kunnen daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de herstel- en veerkrachtfaciliteit

An MP from NSC asks the Finance Minister about the European Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF) following the European Court of Auditors' criticism: whether the government agrees, who controls spending, whether it is unclear where money goes and what results it has produced, whether the EU's role amounts to interference in national policy, and whether such funds should be discontinued. The minister answers that the Court's analysis is largely a summary of earlier reports, that payments are milestone-based and oversight rests with the Commission, member states and anti-fraud bodies, that results are premature to assess, and that the government favours not repeating joint-loan financing but is open to results-based budgeting.
The cabinet is not in favour of repeating the financing of the instrument through joint loans.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een herhaling van de financiering van het instrument middels gemeenschappelijke leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over een ongekend kritisch rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over het coronaherstelfonds

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' critical publication on the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility, covering performance orientation, accountability, cost opacity, output-focused milestones, weak control and recovery mechanisms, overlap with other funds, and debt repayment pressure. The minister responds at length that the publication summarises earlier reports, defends the milestone-based design and the Commission's stance, acknowledges some points (recovery limits, transparency of assessment), is open to results-based budgeting in future, and makes no concrete new commitment beyond taking lessons into account.
The cabinet attaches importance to the controlling role of the ECA and its oversight of the lawful spending of European funds.
Het kabinet hecht belang aan de controlerende rol van de ERK en haar toezien op de rechtmatige besteding van Europese middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Stoffer en Flach over het bericht Cryptomijnen in een land onder hoogspanning

MPs Van Dijk, Stoffer and Flach asked the ministers whether Dutch and EU rules apply to Dutch firms mining crypto in Ethiopia, and about its benefits, its effect on the local population's electricity, and the government's moral view. The minister answered that OECD and UN business standards apply, that crypto mining brings foreign currency but little direct benefit to the population, and that no additional legislation is needed.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to apply the OECD Guidelines on responsible business conduct and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'Uitbreiding stroomnet trekt door TenneT spoor van vernieling bij boeren: je moet instemmen anders kun je worden onteigend'

An MP from BBB asked the Finance Minister about reports that TenneT's grid expansion damages farmers' land, that contractors breach agreements, and that crop-damage compensation is hard to prove after two years. The minister acknowledged complaints, said TenneT uses supervisors and standard contracts, and promised to keep pressing TenneT on careful conduct and to evaluate the compensation process.
I have asked TenneT to continue to pay attention in the coming years to the careful conduct of (sub)contractors and to honour agreements on how the work is carried out.
Ik heb TenneT verzocht de komende jaren aandacht te blijven houden voor het zorgvuldig handelen van (onder)aannemers en om afspraken over de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Hoe christelijke donateurs in Nederland radicale Israëlische kolonisten steunen'

An MP asks the government about reports that Dutch Christian and Zionist foundations fund Israeli settlers building on the occupied West Bank, asking about legality, oversight, sanctions, tax status and prosecution. The government acknowledges the occupation is unlawful, says private relations are not prohibited but undesirable, states it does not monitor such financial flows, and declines to comment on individuals, prosecutions or tax status.

The cabinet does not conduct general supervision of financial flows abroad and therefore does not have information on where and for what purpose money from foundations such as Christenen voor Israël actually goes.

Het kabinet houdt geen algemeen toezicht op financieringsstromen richting het buitenland en beschikt daarom ook niet over informatie waar en met welke bedoeling geld van stichtingen zoals Christenen voor Israël exact naar toe gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de uitspraak van de rechter dat achterafbetaaldienst Klarna verdient aan Incassokosten

An MP asked the government about court rulings finding that buy-now-pay-later provider Klarna earns from reminder and collection fees and may fall under consumer credit rules, and about measures against such practices. The ministers answered that the rulings concern one creditor failing to prove fees were not part of the business model, that BNPL providers will fall under the revised EU consumer credit directive by November 2026 with AFM supervision, and that the industry code and talks with Klarna are being tightened.
It is up to the AFM to assess whether this ruling has consequences for supervision.
Het is aan de AFM om te beoordelen of deze uitspraak gevolgen heeft voor het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de uitzending van Radar van 31 maart 2025 en dan specifiek het onderwerp 'Senioren geweigerd voor tijdelijke lening ondanks overwaarde'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked the Ministers of Finance and Housing about a Radar broadcast reporting that seniors with home equity were refused bridging mortgages. Minister Keijzer (Housing) said such refusals are undesirable, that she will consult ouderenorganisaties, banks, NVB and supervisors, and will raise bridging credit in the monitoring of the Convenant Ouderen & Toekomstbestendig Wonen.
Therefore I want to consult stakeholders to find out why seniors have difficulty obtaining a bridging mortgage.
Daarom wil ik in gesprek met stakeholders achterhalen waarom senioren moeilijk een overbruggingshypotheek kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat loyale klanten meer betalen voor een verzekering

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about an AFM study finding that loyal customers pay higher premiums at nearly half of insurers without verifiable risk differences, and about possible rule breaches, supervisory powers, the UK and Irish approaches, and affected customers. The minister answered that the AFM is responsible for supervision and enforcement, that it has sufficient powers, that the ministry sees no additional role for now, and that the AFM is in dialogue with insurers and will assess compliance.
The AFM report does not go into this.
Het rapport van de AFM gaat hier niet op in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Beroepsorganisatie NBA staakt jacht op frauderende accountants

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the NBA can no longer pursue disciplinary action against accountants for exam fraud because large audit firms refuse to cooperate, and what the government will do. The minister answers that the NBA lacks powers to obtain information, that a review of the professional regulation system will be commissioned this year, and that legislative changes will follow if needed.

It is undesirable if the professional organisation has no power to obtain the necessary information to establish whether there are accountants against whom it wishes to file a complaint with the Accountantskamer.

Het is onwenselijk als de beroepsorganisatie geen bevoegdheid heeft om de nodige inlichtingen in te winnen om te achterhalen of er accountants zijn jegens wie zij een klacht aanhangig wil maken bij de Accountantskamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over nieuwe onnodige regels voor ondernemers

An MP asks the Finance Minister why a draft decree requiring financial firms to register and contract outsourced work conflicts with the coalition goal of fewer rules for businesses, and questions the cost and necessity of the rules and the move away from WOZ-based mortgage valuation. The minister defends the outsourcing rules on AFM findings (11% of firms lacked signed contracts), acknowledges around EUR 421,000 in compliance costs and promises to review feasibility after consultation, and says mortgage valuation changes are not aimed at loan size.
Following the consultation responses, I will examine whether the rules are feasible, and if not, whether alternative options exist.
Naar aanleiding van de consultatiereacties zal ik bezien of de regels uitvoerbaar zijn, en zo niet, of er alternatieve mogelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Vijlbrief en Grinwis over de stijgende kosten voor huiseigenaren en bedrijven als gevolg van het ravijnjaar voor gemeenten

MPs asked the government about rising property tax (ozb) for homeowners and businesses caused by municipal deficits, and about whether this is reflected in purchasing-power, inflation and poverty forecasts. The minister answered that the government is in talks with local authorities, that ozb is excluded from forecasts with only small effects, and that setting local taxes is a matter for municipal councils.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, the level of services and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk, en Haage over het bericht ‘Minister Van Hijum kraakt plan pensioenreferendum van zijn eigen partij: kritisch advies in concept-brief’

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a critical draft advisory note on a pension referendum amendment was real and why supporting documents had not been published. The minister confirmed awareness, said underlying departmental notes will be published with the cabinet response before the plenary debate, and explained that advice is withheld until a ministerial decision is made.
All underlying departmental notes from SZW and Finance used in decision-making will be made public at the same time as the cabinet response.
Alle onderliggende departementale nota's van SZW en van Financiën die zijn gebruikt bij de besluitvorming, zullen tegelijk met de kabinetsreactie openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Fiserv neemt CCV over’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Fiserv's takeover of payments provider CCV and whether CCV is critical payment infrastructure, and whether the US CLOUD Act could force disclosure of Dutch payment data. The minister answered that CCV is one of several retail payment providers, declined to say publicly whether it is critical infrastructure citing confidentiality under the investment screening law, and stated that US CLOUD Act access is possible under strict conditions but considered low risk, pointing to GDPR and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
I cannot make public statements about which institutions belong to the critical or vital infrastructure of the Netherlands, as this is confidential information.
Ik kan geen openbare uitspraken doen over welke instellingen onder de kritieke, dan wel vitale, infrastructuur van Nederland behoren aangezien dit vertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Paulusma over de gevolgen van het halveren van het eigen risico op de hoogte van de zorgpremies

MPs Vijlbrief and Paulusma (D66) asked the health and finance ministers about the premium rise, longer waiting lists, and income and poverty effects from halving the mandatory deductible (eigen risico). Minister Agema answered that the premium rise (about 199 euro in 2027) is a financing effect partly offset by compensation, that the rise in care demand is estimated at about 64 euro, and that the bill was in internet consultation and would reach the House after the Raad van State advice.
It is customary for a bill to first go to internet consultation and then be submitted via the Council of Ministers to the Council of State for advice, before it is submitted to the House.
Het is gebruikelijk dat een wetsvoorstel éérst in internetconsultatie gaat en daarna via de ministerraad aan de Raad van State wordt aangeboden voor advies, voordat het bij de Kamer wordt aangeboden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Rooderkerk over het uitblijven van duurzame investeringen door bedrijven en beleggers

MPs Vijlbrief and Rooderkerk asked whether unclear climate policy is delaying green investment, whether a climate package will be in place this spring, and about the cost of delayed action and government cuts to the green economy. The minister replied that the government is committed to the Climate Act targets, cited grid congestion, CCS capacity and electricity prices as the main reasons for delayed investment, promised clarity in the Klimaatplan and Voorjaarsnota, and deferred several points to the spring budget.
The cabinet has committed in the Coalition Agreement and Government Programme to the existing agreements on the 2030 and 2050 climate targets as formulated in the Climate Act.
Het kabinet heeft zich in het Hoofdlijnenakkoord en het Regeerprogramma gecommitteerd aan de bestaande afspraken voor de klimaatdoelen van 2030 en 2050 zoals geformuleerd in de Klimaatwet.
Antwoord op van het lid Vijlbrief over 'de verhouding tussen KLM (en Transavia) en pilotenvakbond VNV'

An MP (D66) asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about KLM and Transavia favouring members of pilots' union VNV in collective agreement benefits, and about the state's role as shareholder regarding the union's influence on KLM management. The minister answered that wage and union matters are management's responsibility, that the state as shareholder raised disappointment at the 2024 AGM, and that discrimination disputes are for the courts, which she could not prejudge.
KLM's management is responsible for the day-to-day management of the organisation.
De directie van KLM is verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Van der Lee en Hirsch over het over het bericht 'EU Omnibus: EU finance ministers back proposal, Parliament heavily divided'

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about the Ecofinraad discussion of the 'stop-the-clock' proposal delaying CSRD sustainability reporting, and whether the minister urged extending the pause to first-wave companies. The minister confirmed he suggested that first-wave companies also receive a pause, citing the Commission's planned scope reduction and simplification of ESRS, while stating the NFRD remains in force and the Chamber would be informed in time.
However, I made clear in the Ecofin Council that the Netherlands is still studying the proposal and there is not yet an official cabinet position.
Wel heb ik in de Ecofinraad duidelijk gemaakt dat Nederland het voorstel nog aan het bestuderen is en er nog geen officiële kabinetspositie is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over de gewijzigde regeling voor expats, die volgens de eigen ramingstoelichting van het ministerie geen geld zou kosten, doordat gedragseffecten niet juist zijn

MPs Omtzigt and Van Vroonhoven asked why the expat (30%) tax rule amendment was costed at 194 million euros with supposedly no behavioural effects, and why the Belastingplan 2025 treatment appears inconsistent. The State Secretary replied that a 10% behavioural effect was applied, that the amendment yield stays at 194 million, that the 2025 changes also include behavioural effects, and that the salary norm will rise from 2027 in response to a motion.
It is not correct that no behavioural effects were used. A behavioural effect of 10% was assumed.
Het klopt niet dat er geen gedragseffecten zijn gehanteerd. Er is uitgegaan van een gedragseffect van 10%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Beleid staatsdeelnemingen kan beter wat betreft marktverstoring en klimaatrisico’s

An MP asked the Finance Minister about separation of public and commercial activities at state holdings such as NS and Holland Casino, climate risk disclosure, the Tennet loan, and OECD guidance. The minister replied that NS keeps a strict accounting separation reported to the transport ministry, that other holdings lack such separation, that climate risks are managed by boards and reviewed in the periodic policy evaluation, and that Nordic models and OECD recommendations will be considered later.
Because of competitively sensitive information, this separation is not made visible in NS's public annual report.
Vanwege concurrentiegevoelige informatie wordt deze scheiding in het publieke jaarverslag van NS niet inzichtelijk gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Troebele Hollands glorie in de Baai van Manilla: hoe baggeraar Boskalis zich vertilde aan een prestigeproject'

MPs Hirsch and Van der Lee asked about the Dutch export credit guarantee for the Manila Bay airport project by Boskalis and San Miguel, raising sea-level rise, habitat compensation, relocated families and transparency concerns. The government answered that the project meets international standards, that compensation is being monitored and largely delivered, and that it sees no reason to change its decision.

An independent evaluation of the monitoring of this project, recently shared with your House, shows that it is robust and adequately designed to address any irregularities in implementation in a timely manner.

Uit een onafhankelijke evaluatie van de monitoring van dit project die recent met uw Kamer is gedeeld, blijkt dat deze robuust is en adequaat is ingericht om eventuele misstanden in de uitvoering tijdig te adresseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Joseph over het feit dat het pensioenfonds Gasunie wil beleggen met geleend geld voor jonge deelnemers, die daardoor hun hele pensioenopbouw kwijt kunnen raken

Two MPs asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that young pension members could lose their entire accrued pension if a pension fund lifts the borrowing restriction and invests with leverage, and what will be done about it. The minister answers that governance requirements and DNB supervision sufficiently limit the risk, that an evaluation of the practice will follow, and that no further agreements or regulation are seen as necessary.
I believe the current governance requirements and safeguards sufficiently limit the risk.
Ik vind dat de huidige governancevereisten en waarborgen het risico voldoende beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het behoud en de verduurzaming van de Nederlandse industrie

An MP from the CDA asks how the government responds to industry calls and the EU Clean Industrial Deal for relief, including lower energy taxes, the revenue and effects of the CO2 levy on industry, expected ETS and other revenues, subsidy support, and the risk of industrial decline. The minister answers that the government supports EU energy tax reform and an ETS-aware approach, will evaluate the CO2 levy later this year, and shares revenue and subsidy figures, but declines to model the tax loss from industrial shrinkage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat de inflatie in februari is toegenomen

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister whether the February inflation rise matches expectations, what causes it and the gap with the EU average, whether profit-driven inflation is rising, and how purchasing power losses for 2025 will be corrected. The minister answers that the figure fits the CPB's forecast of 3.2% for 2025, attributes the gap to services inflation, a tight labour market and rent indexation, says profits and wages are economically explained, and states that the purchasing power change is mainly driven by lower pension indexation without new cabinet measures.
The February inflation figure fits the recent inflation forecast in the CPB's Central Economic Plan (CEP).
Het inflatiecijfer van februari past in de recente inflatieraming uit het CEP van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Toezichthouders vragen versoepeling Europese bankenregels’

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister how he views calls from European bank supervisors for simplifying EU banking rules, the EU-US banking rule comparison, and related issues. The minister welcomed attention to regulatory burden, deferred concrete steps to sector input, Commission analysis and a forthcoming expert study, and committed to discussing the issue with Dutch supervisors and informing parliament.
I am willing to discuss this with the supervisors and to share my insights from those conversations with your House.
Ik ben bereid om hierover met de toezichthouders in gesprek te gaan en mijn opgedane inzichten naar aanleiding van deze gesprekken met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat een prijsplafond voor gas wordt overwogen

An MP asked whether the government would support an EU gas price cap, how it views state responsibility for gas security and affordability, the effect of energy taxes, the functioning of the energy emergency fund, and whether gas firms deliberately keep prices high. The minister responded that the Commission has no such proposal, the government is critical of market price caps, gas security is shared with the market, energy taxes are a small part of inflation, the emergency fund reached 110,937 households in 2024, and there is no evidence of deliberate price-raising by the sector.
The government sees no deliberate tactic by the gas sector to keep prices high in order to make more profit.
Het kabinet ziet geen bewuste tactiek van de gassector om de prijzen hoog te houden om zodoende meer winst te behalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Financiële les op school moet toenemende schulden bij jongeren tegengaan'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister of Finance about rising youth debt, financial literacy in schools, BNPL regulation, and the link between unpaid health insurance and benefit timing. The government acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing financial education subsidies and debt-prevention measures, said BNPL rules will tighten with the CCDII implementation, and committed to a study on harmonising payment dates.
The Ministry of SZW will therefore commission a study in the coming months into harmonising payment dates.
Het Ministerie van SZW gaat daarom in de komende maanden een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar het harmoniseren van betaalmomenten.
Antwoord op het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Euronext wil populaire handel in ETF’s naar Amsterdam halen’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about Euronext's plan to attract ETF trading to Amsterdam, including market competitiveness, index inclusion of closed-end funds and capital-market integration. The minister answers largely that these are matters for Euronext and the market, that the government considers capital-market conditions and will send a letter on the Capital Markets Union later this quarter, and that a national regulatory overview will follow.

This may be a possible effect whose logic I can follow in theory, although I have no insight into the precise competitive position of Euronext Amsterdam relative to exchanges in other European countries.

Dit kan een mogelijk effect zijn waarvan ik de logica in theorie kan volgen, al heb ik geen zicht op de precieze concurrentiepositie van Euronext Amsterdam ten opzichte van beurzen in andere Europese landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het bericht dat Talpa jaarcijfers aan het zicht onttrekt

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked whether Talpa's use of the 'Blokker construction' to withhold annual accounts from public view is lawful, and what sanctions and changes are available. The state secretary answers that failing to publish a required subsidiary account breaches the publication duty, that the fine is modest but further civil and personal liability remedies exist, and that no legislative change is planned.
Failing to file the annual accounts is an economic offence.
Het niet deponeren van de jaarrekening is een economisch delict.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘’Nederlandse lobby om fintech te lokken na brexit ging nooit vliegen”, naar aanleiding van een artikel in het FD van 2 februari 2025

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch lobby to attract fintech firms after Brexit failed, how many firms settled because of Brexit, why firms may have avoided the Netherlands, whether DNB's supervision and speed of licensing were too strict, and what became of the regulatory sandbox. The minister answered that 56 of 115 facilitated fintech firms are linked to Brexit, that Dutch licensing is generally faster than the European average, that automatic licences were not considered, and that the InnovationHub is being reformed and supervisors will be engaged on the issue.
It is difficult to give a good estimate of the number of fintech companies that settled in the Netherlands after Brexit.
Het is moeilijk om een goede inschatting te geven van het aantal fintech-bedrijven dat zich na de brexit in Nederland heeft gevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Cryptowereld creëert systeemrisico dat aan kredietcrisis doet denken

MP Van der Lee (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Finance about a report that crypto 'cloning' and layered reuse of collateral create systemic risk resembling the 2008 credit crisis, asking about risks, regulation, and investor protection. Minister Heinen answered at length that current systemic risks are limited, that MiCA and Basel-based rules address them, that an EU evaluation is due in June 2025, and that a study into crypto trading risks is underway.
At present, the risks of these developments for financial stability in the Netherlands are limited.
Op dit moment zijn de risico's van deze ontwikkelingen voor de financiële stabiliteit in Nederland beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van der Lee over “de online surveillance van Bunq”, naar aanleiding van een artikel in het Financieele Dagblad van 19 december 2024

MPs Kathmann and Van der Lee asked whether bank Bunq pressured customers via its app to stop online criticism, whether it may link user data to such posts, and whether supervisors should investigate. The minister replied that Bunq denies threatening or terminating customers, that banks cannot use online criticism as a legal basis to process customer data, and that the independent supervisors AFM and DNB cannot be instructed to investigate a specific case.
The AFM and DNB are independent administrative bodies and function as independent supervisors. I therefore cannot ask the supervisors to investigate a specific situation.
De AFM en DNB zijn zelfstandige bestuursorganen en functioneren als onafhankelijke toezichthouders. Ik kan de toezichthouders daarom niet vragen om een specifieke situatie te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over concurrentievervalsing van de Big Four

An MP asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about alleged competition distortion by the Big Four accountancy firms, following a complaint by OvRAN to the European Commission and ACM. The minister answers that ACM found no evidence of prohibited conduct, that joint market power is not itself unlawful, and that no further action is planned.
I therefore see no reason to take further action.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om verdere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Idsinga over de MLT ramingen (tekort en schuldquote) na ieder regeerakkoord

MPs Omtzigt and Idsinga asked the Finance Minister to compare the EMU deficit and debt projections after each coalition agreement (2012, 2017, 2021, 2024) with realised outcomes, and whether projections show structural bias. The minister provided tables comparing Startnota projections with FJR outcomes, noted growing uncertainty over a four-year horizon and that an independent expert group on realistic forecasting will report in March.
The report of the expert group will be sent to parliament in mid-March.
Het rapport van de expertgroep zal medio maart naar het parlement worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk, Teunissen en Stultiens over het rapport 'Takers, not makers'

MPs Dijk, Teunissen and Stultiens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the Oxfam report 'Takers, not makers' on billionaire wealth, inheritance, wealth inequality, tax avoidance, global extraction and wealth taxes. The minister rejected the report's framing, arguing Dutch income inequality is low and stable and wealth inequality has fallen, while pointing to box 3 reform, existing tax measures and a planned review of anti-dividend-stripping options, without committing to higher taxes on wealth or inheritance.
This cabinet is not considering further raising the gift and inheritance tax rates for multi-million euro inheritances.
Dit kabinet overweegt niet de tarieven in schenk- en erfbelasting verder te verhogen voor miljoenenerfenissen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over de memo in handen van RTL aangaande het ingediende amendement Joseph c.s. over een referendum over het invaren van pensioenfondsen

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the government would publish a leaked ministry memo on the budgetary cost of the NSC-backed Joseph amendment on a pension-fund referendum, and whether an MP had access to cabinet-internal documents. The minister confirmed the memo exists and attached it, denied it was a cabinet-internal document shared with the MP, and committed to publish the advice and appreciation of the amended amendment when the cabinet appreciation is issued.

As requested by the standing parliamentary committee on Social Affairs and Employment, the amended amendment will be accompanied by a cabinet appreciation, advice from the Council of State, and views from supervisors, the Tax Authority, pension administrators and social partners.

Zoals door de vaste Kamercommissie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid gevraagd, wordt het gewijzigde amendement voorzien van een kabinetsappreciatie, advies van de Raad van State, en zienswijzen van onder andere de toezichthouders, Belastingdienst, pensioenuitvoerders en sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over de evaluatie van de ATAD-richtlijn per 31 juli 2024

Member Welzijn asks whether the earnings stripping rule under the ATAD implementation in the Dutch corporate tax Act disproportionately burdens housing associations, which must finance through debt, and asks why no exemption is possible or what other EU states do. Minister Keijzer answers that the rule is a generic interest-deduction limit required by ATAD1, that exemptions for housing associations are not permitted under the directive or state aid rules, that the government raised the deduction percentage to 24.5% for a relief of 69 million euros for housing associations, and that the ATAD evaluation by the European Commission is awaited before further steps are decided.
To determine our specific position, we first await the outcomes of the ATAD evaluation currently being carried out by the European Commission.
Voor het bepalen van onze specifieke inzet wachten wij eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van ATAD af die momenteel wordt uitgevoerd door de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het beboeten van supermarkten vanwege te veel ongezond voedsel

MPs asked whether supermarkets should be fined for selling too much unhealthy food, whether advertising and pricing can be restricted, and what the costs of removing VAT on healthy food would be. The state secretary said supermarkets bear a responsibility, that concrete agreements and monitoring of healthy-sales shares will be pursued, that a broad ban on food advertising lacks support while child-directed marketing rules are being prepared, that a bonus-malus scheme is doubtful, and that VAT removal on healthy food is rejected as too costly and legally unworkable.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Pump.fun verboden in het Verenigd Koninkrijk’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the UK ban on the memecoin platform Pump.fun and whether comparable platforms should be regulated and restricted in the Netherlands, including protecting young people from finfluencers and a commission ban for crypto apps. The minister points to the new EU MiCA regulation, a forthcoming study on crypto risks and finfluencers, and says further steps depend on its outcome and the MiCA evaluation.
I have no information about the activities of individual parties.
Ik heb geen informatie over de activiteiten van individuele partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het sluiten van filialen van de Volksbank

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether branch closures at the state-owned Volksbank are a good development, whether reorganisation is necessary, and whether a public deposit bank could protect public interests. The Minister replied that the bank sets its own commercial strategy and the state may not interfere under ACM conditions, that a public deposit bank is not realistic, and pointed to sector-wide measures instead.
Under the ACM measures, NLFI and the state may not interfere with the Volksbank's commercial strategy, such as the number of branches or the choice of brand name.
In het kader van de ACM-maatregelen mogen NLFI en de staat zich niet bemoeien met de commerciële strategie van de Volksbank, zoals het aantal filialen of de keuze voor een merknaam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Van Eijk en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Achteraf betalen kan binnenkort ook in fysieke winkels dankzij nieuwe samenwerking'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about news that buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) would extend to physical shops, and about its effects on young people and indebted consumers. The minister answered that BNPL-in-shops offers minimal social added value with large risks, pointed to the coming CCDII directive, age verification and a sector code, and said a temporary ban is not feasible.
The government therefore finds the announcement to extend BNPL services to physical shops very undesirable.
De aankondiging om BNPL-diensten uit te breiden naar fysieke winkels vindt het kabinet dan ook zeer onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Einde Buy Now Pay Later stap dichterbij'

An MP asks the Finance and Justice ministers whether Buy Now Pay Later providers profiting from late-payment fees fall under the consumer credit directive, following a CJEU ruling. The minister confirms the ruling, explains that the Dutch case awaits the Supreme Court, and notes that the revised directive will bring BNPL under strict credit rules; timing of the Supreme Court decision is expected in the second half of 2025.
To determine whether the BNPL provider in this specific case falls within the scope of the current Consumer Credit Directive and what the implications are, the court's ruling must be awaited.

Om te kunnen bepalen of de betreffende BNPL-aanbieder in deze specifieke zaak binnen het toepassingsbereik van de huidige Richtlijn consumentenkrediet valt en welke implicaties dit heeft, moet de uitspraak van de rechter worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Kan kabinet niet optreden tegen buy now pay later? Dat ligt net een beetje anders’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether EU rules allow a national ban on buy-now-pay-later services, whether member states such as Germany have national rules, and when the new consumer credit directive will be implemented. The minister answered that a permanent ban is not allowed under the new directive, a temporary ban would be undesirable, the implementation consultation is expected in early 2025, and the bill is expected to reach parliament in autumn 2025.
A ban on BNPL services (in physical shops and/or online) is therefore not possible under the CCDII.
Een verbod op BNPL-diensten (in fysieke winkels en/of online) is onder de CCDII dan ook niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Van der Lee over een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een project in Kazachstan

MPs Hirsch and Van der Lee asked about a 2014 Dutch export credit guarantee for a Van Oord canal project at Tengiz oil field in Kazakhstan, including corruption, UBO ownership of the debtor Tenizservice, environmental and social risk assessment, and monitoring. The ministers answered that no claims were paid, the project was assessed under the 2014 policy with risks judged mitigated, UBO identification was not then required, and monitoring was introduced only from 2022.
No, at the time the policy was issued monitoring was not yet laid down in the policy.
Nee, ten tijde van afgifte van de polis was monitoring nog niet vastgelegd in het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over private equity die jaagt op corporatiemiljarden

An SP MP asked the Minister about private equity firms acquiring maintenance companies working for housing corporations, and whether this raises costs and prices. The minister replied that such investment fits an open economy, that cost increases cannot be attributed to it, and that the regulator and competition authority will keep monitoring developments.
This development fits within an open economy and I currently see no signals that cause me concern.
Deze ontwikkeling past binnen een open economie en ik zie vooralsnog geen signalen die mij zorgen baren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Vriendjespolitiek en intimidatie bij Europa’s investeringsbank'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports of cronyism and intimidation at the European Investment Bank, including poor staff survey results on integrity and whistleblowing. The minister said he shares the concern, supports the new EIB president's action plan, says Dutch pressure has been raised in the Board, and that the EIB management committee holds responsibility for workplace safety.
The Netherlands will closely monitor the implementation of the action plan and continue to press for a safe and open work culture within the EIB.
Nederland zal de uitvoering van het actieplan nauwgezet monitoren en erop blijven aandringen dat er binnen de EIB een veilige en open werkcultuur is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de deelneming Schiphol Group

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol Group, a state holding, lives up to its expected exemplary role on occupational health (exposure to aircraft engine emissions, heavy lifting by baggage handlers) and on the planned security tender. The minister answered that employers and Schiphol bear primary responsibility, that the Labour Inspectorate and the government are monitoring, that Schiphol has committed to more lifting aids and audits, and that the security tender is a legal and organisational matter for Schiphol.
As shareholder of Schiphol, I support Schiphol's initiatives to improve working conditions.
Als aandeelhouder van Schiphol ondersteun ik de initiatieven van Schiphol om de arbeidsomstandigheden te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Idsinga over de ramingen van het Centraal planbureau en de grote ramingsfouten die daarin zijn gemaakt de afgelopen jaren

MPs Omtzigt and Idsinga asked the Finance Minister about large forecasting errors in government and CPB deficit and tax-revenue projections, and about whether the new expert group on forecasting would receive their initiative note and report by March 2025. The Minister answered that the note will be forwarded, the expert group's findings await, and forecast errors are attributed to volatile conditions, while declining to commit to legal anchoring of forecast accuracy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over de inkomstenramingen bij de Najaarsnota.

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Van Vroonhoven) asked the Finance Ministry to reconstruct how revenue forecasts in the Najaarsnota 2024 were made, why revenue forecasts have consistently underestimated outturns, and whether an internal evaluation exists. Minister Heinen answered that forecasts follow a model recalibrated with cash data, attributes past underestimates to economic volatility, tax-specific factors and corporate tax timing, and says an expert group on forecasting is still analysing the gaps.
The expert group on forecasts is currently analysing the forecast differences on both the revenue and expenditure side of the budget.
Momenteel werkt de expertgroep ramingen aan een analyse van de ramingsverschillen aan zowel inkomsten- en uitgavenkant van de begroting.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Helft stichtingen ondervindt problemen met de bank: 'Het systeem is doorgeslagen''

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that many charities and foundations face problems with banks due to anti-money-laundering screening, and about the fees and account access issues involved. The minister acknowledged the problem, said banks must apply the risk-based approach, pointed to DNB supervision and an NVB standard, and promised to raise bank fees at the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer.
I therefore consider it essential that banks continue to work on improving their risk-based approach, to prevent unnecessary problems and exclusion.
Ik vind het daarom van essentieel belang dat banken blijven inzetten op het verbeteren van hun risicogebaseerde aanpak, om onnodige problemen en uitsluiting te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vree over het bericht 'Helft stichtingen en verenigingen heeft problemen bank dankzij doorgeschoten anti-terrorismemaatregelen'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he knows of reports that half of foundations and associations have banking problems due to overzealous anti-terrorism measures, what steps he will take, and how banks can be encouraged to apply a risk-based approach. The minister answered that banks must apply the Wwft risk-based, that he will raise this with DNB and the Dutch Banking Association, and that a fuller proposal will follow in early 2025.
Early 2025 I will send your House, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, the elaboration of the government programme on preventing money laundering and terrorist financing.
Begin 2025 stuur ik uw Kamer, met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, de uitwerking van het regeerprogramma op het terrein van het voorkomen van witwassen en terrorismefinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over belastingontwijkingsconstructies met fiscale aftrekposten

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the Finance Minister about tax-avoidance structures using investment deductions (EIA, MIA, Vamil), including whether business partnerships, leasing, debt financing and rulings allow non-entrepreneurs to claim them. The State Secretary answered that the schemes are generic, that usage figures and examples are given, that the Belastingdienst polices abuse, and declined to disclose individual cases citing tax confidentiality, while committing only to investigate publishing anonymised ruling summaries for individuals.
Given the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot discuss individual cases.
Gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘AFM bezorgd over stijging marktaandeel van private equity in de accountancy’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the AFM's concern that private equity's share of the accountancy sector rose from 11% to 21% in a year, and whether this threatens audit quality and what measures are planned. The minister answers that existing and proposed rules already safeguard independence, that the effects are uncertain and could be positive or negative, that primary responsibility lies with audit firms, and that no specific measures against private equity are planned, while monitoring with the AFM continues.

I am not in favour of specific measures targeting private equity parties, because I currently have no reason to assume that the influence of private equity on balance harms the quality of statutory audit.

Ik ben geen voorstander van specifieke maatregelen gericht tegen private-equitypartijen, omdat ik op dit moment geen aanleiding heb te veronderstellen dat de invloed van private equity per saldo afbreuk doet aan de kwaliteit van de wettelijke controle.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen over toenemende investeringen en leningen in sectoren die verantwoordelijk zijn voor tropische ontbossing

MPs Kostić and Teunissen asked the government about rising financing of sectors linked to tropical deforestation, whether Dutch financial institutions should be held to account, and how the EUDR and other instruments could regulate financial flows. The minister answered that financial institutions are expected to follow OECD and UN due diligence standards, that the EU will assess in December 2025 whether to bring financiers under the EUDR (which the cabinet considers unsuitable in its current form), and that supervisors already apply climate and nature risk expectations, while declining to commit to a binding ban on such investments.

The cabinet is of the view that the EUDR in its current form is not suitable for checking financial institutions and financial flows, because it is aimed at checking the production and supply chains of physical products and goods.

Het kabinet is van mening dat de EUDR in de huidige vorm niet geschikt is om financiële instellingen en geldstromen te controleren, omdat deze is gericht op het controleren van de productie en toeleveringsketens van fysieke producten en goederen.

Antwoord op vragen die het lid Eerdmans over het bericht van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) op 10 december 2024, waarin wordt gemeld dat de inflatie in november is gestegen naar 4,0 procent

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Finance Minister why Dutch HICP inflation (3.8%) exceeds the eurozone average, what measures will be taken, the effects on middle incomes, sectors at risk, fiscal drivers and wage-price entrenchment. The minister answered that inflation is mainly driven by a tighter Dutch economy and wage growth, that the government's role is budget discipline and structural spending restraint, and that most other questions are answered by pointing to existing policy or to social partners and the ECB.
Controlling inflation is the responsibility of the European Central Bank, which focuses on price stability in the eurozone as a whole.
Het beheersen van de inflatie is aan de Europese Centrale Bank, die zich richt op de prijsstabiliteit in de eurozone als geheel.
Antwoord op van het lid Grinwis over het artikel ‘‘Fuck de regels’: hoe spotgoedkope Chinese fatbikes Nederland worden binnengesmokkeld’

MP Grinwis asked the ministers of Infrastructure, Finance and Justice about reports that illegal Chinese fatbikes with throttles and excessive motors are smuggled into the Netherlands, how customs and the ILT control them, and what enforcement measures will follow, including on online sellers and the Ouxi V8 model. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that customs controls are risk-based without separate capacity or success figures for fatbikes, that the ILT and police can seize or fine non-compliant vehicles, and that a consumer awareness campaign is running.
It cannot be said how much capacity Customs deploys on fatbike controls.
Het is daardoor niet te zeggen hoeveel capaciteit de Douane inzet op de controles van fatbikes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Inge van Dijk, Grinwis en Maatoug over ‘het uiterst kritische Raad van State advies over het nieuwe box 3 stelsel’

MPs from D66, CDA, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked how the government views the Raad van State's critical advice on the new box 3 wealth tax system, including delay, budgetary shortfall, the Hoge Raad's view on the forfait, and wealth inequality. The Staatssecretaris answers that a one-year delay to 2028 is expected, a shortfall of about 2.4 billion euro in 2027 will be covered by raising the forfait on other assets and lowering the tax-free allowance, and that alternatives including a wealth tax are being studied, with a reply to the advice to follow.
In a further report on that advice the cabinet will provide a full response, and I cannot anticipate that now.
