In een nader rapport op dat advies komt het kabinet met een uitgebreide reactie, daarop kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Grinwis en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Kabinet krijgt tik op de vingers uit Brussel'

MPs Vijlbrief, Grinwis and Inge van Dijk asked Finance Minister Heinen how the cabinet will respond to a European Commission warning that debt and deficits rise beyond EU reference values over the longer term, and why it added 8 billion in spending despite low debt. The minister says the cabinet stays within EU reference values during its term apart from a one-off 2026 deficit overshoot, that further consolidation is for future cabinets, and gives no concrete additional cuts or measures.
The cabinet will not submit to the European Commission a different budgetary path than the frameworks set by the cabinet.
Het kabinet zal niet een ander budgettair pad aan de Europese Commissie voorleggen dan de door het kabinet vastgestelde kaders.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het antwoord op de feitelijke vragen van de vaste commissie voor OCW over de nota van wijziging inzake de vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Onderw

Hertzberger asked the Minister of Finance for the full calculation behind distributing the cross-government subsidy cut across departments, how subsidy budgets were defined and corrected, and how the coalition agreement cuts were taken into account. The Minister explained the allocation pro rata to subsidy budgets, excluding items already cut, items exempt under the coalition agreement, and compensation or Ukraine funds, reducing the base from about 14 to 3.9 billion euros for an effective cut of about 26%.
In the allocation the cabinet decided not to count subsidy budgets already cut under the coalition agreement in the base, because otherwise they would be cut twice.

Bij de verdeling heeft het kabinet besloten om de subsidiebudgetten waarop in het hoofdlijnenakkoord al wordt omgebogen niet mee te tellen in de grondslag omdat hier anders twee keer op wordt omgebogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Staat moet Holland Casino afstoten’

An MP asked whether the state should divest its stake in Holland Casino and whether online gambling legalisation should be reversed, citing rising addiction concerns. The government answered that the casino stake is under review, that the 2023 evaluation found state shareholding not strictly necessary but not to be ruled out, that talks with Holland Casino on the gambling tax increase are ongoing, and that a decision and update are expected around summer 2025.
I aim to inform you around summer 2025 about developments at Holland Casino.
Ik streef ernaar om u rond de zomer van 2025 te informeren over de ontwikkelingen bij Holland Casino.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de toekomst van de Volksbank

An MP asked the Finance Minister why privatisation options (private sale or IPO) are considered for the Volksbank rather than public or cooperative models, and whether public interests like branch access and a diverse banking sector are secured without state ownership. The minister answered that the NLFI advice favours sale or listing, that public interests can be safeguarded by sector-wide instruments, and that the reorganisation and job cuts are decisions of the bank's board, though he could not rule out branch reductions.
It is up to the bank's board to determine the commercial and operational strategy.
Het is aan het bestuur van de bank om de commerciële en operationele strategie te bepalen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘AI fraude neemt snel toe in de financiële sector’

MP Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about a report that AI-enabled fraud is rising fast in the financial sector, whether firms lack resources to tackle it, and whether biometric checks and eID could better protect clients. Minister Heinen agreed the trend is worrying, pointed to the MOB security working group and the Integrated approach to online fraud, said banks already use strong customer authentication and biometrics, and reported no signals that the sector lacks means or expertise.
So far I have received no signals that the financial sector in the Netherlands currently lacks the means and expertise to tackle this threat.
Ik heb tot nu toe geen signalen ontvangen dat de financiële sector in Nederland op dit moment niet over de middelen en expertise beschikt om deze bedreiging aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Michon–Derkzen over het bericht 'Drugscriminelen in hele land actief met hypotheekfraude'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that drug criminals are committing mortgage fraud nationwide, housing Bulgarian migrant workers. The government confirms police reports of roughly 8,000 affected homes, describes enforcement, information-sharing and planned reviews (including Belastingdienst income checks and Kamer van Koophandel measures), but declines to give municipalities a direct role in informing mortgage lenders.

The Minister of Justice and Security will, together with the State Secretary for Fiscal Affairs and the Tax Authority, further explore the effectiveness, efficiency and feasibility of this and then inform the House of the conclusion.

De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zal samen met de Staatssecretaris van Fiscaliteit & Belastingdienst de doeltreffendheid, doelmatigheid en uitvoerbaarheid hiervan nader verkennen en vervolgens uw Kamer informeren over de conclusie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen en Six Dijkstra over het artikel inzake het plegen van hypotheekfraude door drugscriminelen

MPs Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen and Six Dijkstra asked about reports that criminal networks, including drug criminals, commit large-scale mortgage fraud and whether police and prosecutors can detect and prosecute it. The government answered that the problem is recognised but not systematically registered, that data-sharing options with banks and the Tax Authority are being explored, and that police knowledge of new modus operandi will be shared with lenders.
Mortgage fraud is not registered separately by the police or the Public Prosecution Service, because it consists of the offences of forgery, fraud and/or money laundering.
Tot slot wordt hypotheekfraude niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd bij de politie of het OM, omdat hypotheekfraude bestaat uit de delicten valsheid in geschrifte, oplichting en/of witwassen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de ontkoppeling van ontwikkelingshulp

An MP asked whether the decision to decouple development aid from economic growth was discussed with coalition parties, and about a past statement by an NSC financial spokesperson denying it was discussed with his faction. The minister answers that the cabinet chose not to adjust the ODA budget to the new BNI forecast, reporting the decision was communicated via the budget documents and a letter, and declines to pre-empt the spring 2025 review.
The cabinet chose not to update the ODA budget in the budget for the new GNI forecast in the CPB's Macro-Economic Outlook, in light of the overall government-wide problems.

Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om in de begroting het ODA-budget niet te actualiseren voor de nieuwe BNI-raming in de Macro-Economische Verkenning (MEV) van het CPB, in het licht van de totale Rijksbrede problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Vijlbrief over de Meerjarige Productie Prognose 2024-II

MPs Podt and Vijlbrief asked the Minister of Finance whether he knew of the MPP 2024-II forecast for Asylum and Migration, why the budget cuts for COA and IND were approved despite gaps with the forecast, and how he responded to the Court of Audit's concerns. The minister confirmed knowledge of the forecast, said the 2024-I version was known when the budget was set, pointed to the coalition agreement's planned asylum spending cuts, and promised to address budget adjustments in Voorjaarsnota 2025 using MPP 2024-2 data.
As usual, the cabinet will inform your House in the Voorjaarsnota 2025 about any budgetary adjustments to the Asylum and Migration budget.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal het kabinet uw Kamer bij Voorjaarsnota 2025 informeren over eventuele budgettaire bijstellingen voor de begroting van Asiel en Migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het stopzetten van leningen aan bedrijven die zich alleen richten op het oppompen van olie en gas en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe velden

MP Vermeer asked the government whether ING's halt on new loans to pure-play oil and gas exploration companies is allowed, what its economic and financial effects would be, and whether other banks follow. Minister Heinen answered that ING's decision is its own commercial choice, that effects on the Dutch economy are expected to be very limited, that the bank's counterparties are confidential, and that gas remains needed during the transition.
Which parties financial institutions enter into financing relationships with is commercially confidential information.
Met welke partijen financiële instellingen financieringsrelaties aangaan, is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Aukje de vries en Erkens over de financiering van kernenergieprojecten

MPs Aukje de Vries and Erkens asked about international banks' pledge to support nuclear energy, how the government will engage banks and COP29 for financing new Dutch nuclear plants, and how to keep gas extraction in the North Sea financed. Minister Hermans answered that a market consultation is ongoing with results to follow, that the government will engage the financial sector including via the climate commitment, and that the sector must make its own financing decisions while a sector agreement on North Sea investment is being prepared.
Within a few weeks the cabinet will inform the House about the results of the market consultation, a cabinet appraisal of them and the follow-up process.
Binnen een aantal weken zal het kabinet de Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de marktconsultatie, een kabinetsappreciatie daarvan en het vervolgproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over private equity in de accountancy

The SP MP Dijk asks the Finance Minister whether private equity ownership of accountancy firms threatens audit quality, independence, and access for small firms and clients, citing expert and AFM concerns. The minister acknowledges the risks and says he is monitoring developments, points to existing Wta independence safeguards and the pending Wijzigingswet accountancysector, but sees no current need for further statutory measures and no signals of harm to small clients.
That is why I am closely monitoring developments regarding private equity in the accountancy sector.
Daarom houd ik de ontwikkelingen van private equity in de accountancysector goed in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Maatoug over de inrichting van nieuwe ministeries

MPs Sneller and Maatoug asked the Finance Minister about the organisation of three newly created ministries, including whether shared secretaries-general and FEZ directors comply with rules, the duration, costs, and the ministries' contribution to the staffing cut. The government answered that the arrangement is temporary until 1 January 2025, that minimal changes apply with a dedicated SG and FEZ director per ministry, and that costs are modest and not yet quantified in full, with no formal consultation with the Algemene Rekenkamer.

The Court of Audit notes in its letter on the draft budgets that sound budget management, financial management and operations cannot exist without a well-organised financial function at the ministries.

De Algemene Rekenkamer benoemt in de brief bij de ontwerpbegrotingen dat goed begrotingsbeheer, financieel beheer en bedrijfsvoering niet kan zonder goed ingerichte financiële functie bij de ministeries.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Peter de Groot en Van Eijk (allen VVD) over het artikel 'Enorme ozb-verhoging Amsterdam ’Middenklasse maximaal uitgekleed”

VVD MPs asked the government about a steep property tax (OZB) increase proposed by Amsterdam, its effect on household costs, parking charges and erfpacht, and whether the government would engage Amsterdam to cap OZB rises. The minister declined to comment on Amsterdam's local tax decision as a matter for the municipal council, provided cost data, and committed to talks with municipalities on capping OZB increases.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, service levels and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het einde van het gunstig belastingregime voor private equity in Engeland

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the UK's proposed end to favourable tax treatment of carried interest for private equity and whether the Dutch carried-interest regime, including the partial foreign tax liability option, is fair. The state secretary said the UK is consulting on reform, that the Dutch regime has provided clarity since 2009, that a review of the lucrative-interest scheme is underway with results promised before the Christmas recess, and that the partial foreign tax liability option is being abolished from 2025.
The intention is to share the results of this review with your House before the Christmas recess.
Het voornemen is de resultaten van dit onderzoek vóór het kerstreces met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht China verlaagt rente en plant extra stimulus voor economie

Rep. Van der Lee asks the Finance Minister about China's interest rate cut, deflation risks, its rising public debt, and the implications for Europe and the Netherlands. The minister answers that the cut aims to support the Chinese economy, that IMF projections show rising Chinese debt, and that the effects on Europe and the Netherlands are limited and mainly trade-related.
However, it is not for the cabinet to speculate about hypothetical developments and the associated geopolitical implications.
Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om te speculeren over hypothetische ontwikkelingen en bijbehorende geopolitieke implicaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oostenbruggen en Vermeer over de onderzoekscommissie naar de kwaliteit van de ramingen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister to confirm and explain the expert group on forecast quality, including its independence, membership, mandate, timeline and comparisons with other countries. The minister confirmed the group, said it is led by an independent chair with CPB, DNB and CBS involved, declined foreign members and internal-only staffing, and promised a report by 1 April 2025.
I will inform you about this in the letter sent at the same time as this reply.
Ik informeer u hierover via de gelijktijdig met deze beantwoording verzonden brief.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Baudet over het tabaksaccijnsbeleid

An MP asked the Finance Minister about falling tobacco sales, cross-border purchases and smuggling, and whether excise increases should be reversed. The state secretary said the industry-funded sales monitor cannot be verified, cross-border buying is rising, further monitoring is underway, and the government has no plans to change the tobacco excise.
The cabinet does not intend to raise or lower the tobacco excise.
Het kabinet is niet van plan om de tabaksaccijns te verhogen dan wel te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Bijna driekwart van de notarissen maakt nevenfuncties niet openbaar: na fraudeschandaal is weinig verbeterd’

An MP asked about reports that most notaries fail to disclose their side jobs (nevenfuncties) and whether oversight has improved since the 2021 fraud scandal. The Secretary of State answered that no figures exist, that non-compliance mostly involves forgotten or unrecognized private holding companies, that BFT and KNB will raise awareness, and that the BFT's oversight and evaluation are its own responsibility.
The BFT and the KNB will continue to draw the notaries' attention to the importance of correctly registering side activities.
Het BFT en de KNB zullen verder aandacht bij de notarissen blijven vragen voor het belang van correcte registratie van de nevenactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de sluiting van online geldvraagbaak Kandoor

An MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about the closure of the online financial help service Kandoor just before the pension transition, and whether pension funds are prepared for the resulting flood of questions. The minister answered that pension providers are responsible for informing members, that existing government information channels exist, that he has confidence in the sector's preparedness, and that he will examine with the sector whether Kandoor's functions could be added to the communication approach.
I cannot give insight into the annual costs, as this concerns business-confidential information of Kandoor.
Inzicht in de jaarlijkse kosten kan ik u niet geven, dit betreft namelijk bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie van Kandoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de kosten van betaalrekeningen en rente op spaarrekeningen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about rising bank account fees and low savings interest rates, and whether banks are justified in raising prices. The minister replied that fees are set by banks through market competition, that deposit rates lag policy rates, and that he will address switching barriers and transparency in the savings market with banks and in the MOB.
I am committed to lowering switching barriers for consumers and making the savings market more transparent and accessible.
Ik zet mij in om de overstapdrempels voor consumenten te verlagen en de spaarmarkt transparanter en toegankelijker te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk en Joseph over de berichten ‘ACM-beschuldiging van stilzwijgende kartel zit bank hoog’ en ‘Protestacties lijken ING niet te raken’

Two MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about ACM findings on tacit collusion and weak competition in the Dutch savings market, including bank share buybacks, savings rates, account fees, cybersecurity costs, liquidity and credit to SMEs. The minister largely accepts the ACM diagnosis, announces studies on unbundling and fee issues, and defers many questions to banks and DNB, declining to act directly on buybacks.
I will commission research into the impact of an obligation for banks to offer a standalone full savings account to customers who have no current account with them.
Ik ga onder meer onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van een verplichting voor banken om een zelfstandige volwaardige spaarrekening aan te bieden aan klanten die bij hen geen betaalrekening hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Oostenbruggen over de altijd weer enorme meevallers op de rijksbegroting

An MP asks the Finance Minister why budget deficit forecasts for 2022-2024 were repeatedly far above outcomes and whether forecasts are realistic, and asks for current deficit projections. The minister answers that forecasts aim to be realistic, attributes the windfalls to incidental factors, underspending and corporate tax surprises, and points to the Miljoenennota 2025 for updated figures.
The starting point for the forecasts of the budget balance is realistic forecasting, meaning the forecasts are the best possible estimate of expenditure and revenue.
Het uitgangspunt voor de ramingen van het begrotingssaldo is realistisch ramen, wat betekent dat de ramingen een zo goed mogelĳke inschatting zĳn van de uitgaven en inkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee en Koekkoek over de exportkredietverzekering voor het LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee and Koekkoek asked the ministers about the export credit insurance for Total's LNG project in Mozambique, including the re-assessment process, independence of security information, Total's role, the Palma attacks, and compliance with the Thijssen motion. Minister Heinen answered that the re-assessment is not finished, that all Proximities report recommendations were implemented, that the government will not postpone the decision as the motion asked, and that delayed Woo requests led to penalty payments.
As long as the assessment process is ongoing, I cannot make statements about its content in order to ensure a careful process.
Zolang het beoordelingsproces loopt, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de inhoud daarvan om zo een zorgvuldig proces te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de uitspraken van staatssecretaris Jansen over de limiet voor contante betalingen

An MP from CDA asked the Finance Minister whether the government stands by its proposed 3,000-euro cash payment limit after State Secretary Jansen was quoted saying a stricter limit misses its goal and that a 10,000-euro limit is reasonable for businesses. The Minister answered that the 3,000-euro limit balances money-laundering risks, access to payments and business burdens, that the cabinet position is unchanged, and that the State Secretary's remarks fall outside his portfolio.
The cabinet position is unchanged: a limit on cash payments for goods from 3,000 euros is an effective way to address money-laundering risks
Het kabinetsstandpunt is onveranderd: een limiet op contante betalingen van goederen vanaf 3.000 euro is een effectieve manier om witwasrisico's aan te pakken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de aankondiging van Holland Casino om over te gaan tot ‘agressieve gokcampagnes’ om meer gokkers te werven

An MP asked the government whether Holland Casino's announcement of aggressive gambling campaigns to attract more gamblers, despite its state ownership and the advertising ban, was acceptable and what it would do about it. The state secretary replied that Holland Casino has no plans to significantly increase marketing spend, that aggressive campaigns are unacceptable to it, and that as shareholder the state expects compliance with rules and an exemplary role.
It is therefore not the intention of Holland Casino, and never has been, to attract more customers through aggressive marketing campaigns.
Het is dus niet de bedoeling van Holland Casino, en ook nooit geweest, om met agressieve marketingcampagnes meer klanten te werven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht “Overzicht eerste half jaar 2024” op www.hypotheekshop.nl

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about inconsistent treatment of student debt in mortgage capacity calculations after new DUO debt rules, and whether they would adopt clearer rules. The minister acknowledged the signals, said the 2025 amendment regulation will clarify how lenders calculate student loan payments (including temporary reductions), and that consultation responses will be considered.
I intend to include this point in the annual amendment regulation on mortgage credit.
Ik ben voornemens dit punt mee te nemen in de jaarlijkse wijzigingsregeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht ‘Een hypotheek voor een tiny house, Esther kreeg het voor elkaar: ‘Ik kan het nog steeds bijna niet geloven’’

CDA MPs asked the housing and finance ministers about difficulties obtaining mortgages for tiny houses and flexible homes and the resulting inequality. The minister said the government will study mortgage rules for movable homes with the Ministry of Finance, NHG and the market, and will discuss with the NVB, but defended current lender risk-based conditions and gave no data on tiny house mortgages.
There are no figures available on the owner-occupied sector.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de koopsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Zeedijk over de trend dat Nederlandse banken stoppen met de ondersteuning van contactloos betalen via eigen apps

MPs Six Dijkstra and Zeedijk asked the government about banks such as ING and the Volksbank dropping their own contactless payment apps in favour of Google Pay, and the consequences for privacy, digital sovereignty, and consumer choice. The Minister of Finance answered that banks set their own policy, that supervision of privacy falls under the AVG and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, that the DMA obliges Apple and Google to allow alternative payment apps, and that no general open contactless payment protocol is needed for now.
Banks conduct their own policy and decide for themselves whether they offer contactless payment via their own app or in another way.
Banken voeren hun eigen beleid en bepalen zelf of zij contactloos betalen aanbieden via een eigen app of op een andere manier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over inflatie

MPs Maatoug and Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about inflation governance, the role of DNB and the government in price stability, measures against supply shocks, CBS measurement, and whether profits drove inflation. The minister answered that the ECB is primarily responsible for price stability while fiscal policy and social partners also matter, outlined energy-crisis support measures, and said that profit-driven inflation needs further research, with a promised discussion in the upcoming Miljoenennota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Vijlbrief over het bericht ‘Influencers zamelen via Nederland geld in voor uitrusting Russische militairen’

Two D66 MPs asked whether crowdfunding via Dutch platform Boosty for equipping Russian soldiers constitutes sanctions evasion, about the corporate ownership chain, and what the government will do to deter sanctions evasion via the Netherlands. Minister Veldkamp replied that the government cannot comment on individual cases, that sanctions enforcement is for courts, supervisors or the prosecutor, and that the government raises signals with authorities and works through existing coordination platforms, without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet cannot publicly comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over cryptotoezicht door AFM

MPs Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about the AFM's crypto supervision budget, which the ministry reportedly limited to a 'minimal' scenario despite risks to young investors. The minister defends the chosen capacity (about €7 million) as sufficient for risk-based supervision, promises a review at the end of 2025, and notes the AFM can draw on contingency funds if needed.
With this [allocated] capacity the AFM can supervise well, in a risk-based manner
Met deze [toegekende] capaciteit kan de AFM goed toezicht houden, op een risicogestuurde manier
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Topman Franse centrale bank slaat alarm: 'Zeer negatieve schok''

An MP asked the Finance Minister how Dutch government should respond to the French central bank chief's warning of a very negative shock from high French deficits and debt, and how the EU fiscal rules will enforce consolidation. The minister shared concern, pointed to the revised EU fiscal rules and enforcement mechanisms, and outlined the Dutch budget path while noting the two countries' finances are not directly comparable.
The cabinet will work for a sound implementation of the revised European budget rules.
Het kabinet zal zich inzetten voor een gedegen implementatie van de herziene Europese begrotingsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Sneller over het betrekken van deTweede Kamer bij de budgettaire besluitvorming

D66 MPs Vijlbrief and Sneller asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the role of the Prime Minister, the cabinet's budget decision-making and how parliament would be involved before Prinsjesdag 2024. The government answered that decisions are taken collectively in the Council of Ministers, promised talks with parliament's financial spokespeople and the Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen, and said the budget would be presented on Prinsjesdag, but gave limited concrete detail on timing and content.
The deliberations of the Council of Ministers are therefore secret.
De beraadslagingen van de ministerraad zijn derhalve geheim.
